text:
Currently, the last / bottom picture shows two different lids. The “straw lid”, on the left, is NOT included with this water bottle. The water bottle for this listing includes a screw on/off Only.

The title of this listing shows “easy sip lid”. I’m not sure what they mean I that because you cannot really “sip” from this lid. The lid does not have a hole in it. You have to remove the lid to drink from it. When you do that, obviously, it’s a very large opening.

This lid has what they are calling a “carabiner clip cap”. But the carabiner is not included and you will have to provide that yourself if you wish to use one. But the lid does have a spring activated latch on the side so that you can attach it easily to a backpack. As long as you have a loop to attach it to, a carabiner is not really required.

This water bottle stands 10.75 inches tall including the. It measures just over 2.75 inches across on the bottom. This is a made in China water bottle which is stainless steel with a painted coating. Because of the painted coating, this is a hand wash item only. A bottle brush makes this very easy to clean properly. But a bottle brush is not included and must be purchased separately if you do not already have one.

title: Very lightweight. Lots of storage. Made in Vietnam.
text:
This day backpack has a weight of approximately 1 lb. 5 oz. It is a very versatile backpack. Great not only for hiking, but also for students… Taking to the office… Running around town… And so on.

One thing that might take some getting used to is what they call “Mesh-covered die-cut foam back panel”. It is ribbed firm foam which is mesh covered. It is rather stiff and not as soft as more traditional phone. The shoulder straps have a little padding but not a lot. But it certainly makes this backpack more “airy” so there is good ventilation so your back doesn’t sweat.

There are two expandable mesh pockets on each side for water bottles. There’s pockets both on the outside and the inside. Lots of great storage space.

This is the “plus” version of this backpack. It also comes in a “regular” version, but there is not as much storage space and the cost difference is currently only 10 bucks. I prefer this 1 for the extra space.

Made in Vietnam.

title: Kind of pricey, but a very cool ball at night.  Made in China.
text:
If you look at the 4th and 5th pictures. . . as well as the video. . . you will see that this stripes are what illuminate. Not the entire ball. But this company offers an orange ball which does completely light-up, under a different listing.

This is a "light-up" ball, and not a "glow-in-the-dark" ball. The difference being that this one has lights inside and operates with batteries. A "glow-in-the-dark" ball is one where you place it in bright like for a bit. . .then it will "glow" for a few minutes. Because this is a "light-up" ball, the lights are brighter and will last longer. Also, there are additional batteries included, which is a plus.

There's not an "on/off" button. You simply bounce the ball and it will turn-on and illuminate. The lights will "turn-off" after a minute of not "agitation" / bounce.

This ball is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. At the current price of forty bucks, I think it's a bit pricey. . . and it is more of a "toy". if you're looking for a "professional" basketball. . . this is not it. But it is a VERY cool ball to play with in the dark!

title: Lots of nice features.  Made in Vietnam.
text:
As with all Osprey packs, this one is engineered extremely well. It’s sturdy, and it’s full of features. To begin with, the waist strap is setup completely like any backpacking pack, with the same types of clasp and adjusters. In other words, an extremely well-built pack. The zips and other fasteners are just the same as backpacking packs as well. There are four separate compartments, and two holders, one on each side, for water bottles. There are adjusters on each side that will allow the pack to be “snugged up” so it will be secure and stable. The water bottle holders have elastic straps that hold the water bottles secure at the top so they won’t fall out. The back of the pack is vented where it rests against your back. There is also a reflective loop at the lower back of the pack where a light can attach. This is a great pack that I’ll probably use for day hiking as much as mountain biking.

Made in Vietnam.

title: Tilt to drink. Leakproof. Made in China.
text:
This listing is for different bottles. I have the 32 ounce Contigo AUTOSEAL Water Bottle. This is a “tilt and drink” type water bottle. It stands 11 inches tall and the base is 3 ½ inches across. Because it is stainless steel, and not painted and powder coated on the outside… Like some of the other bottles in this listing… It is dishwasher safe. If you wish to wash it by hand, you will need a bottle brush, which is not included and is sold separately. You may also wish to purchase a straw brush or other type of small brush to clean all of the nooks and crannies of the top of the lid as well. Because such a brush is also not included.

There is a fliptop on the lid that snaps into place. Then there is a button on the back you must press to drink from this water bottle. Nothing will come out unless you press the button on the back. So it is leakproof. There is also a small latch you can move to the left which will lock the button. There is a handle on the top for carrying.

You can also use this tumbler for hot beverages, but if you do so, you need to press the button on the back away from your face to release any hot vapor.

This tumbler is made in China. At the current price of 24 bucks it is considerably higher in cost than many other Chinese made tumblers, but it has a very good design and works really well.

FYI this same company offers the same tumbler but with a lid that has a straw. So if you prefer that style as opposed to having to tilt the tumbler to drink, you will find it under a separate listing.

title: Super lightweight. Comfortable to hold. Tightly strung.  Made in China.
text:
These badminton rackets have a weight of just over 3 ounces each. Incredibly lightweight. The entire kit with case, rackets, and shuttlecock’s weigh only 1 pound.

The handles are long and comfortable. Easy to grasp. Strong very tight. Incredibly nice to use. The case is nice too. Though it would’ve been nice if there were a couple of pockets, but there are not.

This set is made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. At the current price of 66 bucks I think it’s a little expensive, but these are really nice rackets. Much better than the ones I used in my younger years.

title: Very lightweight. Made in Vietnam. Padded strap.
text:
This sling backpack has a weight of 9 ounces. So it is quite light. It has a nice padded strap, and the back of the backpack also has some padding. The zippers are very easy to operate. I like that they have a pull tab. It measures approximately 14” x 9” and went back is about 3-4 inches thick, all depending upon what you place inside.

On the front outside you’ll find a fairly large apartment. The main compartment offers a woven zipper pouch along with an open pouch.

Though the listing shows that this bag is designed to be worn over the right shoulder… The information included with the bags shows it can be worn over either the left or the right shoulder.

Made in Vietnam.

title: Super light.  Great for a short trip.
text:
This pack weighs 2.8 ounces. It could be even lighter, but there is a thin padding in the pack in the area next to the body. The pack comes stuffed in it’s own attached stuff sack that measures approximately 4 inches by 3 inches by 1.5 inches thick. The stuff sack actually becomes a security pocket inside the pack when unfolded. This pack has three pockets. A medium size outside pocket, a larger middle pocket, and the aforementioned security pocket. It has a 1 inch adjustable strap with a single plastic buckle. This will be a great pack to use when backpacking and going out for short explorations after setting up camp. Very nice pack.

If you're looking for something a little larger. . . and that also holds a water bottle. . . You might check-out the Osprey Savu 5 Lumbar Bike Hydration Pack

title: Not "pro" quality, but OK overall.  Made in China.
text:
This disc golf basket is fairly easy to assemble. It does not come with a bag, but it’s easy enough to toss into a truck, if you’re going to be traveling with it. It’s not super sturdy. Certainly not “professional grade”, but it works. It would be nice if there were more chains, and if the chains were sturdier.

This item is Made in China. At the current price of almost one-hundred-fifty bucks, I think it’s crazy expensive for what it is. But when you look around, the price is not too far out of the ballpark as compared to others.

title: Not that bright.  Made in China.
text:
If you look at the top picture. . . These look really bright. But in reality, they are not all that bright. There is one tiny little light inside. The video shows them a little better.

I have the ones which are listed as “nylon”. . . but they are plastic. . .and I guess they are supposed to look like nylon.

There are no instructions given. . . But. . .There is a tiny black on/off switch on the inside center of the shuttlecock.

These shuttlecocks are Made in China.

title: A "fun" light-up ball.  Eight batteries included.  Made in China.
text:
This is a fun “playtime” ball. Though the listing shows that the exterior is “rubber”, it looks / feels more like silicone to me. Also, it’s a “light-up” ball, and not a “glow-in-the-dark” ball. “Glow-in-the-dark” would mean that you place it in bright light for a bit. . . then it will glow in the dark. But this ball lights-up due to LED lights and batteries.

There is a LED light on each side. Batteries are already inside. Six additional batteries are included (so a total of eight batteries). They are LR44 batteries.

The lights come-on when you bounce the ball. If you do not bounce the ball for one minute, they turn off. There’s not “on/off button”.

A manual air pump is included. If you’re looking for the needle for the pump. . . it’s in the handle of the pump.

If you’re looking for a “real” basketball. . . You can find “composite” balls for the same price of less than this one. But if you’re looking for a “fun” / entertaining type of ball that you can use to play outside at night. . . then this one might be it.

The ball comes deflated in a nice cardboard box. Easy to wrap, if you're giving as a gift.

This ball is Made in China. At the current price of just over twenty-five bucks, I think it’s a bit pricey for what it is. . . But again. . .It’s “fun”.

title: Not super large.  No dance parties.  Way overpriced.
text:
The listing shows that this tent can be used for breakdance parties. That's, of course, a farce. It's far to small to stand-up in... much less dance.

The listing shows that this is also a four-person tent.. That too is not really the case. . . Unless you want to sleep side-by-side. . and sideways. You would be able to easily fit two adults. . . and perhaps at least one small child.

This tent is made in China. At the current cost of over two-hundred-fifty bucks. . . It's crazy expensive. I like it, but it really should be more reasonably priced.

title: Crazy Expensive, but nice overall.
text: This mat is very easy to inflate / deflate.  It's fairly comfortable, for a mat like this.  Nice not only for camping, but also when you need an air mattress in a pinch at home.  It's made in China, so I think the current price one-hundred-eighty bucks is crazy expensive.  There are certainly a lot lower-priced options available.  But this one is nice overall.

title: Something different from just standing on a flat floor.
text: This active board weighs 6.5 lbs, and measures 21” wide, by 14” deep, by approximately 2” thick at it’s thickest point. It appears to be well made, having a stained, smooth plywood core. The top is a fairly firm “anti-fatigue” surface, in that itit is covered in raised dots that are about 3/8” in diameter. I usually wear shoes when I’m working at my standing desk, so they really don’t come into play for me, but if you like going sock or bare footed, they would be pretty comfortable. The top surface itself is pretty much straight and level, not concave or convex. The bottom of the board is a curved, textured thin vinyl-ish material that would protect floors and keep from slipping. There is about an 1 1/4” hole on one end of the board at the bottom, intended, I’m sure, for carrying, although there is no mention of it in the one-page slick that comes with the board. When working standing up, I found the board to be pretty stable when standing, with no perceived effort to keep balance. Honestly, I don’t know if it would burn more calories than standing without it, but I can say that it was a nice platform to stand on.

title: Nice "set".  Cool look.  Made in China.  Nice packaging.
text:
These paddles look so cool! Lightweight. They feel good in the hand, though the handle is about a half-inch shorter than I would prefer. . . but they still work. Four balls are included. The balls are nice-and-hard. The seam is pretty smooth. Two “cooling towels” include. Carrying case is also included. Honestly. . . .With the paddles looking so cool. . .The carrying case is a bit boring and 70’s looking. Hahahahaha But I can work with that.

These paddles are Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. There are a ton of these paddles being offered on Amazon by Chinese companies right now, but with the “coupon” that’s currently being offered, they are some of the more reasonably price ones.

title: Looks just like the pictures.  Made in China.  Cool ball.
text:
This ball is exactly as it shows in the pictures. Nice, bright colors. It comes deflated. Nice feel. It’s made of “composite leather”.

Composite leather is a synthetically produced material that feels like leather. Synthetic basketballs can be used on both indoor and outdoor surfaces. Unlike leather, synthetic leather does not need prolonged usage for the material to break in. Such basketballs give better control and grip.

This basketball is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. It’s a bit pricey, but it’s a very good looking ball, and I quite like it.

title: Crazy expensive for Made in China plastic. . . but. . . overall . . .they are fine.
text:
These balls have a nice bright color. They come in a mesh bag with drawstring. They seams are fairly smooth. So far they have worked just fine, without breaking / cracking / falling apart.

These balls are Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. At the current price of almost two bucks for Made in China plastic. . . they are crazy expensive. Nonetheless. . . Overall. .. They are fine

title: Made in the USA!  Nice design.  Lightweight.  Insulated.
text:
I have the “moss zipper” design. I really like the design. Looks cool and is not childish.

This insulated bottle stands just shy of 7”. The bottom is just shy of 3” across. It’s quite lightweight as well. I really like that it’s insulate, but doesn’t have the weight of stainless steel. Easy to unscrew the lid. Top pulls open and pushes closed. Ring for carrying or attaching to a backpack. Really great that it’s dishwasher safe as well.

LOVE that it’s Made in the USA! There are a ton of cheap (though not inexpensive) made in China water bottles which are being sold on Amazon by Chinese companies. This one is certainly the best.

title: Nice set.  Made in China.
text:
These paddles have a weight of 7.23oz. Lightweight, but fairly durable. The handles are slightly short for my hand, but still usable. Grips are wrapped well.

Four balls, two wristbands and case. The case has a mesh pouch on the outside. Some padding in the case as well. Adjustable carrying strap and handle on top.

This set is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. There are hundreds. . . if not thousands . . . of these same paddles, with different designs, being sold on Amazon by Chinese companies right now. Though they are all crazy expensive for Made in China paddles. . .This is one of the cheaper priced sets.

title: Made in the USA.  Dishwasher safe.  Insulated.
text:
Polar bottles are Made in the USA, which I really like. There are thousands of made in China bottles being sold by Chinese companies on Amazon . .. so it’s really nice to find something that’s Made in the USA>

This water bottle stands 6.5” tall. It’s 3” across at the base. It has a simple screw on/off top with a pull up / push down cap. Though I don’t show it on the bottle itself. . . The listing shows that it’s dishwasher safe.

Unlike stainless steel insulated tumblers. . . This one is both insulated and lightweight. There’s a ring for carrying. You could also attach it to a backpack, but would have to provide a carabiner on-your-own.=

title: Made in China.  This one is crazy expensive.  Nice to have around.
text:
This collapsible stool measures 10” across and is 2.5” tall when collapsed. It has a weight of 2# 4oz. When fully extended, it’s just shy of 17.5”. You can adjust it to different heights, but to be honest, that’s easier said than done. Fortunately, I’m usually using it fully-extended. There are no instructions included, so make sure you read the information and view the pictures online.

There are hundreds, if not thousands, of this same item being sold by Chinese companies on Amazon. For cheap molded Made in China plastic. . . this is one of the more expensive ones at the current price of forty bucks. So make sure you look around before purchasing. Some even include built-in power stations.

They are a handy item to have. They are a bit bulky if you’re going to be walking around with them. . . but. .. for a stepstool at home. . .or to have in your car. . .it’s nice to have.

title: No wheels, but easy enough to move.  Made in China
text:
I have the “L Screen”. It’s easily assembled. It does not have wheels, but it’s not that heavy, so easily moved with two people. 7’ X 7’ at the highest points.

Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. At ninety-six bucks, I think it’s about twice the price it should be. . . but. . overall it works.

title: Great look.  25.5"  Made in Vietnam.
text:
This is a 25.5” volleyball. It comes deflated. The colors are fantastic. I think of it as “multi-colored melon”.

This ball is made of “Composite Leather”, which is “fake leather”.

Synthetic or composite leather is an artificial type of material that feels like leather but is cheaper to produce. The materials are also more versatile and can be used both indoors and outdoors. Synthetic leather doesn't need to be broken in as it already has that softer feeling to it.

It has a nice soft feel to it. So far, it is holding air without a problem.

This ball is Made in Vietnam, though CHANCE Athletics is a U.S. company. At the current price of nineteen bucks, it’s a little pricey, but overall it’s a nice ball, and I really like it.

title: Plastic-Coated.  Made in China.  Can be used for more than just a key ring.
text:
These wire “key rings” are plastic-coated. The listing shows “nylon covered”, but it feels and looks like plastic to me. If you place your mouse over the bottom picture, and move around the ring, I think you can see it best. No matter what the coating. . . I’m glad that there is indeed a coating.

Though these are called “key rings” they can be used for a number of different things. They are easy to connect. If you need something longer, you can simply connect more than one together.

These items are Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon.

title: Made in China.  Batteries Included.  One tone - three volume levels.
text:
Though the listing shows “three tones”. . . It’s actually one tone and three volume levels.

This electronic whistle requires four button batteries, which are (thankfully) included.

It’s a simple press button operation. Fits easily in your pocket. Also comes with a lanyard. Great option, especially due to the current COVID-19 conditions.

This electronic whistle is Made in China. At the current price of sixteen bucks, I think it’s a bit overpriced. But it includes the batteries, which other options do not.

title: 3 AAA Batteries Not Included.  Made in China.
text:
This is a very cool electronic whistle. It has three tones (though two are quite similar) and three levels of volume.

Three AAA batteries are required, and not included. . . though they should have been.

Easy to use. Great for coaches. . . especially during the current COVID-19 environment. Fits in your pocket. Lanyard included.

This electronic whistle is Made in China. At the current cost of sixteen bucks I think it’s about ten bucks too expensive. . . but. . I really like it.

title: Pricey for Made in China.  Dishwasher Safe.  Tall.
text:
This is a tall water bottle. Standing at 12”. The base is just shy of 3” across. The bottle is translucent. There are indentations, closer to the top, to make it easier to hold, without slipping.

This water bottle has a locking flip-top lid. There’s a silicone strip around the lid to make it easier to open. Though a straw is not included; you could use one, if it’s really long (sold separately). The symbol on the bottom shows that this water bottle is dishwasher safe.

This water bottle is Made in China. At the current price of sixteen bucks. . . It’s about twice the price it should be. Nonetheless, it’s a nice water bottle overall.

title: Crazy expensive.  Not for kids.  Made in China.
text:
These are NOT for little kids. . . As it shows in one of the pictures. These are heavy and dangerous. If you get hit by one of these. . . You might be on a trip to the hospital. They are one pound in weight. They are kind of squishy. If you shake them, you’ll feel the inside shake around.

Because they are “squishy”, you can use them to squeeze and build hand / finger strength.

These balls are Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. At the current price of thirty-six bucks. . . I think they are crazy expensive. Twelve bucks would be more appropriate.

title: Pricey. Made in Vietnam.  Soft outside / Fuzzy inside.
text:
These basic fleece shorts are made of 76% polyester and 24% cotton. They are soft on the outside. Fuzzy on the inside.

I have the size Small. They measure 17.5” from the top to the bottom. The inseam measures 7”. 11” leg opening. The waist measures 29” before any stretch. Thick 1.75” elastic waistband. Inside drawstring. Medium depth “slice” side pockets. No back pocket. No fly.

These shorts are Made in Vietnam. At the current price of thirty-five bucks, they are at least twenty bucks too high. . . but. . .you’re paying for the Speedo name. Overall I quite like them.

title: Easy to assemble.  Made in China.  Nice color.
text:
The instructions were fine, and assembly was quick-and-easy. This balance / beginner bike has an adjustable seat. Supports kids up to 66 pounds. Lightweight, and relatively small. Easy to toss into a car so you can ride it at the park.

This balance bike is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. At the current price of sixty bucks. . . I think it’s quite expensive for what it is. Twenty-five to thirty would be more appropriate, but overall it’s fine.

title: Nice "starter" set.  Colors may vary.  Made in China.
text:
Note that the colors may vary. For example. . . The rackets I received. . . one is black and one is red. The case I received has white lettering / logo.

For the price, the rackets are nice and well-strung. It’s really nice that the shuttlecocks are actually goose feather, and not plastic. The carrying back is “basic”, but it works just fine.

This badminton set is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. If you’re looking to get started in the sport. . . and not spend a fortune doing it. . . This is a nice set.

title: Leather.  Made in China.  Hard.  Nice stitching.
text:
These pads come with a heavy cardboard backing, which is really nice, so the pads do not bend.

The paper is relatively thick with “canvas texture”. Nice for kids and/or when you’re looking to experiment a little without having to spend a fortune.

These pads are Made in China

title: Lightweight.  Nice look.  Made in China.
text:
For a set of mid-grade, lightweight paddles with case. . . These are nice. With a weight of 7.8oz; they are quite lightweight. The grip is adequate and easy to hold. I wish the handle were slightly longer, but it still works for me.

Four balls (two indoor and two outdoor) are included. Basic case is also included which has a mesh pocket on the front. . . Handle at the top. . . and also a strap.

This set is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. Chinese companies have flooded Amazon with such paddles. Though I like them. . . At fifty bucks. . . I think they are quite expensive for what they are. Twenty-five would be more reasonable.

title: Pricey but nice.  Good arch support / padding.  Made in China.
text:
These shoes are very lightweight. Only 3.24oz per-shoe. The reason for that is that the sole is made of plastic. Not too slick on the bottom.

The upper is mesh. The footbed has very nice padding with very nice arch support. Arch support is usually lacking in such shoes, but not these. There’s also nice padding around the ankle and heel.

Velcro closure. Laces are elastic, and more-or-less for show.

These shoes are Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. At the current starting price of twenty bucks. . . I think they are over twice the price they should be. Nonetheless, I quite like them.

title: Fake Leather.  Made in China.  Very colorful.  Soft.
text:
I have the Remix - Pink/Blue/White design. Super bright pink.

The listing shows that it’s leather. . . but it’s not. It’s “pleather”. So it’s fake leather. But it is quite soft and flexible.

The one thing I wish this glove had is a Velcro wristband to make it fit a little better.

Made in China.

title: Nice surface.  Large size.
text:
This same company offers a “slam ball”, which is similar, but has a different no-seam exterior. Some may prefer one style over the other. As for use, I use them interchangeably. If you’re interested in the “other one”, you will find it by doing a search for B0876J4C9B

This medicine ball has a textured surface, but it’s not too “rough”. The exterior is made of polyurethane. It feels quite durable. So far, I haven’t had any issues with “weight shifting”, but I haven’t used it a ton to have such issues. I tend to have more issues with that the longer I use such a medicine ball.

title: Incredible texture.
text: This medicine ball has an incredible exterior.  It’s like tread on sneakers.  Some might prefer to use gloves, due to how hard / rough it is.  But it certainly feels ultra-durable. I really like it a lot better than others which have a seam.

title: Crazy Expensive.  Made in China.  Ok overall.  Plastic Carabiner.
text:
This is the “trainer” only. Volleyball not included.

It’s hard to measure this item, due to the amount of adjustment that can be made. . . But. . . It’s about 30” long.

I believe the carabiner is plastic. It would be a lot better if it were metal.

The round foam strip is nice-and-firm. The nylon straps for the ball are heavy enough. Attaches to the ball with Velcro.

This volleyball trainer is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. At the current price of twenty bucks. . . It’s crazy expensive for what it is. Five bucks would be more appropriate.

title: Have to remove lid to drink.  Made in China.
text:
“Spartan” is kind of a “mud race”. You can find more information online about it by searching for Spartan Race. They are held around the country.

Unless I’m missing something. . . . The only way to drink from this bottle is to remove the cap completely. The cap is on a plastic strap, so you’re not going to lose it, but it would have been nice if there was a different drinking possibility such as a flip-up top, so you didn’t have to unscrew the whole thing.

There is a silicone band around the middle, which makes it easier to hold without slipping. There is a silicone strip around the cap to make grip better.

A straw is not included. If you’re going to use a straw. . . . it’s going to be more of a hassle, as again, you have to remove the cap completely.

This water bottle is dishwasher safe. If you’re going to hand-wash, then you’ll need a bottle brush, which is not included.

This water bottle is Made in China. Franklin Sports is a US company. At the current cost of over twelve bucks, I think it’s quite expensive for such a water bottle. But if you’re a fan of Spartan Races, then it has a nice look.

title: Nice, but pricey for Made in China.  Simple/Basic Water Bottle.
text:
This plastic water bottle stands 10.5” tall. The bottom is 3” across. It’s a super simple design. You unscrew the cap 180º to open. . . and twist back to close.

One thing the pictures do not show. . . . is that there is a “strainer” in the cap. The keeps ice / lemon wedges from clogging the spout.

This water bottle does not include a stray. . .and you can’t really use one. . . unless you remove the lid completely. If you’re interested in a water bottle with a stray. . . this one is not the best fit.

This water bottle shows to be dishwasher safe. If you’re going to hand-wash it. . . You’ll need a bottle brush. . . which is not included.

This water bottle is Made in China. Hydrapak shows to be a company in California. At the current price of seventeen bucks, I think it’s over double the price as it should be. Nonetheless. . . It’s a nice bottle overall.

title: Power Bank is a nice plus.  Made in China.
text:
The one thing that this retractable stool offers that a lot of other similar retractable stools do not. . . .is a power bank. Though it’s only 4400mAh, it’s still nice to have if you’re out fishing. . .at a sports event. . . or elsewhere and need to charge your phone.

Honestly. . . .I have always been afraid that at some point this stool would collapse and I would fall on my behind. But. . .After using it several times. . . That hasn’t happened. Still, I try not to do any twisting/turning while sitting on it.

It’s not super light. . . but. . .it’s fairly compact. If you’re looking for something more lightweight; there are foldable canvas stools. But one of the “issues” with those is that the legs will sink into the ground. That doesn’t happen with this stool.

This stool is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. For a plastic stool, I think it’s quite expensive. . . but. . . it does come with a power bank.

title: Very flexible silicone.
text: These are made of silicone, so they are very flexible.  You can easily fold them for storage.  Easy to use and convenient under appropriate circumstances.  Bottled water comes in handy for rinsing when using outdoors.

title: Keep your feet warm with these.  Made in China.
text:
These shoe covers are black with reflective at the side and bottom rear of the boots. They are what I’d call “medium-thin” neoprene material. They have zippers at the rear and a hook and loop closure at the bottom. The front of the covers have reinforced rubber pads. My cycling shoes are size 11. These covers fit perfectly. I was able to pull them over relatively easily. The bottom fasteners, unhooked, allowed the covers to go on well, and then when hooked, the covers were very secure. Pulling the back of the covers into place wasn’t very difficult as there are pull loops for securing them. Zipping up was no problem. The only thing I would change is that, when zipped up, the tops of the covers were just a little tighter on my calf than I would like with long cycling tights, but hopefully will loosen a little over time. The minute I got the covers on my feet started heating up.

Made in China and sold by a Chinese company on Amazon.

title: Tall...Thick....Heavy.  Made in China.
text:
This water bottle measures 11” tall. The base is 3.5” across. It has a weight of 15oz.

This is a hand-wash item only. The easiest way to wash it is with a bottle brush. If you don’t already have one. . . . you’ll need to purchase one separately.

A straw is not included, but one would fit if you would like to use one.

This is a two-hand operation stainless water bottle. You unscrew the top cap. There is a silicone ring around the lid for easy on/off. But the top cap is plastic, and a little slick. Plastic ring for carrying.

This water bottle is Made in China.

title: Easy open / close.  Made in China.  Adjustable.
text:
This stool has a weight of 2lbs, 6.87oz. It’s made of hard plastic. Closes, it measures 10” across and 2.5” thick. When extended, it measures 17.75” tall.

The listing shows a maximum weight of 180kg / 396#. But there is nothing on the information enclosed with the item to show a maximum weight.

This stool is adjustable, but it takes a little bit of “trial-and-error” to adjust the height. If you’re pulling it all the way out. . . .it’s super easy.

Comes with both a carrying bag. . .and there is a carrying strap on the stool.

Honestly, I’m fearful that I’m going to land on my bum while sitting on it and that it will just inadvertently collapse on me. But. . . So far. . .That’s yet to happen.

This item is Made in China and being sold by numerous Chinese companies on Amazon.

title: Heavy Rubber Coating.  Easy to attach.  Made in China.
text:
This heavy-duty lock set is covered in in thick rubber. It has a great look and feel. Easy to attach to your bike. Easy to unlock / lock. The cable too has a thick coating.

I’ve seen others for lower prices, but the cost difference wasn’t worth the great difference in quality. Others do not have the rubber coating, which can obviously damage your bike over time.

This lock set is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon.

title: Not perfectly shaped.  Tape Measure not received.  Made in China.
text:
The first thing I noticed about these markers is that they are not “perfect”. Neither are the T’s perfect T’s. . .nor are the L’s perfect L’s. For just basic markers, being a little “off” is not that big of a deal, nonetheless, I find it noticeable.

The bottom of these plastic markers have “dots” to help them stay in place a little better. But when/if you step on the markers; they will move around.

The listing shows that there’s supposed to be a tape measure included. My box did not have a tape measure. The box was taped shut when received. The information on the box shows nothing about a tape measure.

This item is Made in China.

title: Two balls, case, tote.  Nice packaging.
text:
These paddles weigh 8.11oz each. They have a slight more “texture” on the surface than some other paddles I’ve tried.

Nice “rubbery” non-slip grip. Slight “spongy” feel.

Neoprene case with zipper. Black “tote” also included (not shown in pictures) Two balls.

This set comes in a nice cardboard box with Styrofoam cutouts for the paddles balls. Easy to wrap, if you’re giving as a gift.

Though I don’t show it on the packaging. . . I assume these paddles are Made in China. ONT Sports is based in California.

title: Lightweight.  Cool design.  Nice, thick, non-slip grip.  Made in China.
text:
These racquets are quite lightweight. 7.4oz each. Thick “rubbery” non-slip grip.

These paddles come with nice neoprene zipper covers. Four balls included in the set.

I really like the look / design on these paddles. Very attractive.

This set is Made in China. “Therm La Mode” shows to be a company based in the United Kingdom.

title: Candy Apple Red.  Made in China.  Hand--Wash.  Bottle Brush required.
text:
This item is listed as “Mirror Blood” color. I prefer to call it “Candy Apple Red”.

This tumbler measures 9.5” tall, including the lid. The bottom measures 2.5” across. There is no silicone / rubber on the bottom. This is a very “slick” feeling tumbler.

The top has a silicone ring around it for easy off/on. Simple operation. .. Simply unscrew. There is no “flip opening” or anything of the sort. So this is not a one-handed tumbler.

There is a plastic ring on the side for carrying, or attaching to a backpack.

This is a hand-wash item only. You’ll need a bottle brush (sold separately) to clean it properly.

Maison Huis is a Chinese company using a French-sounding name.

title: Great "Starter" set.
text: If you’re a “Pickleball Beginner”. . . These are nice rackets to get you started in the game.  They are lightweight but sturdy.  It’s nice that not only are two rackets included. . . . but also two balls and a case with mesh pocket and handle.  I’m not a real fan of the grip, but again, for a “starter” set, they are nice.  The grip is much better on high-end rackets, but there’s no reason to pay more until you know that you’re going to like Pickleball, and that you’ll be playing a lot.

title: Nice feel.  Lightweight.
text:
If you’ve used a wooden Pickleball paddle, then you know how heavy they are and how exhausting they can be. This paddle is just the opposite of that. It has a weight of 7.72oz.

This paddle has a firm grip. You’ll notice the “spirals” around it. Fits my hand perfectly.

It’s nice that these paddles come with what feels like neoprene covers to protect your investment.

title: No assembly required.  Quick-and-easy.  Carrying bag.
text:
This is super easy to set-up. There is really little set-up at all. You simply pull it apart, and you’re done! So assembly. The one thing though. . . It doesn’t “lock”. Though I don’t think there’s an “issue” with that, per-se. It’s not like it’s going to fold-up and hurt someone.

One end has a mesh pocket. It comes in a carrying bag. The bag has two handles, but not shoulder strap. There is no back to this item.

This item is Made in China.

title: Super colorful.  Writing / Logo glows.  Made in China.
text:
The parts which “glow” on this ball are the writing and “white” part of the logo. The colored portions of the ball do not glow. . . but. . . they are super bright and colorful.

If you’re wondering about “adekale” . . . It’s a Chinese sports brand. This ball is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon.

It’s nice that included with this ball is both a pump and net. This ball comes deflated. If you’re looking for a nice gift for a kid (or adult) who likes basketball, and would enjoy something “flashy”. . . .Then this ball fits.

title: No more overturned trampoline!
text:
I think it's amazing that all trampolines don't already come with these stakes. .. but mine didn't.

If you are looking for something to keep your trampoline steady. . . and not turn-over when kids are jumping on it. . . or from high wind. . .Then this is it. The anchors screw into the ground. Then you attach the heavy-duty nylon straps. You will want to adjust the straps regularly.

FYI. .. I know that there is such a thing as a "stake bit" for a drill that may make it easier to screw the anchors into the ground. I didn't use one, but I have seen them. . . sold separately, of course. . . but if you will be needing to move your trampoline from time-to-time, it might be worth looking into.

title: For the price. . . they are just fine. Made in China.
text:
Note that this listing is for two different "sets". . . One is a set of two sticks only. . . and the other is a set of two sticks with goal. If you already have a goal. . . then obviously you don't need to pay extra for it.

These sticks are "entry level" sort of sticks. Fun for kids (and some adults) to have fun with. . but. . . you don't have to worry much about one getting damaged or even broken and this price. For the price, and for what they are, they are fine.

The sticks measure 40" in length, and the blades are 4" in length. They also come with two balls.

Made in China.

title: One set can be put together for four different sizes.  Made in China.
text:
The goal can be set-up in four different sizes. But the largest size is 5.2' X 3.9'. Having the ability to change sizes is nice though.

This goal comes with a carrying case. The case is relatively small, so it's easy to carry.

Though it's easy to put together. . . there are quite a few pieces. It goes without saying that a "pop-up" goal would be much quicker, but not nearly as sturdy and durable as this goal. So I'm happy spending a few extra minutes setting it up for better quality.

Made in China.

title: For what it is. .  .and for the price. . . It's ok.
text: It is true that this is a quick to set-up goal.  But there are limits.  If you look at the pictures, you will see that even "broken-down", it's still quite large.  There is no net, which can be a hassle.  The stakes that go into the ground are not that sturdy either. . . But. . .  .In the end. . . and for this price. .  .it works.  If you can afford more, there are certainly better options . . . including a net. . . But again. . . For something very simple and relatively inexpensive, then this works.

title: Nice color.  Compact.
text:
This outdoor blanket comes in a "rolled" bag with carrying handle. It's quite small and is easy to store in the trunk of a car for emergencies, or just whenever you might need it.

It has a nice "pearl blue" color. Not overly bright, but also not dull either. A nice color for a blanket such as this.

Works well for a picnic. . . day at the beach. . . cover-up at a football game. . . etc. etc. etc.

title: Tiny flashlight is a nice plus.  Made in China.
text:
This Chinese hand warmer offers one thing that I haven’t seen on other hand warmers. . . .A tiny flashlight. It’s really small, and doesn’t put-out a lot of light. . . But. . If you need to look for something in your purse, bag, etc. . . it can help.

This hand warmer comes with a short micro charging cord (AC power plug not included), strap and velour pouch.

It heats-up fairly quickly. This is one of the more powerful power banks at 10000mAh. But of course. . . keep in mind. . . If you deplete it by using it as a power bank. . .then you won’t be able to use it as a hand warmer, until you charge it back up again. But it’s nice that it’s also a power bank, because you can use it in warm weather as well.

title: AFMAT Logo - Not shown in listing.  Made in China.
text:
This hand warmer has a logo on it, which is not shown in the listing pictures. It shows “AFMAT”. I’m not exactly sure what that is, but I can only assume it’s the name of one of the plethora of Chinese companies which offers this hand warmer. This hand warmer is exactly the same as a lot of others being offered right not on Amazon by Chinese companies.

This hand warmer heats-up quickly. It has three levels of heat. It can also be used as a power bank.

A lot of these look exactly the same. . . and they are. . . except for the amount of power. This one is 7800mAh. Some are a lot lower. . . and some a bit higher.

Overall this hand warmer is ok. I just don’t like the fact that there is a logo on it and that’s not shown in the listing.

title: Warm Weather Mat.  Made in China.  Pricey
text:
This mat, inflated, measures 6 feet in length and 19.5 inches in width at its widest point, and about 2 inches thick. That’s definitely a minimal mat. Packed and not in the bag, the mat measures about 4 inches in diameter and 9 inches in length. On the R-rating line on the included card, it says “R value *: 2 (*visit UST site). When I visited the site, someone had asked in the Q&A about the R value. The answer from “juanito”, who I assume is with the company, was as follows: “We’re in the process of finalizing testing on the R-value right now. The freestyle will be near R:2 based on the design and our internal testing. The freestyle is not insulated, so it’s not overly warm. It’s mostly designed to be lightweight and packable.” I would agree. Don’t use it in cool/cold weather and expect it to provide any ground insulation on its own. While the included specification card lists it as weighing 17 oz, I put it on a scale and it weighs 21 oz packed with the included stuff sack/ inflation pump. The stuff sack / pump design is, I believe, basically a copy of a more well-known manufacturer’s design, which is probably patented, hence it’s not an exact copy. The stuff sack is a medium size, and will hold other things inside other than just the mat. Quality, on a scale of 1-10 would probably be a 6 or 7. The 7 inch nozzle that is used to attach the pump to the mat leaves something to be desired, but overall the pump worked ok, not great. But it did do the job, inflating in probably about 6 full pumps. While this mat does not have a dedicated air release hole, surprisingly, it wasn’t that difficult to get the air released, as the “passive” one-way valve in the air hole released the air pretty well and folding up was relatively easy. Overall, this would be a decent mat for a small, lightweight person, intending for use in warm weather.

At over a hundred bucks. . . It’s crazy expensive for a Made in China mat.

title: Not bad, but pricey for a Made in China tent.
text:
This tent without the carrying case, weighs 5 lbs. The carrying case, which is really not necessary if you’re watching weight, its 3 ounces. The carrying case is pretty nice, though, and it has the instructions for setup sewn into the case. The case has a drawstring and two latch straps built in, that have a handle that is connected to the two straps. It comes with a footprint and a rain fly.

Setup was not really difficult, just like any new tent I’ve assembled, it just takes getting used to. The stakes are aluminum and have pull loops attached. All loops and guy ropes have reflective material so they can be easily seen at night with a light. It has a gear loft that buckles into the roof of the tent. The tent is spacious enough inside to fit two people pretty comfortably. The inside measures 4 feet wide, 7 feet long, and 3.5 feet tall. I was able to put it up in about 30 minutes, and would have been several minutes less if one of the guy rope ends had not been assembled with the loop too small to fit over the stake, so I had to untie it and retie. No real biggie. I’d say that, with practice, it could easily be set up in 15-20 minutes alone, and quicker with two people. I

t’s a decent tent that’s complete with all you need. For the money, at 5 lbs, it’s not much of a bargain for sure, but not a bad tent.

Made in China.

title: Nice size.  Made in China.
text:
This hand warmer comes with a short micro cord for charging. AC power adapter not included. It also comes with a carrying strap and a velour pouch. It’s in a nice box, which makes it very easy to wrap, if you’re giving it as a gift.

There are a lot of very similar hand warmers being sold on Amazon right now by Chinese companies. The one difference with this one is the light going around the edge. They call it “breathing lights”, for some unknown reason. First of all, you can choose to have the light on or not. Second, you can either have it as one color. . . or. .it will change between colors.

You have to press the on/off button for three-seconds to turn the hand warmer on. . . or. . .off. Then you press it quickly to change between the three heat levels. The one thing I don’t like about this hand warmer is the fact that the power / heat level button is on the side. If the hand warmer is in your pocket, it’s very easy to simply tap it accidentally and the heat level will change without your knowing.

Made in China.

title: Looks nice.  Made in China.
text:
I have the 64oz in Black.

It stands right at 11” tall. It’s 4.75” across at the bottom. It has a weight of 1# 13oz.

The lid is easy to screw-on/off. There is a rope around it so that it’s attached to the growler itself. Honestly, I wish this were done with silicone and not with a “rope”.

One of the pictures shows a woman as if she is about to drink from this growler. Though you can do that. . . It’s not really “ideal”. You could do that a little easier from the 40oz. But most people would use a separate cup.

Though I don’t know for sure. . . I believe this item is Made in China. I also believe that “Off the grid” is a Chinese company.

If you look online, you’ll see that this is the exact same growler being offered by multiple Chinese companies with different designs. If the logo is not a “big deal”, then you might be able to find it at a lower price.

title: Not a fan of the lid.  Made in China.
text:
This is a plastic tumbler with paper insert and stainless liner. Plastic outside – stainless inside the tumbler. It’s hand-wash only.

It stands 7” tall. It’s 2.5” across at the bottom.

The one thing I don’t care for about this tumbler is the way the lid opens. There is a latch, but it does not attach to the back of the tumbler. So it’s “floppy”. You have to use your finger to keep it back. Your nose will probably also touch it when you drink.

Made in China.

title: Some "issues".  Made in China
text:
If you need two hand warmers. . . then this is certainly an option. But will save you a little money as opposed to purchasing two “full-size” hand warmers. But there are some “issues” with this type of hand warmer.

• You have to charge each side separately
• You have to turn each side off/on separately.
• Only the rounded size will heat.
• Heats a little slower than one other hand warmers.
• Though you’re supposed to be able to use this as one single hand warmer. . . there is a magnet to hold the two sides together. . . but. . .the magnet is not very strong, so they slide apart constantly.

If all of these things still work for you. . . great. But if you’re looking for a single, full-size hand warmer, then you might check-out Ocoopa brand hand warmers.

Made in China.

title: Heats Quick - Cool design / color.  Made in China.
text:
I have the green color, which is a really cool color indeed. Very smooth overall. Slips-and-slides through your hands.

Almost instant heat. Press the on/off button for a couple of seconds to turn it on and off. Press it quickly to change temp.

This is the second-to-highest most powerful hand warmer for this company. They offer several options. Click on “Visit the OCOOPA Store” to see all of the different options. All of them are really great. Just a slightly different design and power.

This comes with a short power cord. No AC adapter charger.

Made in China.

title: Heats Instantly / Nice Size / High-Power / Made in China
text:
This is a very comfortable hand warmer to hold. It heats-up quickly. But you have to know that you need to press-and-hold the on/off button for a couple of seconds to turn it on and off. Then press it quickly to change the temperature. (three levels)

This is the high-level of hand warmer / power bank. If you click on the Ocoopa name at the top, you’ll see that this company offers several different hand warmer / power bank options. They are all, more-or-less, the same. . . except the amount of power.

The box is not easy to slide-out. If you don’t want to rip it, you’ll need to run a thin, long item (I used a letter opener) all around the box to be able to slide it out.

Made in China.

title: Compact Size.  A bit pricey.  Made in China.
text:
When rolled-up, this blanket is quite compact. It’s 12” tall and 19” all the way around. It has kind of a “luminescent” look to it.

As it’s so compact. . . it’s obviously quite thin. But it still adds some warmth.

As you can see in the pictures. . . There are “rings” at each corner, so you can attach it to something, or use spikes to keep it in place on the ground. But attachments / spikes are not included.

Overall, for a rather simple sort of item, it’s fine. It’s Made in China, so at the current price of forty bucks, I think it’s a bit expensive. FYI. . . Some sleeping bags, in this same price range, will open-up and become a blanket as well So they are more multi-purpose.

title: Not a bottle you can drink from unless you remove the airtight lid. Made in China.
text:
Many stainless steel bottles such as this are painted on the outside with a powder coating. This one actually has plastic on the outside. The screw cap on top is also plastic.

This is not a bottle you can drink from directly unless you unscrew and remove the Inside. If you look at the pictures you’ll see what they are showing as the “airtight lid”. There is a button on top of this lid which has “push” written upon it. If you press this button, then you can pour the liquid out into a cup, but you cannot drink from it. The only way to drink from this bottle is to remove the “airtight lid”.

There is a silicone handle on the top. You can attach this thermos to a backpack, but will need to provide your own carabiner.

This thermos stands 11 ½ inches including the handle at the top. It is just shy of 2 and three-quarter inches across at the bottom. It has a silicone ring on the bottom to keep it from sliding.

Hand wash only.

This thermos is made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. It comes in a cardboard box which makes it easy for wrapping if you are going to give it as a gift.

title: Other options are available.  Pouch included.
text:
This company makes several different hand warmers. For the most part, the only difference is the style. . . and the mAh. For example, this one I 9000 mAh. Some are 10000 mAh. . . some 7500 mAh. . . and so on.

This one has a very nice look. It comes in a nice box, so if you’re going to give it as a gift. . . it’s easy to wrap.

To turn it on/off, you have to press and hold the button. But to change the temp you press and release quickly.

It heats-up very quickly. Fits nicely in your hand, pocket, etc.

It also comes with a pouch.

Made in China.

title: 12" Long.  3" Handle.  Made in China.  "Spectator Use".  Nice for kids.
text:
I have the Matt-Orange color. They are not foil. It could be that some of these are foil (perhaps silver). . . but not all.

They measure approximately 12” long. The plastic handle is 3” long.

I would say that these pompoms are not really for “cheerleader use” but for “spectator use”.

These pompoms are Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. At the current price of over a buck each. . . They are crazy expensive. They could not have cost more than a few cents to make in China. They are not super full, but still for “spectator use”, they are fine. Especially great for kids.

title: Pricey.  Made in China.  Nice color.
text:
I have the “Lake Blue” ball. Very nice color. Easy to see.

This ball comes deflated. Included is one pump. . . two “needles”. . .and one really thin net for carrying the ball, if you wish.

This is a “pleather” ball (fake leather).

At the current price of twenty bucks. . . I think this is a very expensive ball. . . being that it’s Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. It could not have cost more than a buck or two to make in China. Nonetheless. . . overall the ball is fine for a “basic” volleyball. Wilson balls are less expensive. . . and even though they are probably also Made in China. . . they are a U.S. company and so their balls would be made to U.S. standards.

title: It's A Winner!  More powerful than most.  Made in China.
text:
This hand warmer comes in a slicing box. After trying a couple of times . . . not being able to get it to slide through. . . and not wanting to tear it apart. . . I ran a long letter opener around all sides, and was finally able to push it through.

You have to press-and-hold to turn it on. Press-and-hold to turn it off. Once it’s on. . . you press quickly to change the temp up-or-down.

It heats instantly. Being that it also has 10000mAh; this makes it one of the more powerful hand warmers / power banks. Especially for this size.

I have the “orange” color. The orange part has a slight texture to it. A bit like silicone. Very comfortable in the hand or pocket.

You can charge it either via micro port or USB-C port. A short micro cord comes with it. No AC adapter.

It comes with a strap as well as a soft gray pouch.

Made in China.

title: Unique Water Bottle.  Made in China.
text: Nice bottle in teal color with fluorescent yellow trim. This piece has a removable bottle/bag that holds 17 oz of liquid. It has a secure bite valve that, so far, hasn’t leaked a drop. I didn’t find the valve difficult to use. The pouch that holds the bottle has a side zipper for putting the bottle in the pouch. The rubber grommet at the top holds the bottle securely. On the opposite side of the zipper for the bottle there is a zipper to insert a cell phone, keys, or whatever will fit. The phone I have is a standard size iPhone 6 with a LifeCase,  which is pretty thin. It fits very snugly, but it does fit. The handle on the pouch has a thumb hole and an adjusting strap. The pouch also has some pretty nice reflective trim. I run in the dark, so I like that it has that. The interesting thing about the water reservoir being a bag-type reservoir, is that when you squeeze it, there is no air void in the bag, so the liquid doesn’t slosh around. That’s a pretty neat feature. While it’s not a well known name brand, it’s a pretty nice system and comfortable to hold and easy to drink out of.  Made in China.

title: Pricey.  Hand-wash only.  Straw brush not included.  Bottle brush not included.
text:
This is quite a tall water bottle. . . but it’s 32oz. It stands 11.25”. It measures about three inches across.

There is a straw inside, but a straw brush is not included. You’ll certainly want to purchase one separately, if you don’t already have one, as the inside of the straws will mold and the only way to clean them is with a straw brush.

This water bottle has a bit of a “satin” finish. It’s hand-wash only. So if you don’t already have a bottle brush. . . . you’ll also want to purchase one separately.

There is a lock on the lid. If it’s up. . . then it’s locked. If it’s down. . . then you can press a button and the top will pop-up. There’s a nice nylon strap for carrying as well.

This item is Made in China and being offered by a Chinese company selling on Amazon US. There are a TON of these same bottles . . .and similar bottles Made in China and being sold by Chinese companies on Amazon. At the current price of seventeen bucks. . .this is one of the more expensive ones. So make sure you look around before purchasing.

title: Steel. . . Not plastic.  Easy to set-up.  Made in China.
text:
I was afraid that the florescent green “frog mouth” rings might be plastic. . . But. . They are not. They are very strong steel. That makes this heavier, but much more sturdy / durable.

It measures 25” across. The “half-circle” measures 12”, so when the “frog mouth” is open, it’s 24”.

The netting is decent. Not super thick, but not super thin either.

Nice to carry balls. . . Easy to set-up. . . Works for multiple sports. . .

Made in China.

title: Made in the USA!  Easy to clean.
text:
If you’re looking for a water bottle that offers insulation, but you don’t want stainless (heavier, can’t squeeze, etc.) then this is certainly a nice option to consider.

It has an easy one-handed operation (as long as you use your teeth to pull-up the cap). Easy to fill. Opening is large enough to add ice, if you wish. Ring for carrying. You could also attach it to a backpack, but will need to provide your own carabiner.

This water bottle stands approximately 9.5” tall. It’s 2.75” across at the bottom. It’s dishwasher safe.

Best of all. . . It’s Made in the USA! (Colorado)

title: Great for all types of events / work.  Heavy-Duty.  Made in China.
text:
This container had a bit of a smell when it arrived. . . but. . . after washing and letting it dry-out; it was fine.

It’s certainly a very heavy (when filled) as well as heavy-duty item. It’s easy to open / fill / close. I like that the handle “snaps” into place will you lift it up or pull it down.

This cooler is great for remote outdoor work. . . schools. . .sporting events. . . and so much more. I think it’s a bit pricey for Made in China plastic. . . but. . I really like it.

title: Remove paper from back of numbers/letters - Huge Pain
text:
This is a “throw-back” jersey for the original Space Jam movie from 1996. Certainly a family favorite.

I have the size Small. It measures approximately 28” from the top to the bottom. It’s about 2” longer in the back. It measures 20” across, so it’s a bit large, but loose-fitting for a size small.

Both the logo on the front. . . and the numbers / letters are the back are a thick machine-made material which is sewn on. Due to the thickness, the logo on the front is not very “flexible”. Nonetheless, I really like it better this way than if they had used that awful “rubbery substance” that sprays-on. . . but cracks and melts in the dryer. When the button is held for 2+ seconds, a small LED light comes on, giving you a light on the battery even if when not attached to the flashlight. Again, a really cool feature. Warranty on the battery and the flashlight is 3 years. The battery is part of a multi-product system that utilizes the same battery type for all devices. I have the black flip top model. It measures approximately 9 ½ inches tall. It measures approximately 3 inches across at the base. It has a very unique matte finish.

There is a lock on the cap. You must pull it down first then press the button and the top pops open. It is very easy to use.

This is a hand wash only water bottle. It is easiest to clean if you have a bottle brush. But a bottle brush is not included in must be purchased separately if desired.

This water bottle comes in a nice square cardboard box. So if you are giving it as a gift, it is very easy to wrap.

This water bottle is made in China. So at the current cost of over 20 bucks, I think it is very expensive. Nonetheless, I really like this water bottle.

title: Simple and easy. Dishwasher safe.
text:
This water bottle stands approximately 9 and three-quarter inches tall. It’s approximately 3 ¼ inches across at the widest point. The bottom is about 2 and three-quarter inches.

This water bottle has a simple design that works. ½ twist and the cap comes off. ½ twist and the bottle is closed. There is a pull up loop behind the cap so you can attach it to a backpack. But it does not come with a carabiner, or anything else to use to attach it to a backpack, so you will have to supply that yourself.

There are indentations on the bottle to make it easier to hold and less likely to slip out of your hand.

This water bottle is dishwasher safe. Made in China.

title: Some nice features, but lacking in padding.
text: This pack weighs in at 2.04lbs. Not the lightest in its price range, but not bad. It’s pretty minimalistic in features, but has most of what you’d need for a pack its size. The one thing I noticed immediately is that there is very little padding in the shoulder straps. There are lower shoulder strap adjusters, which are nice, but I’d really like to have seen more padding in the shoulder straps. There are adjustable chest and waist straps. Where many backpacks have a wide waist strap, this one is 3/4 inch wide. I have seen, however, that a lot of packs in this size have thinner waist straps. The padding section of the waist strap, next to the pack itself, does not have zippered compartments, but for me, I normally wear cargo pants anyway, so that’s no big deal. Again, it’s all somewhat relative to the size of the pack and what its intended use is. This is not a “long haul, heavy load” pack. It has a very nice drawstring enclosure at the top of the pack with a very nice, wide opening. There is a “lid” on top to cover the opening of the pack that is a zippered compartment with plenty of easy-access room to necessities for a day hike. It is secured with a clasp and not a latch, which was a little unusual, but it seems to work fine. Honestly, the hook clasp has less chance of failure than a plastic latch. There is a decent size stuff compartment on the outside of the pack with adjusters at the top. It has two water bottle holders on the bottom sides, which was not easily seen in the photos online. Inside the pack is the divider that will hold a 15” laptop, or a hydration bladder, and it has a latch at the top to secure the bladder in place. There is an opening at the top of the pack specifically designed for the hydration tube. There is no clasp on the shoulder straps to secure the tube. There is also a nice, strong woven handle at the top of the pack. One thing pretty cool are the long side access zippers so as to access things like a rain jacket without having to open the whole pack to get to it. These zippers are not rain resistant, it doesn’t appear. The material that the pack is made of appears to be extremely durable. I can’t attest to its water resistance, but the notes indicate that it’s more resistant than most waxed canvas packs. Time will tell. The back pad is, again, minimal and marginal on ventilation. It has some extra loops and a special loop to hold hiking poles. This is a nice pack and has a lot to like, but unfortunately the overall comfort of the pack is lacking.  Made in Vietnam.

title: Straw brush not included. A little pricey.
text:
This is a really nice water bottle. It measures about 11 ½ inches tall. It is approximately 3 1/8 inches wide.

This water bottle comes with a straw. But you do not have to use the straw. It does not come with a straw brush, so if you are planning on using the straw, then you will need to either already have a straw brush or purchase a straw brush separately. Straws get very yucky very quickly. They are not clean by simply handwashing them or placing them in a dishwasher. You must have a straw brush.

This water bottle has a nice locking feature. Unlock. . . Press the button and the top opens up. I also like the fact that it has a strap. So you can carry it around your wrist, or attach it to a backpack, etc. There are also “dimples” on the bottle to make it easier to hold so it will not slip from your hand.

This water bottle is made in China. I think at the current price of 18 bucks it is a little expensive, but I really like it.

title: Compact hammock.
text:
This hammock has a weight of 1 lb. 15 oz. If you look at the video, you will see how compact it is when rolled up in the carrying bag. It is approximately 8 ¼ inches tall by just about 6 and three-quarter inches wide. It has a strap so you can attach it to your backpack. It’s very lightweight fabric but also very strong. It has a maximum weight capacity of 500 pounds. I know that currently the listing shows a different maximum weight limit, and I don’t know if that is based upon the color of the hammock and perhaps different material being used for different colors or what. But mine shows a maximum weight of 500 pounds.

This hammock does not come with a mosquito net, but this same company does offer a hammock that does.

title: A lot of nice features for a pricey cooler.
text:
This cooler measures 37 inches wide, 18 inches tall, and 18 inches deep, and weights 17.5 lbs. It has strong handles on the top of both sides with a single piece top. The inside measures 15 inches tall, 15 inches deep, and 32 inches wide. It's obvious on the inside that there is considerable insulation in the walls of the cooler. The top, while secured with plastic hinges, has a strap on the inside right end of the cooler to keep the top from over-opening and damaging the hinges. I had a similar cooler with the same type hinges that broke due to the fact that they didn't have a securing strap like this one. This should be a good feature, making the top hinges last much longer. This cooler has recesses, one at each corner on top, to put drinks. They are only about 1/2 inch deep, so not to be used while moving the cooler. There is an inch/centimeter gauge molded into one side of the top, running almost the full length of the cooler (25 inches/ 66 centimeters), so you could throw a fish up there and give it a measure. This cooler does not have wheels. There is a single water drain at one end of the cooler on the bottom.

I think it's quite expensive for molded plastic, but it is made in the USA, so I'm giving it 5 stars.

title: Soft and squishy. Waterproof cover inside underneath.
text:
If you look at the video on the listing, you will see how easy this bike seat cover is to install. It’s a very “squishy” seat. That’s not good or bad. It simply a personal preference of what you like. Some people like sleeping on a soft mattress and some people like sleeping on a firm mattress. At this seat cover is very squishy and soft.

It measures approximately 10 inches across at the widest point. It is approximately 11 inches from front to back.

Please Note: It is only waterproof if you put the waterproof cover on it. The waterproof cover is tucked inside underneath the seat cushion. It does not show this on the video, but that is where the waterproof cover is located. So you may wish to remove this cover and place it into another bag for quick access should you need it.

Made in China.

title: Cool "bullet" packaging.  Refillable.
text:
This kit comes in a heavy duty metal “bullet”. There are 10 repair strips total. 5 black and 5 bacon, depending upon the type of tire, and size of hole you need to repair.

I highly recommend you watch online videos to see exactly how to use the strips before you get out onto the road and actually have to repair a punctured yourself.

The “bullet” is refillable. So you can purchase the repair plugs separately when necessary.

This product is made in Taiwan. I believe that Marque Cycling is also headquartered in Taiwan.

title: A bit pricey, but overall a nice bag.
text:
If you look at what is currently the 4th picture down, you will see that the inside of this bag is blue. There is an elastic strap on the bottom of the bag inside and also on the side inside so if you want to keep something from jostling around.

The bottom measures approximately 10 inches. The back measures approximately 6 ½ inches and the top measures approximately 8 ½ inches it is approximately 2 inches wide/. Velcro straps hold it on. This is a soft sided bag. There is no cardboard inside.

I think this is a little bit pricey for what it is, but overall it’s a nice bag. Made in China.

title: Not cheap, but they are leather. Made in China.
text: These youth baseballs are made in China. At over $4.50 each, they are quite expensive. But they are leather. The stitching looks good. They come in a 5 gallon plastic bucket. 24 baseballs only fills the bucket about one third. The lid has a foam insert so you can sit on it. If you are simply looking for practice baseballs, then Rawlings offers synthetic balls for a fraction of the cost. You can search for:  B0015CFUZW

title: Crazy expensive. Not a lot of room.
text:
This is an empty storage box. The listing shows pictures with some other items, but this is simply an empty storage box. It comes with the Velcro cables and such to be able to attach it to your bike.

There are 2 sides. There is heavy cardboard between the 2 sides. There is also heavy cardboard on the outside. The box does not expand. Not a huge amount of room inside, but certainly you can fit several small items.

Rockbros is a Chinese company selling on Amazon. Though I think it looks nice, at the current price of over 25 bucks I think this is over twice as much as what they should be charging. So it’s crazy expensive.

title: Watch the video to see how it works.
text: This item comes in a nice box. There is a small card with a QR code inside. It is only written in Chinese, but I used Google translate and basically if you can scan the QR code it will show you a video on how to use this item. I recommend watching the video. Liquid lighter fluid is not included, and you will need to purchase separately to use this item.  Ronsonol and Zippo are the 2 best known brands, and you can purchase this on Amazon as well. There is a spare wick in the bottom of the box.

title: For smaller bottles, unless you're able to bend it.
text:
The pictures make the “arms” of this water bottle holder look straight. They are not. They are curved. It will only fit smaller water bottles, unless you try and stretch it. It will fit a bottle which, when measured all the way around at the widest point, measures 8.5”. . . give-or-take.

Lingmai is one of a plethora of Chinese companies which have flooded Amazon. The water bottle holders actually have “Ushake” written upon them. When I look online, “Ushake” is a Chinese brand, though I don’t think they are the ones who actually make this bike holder either. I believe it to be a “generic” bike holder, being sold by several Chinese companies on Amazon. If you look around, you’ll find it offered by other Chinese companies.

title: Make sure you look at the illustrations if you are new to dry bags.
text:
If you are unfamiliar with dry bags, then you will want to make sure and look at the current 3rd picture down which gives you illustrations of how to roll and hook the straps of this bag. These instructions are not included with the bag.

This bag has a medium zipper pocket on the inside. There are no pockets on the outside. There is a removable strap.

I did some online research, and it looks like “Jiekaying” (written on the bag) is a Chinese brand name. They offer a lot of outdoorsy items including ponchos, backpacks, swim goggles, swimsuits, and so on.

title: 34" Waist has 30.5" Inseam.  Made in China.  "Generic" Pants.
text:
The listing only gives you the option of waist size and not length. I have the size 34 in the inseam is 30 ½ inches. There is a little bit of elastic in the waist and there are 2 inch belt loops. There are deep zipper pockets on both sides. There are 2 back pockets with Velcro there is one leg pocket Velcro on the right side and none on the left side. These pants are thinly lined with fleas. They are made of 87% nylon and 13% spandex. The fleece lining is 100% polyester. The washing instructions say to wash and line dry. There is a lot of stitching down both legs. I can only assume that is to keep the lining in place.

These are “generic” pants made in China. There is no branding on the pants. The company selling these pants is 1 of many Chinese companies which have flooded Amazon. If you look around you will see the same pants being offered by other Chinese companies. So if you are interested in these pants make sure you look around to find the best price.

title: Better than expected.
text:
This bike saddle is actually a little better than expected. It has nice firm padding as well as strong springs. Of course you will need your own tools to install the saddle. There is a reflective red stick on strip on the back. It is a reflective strip only and does not light up. The construction looks very good on the saddle. The stitching is good and it looks like it will last for quite a long time.

This is a “generic” bike saddle. Ynport is 1 of many Chinese companies which have inundated Amazon with products. There is no branding on the saddle or packaging. If you search, you will see this exact same saddle being offered by additional Chinese companies.

title: You'll need to provide your own straps to attach to bike.
text:
Zukka is one of a plethora of Chinese companies selling on Amazon.

The only instructions given are how to change it from “Schrader” to “Presta”. So you will want to look at the pictures on the listing for more information.

The hose fits into the handle, but it does not lock in place.

If you look at the top picture, you will see that it includes a needle to inflate sports balls like footballs, basketballs, etc. It also includes a very small end for inflating other things, like pool toys and such. . . but. . .again. . . it’s very small and will be too small for many items. You can try and clamp your fingers around whatever you’re trying to inflate to see if that will work for you.

Straps to attach it to a bike are not included. So if you’re going to attach it, you’ll need to provide your own.

This is actually a “generic” bike pump which simply has the name “Zukka” on the side. If you check on Amazon, you’ll see other Chinese companies selling the same pump. So check around for the best price.

title: Great Looking / Nice Comfort
text:
When rolled, this sleeping bag measures approximately 17.5” X 11”. It has a weight of 5#, 5.4oz. I have the “blue” model. The material is a bit “shiny”. Looks very nice. It’s made of 100% polyester. This is a sleeping bag for temperatures up to 20ºF. Note: Different sleeping bags have different temperatures levels.

This bag is Made in China. Overall, the quality looks very good.

title: 9-Hour Plus Includes Lanyard.
text:
All of the Zippo hand warmers are offered on this listing. Though some of them look similar, they are not all the same. The one that I have is the 9-Hour Plus model. Make sure you are reading the review for the hand warmer you are interested in.

This device, being produced by Zippo, historically a lighter manufacturer, has the look and feel of a large cigarette lighter. Even the power button is located for thumb operation and is configured much like you’d use a lighter. That’s kind of cool, actually. The feel in the hand is very nice and comfortable. When the power button is depressed for 3+ seconds, the heater comes on at level 1, side one. There are six total heat levels that involve levels one through three, single sided of the unit, and one through three with both sides heating. I can tell you that I was totally amazed at how quickly the unit heated up. Almost instantly you feel significant heat. It cools back down almost as quickly. While the unit does not have a pouch with it, like some similar devices of other brands, I’d consider that it’s not likely to burn you unless you kept it on the high setting right against the skin for a significant amount of time. However, I would not consider this a device for young children. The detachable lanyard, which does not show in the pictures, was a stroke of genius! It measures 18 inches long. You can wear it around your neck at, say, a sporting event that you’d be at for a while in cool temperatures, and be able to detach the device from the lanyard with the latch, turn it on and put in a pocket or pass it to a friend, and then attach it again. Just a great convenience. And, of course, the fact that it has two ports for charging external devices. It only comes with one short charging cord however, the Micro USB that it takes to charge the device itself. Of course you could use it to charge a compatible Micro USB device. IOS users will have to furnish a cord. I just really like this device and find it very useful. Made in China.

title: Watch the video, so you know how to put them together.
text: I like the fact that there is a sticker which is placed over the end of the box where you open it and gives you a QR code so that you can watch a video to see exactly how to assemble these trekking polls. It’s very helpful to get you started, and gives you other information about the polls as well. The polls come in a black bag which is mesh on the back. The bag is about 15 inches long and about 4 ½ inches wide everything is nice and compact and of course they are quite light. This set is made in China, but the overall quality is fine and quite a bit better than some other less expensive polls that I have seen. Once you know how to do it, they are quite easy to put together, take apart, and also adjust the length.
