Though there is a little booklet that comes with this set to show you how to do it, again the online video is much easier to watch and understand. Overall I think it is a nice set for the money.

title: Expensive, but overall a nice bag.
text:
The bag that I received has the word / brand “Promend’ written on both sides. There is a tag, written in Chinese, which is attached to the bag. When I use Google translate it simply shows that it is a bicycle bag and the name of the company etc.

There are 3 Velcro straps to attach the bag to your bicycle. One is on the front, and 2 are on the bottom. There are 2 zippers to unzip the top cell phone case. In the bag itself you will find the toolkit, and the rain cover. The toolkit is fine, especially for emergency purposes. The bag can also hold additional items like keys, a small flashlight, and a few other things.

Overall I like the bag, but at the price of almost 30 bucks, I think it is quite expensive for something cheap made in China.

This item is being sold by one of a plethora of Chinese companies which have started to flood Amazon.

title: Works as expected
text: Because this is a Dry Bag, it has a fair amount of weight to it.  The top is open.  It would have been nice if it had a Velcro closure, but it doesn’t.  It has some pockets and such, but not a lot.  There is some padding on the straps and back.  There are some reflective strips on the straps.  It would have been nice if there were more reflective strips on the bag overall.  Made in China.  BRU is a USA company.

title: Tons of pockets / straps / loops and so on
text:
If you look at the pictures, you’ll see that this backpack has a ton of pockets. . . straps. . loops. . and so on. You’ll just have to remember where you put what!

If you’re looking for the “Rain Cover”, it’s located in the zipper pocket on the very bottom of the backpack.

The gray mesh strips on the back are nicely padded, making the backpack more comfortable to wear.

The overall quality looks nice. At 50L, it’s quite a large capacity backpack.

Homiee is one of a plethora of Chinese companies which have flooded Amazon with goods.

title: I can't imagine a better cover
text: Weighing in at 2 lbs., this is definitely a heavy duty bicycle cover. It comes in a drawstring pouch with an information card that has a link to a YouTube video giving instructions on how to "Dress Your Bike" with the cover. It has a 360 degree elastic base around the bottom of the cover. There are two strong, adjustable latching straps on the bottom. There are dual-hole lock access ports at each end of the cover that are lined with a very durable material. There are very durable handles sewn in at the top to enable positioning of the cover properly over the handlebars. When it comes to absolute strength, quality of construction, and durability, I can't imagine a better cover.  Made in China.

title: "Bits & Pieces" of memory foam.
text:
This pillow has a weight of 10oz. It’s approximately 7.5” X 6”, when rolled-up in the pouch. It takes some effort to get it into, and out of, the pouch / bag.

Once you take it out, you need to let it sit for 15 – 20-minutes so that it fully expands. It’s made of “bits-and-pieces” of memory foam, and not a single piece. So it’s still a bit “lumpy”.

The outside “pillowcase” is washable. Inside you’ll find a “crinkly” tag on the actual pillow inside, which you may wish to remove, as it makes noise if you don’t.

There certainly a lot of much smaller / lighter inflatable pillows, but they are hard and not really comfortable. If you’re looking for a small, portable pillow which will offer more comfort, then this one is worth a try.

Made in China, so at over twenty bucks, it’s quite pricey.

title: Batteries Included
text: This four-piece camping lantern set has 3 AAA batteries with each lantern in the pack. There are two lanterns with orange covers and two lanterns with blue covers. With batteries, each lantern weighs 1.8 ounces. Pretty light. There is a carabiner-style swivel clip on the bottom of each lantern that can be used for hanging. The cap that the clip is attached to is also the battery cover. You remove it and there is a three-cell carriage that comes out and holds the batteries. There is an opaque globe on each one. Virtually every piece of the lantern is plastic. There is a single switch and three settings. The first one is said to be 6000K, the second one is said to be 3000K, and the third one is said to be 5000K. Honestly, I couldn’t tell much difference at all between the 6000 and 5000. Both of those settings really look “LED white” to me, while the 3000K, which is noticeable dimmer, is more of a beige color light, looking more like a regular incandescent bulb. I do like that feature, as I don’t always like the white color light. I’ll most likely use two or three for emergency lighting in the house and one for a tent light. While I can’t say that it is the most extremely high quality look to it, it’s a very good light set that should work well.  Made in China.

title: "Crinkly" - Makes a sound with each move.
text: At 6 feet 8 inches, this is a pretty long pad. It has a pillow made into the top of the pad. There are two ways to inflate and one way to deflate. The port at the bottom of the pad can be used to blow into the pad by mouth, which I had no intention of doing. And it can be used to deflate the pad. The port at the top, pillow end, has a one way valve and some sort of relatively ingenious built in pump device, that you put the palm of you hand over to pump up and down to inflate the pad. It says with the hand pump, it takes “about 2 minutes”. I can tell you it took me longer than two minutes, although when you first start pumping, the “breaths” of the pump are small, but as it begins to fill, they seem to increase in volume. The pad isn’t the thickest by any means, and it’s definitely “crinkly” in that it makes sounds upon every move. I’m not crazy about that fact. The built in pillow is ok, not great. The width of the pad is 24 inches.

title: Works for my 56cm bike
text: This is a very nice looking and very light weight cover. I love the green and silver color. The green makes up most of the cover, with a silver reinforced material on the top, narrower toward the back and wider at the handle bars. There are red colored holes at the front of the cover so you can put a bike lock through the holes and fasten for security. It has plenty of room to fit what I’d say would be the largest of single bikes. Mine is a 56 cm road bike and it more than covered it. The material that the cover is made of seems to be very strong, despite it’s light weight. It’s a nice compliment to any high quality bike. Made in China.

title: Large pocket in back.  Super bright. Mesh back.
text:
Unless you look at the picture of the back. . . and you place your mouse over the picture. . . you’ll not be able to tell that most of the back is mesh. There are strips on the side which are also mesh. This makes it “breathable” and also keeps it from “ballooning” or “flapping” when riding a bike.

There is a large, wide, back pocket. It is covered in material on the outside, but mesh on the inside. You can easily place a couple of water bottles. . phone. . . and so on inside. There are no other pockets.

This item is machine washable. Made in China. I think it’s a little pricey, but the quality looks good, and I really like it.

title: Pricey for Made in China.  Ok overall.
text:
This sleeping pad has a weight of 1#, 7.4oz. When folded-up in the bag, it’s about 10” X 7.5”.

This sleeping pad has an “inflator” built-in. You can use your foot or hand to inflate it. You have to be careful, as there are two “nozzles”. One is to let air in. . . and one is to let air out. So you have to make sure you have the correct one open. . . and the correct one closed. . . depending upon if you’re going to inflate. . . or deflate the pad. It’s in the plastic which-is-which, but you might want to use a marker to make it easier to tell.

When you have a sleeping bag on top, it’s fairly comfortable. There is a pillow at the end. If you prefer to use a different pillow, then you can simply turn it around.

This sleeping mat is Made in China and is offered by one of the ton of Chinese companies now selling on Amazon. At the current price of just over thirty bucks, it’s quite expensive. Half the price would make it more “reasonable”.

title: Super Bright!
text: This is one heavy duty vest. Probably one of the most substantial I’ve seen for an athletic-type vest, and I’ve seen a lot. I run, walk and ride bikes at night, so I’m always attuned to what is truly visible in the dark, and this one definitely fits the bill. With large reflective  center stripes on each side, the one in the front is actually part of the large center-chest pocket, that has an earbud hole made into the vest. Belly and side reflective is large and bright. Two smaller shoulder stripes in the back and four in the front round out the reflective coverage. The velcro (sorry, hook and loop) fasteners on the side are such that should have no trouble fastened. Then comes the LED lighting. It’s crazy bright! Green in color with three on settings: Steady on, fast blink, slow blink and off. The battery back rests in a special velcro-closed pocket in the back of the center front of the vest. There is a push button micro switch in the front of the vest to turn on the light. There is also a master on-off switch on the small battery-switch unit, and the USB micro-b charging port is there as well. There are visible wires coming out of the battery pack, connected to the LED ends, but the pocket seems to be substantial and protective enough that, barring abuse, should hold up pretty well. This is not a lightweight vest, but if you’re getting out in the dark, go safely. This is a great vest to do it.

title: One Size - Better for mid to small person
text: This vest is a very nice, lightweight vest that looks and feels great. It’s a one size vest that I’d really say would be better fit to a mid to small person. The side straps are adjustable and have light plastic closures. I think these could be a little more substantial than they are, but not bad. There are large, reflective, “design stripes” in across front and back. At their largest width, just over an inch in width. There is reflective piping along the entire vest and the side straps themselves have reflective material on them. There is a pocket in the bottom back that should be plenty big for most cell phones. Pocket is certainly not weatherproof and has a two small reflective stripes outlining the zipper. This vest is a very attractive vest for what it is and, while some of the reflective is smallish, I can attest to the fact that it’s very bright.  Made in China.

title: Lightweight.  Easy to carry.
text: This camping pillow weighs in at 4 ounces with carrying pouch. It is easily inflatable with just a few breaths and has two valves for air, on large open valve and one smaller (inside the larger valve cover that has a one-way valve). The smaller valve would be the best for filling and the larger for releasing air. The valve (bottom) side is covered in non-slip dots that actually do a very good job of keeping the pillow in place. I definitely like this feature. It also comes with a removable strap that can be used to anchor the pillow to a sleeping bag. The pillow has a reasonably comfortable, sort of soft side that is against your head. Actually, I found it pretty comfortable even without any kind of cover. It does not come with a pillow cover. It seems to weigh about the same as other camping pillows that are twice the price, although some of those pillows do have more padding for the head. Overall, I do consider this “ultralight” and a good value for the quality.  Made in China.

title: Lightweight.  Quality Construction.
text: Weighing in at just 19 oz. this is a light 15 liter bag, especially for the durability of construction. It comes with a drawstring carrying bag. Color of carrying bag is black, color of the duffel itself is gray with a topo map design printed on sections of it, making it a very sharp looking bag. The quality of construction, sealing points, and stitching seem to be impeccable. It has very strong and adjustable straps on both ends and on the sides, forming the carrying handles. There are four tie-down loops, two on either side of the bag. There is two handles, one at each end of the bag. When set down, it has a nice shape-form that produces a very nice shape small duffel. I can definitely see the versatility of this bag in carrying valuables like camera equipment, other electronics, and the like. While a little pricey, there’s no question that it’s worth it to keep valuables dry.

title: Quality poles at a reasonable price
text: These poles come with a lightweight, durable zippered carrying case and four (8 total) pole end attachments for leaves, snow, blunt-end, and curved trekking. All the attachments alone are accessories that you have to purchase separately with many more expensive pole sets. The snow and leaf attachments are plastic, screwed onto the poles with threads, and the other two are rubber push-on. These are a single-clamp design for length adjustment and compact storage. They have very nice, comfortable wrist straps. With the extensions retracted, their stored length is 31 inches. They have carbide tips at the ends of the poles and the grips are a firm foam material. I love the “lower grip” on each pole, which is great for when you are trekking steep uphills and need to grip the poles in a lower position, or if you are traversing side-hill and need one pole shorter on the uphill side. I can tell you that these poles are extremely light at 5.5 ounces per pole. I have a set of CMT poles that are a two-clamp design at 7.6 ounces each. I can honestly say, in the whole of all of my hiking/backpacking equipment, I know of no other equipment that delivers the quality and light weight compared to price as these poles. There are few items I know of that are more deserving of the five stars that I give these poles

title: Very cool bag. Better-than-expected. More mature look. Very durable.
text: This slingback baseball bag has a lot of nice perks to it.  I like that the zippers have pull tags on them. The material is heavy and durable. It’s made of polyester. The logo is stitched. This bag can be used both for baseball equipment, but also as an every day bag as well. Very stylish. Made in China. Nice for teens because it has a more mature look to it. And not so childlike.

title: Logos/numbers are that "rubbery" substance.  Made in China.
text: The numbers and logo on this shirt are of that rubbery substance which can easily melt and or crack if placed in a hot dryer. So you will need to use caution when washing. It is made of 100% polyester. There are side panels which are mesh. The entire shirt is lightweight fabric. I have the size 8 and it measures 23 inches from the top of the shoulder to the bottom.6 it measures 17 inches across all the way down. This shirt is made in China.

title: You'll probably need a ceiling mount, and possibly a longer chain.
text: This set is for kids ages 5 to 13. Though certainly kids in this age range could use a full size adult bag, it’s nice to have one that’s a little bit smaller and just for them. The gloves which come with the kit are not great, but a nice starter set. You’ll probably want to invest in something a little bit better if your child decides they really want to continue working out in this way. It keeps them from being on video games all day long, which is a good thing. The bag looks to be very well made and sturdy. The stitching is good. You’ll probably need a ceiling mount, and perhaps a longer chain but otherwise it’s a great set.

title: Great for an emergency.  Easily fits in your backpack / car or even pocket.
text: The sleeping bags come both in orange and green. I personally prefer the orange because it is much more noticeable in case of an emergency. If you are going on a regular camping trip, then of course you would have your own regular sleeping bag. But this is for emergency purposes. This listing has both one sleeping bag options and to sleeping bag options they are very small and are easy to fit inside your car as well as a backpack or even your pocket. Something like this is especially important during cold weather. This same company also offers an emergency tent. It’s really a nice item to have for emergency purposes.

title: "Tube" Tent - Compact / Lightweight - Emergency Use
text: Keep in mind that this is a “tube”.  There is no way to close the ends.  No flaps, or anything of the sort.  Also keep in mind that you will need to tie the paracord rope to something. .  .usually trees.  If you’re in an area that’s flat (desert and such) then this might not work.  But this is truly for an emergency.  Obviously if you’re going camping, you’re going to have a “real” tent.  But in an emergency, this can come in very handy.  It’s very compact and lightweight. You can actually fit it in some pockets.  So overall, I’m happy with it for what it is.

title: Right price for a quality set for kids.
text: Just in case you’re thinking this is a “costume”, such as for Halloween. . . . it’s not.  It’s the “real deal”.  Granted, it could be used for Halloween, if you wanted, but it’s a “real” boxing set.  It comes in a clear tote, which is nice, so you can keep it altogether.  This is a “one-size” item.  It’s for kids 2 – 5-years-old.  The set includes gloves, headgear and mini punching bag.  Overall the quality is “above average”

title: 8.95oz Each - Made in China
text: These grips have a weight of 8.95oz each.  So they are not something “flimsy”.  They are built to last of dense silicone.  They are easy to attach / remove.  Easy to clean / wash / sanitize.  The have a 1” hole.  4.75” long and 2.2” across.  They are Made in China.  Though some might prefer a different color; orange works for me.  Easy to see, in case someone decides to “borrow” them. ;-)

title: Hold the bottom and pull up the top.  Made in China.
text: No “instructions” come with this box.  It just comes in a plastic bag.  You simply hold it on the bottom, and then slide the top up.  But I’ll be honest. . . it took me a minute to figure that out. .  .hahahaha. .  . The beveled edges make the box look a little nicer.  The “cradle” is fixed at the bottom.  The edges of the “cradle” are slightly sharper than I would have preferred.  It measures just a hair under 4” square.  Made in China.

title: A little bit of padding and a lot of good look!  Made in China.
text: This seat cover comes in a sturdy cardboard box that’s super easy to wrap, if you’re giving it as a gift.  The box measures 9” X 6.25” X 4”.  There is some padding, but not a lot.  This is really more for the cover / protection / look than the padding.  Easy to put on.  The headrest cover may or may not work for your headrest, all depending upon shape size. . . not to mention you may not like the way it looks.  Made in China.

title: You are going to LOVE these pedals.
text: Made in Taiwan.  I’ve been wanting to install a set of clipless on my hybrid bike and these were a great option. One side clipless and the other platform. The kit comes with the two pedals and the cleats and screws to mount on shoes. These are the two-screw SPD-type cleat mounting design. They weigh 331 grams per pair, and for what they are, feel pretty light. The pedals install with a 5 mm hex through the back of the crank arm and not with an open end wrench, which works fine. Aesthetically, they look very nice and represent quality construction. In operation, they work great. Shoes lock into the pedals smoothly and extraction equally as smooth. Flipping over to platform is a breeze for when my wife, who doesn’t do clipless, to use. Raised spikes on the platform side provides good grip. Definitely five stars

title: Extra soft and just a little bit "fuzzy".  100% polyester.  Made in Bangladesh
text: The soft, and slightly “fuzzy” fabric, on the outside, is nice.  It’s not “fuzzy” on the inside, but still soft.  This onesie is Made in Bangladesh.  Fun bedtime and loungewear.  As there are tags in the neck, you’ll want to use caution when removing.  There is a thick seam covering them, but if you’re careful, you should be able to cut under the seam, so that nothing is sticking-out to “poke” your child.  There is a gray fabric with little footballs on the bottom of the feet, but I do not believe it to be anti-skid.  100% polyester

title: Wish it were glow-in-the-dark.  More fun at night
text: The video shows this being played with during the day, so you don’t see the lights.  But when you play with it at night, then you’ll certainly see the lights.  It’s simple to use.  It doesn’t really fly very far though.  That might be a good thing at night, as the lights turn-off fairly soon after it lands.  Unfortunately they did not make this a glow-in-the-dark item.  Made in China.

title: 5.5" Slits at the bottom.  Made in Guatemala
text: This tee-shirt has 5.25” slits at the bottom of each side.  It is somewhat fitted.  It’s 100% cotton, so you can expect some shrinkage.  It’s smooth, but not overly soft.  There is no tag in the neck.  It’s a nice shade of deep red.  The “A” on the front is the sort of “rubbery” type of material that can melt / crack if your dryer is too hot.  This tee-shirt is Made in Guatemala.

title: Nice sleds, but you can also use them as platters!
text:
The Slipper Racer Downhill Snow Sled is shaped in a disc shape and can hold either kids or adults. Each sled (this comes in a pack of 3) includes handles on each side with a large space in the middle of the disc for a child or adult to sit. These are made of heavy duty plastic so they should hold up well over time. I’ve not had the opportunity to use them yet as we’ve not had snow yet this year; however, I believe they will hold up well for any amount of snow or ice that they are used on. I like the fact that these are sold in sets of three so that multiple people can enjoy snow sledding at the same time.

FYI. . . Believe it or not. . .You can also use these as large "platters" if you're serving a lot of people on a buffet!

title: Made in China.  Three sets of two, so six wristbands total
text: This is a pack of three sets of two, so there are six wristbands total. The pack that I received has one set of black. . . one set of gray. . . and one seat of white.  All of them have the Starter logo stitched into them.  They are Made in China.  The material is 78% cotton, 11% olefin (a synthetic fiber made from a polyolefin), 8% polyester and 3% elastodiene (A term used to describe fibres composed of natural or synthetic polyisoprene).  They have nice stretch to them, and a nice thickness as well.  Quite comfortable.  The information shows to hand-wash only.

title: Size Small may be too short for some.  Made in Pakistan.
text: I have the size Small.  It may be too short for some.  It measures 18” from the top of the shoulder to the bottom.  The sleeves measure 16” from the top of the shoulder to the end.  It’s made of 55% cotton and 45% polyester, so there should not be too much shrinkage.  This hoodie is Made in Pakistan.  The outside is smooth and the inside is fuzzy.  There is no drawstring on the hood.  There is a “kangaroo pocket” in the front.  The “A” on the front is the “rubbery” sort of material which will crack / melt in a hot dryer, so you’ll have to use some caution there.

title: Expensive, but I like it.
text: This softball is Made in China.  It shows to be “official size / weight”.  It has a synthetic cover which has the look and feel of leather.  The stitching is very good.  I like the neon color.  Solid core.  Overall it is fine, but I think for Made in China, at the current price of fourteen bucks for a single ball that probably cost less than a buck to make. . . it's crazy expensive.

title: Not really worth the high price.  Easy to assemble though.
text: This is a fairly easy game to assemble.  Each piece is numbered.  Though this comes with a “mini pump”, only the soccer ball has to be inflated.  The others are “stuffed”.  Though there really isn’t a “ball return” on this game, there is a “pouch” that you attach to the back, where you can then retrieve the balls.  The screens trade-out with Velcro.  The back drape that catches the ball is made of some interesting....less quality...material.  They point out, several times...set up in a clean area....that is because that material is like Velcro...all kinds of stuff attaches to it...and doesn’t want to let go.  They could have used a different nylon and that would not be the case....like the nylon used on the front screens.  It also seems pretty flimsy.  It’s Made in China, and honestly, it’s simply not worth the current price of seventy bucks, but it’s not super bad.

title: Super bold / dark color.  Made in Egypt / 100% polyester - lightweight and slick
text: Such a nice, dark, crimson color.  This shirt is made of 100% polyester, so the color should not fade as well.  Lightweight and slick sort of material.  Tag-free in the neck area.  There is some writing, but it’s smooth.  This tee-shirt is Made in Egypt.  The design on the front (one of at least a couple offered) is the “rubbery” material you often find on tee-shirts.  It will melt/crack in a hot dryer, but as this is 100% polyester, a low dryer is required anyway.

title: Made in Egypt - 100% polyester - Slick / Slinky feel
text: This is one of at least a couple of designs for this team.  The design on the front is that “rubbery” substance, which does not do well in hot dryers, so make sure the dryer is on low, otherwise the design could melt / crack.  This tee-shirt is made of 100% polyester, low dryer is best anyway.  It’s thin, lightweight and slick.  Kind of a “slinky” feel.  It’s tag-free in the neck area.  Nice bold / dark color.  Made in Egypt

title: Love the caddy.  Made in China.
text: The set I was playing with previously wasn’t nearly as nice as this one.  I really like the holder.  It works well, and looks great too. The balls have a very night feel to them.  They are made of durable resin.  These should really last and last.  This set is Made in China.  A bit pricey, but not crazy expensive.  Though the “backyard” set looks ok, I think it’s worth the extra money for the “professional” set.

title: Target only - Goal not included.  Made in China.
text: If you place your mouse over the goal, you’ll see how this attaches to the goal with bungee, which is included.  It’s a rather thick tarp with different “holes” (scoring zones).  The bungee gives it some “bounce” when you miss the hole.  Note that this is the target only, and the goal itself is not included.  Made in China.

title: Works for "average" use.  Made in China.
text: As you can see. .  . .This is a large lacrosse goal backstop.  It takes a bit of time to assemble and get it up, but to be expected for an item such as this.  This is certainly not super high-quality.  It depends upon how you’re going to use it, whether or not it’s going to work for you.  If you’re standing close. . . . and firing at a zillion miles per-hour. .  then no. .  .it’s probably not going to work.  But if you’re a bit further away. . .  hence the need for the backstop in the first place.  ..then it works ok.  Made in China.

title: Pricey, for Made in China, but it's a really nice bag.
text: Made in China. This is a very nice, very durable backpack. It has very nicely placed ventilated padding next to the back. It has a single water bottle pocket and a single external paddle pocket with an elastic band to keep paddle in place. There is a soft lined pocket inside top of the main compartment to keep cell phone and valuables. It has a handle on top of the bag and a fence hook just inside the top closure flap. There’s an additional long zip pocket inside the main compartment that is just right for balls. The large main compartment will hold several paddles. There is a good sized compartment at the bottom that would be good for containing clothing. This is a well-made piece of equipment that I have no doubt will last long use

title: Perfect for the "everyday" sort of biker.  Made in Italy.
text:
When I first saw this saddle, I thought it looked like there’s a “hole” in the back, next to the brand name, in the listing pictures. But rest assured, that’s not the case. It’s just that it’s “glossy” in that section, and matte over the rest.

The packaging shows that this is the “Moderate” saddle. That’s the kind of rider I am, and it’s really comfortable for me. Much more so than my last one. The gel / padding has just the right amount of give. For an “everyday” / ride-around-town sort of biker, this is a great option.

Made in Italy.

title: Adjustable height, smooth, Made in Taiwan
text: Made in Taiwan. With the reputation of Crank Brothers, I’d expect nothing less than a really nice pair of pedals. These pedals are exactly that. They measure approximately 4 3/8” x 4 3/8” and are extremely good looking, in what I assume is powder coated red paint with the Crank Brothers logo in white on the front, back and side. At 470 grams, they seem to be about average weight for similar platform pedals. I really like the adjustable-height traction pins. The pedals installed very easily and are extremely smooth turning, with the double shaft bearings and lip seal to keep out contaminants.

title: Nice, sturdy water bottle.  "Blue Ice Stick" a plus. Made in Malaysia.
text: This is a very sturdy water bottle for kids.  It’s nice that it includes a “blue ice stick” to keep drinks cold. . . but. . . it would have been nice if there was information included, and instructions.  There is not.  You’ll want to freeze the “blue ice stick” first, and then it snaps into the top of the lid.  This water bottle is top-rack dishwasher safe.  It does NOT come with a straw brush, so that’s certainly something you’ll want to purchase separately, if you don’t already have one.  Made in Malaysia.

title: Nice kids set - Cool colors
text: This is an all-in-one kids snorkeling set.  The only think you’ll need to add is a swimsuit! ;-)  The find measure about 14 X 6.5” at the widest point.  The heel strap is adjustable.  Once you have it adjusted, you just snap-on.  The mask has nice silicone for around your face.  The strap is adjustable and you just snap it on, after adjustment.  The snorkel has a soft, silicone mouth piece.  Easy to use.  The set comes with a mesh bag for storage as well, which is a very nice touch.

title: I prefer the "paw-only" design.  See review
text:
This is a nice looking piece. . but. . .it’s so expensive for what it is. I appreciate that it’s Made in the USA. . but still.

It’s a thin sheet of chrome mirror with a much thicker sheet of black plastic on the back. There is a “cutout” so that you can hang it, if desired, but you’ll need to provide your own nail.

The designs are what I would call “stickers-on-a-mirror”.

This same company also offers a “paw-only” design (which I personally like a little better) which has some “depth” to it. See the link below.

[[ASIN:B076HC2JNH Chrome Domz - Clemson Tiger Paw]]

title: About 13" long, before strap.  Very colorful and bright.
text:
These do not come with any sort of storage bag, so you may wish to find something of your own to keep them together.

I have the size Small / Medium. Though it’s kind of hard to measure, they are about 13” long, not counting the heel strap. They are 6.5” wide, at the widest point. The heel straps are adjustable, and once you have them adjusted, they are fairly easy on/off. The fin is semi-flexible plastic.

title: The "charge your phone" part is really for emergencies, at best.
text: The way this is designed, you have to pull the front light off to charge.  So you have to make sure you don’t lose the light, otherwise it’s useless.  It shows that it takes 5-hours to fully charge.  It also shows, if you use your flight at the full 600 lumens for an hour, you can charge your smartphone up to 1/3.  So the charging part, which they go on and on about, is really more for emergency use.  But that’s kind of what I expected.  The max run time at 600 lumens is 2-hours.

title: I prefer the Cressi Tao, but this one isn't bad.
text:
Though this snorkel is not bad, I actually prefer the Cressi Tao (see link below). Though it shows that the mouthpiece on this one is supposed to be silicone, it doesn’t feel as soft and is not as comfortable for me at the Tao. It’s also not as flexible as the Tao. But of course these things tend to be a personal preference as well. This one is Made in Italy as opposed to the Tao is Made in Taiwan.
[[ASIN:B017DUZPEK Cressi Tao, clear/black]]

title: 10.5" long.  Made in China. No adjustment
text: The sizing chart is shown on the current third picture down.  There is no adjustment to the sleeve, so you must be accurate.  The instructions show to “Straighten your leg and meausre the circumference of your knee mid patella.  Use a flexible tape measure.  If you fall betweren the measurements, size up for comfort or down for compression.”  I have the size XL, and it meausre 10.5” from top-to-bottom.  Made of fairly thick Neoprene.  Made in China.

title: Apx. 17.5"  Easy on/off.
text: I have the large / XL size.  They measure approximately 17.5” in length.  So not so long as some.  This makes it easier to travel with these fins.  They show to fit men sizes 9 – 13.  The blade (blue part) are stiff plastic.  They are open-heel.  The “foot pocket” is flexible rubber.  Once you have the straps adjusted to fit you, they are easy on/off.  I don’t show where they are made, but I expect China.  Overall they are fairly reasonably priced, and work just fine.

title: Nice mouthpiece.  Made in Taiwan
text: The mouthpiece is quite soft and comfortable silicone.  It’s also replaceable, should that become necessary.  The length is approximately 20.5”.  The flexibility makes for easy storage.  Overall it’s as described.  Reasonably priced.  Made in Taiwan.  Though the Cressi snorkel sets can be at a bit of a better price point over, if you only need the snorkel, then this is a nice one.

title: Made in Bangladesh.  Two side pockets.  20.5" long
text:
Note that his listing is for the shorts only. Socks, etc. are all sold separately.

I have the white shorts. They are fully lined. . . and the lining is white also. The outside is 100% nylon. The lining is 100% polyester. If you look very closely, these shorts have a matte / gloss strips running down them. Not that easy to see, but if you look really close, you can see them.

These shorts have wide/deep pockets on each side. There are no back / inside pockets. There is a 1.75” elastic waistband, with inside drawstring. I have the size XL, and they measure 20.5” from the top of the waistband to the bottom of the leg. The inseam is 8”. The leg opening is 15” across. They are Made in Bangladesh.

title: Nice overall.  Strong smell.  Hopefully it will dissipate in the not-too-distant-future
text: This is a pair (2) kickboxing / Muay Thai / MMA (or anything else you would like to use them for) kick / punch / strike shield pads.  They are synthetic leather, or as I like to call them “Pleather”. They measure 16” X 8” and are 3.5” thick.  The inside padding is fairly “firm”, which is a good thing.  The straps on the back are easy to work with.  I will say that they have a very strong smell.  Even after several days, it’s still there, but hopefully it will dissipate in the not too distant future.

title: Easy to apply.  More cushion than my original grip. Non-slip
text: If you need to replace the grip on your pickelball paddle, or just want some extra cushion, then this is a good option.  It’s easy to apply.  Sticks well.  It’s not slick (like some others) so you are able to hold onto your paddle without a problem.  This is a lot better than the “original” grip I had.  Glad that I changed.

title: For the serious table tennis player
text: These balls are quite smooth.  You neither feel, nor see, a seam.  They are very evenly balanced.  These are plastic, A40+, ITTF approved balls.  They are Made in China. For just “everyday play, there certainly are less-expensive options.  But if you’re serious about your table tennis game, then these are nice balls to use.

title: Plastic inside with foam covering.
text: This stick feels like it’s probably plastic inside, and covered with a bit of foam and plastic to make it a bit softer.  But it’s not solid foam, so it could still do some “damage” if you hit someone / something really hard.  The ball is also soft.  Just over 26” long, so this is certainly a kids item.  Fun to knock around the ball in a basement / garage and elsewhere.  Very bright and colorful.  Made in China.

title: No cheap. . . but. . . I hope to get a few seasons out of them
text:
This is a twin-pack of sleds. They are also sold individually, but they are at a slightly lower overall price when purchased at a twin-pack.

They are of a size for either one adult or one adult and one child or two kids. For two adults, both would have to be quite small.

There are holes (handles) on each side. Two in the front and two in the back. Rope is also attached to the front.

I think they are quite expensive for molded plastic, but the overall quality is better than some much less expensive models. I hope to get at least a few seasons out of them.

title: Large measures approximately 18" x 14"
text: I have the “Large” size.  This piece measures 18” X 14”, at the widest points.  It’s about a half-inch thick.  Metallic paint is used, so it “glistens”.  Some places around the edge are a bit sharp, so you have to use a little caution, but after you hang it, then of course you’re probably not going to be handling it very much.  There is a “slot” on the back for hanging.  The back looks to be black plastic.  This item is Made in the USA, and I greatly appreciate that.  But I still think it’s a bit pricey for what it is.  But it looks to be well made, and it looks great.

title: Wood is kind of rough.
text:
This is an inexpensive racket for someone who wants something a little better than the really cheap sort of rackets. . . but. . . who doesn’t want to spend a fortune on a professional racket.

Speed: 64
Spin: 66.5
Control: 81

This racket is (of course) Made in China. The wood is not super smooth, but it’s as expected for a racket in this price range.

title: Everything you need to play
text: This set comes with 2 Kan Jam goals, a youth size football, decals to place on the Kan Jams and instructions. So, everything you need.  There is no tackling. . . no flags. . .  so no pads are needed.  Fun for boys. . . girls.  ..  families. . .  Lightweight and portable.  Easy to take to the park.  This is the football version of this game, but other versions are available.  The box shows:  Designed, engineered and assembled in America. . .  .but it doesn’t say that it’s Made in the USA. . . so I have the feeling the pieces are probably made in China.

title: Clemson Tigers - Has nice glitter outline.
text: I have the Clemson Tigers shirt.  You really can tell this from the listing picture, but the lettering is outlined in what looks almost like copper glitter.  The tiger paw print is also covered in the same glitter.  It’s quite distinctive and looks really nice.  I have the size Medium, which measures 26” from the top of the shoulder to the bottom.  It measures 16.5” across, under the arms. . .  16” across at the midsection.  .  and 17” across at the bottom.  It shows to be made of 54% cotton and 46% polyester.  It is machine washable, but you’ll want to be careful due to the glitter.  Made in China.

title: Easy set-up.  Comes with carrying bag.  Four anchors.  Made in China.
text: This goal is very easy to set-up.  It doesn’t take more than ten to fifteen minutes. . . and will probably take even less time after you’ve done it a few times.  Most of the time spent is putting the net on.  It comes with a zipper nylon bag for carrying.  It’s thin, but it works very well. There are four anchors to keep it in place.  It’s Made in China.  Great for travel. . . Taking to the park. . . camping. . .  .grandma’s house. . . and so on.

title: Make sure you know how heavy it is.  Nice overall though
text: This shows that you can play in three-minutes.  Well. . . that all depends.  First of all this is quite heavy.  You’ll notice the shipping weight is 85-pounds.  So this is not something that you’ll want kids trying to do.  Being that there will be two players, and if both players are adults, then both can help to put it on top of your pool table.  It certainly is better / easier with two adults.  So this is not some “flimsy topper”, so to speak.  It also comes with a net, but paddles are not included, and you’ll need to purchase on-your-own.  As long as you have a place to put it, while not in use, and don’t mind the weight, then it’s a nice item to have.

title: Works for smaller kids and toddlers
text: This is a sled for smaller kids and toddlers.  It’s simple molded plastic, so it’s kind of pricey for what it is, but the price is also in line with other makers / models.  This same company, “Slippery Racer” offers lots of different models and colors of sleds.  There is no “break” with this model, though they do offer that with some other models.  Overall it’s find.  I just don’t know if it’s going to last more than one season.

title: Hard not to think of the "breaks" as "handles".  Certainly a toddler item
text: This same company, “Slippery Racer”, makes several different models in several different colors.  What looks like “handles” are actually the “breaks”.  So it’s really “challenging” not to want to hold onto them, and pull them, especially for a toddler.  This sled is really for toddlers, and not for older / larger kids, and especially not for adults.  It’s not heavy duty at all.  But it’s certainly nicer / better than using a trash can lid! ;-)

title: Foam bat/ball also offered.  See review.
text:
This is a plastic bad, with a nice padded handle, and whiffle ball. It’s Made in China. Of course you pay a little extra because of the official team logo and such. But it’s fun to play with outside. Extra-large, so it’s easier to hit the ball.

Franklin Sports also offers a foam bat / ball, if you prefer. See the link below. I like both. Some might think that foam is a little “safer”.
[[ASIN:B00NIIAZBU MLB Arizona Diamondbacks Team Jumbo Foam Bat and Ball Set, 21-Inch, Black]]

title: Super "tacky"
text: I have the size Large.  For what I would consider my “average” size man hands, they fit very snug.  XL might work a little better.  Across the knuckles, on the Large size, they measure 3.75”.  From the wrist to the tip of the middle finger, they measure 8”.  There is no padding inside.  But of course the fingers / palm are very “sticky”.  I do not show where they are made, but probably somewhere in Asia.  They certainly look cool, but kind of pricey.

title: D-Link Belt - Flags are 16.25"
text: The flag length on these is 16.25”.  The design is on one side only.  They are Made in China.  The Velcro is nice and “firm”.  Takes a good yank to remove the flag, though it certainly could become easier over time.  Though the D-Link belt works. . . I think it would be a little better if plastic “buckles” had been used instead.  That might be more of a personal preference though. Though it comes in a nice box, I wish a carrying pouch had been included.

title: Lightweight -Case, if desired, sold separately
text: If you’re just getting started with Pickleball, and you want to give it a try. . .  This is a nice set.  It comes with two aluminum paddles and two balls, so you’re set to get started for two players.  These also come in handy if you’re introducing another couple to the sport, so nice to have these on-hand. As they are aluminum, they are quite lightweight (much better than wood).  The handles are comfortable.  They do not comes with cases, so if you would like to add that, you’ll need to purchase separately.  Franklin offers a wide range of paddles, from very high-end to low-end.  All are Made in China.  This set I would consider “affordable” for the quality.

title: Not only for outdoors . . . I'm using it as a school display!
text:
Easy to put together. One person job for the most part. A hex screwdriver and a small wrench are included, extra tools are not needed unless you need something to pry off the ends of all of the pipes. All the parts come with caps on the ends of the poles. They need to be pried off with something, unless you don’t mind messing up your nails.....I used my nails for most needed a pair of scissors for a few of them. The poles all snap together and a button pops out so you know it is in place.

FYI, this item does not come with any sort of case. It’s Made in China. Mine, at least, sits a bit crooked. . . but I don’t mind too much as I’m using it mostly as a prop at school right now. It comes with stakes you can use in the ground, so it will not blow-over.

title: Smooth - Junior (shorter) Cue
text: This is a very nice pool cue for a young lady who wants to get started playing pool. It is a junior stick so it is only 48 inches long and 16 oz. Since it is shorter it can also be good for tighter spaces. The best thing about this cue is that the shaft is smooth and silky so it does not stick to your skin making it easy to slide for a smooth shot. The only thing you will need to note is that the sticker on the butt is hard to get off. You might need some “Goo Gone” to remove it.  Do a search for Goo Gone and you’ll find it.  There are lots of different sizes, but a small bottle will last you a LONG time.

title: Fragile - Expensive - Made in China - Cold only - See review for better / less-expensive option.  . .one of many
text:
This item comes with a pint-size (16oz / 2c) “regular” mouth mason jar. You can use any size mason jar you like, as long as it has a “regular” mouth, and not a “wide-mouth”.

This is ok. . . but. . .here are my “issues” with this item. . ..

• At the current price of fifteen bucks, it’s very expensive for Made in China.
• It’s glass, so obviously the jar is fragile and can break.
• It’s for cold items only.
• If what you put inside is ice-cold, then you’re going to have lots of condensation.
• Did I mention it’s fragile?

There are MUCH better options out there for either the same amount or less than the current cost of this “jar”. Take for example the below stainless-steel, double-wall bottle with cover and brush. But this is only one option of many.
[[ASIN:B01MTR9YU9 Sportneer 17oz Double Wall Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle, BONUS A Cleaning Brush & A Bottle Cover]]

title: Stronger than you might expect
text: This CaseMaster Q vault billiard/pool cue hard case holds one complete two piece cue (one butt and one shaft). The case is very nice. It is sturdy and strong. It is not just a cushion to carry your cue inside, but it is a strong case for protection against falls or strong bumps. The biggest guy or gal at your local pool hall could step on the case with your cue inside and there is a good chance no damage will be done. You get two pockets to stash a few items inside that both zip. Nice case.

title: Nice wight and roll to them
text: This set of foosballs comes with 4 white and 2 orange. They are each 35mm size and have a great feel to them. They are textured, but have a smooth roll. You can feel the weight which allows for a lot of power when you have a good strike. Foosball is one of my favorite indoor table games to play. If you like foosball and need some new balls then you should definitely consider these.  Made in China.

title: Two-in-One Set
text: The Triumph bocce ball combo set is awesome. It comes with your standard bocce balls 4 red and 4 blue with the one pallino target ball. This is a combo set which means it comes with a fold-up shuffle board target with scoring segments. You are also given 8 metal boarder anchors to secure the shuffleboard target into the ground. If you are looking to get a bocce ball set then you should definitely consider this set because you get the added benefit of playing shuffleboard bocce.  Made in China.

title: Three AAA Batteries - NOT Included
text: This is a very cool indoor basketball game that you can connect to the top of your door. It glows in the dark and keeps score. It requires three AAA batteries. Note that batteries are NOT included. The basketballs require you to pump air in them, but a pump is included with the needle needed to pierce the ball. The coolest part is the basketball glow. Another great thing about this set is the material under the goal to let the balls roll back out toward you. Nice addition that makes shooting games easier and more fun to play. However, this ramp does get in the way of dunking!  Made in China.

title: Much nicer than using masking tape
text: This is a sticker that you are able to stick on the floor to mark the distance between you and the board on the wall. It can be used for steel tip dartboard or an electronic dartboard. If you have a steel tip board you need to make the line 7 feet and 9.25 inches away. If you have an electronic plastic time board then you need to stand back 8 feet from the board. This an axis rectifier scale so you can adjust your stance as needed. The strip is solid, but you will want to note after you remove this it could leave some sticky residue.

title: Easy Under-Bed Storage
text: This is a nice under the bed storage bin. It is 6.5 inches high so if your bed is not at least 6.5 inches off the ground then it will not slide under. The top is detachable and attachable by Velcro on two of the sides. There are two handles on the front made out of what I assume is nylon which allows for easy grab and pull. I have the super bowl champions, Philadelphia Eagles. Go Eagles!  Made in China.

title: Nice for starters
text: This paddle weighs in at 7.65 ounces. As billed, it has a larger handle, 4.5 inches circumference at mid-point of the 4.75-inch handle. It has the plastic outer edge protection and measures 8.25 x 10-inch main body of the paddle. I found this paddle to have a significantly sized sweet spot, with a medium-low level of liveliness, giving it good control and a quieter-sounding rebound. I believe this would be a great beginning paddle.  . though I think it's quite expensive for Made in China.

title: My Go-To Paddle
text: This paddle weighs in at 7.65 ounces. The main body of the paddle is 8.25 x 10 inches, with a plastic outside border. The handle feels very good in my medium-sized hand and is 4.25 inches in circumference at the mid-point of the 4.75 inch length handle. The wrapping feels very good in the hand. It has a very lively bounce off of the face, giving the ball a lot of speed. I think this would be a paddle that would be excellent for an intermediate to advanced player. I really like the overall feel of the paddle and believe it will probably be my go-to paddle from the several that I own. It's Made in China, so it's crazy expensive at almost a hundred bucks. . . but I still love it.

title: Nice overall
text: This standing golf bag has just about anything and everything you could want.  Lots of pockets, including one “cooler” pocket. . . towel ring. . . umbrella holder. . . dual strap. . . zippered hood. . . quick-grab carrying handle for removing from your trunk. . . . .and so on.  Not only these things, but I think it looks really great as well.  It’s Made in China.  Overall it’s nice for what it is and not crazy expensive.

title: Wish a carrying case was included
text: This is a portable, kid-friendly on a backyard staple. The upsides: the set is easy to set up and play with and, as it turns out, the separate components can be used fairly entertainingly all on their own (the base makes a good throwing disk). The bright colors make the pieces hard to loose, which is also a plus. On the downside, the lack of carrying sack is a minor annoyance. Additionally, there are several included stakes that serve no obvious purpose; they appear to be intended as pilot-hole pushers, but that seems redundant. Still, it’s a fun set that provides entertainment to the kids!

title: Works for bikes / kayak. . . but could also be used for other items
text: This hoist system functions as advertised, getting your bike (or kayak, with the included accessory) out of the way. Setting the system up takes some time, but that’s due to the nature of the device and not a flaw in the system. The included rope is sturdier than I expected it to be, which was a very nice surprise. With some creativity the included braces and pulleys can also be used in other configurations for assisting with moving and lifting a hoist system, though that is beyond the product’s intended use.

title: Very breathable - Impressive capacity
text: The designers of this pack went all out on its ventilation capabilities. The stand-off frame, mesh back fabric, etc. all combine to make for an extremely breathable pack. The bladder’s capacity is impressive, though when full is not an inconsequential weight. That said, if you’re packing water for a small group on a day hike this one pack will do the trick. My biggest concern is the quality of the plastic clips, they don’t appear to be made to stand up to heavy use and I suspect they’ll fail long before the rest of the pack does. Even if they do though the rest of the system should largely function as intended.

title: Make sure you watch the videos
text:
If you’re unfamiliar with how this device works, then you’ll probably want to watch the SKLZ videos on YouTube. You can easily find them by doing a search for SKLZ Acceleration Trainer.

The bungee cord in the strap that the coach holds makes for an easy release, and also you don’t have to spend a lot of time rolling-up the strap.

This item comes in a carrying case. It’s Made in China, so I think the current price of sixty bucks is crazy expensive, but it’s a nice training for athletes / coaches.

title: Super Slick
text: This is made with a super smooth, lightweight, thin material.  It’s very comfortable.  Loads of stretch.  It’s so slick one might think it’s covered in oil!  The added pink stitching and color patches look nice too.  Simple but nice.  Though Cressi is an Italian company, this item is Made in Mexico.

title: Not a lot of padding in the actual helmet itself, around the skull
text:
This helmet can really be used for lots of assorted sports. There is NOT much padding in this helmet around the head. It’s mostly plastic with a very thin layer of padding; perhaps 1/8” thick. The ears, on the other hand, have nice, soft padding. Also, there is a bit more padding right at the back of the helmet, but it’s where it’s sticking out from under the plastic, so it’s mostly to keep the helmet from digging into your neck.

The straps work fine and are, of course, adjustable. I like that there is a goggle strap clip on the back.

I can’t find where this helmet is made. I would assume China, but I don’t know for sure.

title: Super Bright Red!
text: These socks are quite comfortable.  I have the San Francisco 49ers socks, and they are super bright red.  You can see them from a mile away!  At first I wasn’t sure that I would like the “sideways” logo.  .. but. . . I guess it doesn’t really matter.  It’s “right-side-up” on the back, though smaller.  I almost feel sorry for anyone who supports a team whose colors are dull!  These are certainly my “go-to” socks for game day!

title: Assembly is a pain
text: The first thing I noticed about this weight bench when it arrived was that the contents are not packaged very well. Everything was moving around as if the box was filled with a bunch of loose broken pieces with no foam or anything to keep items from bouncing around. When I opened the box all of the nuts, bolts, screws, ect...where all loose in the box. There was a plastic ziploc type bag (I assume this should have been for the loose parts) that was empty and SEALED shut. There was a small hole, but I am wondering if the loose metal parts were even placed in the bag at all or if they were just dumped loose into the box. Once I pulled all the pieces out and collected all of the loose parts I had everything ready to begin the assembling process. However, I did not even attempt to assemble this item because NO instructions were included. Considering all the parts were loose and the shipping box was dented, cut, crushed up I am not even sure if I have all the pieces. If I had the instructions I would check to make sure all the parts that should be included were included. Aside from those issues, the legs and bench feel solid and made of a study steel. The bench pad is made of polyethylene foam and the cover is 100% PVC.  Made in China.

title: I'd rather hit "countless balls at the range".
text: This impact bag measures 16 inches in diameter and 10 inches tall. It appears to be made of a very durable coated fabric that seems that it would stand up to a lot of use. It has a nylon strap-type handle on the top, under which lies the zipper that is used to install the towels or other soft materials that can be used to fill the bag for use. There is a plastic anchor loop on the bottom that could be used to anchor it to something solid to keep from having to consistently have to chase it after striking it. Now, I must admit that I am an intermediate golfer at best. With that, my main takeaways from using the bag is that it provides a durable, soft impact surface that can be used to swing a club and just practice the swing for purposes such as loosening up after injury, etc. While you could conceivably feel an open or closed club face at impact, I’m not that certain that there is a tremendous amount of actual feedback value that could be gained in reference to the swing. I certainly wouldn’t agree with the promo statement “Use at home to provide same quality practice time as hitting countless balls at the range”. There is also the issue of the noise. If used outside, especially in a fairly populated area, the loud noise that it makes at impact could certainly irritate neighbors. If used inside, I think you’d pretty much have to use earplugs. There may be other users that are more experienced golfers than I that might know of more valuable uses, but as for me, I’ll give it two stars.

title: Up to 8-Players / 43 games
text:
The Viper Orion electronic dartboard is a great board. It comes with the mounting hardware required to hang on the wall, 6 flights, many tips and barrels. The only thing you want to be aware of is that this board is powered by AC only. So, you will need to install this board close to an outlet or you will need to use an extension cord. There are 43 games with 320 different variations that can be played with 1-8 players. The instructions are very detailed. This allows you to experiment by playing different games and varieties that are offered. It is viper laser compatible, but this one did not come with the laser. A great board! Made in Taiwan.

Note: This is a "step down" from the Viper 800 board, which has more games up to sixteen players. If you're interested, click the link below.

[[ASIN:B00PHEP79S Viper 800 Electronic Soft Tip Dartboard]]

title: Quick-and-easy storage
text: This is a great storage bin for the Patriots fan (or any NFL team of your choice) in your home. It would make a great gift that anyone could use in their game room or tailgating wherever the NFL games are being played. Since it is collapsible it can easily be pulled out for game day and put away after the game is over. It has a top, but it is not strong enough to support someone sitting on it. There are two mesh pockets on each side. Another good thing is that if you fill it up with heavy items there are handles on the side for easy pick up.  None of the pickets show this item collapsed, but it’s no more than a couple of inches tall when collapsed.  Easy to store away.  Made in China.

title: Nice Travel Goals - Might want stronger stakes to secure
text: This is a pack of 2 easy pop up goals. They are very lightweight and come with stakes to secure them into the ground. Even though you have stakes to help keep the goal from flying away it is not going to be strong enough for older kids/adults kicking a heavy ball into the net. It is easy to open and place into the ground. It took a minute or two to fold it up the first time, but with practice you will easily be able to fold them both up in seconds.  Made in China.

title: Nice "Starter" Racket
text: The Addoy 2000 table tennis (ping pong) racket is a very good racket for someone who is just starting to get into the game. It is rated as 75, 50, 100 in terms of the speed, spin, and control. A few friends of mine who play ping pong a lot described this as a very good beginners racket or a good racket for defense. Since it has a lot of control and not much spin they said it would be good for defense. Great racket for the price!  Made in China.

title: As good or better than higher-priced rackets
text: The Timo Boll CF 1000 table tennis butterfly racket is a very nice racket. It is rated on a few websites that lists the speed, spin, and control as 95, 80, 65 and on another as 90, 70, 70. Personally, I like the way it feels in my hand. One of my friends, who plays A LOT more that I, took it to practice and had his friends look it over. Everyone said it was a nice racket for the price. Some who spent seventy bucks, or more on their table tennis racket said this one was just as good or better. Since it is rated for very high speed and spin it is also considered a very good offensive player racket.  Made in China.

title: Nice "Softstrike" ball - No, it's not "squishy"
text: This is a nice “Softstrike” baseball.  It has a soft sponge core, but it’s certainly not “squishy”.  I have the Houston Astros ball, and the colors are very bright and bold.  Though it looks like this is a blue and white ball, the white portion is actually “pearl”, so it looks even better than white, in my opinion.  The dark stitching also adds some depth and character to the ball.  Made in China.

title: Check the pictures for the "0" Degree - Reg so you see how this sleeping bag works.
text:
This sleeping bag has a weight of 3# 15oz. . . so right at 4#. In the bag, it measures about 28” all the way around and about 16” long. This “cocoon” type sleeping bag has a great color. . .feel. . . .and is very comfortable. I like that the head portion is also quilted / padded. As you can see in the pictures. . . the zipper comes down to the gray stripes, but not all the way to the bottom of the sleeping bag. That’s so, if you wish, you an unzip the bottom portion across, and stick your feet out for more ventilation. Pictures of how this works are shown on the “0” Degree – Reg model, but not the other models. So no matter which one you’re considering purchasing, make sure that you look at the pictures for that one, so you see how this works. They all work the same.

This sleeping bag is Made in China, so it’s a bit pricey, but I like it.

title: No Pockets. . . Crazy Expensive. . . Not worth a buck. . . Cheap Made in China item. You're paying for the adidas name
text:
I think this bag looks much nicer in the picture than it does in person. At the current price of twenty bucks, you’re paying nineteen bucks for the Adidas name, and one buck for the back. Super cheap. Made in China. It measures approximate 8.5 X 14.5 X 3.5”. It would have been nice if at least the logo was reflective. . . but it’s not. There is a 2” section of mesh below the Adidas name, so there is air circulation.

There are NO pockets . . .None. . .Not inside. . .Not outside.

title: See review for measurements.
text:
This set is very colorful. I have the Blackhawks design, which has a lot of color, but some will be more colorful than others simply due to their logo.

The shirt is a “one-size-fits-all” sort of thing and is supposed to be for ages 5 – 9-years-old. It actually shows “Medium” on the shirt itself. The shirt measures 21” from the stop of the shoulder to the bottom. It measures 16” across, not including the sleeves.

This is a 100% polyester shirt. It’s quite an “open” weave, so it’s very “airy”. It’s Made in the Dominican Republic. The logo on the front is of a “rubbery” material. You’ll wants to be careful when washing. I would HIGHLY recommend hand-washing and hanging to dry. If you wash it in a washing machine.. . . and especially if you place it in a dryer. . .it’s very likely that it will melt / crack.

The mask is made plastic. The back (opening) measures 7.75” X 11”. The mask is Made in China. There are elastic Velcro bands in the back.

At the current price of thirty bucks, I think it’s quite expensive for what it is. . but. . .I like it.

title: Bright Colors
text: There is one ball. . . and one puck included with this set.  You may or may not be able to use these with sticks / nets, all depending upon what sort of surface you’re playing on (slick linoleum would work, for example).  I have the blackhawks version and the colors are nice and bright.  They have a foam core and are soft.  They are kind of pricey at over ten bucks, currently, bur for a fan, they are a nice item to have and play around with.

title: Nice looking.  .. . albeit expensive ball
text: This is a red, white and blue digital camo soft-strike ball.  I have the Boston Red Sox version.  Though it has a sponge core, it’s still not super soft / squishy.  It’s rather firm, but not as hard as a “regular” baseball.  Though it certainly has a nice look to it, I’m not so sure it’s worth the current listing price of over thirteen bucks. .  . .as it’s Made in China.  Obviously you’re paying all of the extra “fees” for it being an “official” ball.  Nonetheless, it’s a very nice looking ball and looks to made ok.

title: More balls would have been nice.
text: This Franklin mini hockey set comes with 2 sticks, a goal, and 2 foam balls. The foam balls are bigger than a golf ball, and maybe slightly smaller than a racket ball. Because they are balls and not traditional shaped pucks you are able to play on any flat surface. The goal requires assembly and the instructions are not very detailed. You only get black and white pictures that show you what needs to be done. Either way it still fairly simple to put together. The only thing I would like is to have more balls. Since the goal can be used for other games that somewhat makes up for it. Not strong enough to be used as a soccer goal unless you are playing soccer with a beach ball or another very light ball.  Made in China.

title: Spinning doesn't really add a lot. . . but it's ok. . . Two AA Batteries - NOT Included
text: The Franklin spin n bowl bowling game is a pretty cool game. The only thing I do not quite get is why it spins. Spinning is fine, but it really does not add much to the game because the pins are plastic and will still go flying everywhere when hit. Instead of the spinning action I would have appreciated a quicker way to set up the pins. For example, maybe they could be attached to a string in the back and when you pull the string they stand up easier. Not sure, but you will not like having to reset the pins every single time.  Made in China.

title: More darts would have been nice
text: The Franklin flying darts with target is a cool toy. The fabric of the target is about 33 inches wide (across) and 40 inches long (up and down measure). Each of the targets on the corners are about 16 inches in diameter, and the center target is about 9 inches in diameter. Assembly is required, but it is a simple set of instructions to follow. The game is played by shooting the dart 7 to 10 feet away from the target. The dart is foam with a rubber band that is shot like you would shoot a rubber band. The only thing I wish they included were more darts. However, because you can use the target for other games I can deal with it.  Made in China.

title: Two AA Batteries Not Included
text: The Franklin spin n putt golf game is a pretty cool game. It comes with a base (with ramp), flag, 10 plastic golf balls, and a plastic/metal putter. The foot pedal is used to start and stop the spinning motion of the base. There are 10 holes/slots for the golf balls to land in with points ranging from 5 to 100. 5 of the 10 balls are white and the other 5 are yellow. Once you decide who goes first he or she will putt all 5 balls toward the base. Anything not in a slot counts as 0 points. After player one shoots player 2 gets to shoot his or her 5 balls. Clearly, you are able to make up your own game and rules.  The one thing I like about this set is that there is no putting green strip. Therefore you are able to putt from any angle or even try to bounce off a wall and into the slots. If you had a putting green strip this type of play would not be easy because you would have to roll up and over the edge of the green. Cool game.  Made in China.

title: Reasonable quality / price for a suit such as this
text: This Sauna Suit is Made in China of lightweight vinyl.  It’s a unisex suit.  The elastic is not too tight, so it’s not going to strangle you.  Though this is a hand-wash item, if you have a front-load washer, you can probably wash it on the hand-wash or gentle cycle without a problem.  At least I did, and it came out fine.  If you’ve never worn one of these suits before, I highly recommend you only wear it with others around.  One can easily become overheated if not careful.

title: Nice and VERY affordable
text: This set of 6 table tennis ping pong balls are advertised to be very round, very new, very easy. From the looks they appear to be very round. I held them up under a light to inspect them and I did not see any spots that were not smooth. They are very smooth too. If I close my eyes and feel the ball in my fingers I am not able to tell where the seam is. Again, noting they are definitely round. Nice set of balls and currently VERY affordable.  Made in Germany.

title: For Serious Table Tennis Players
text: This 3 star pack of ping pong balls are made for serious ping pong gamers. Usually the 3 star balls are used for competition and the 1 and 2 star balls are used for practice and rallying. The 3 star balls should be more durable with a better balance and elasticity. If you hold a 3 star ball and a 1 star ball up in front of a strong light you will be able to see the 3 star ball is made with more consistency and the 1 star ball will have spots that are thicker and thinner and thus not as consistent. Also, the seams of the 3 star balls should be superior. If you are serious about pong then you will need to purchase this 3 star ball set.  Made in China.

title: See size chart in review
text:
These are not the easiest “socks” to put on. The listing shows that they are lined with “Metallite”. I’m not sure what that is, and could not find it online either. Nonetheless. . . eventually you get them on.

Size Chart:
Men:
Small: 6 - 6.5
Medium: 7 – 8
Large: 8.5 – 9
X-Large: 10 – 11

Women:
Small: 8 – 8.5
Medium: 9 – 10
Large: 10.5 – 11
X-Large: 12 – 13

These socks come folded flat. They have a thin non-skid surface on the bottom. They are Made in Cambodia.

title: Zip-Up the Back Version - Front-zipping also offered
text: Some of the Cressi suits zip in the front.  . .some zip in the back.  This one, as you can see in the pictures, zips in the back.  There is a cord to pull the zipper up.  There is a Velcro strap that also goes around the back of the neck.  This suit is 2.5mm neoprene and it’s Made in Cambodia.  It has a good, comfortable feel to it.  The construction looks fine.

title: Make sure you watch the video at the top
text: If you watch the video at the top, you’ll see what makes this saddle pad so special.  By just looking at it, you would not be able to tell that there are so many layers / technology to this pad.  It has a very strong / durable feel to it.  The colors are nice and dark.  Thick and heavy pile.

title: Index finger and thumb can be used on touchscreen mobile devices
text: Huntworth offers several different options when it comes to hunting gloves, for both men and women.  One of the distinctive items with these gloves is the fact that the index finger and thumb can be used on mobile devices.  These gloves are lightweight, but have very nice warmth to them.  They will shed light rain and  snow, but are not really made for real “snow work”.  They are easy-on / easy-off.  Overall I like them, though currently I think they are a bit pricey at over thirty bucks.

title: Pop-Off Mitt Tops
text: These are cool mitts / fingerless gloves.  To be quite honest, many might prefer “traditional” gloves. . . but.  . with these mitts / fingerless gloves you have more feel because your fingers are not covered when shooting.  When you pop the top of the mitt off, it turns around and sticks to the back of the glove, so you won’t lose it somewhere.  They are quite warm, as they are also lined with fleece.  Made in China, so at the current price of over forty bucks, they are crazy expensive.

title: Like the large "kangaroo pocket"
text: This is a nice hoodie.  I really like the large “kangaroo pocket” in the front.  Sometimes these pockets can be really small, and you can’t fit your hands inside them, especially with gloves on. . . but not so with this hoodie.  There is also a small zipper pocket on the upper left sleeve.  It’s quite small, and may hold some smaller phone / mp3 players, but not a lot more.  This item has a draw cord around the hood, but not the bottom.  Made in China.

title: Also offered in long sleeve - See review
text:
I have the black / pink version of this top, and the pink is really nice and bright. This is the short sleeve version of this top, though it is offered in a long sleeve version. See the link below. Pricing depends upon the size / color you select, so you may want to check them all. This top has a nice feel to it. It is a bit heavier than some others I’ve tried, but that’s actually something I like about it.

[[ASIN:B00D3Z1A80 Cressi WOMEN'S LONG SLEEVE RASH GUARD, Adult Rash Guard for Swimming, Surfing, Diving - Cressi: Quality Since 1946]]

title: Nice Mask - Make you check them all out - two different masks offered in this listing
text: You’ll notice that this listing is actually for two different styles of masks.  . as well as assorted colors. The color will determine the final cost. I have the clear / pink mask.  There really isn’t much “pink” to the mask.  I like that the lenses are tempered glass (and not plastic).  The silicone is soft and fits well.  The back strap fits well. .  .but . . I will say that the solid color masks have a wider strap, and some may prefer that.

title: Nice Jr. Suit - Zipper in the front is nice
text: This is quite a nice suit.  I really like that the zipper is in the front, as many kids will be able to put it on themselves.  When the zipper is in the back, that’s usually not the case.  I also like the fact that the zipper is nice-and-wide.  There is not a lot of color on these suits, but the “strips” on the side are nice and bright.  It fits snug, but not tight.  The overall quality looks to be quite good.

title: Nice cowhide (inside) glove
text: This glove weighs one-pound.  It’s quite lightweight.  The inside is soft cowhide.  The outside is “PU leather”, a material made with a split leather backing covered with a layer of polyurethane (hence the term "PU leather").  The inside is soft.  There is a wide Velcro wrist strap for adjustment.  This 12.5 glove is for smaller hands.  My adult hand will barely fit, but it’s not very comfortable for me.  This glove is Made in China.

title: Very lightweight.  Pink stitching is not too noticeable
text:
I have the glove with pink stitching. The pink stitching doesn’t stand-out too much, but it’s noticeable.

This is indeed a very lightweight glove. There is a Velcro wrist strap for some adjustment. The inside of the glove is PU leather (a material made with a split leather backing covered with a layer of polyurethane (hence the term "PU leather"). The outside is “mesh”.

This is a 12” glove for smaller hands. It’s Made in China.

title: Pimp Your Ride - And Protect too!
text: The AMS honeycomb frame guard is made to help protect your bike from dings and scratches. The silver coloring is only to denote the logo that is printed on the guards. The majority of the guard is clear so when you apply it to your bike you can still see the color of the bike underneath, but you will notice the textured honeycomb. You can easily tell without hitting your bike that this will help protect your bike from being dinged up.

title: Atlanta Falcons
text: This is your standard Atlanta Falcons sweatshirt with a hood. It as the Falcons logo on the front and that is it. No words or letters, just the logo. The medium is about 21 inches wide, the sleeves are 25 inches long, and from the shoulder to the base is about 27 inches long. The front pocket connects so when you put both hands inside your fingers can touch. Nice sweatshirt for the falcons fan in your life.  Made in China.

title: Nice looking - case is kind of cheap, but for the price they are nice
text: This is a very nice set of darts. My favorite part at first glance is the look. They actually look like a bomb! They also have three stripes, a red, a white, and a blue. The case is nice to have, but it somewhat cheap feeling. It is not a big deal, because you will only use it to keep the support our troop flights and darts all together. A part of the proceeds are donated to help disabled veterans, but I do not know how large the "part" is. I hope it is a large part. Great set for the veteran or service man or woman in your life.

title: Nice for fans of short darts. . . or if you want to try something different
text: The viper bee atomic darts are a nice set to get when you want to experiment with different dart styles, shapes, and weights. These darts are shorter than the standard darts that you will typically see. If you have never used a short barrel dart then you should definitely try these. The barrels are knurled and so you will have a lot of grip. The tips are also very strong. You should note that you do not get any extra parts with this set.  Made in Taiwan.

title: Smooth barrel with rings
text: This would be a great set of darts for anyone who is wanting to support the pink movement dedicated to supporting breast cancer. October is the official breast cancer awareness month, but you should support this cause every month of the year. Part of the proceeds from the sale of these darts are donated to the breast cancer research, but I do not know what they mean when they say "part." It would be nice if they stated all of the revenue (or at least profit) will go to the cause. For all I know, they give a penny for each set sold. Either way, the darts are nice. The barrels are smooth with rings.  As you can see, these darts come with a case and some extra parts as well.

title: Smooth Barrel - Priced Right
text: This is a nice set of 3 darts. The barrels are definitely nice if you like a smoother barrel. If you are looking for a rough knurled barrel then these are not for you. This is a good set of darts to get if you want to experiment with different styles and weights because they will not break the bank. They feel good in my hand, and I look forward to experimenting more with these and the other viper brand dart styles.  Made in Taiwan.

title: Pineapple instead of knurled
