text: This is my first set of pineapple cut barrel darts. I am excited to put some practice time throwing these darts. Usually I throw steel tip knurled barrel darts, and sometimes the knurling is so rough they feel like sandpaper. If you think you would prefer a smoother dart, that will glide out of your fingers then you must give these a try. Plus, they are awesome for anyone who likes comics and cartoons. A must have for anyone who wants to experiment with different dart styles.

title: Easy "upgrade" from what usually comes with an electronic board
text: These are the viper silver thunder 18g 2 knurled band darts. The knurled bands are what I would call an average grip. Not too rough and not too smooth. The flights are longer in length than width. The tips are a lot stronger than the tips of the darts that come free with an electronic dartboard. If you own your own electronic dartboard or play on one a lot then you need to upgrade from the free darts immediately. This would be a good start.  Made in Taiwan.

title: Nice for the price
text: These steel tip darts are quite nice for the price. The 4 knurled strips are an average gripped knurl. You should note that the barrels are different depending on the weight. These are 22 grams with three painted black rings between each of the knurled strips. The flights are sturdy and easy to shape when they arrive flat out of the box. If you are looking to build your dart collection with a variety these would be a good choice to play around with.  Made in Taiwan.

title: A bit smooth to the touch
text: This is a standard long barrel soft tip set of darts. The tips on these darts are very strong and do not feel like they will are susceptible to warping like the cheap soft tip darts that come with an electronic dartboard. The knurling on the barrels are not that rough, and are almost smooth to the touch. Not exactly the best darts for someone who prefers a lot of grip. Overall a good set.  Made in Taiwan.

title: FYI...No extra parts included
text: The short length darts are usually not my go to. However, I like these because the tips are extremely strong. I have had soft tip darts where the tips will warp and bend, but these do not feel like they will start to change shape after extended use. The barrels are wider than the standard barrels. The knurling on the barrels are also not as rough as some knurled barrels I own. Honestly, the knurling is quite dull, but that does not mean they are bad. This would be a personal preference. The only issue is that when you take them out of the package the flights need to be straightened out. You should note that many dart sets come with extra parts, but these do not.  Made in Taiwan.

title: It really does keep things hot for a loooooooooooooooong time
text: This is a 15 oz stainless steel bottle that is advertised to keep your hot liquids hot for 12 hours and cold liquids cold for 24 hours. It is dishwasher safe, but it is noted that you should hand wash to keep the exterior decoration from fading. The one thing I would change would be the opening diameter and the bottom base. It would be nice if both were wider and to have a piece of rubber to provide a better grip when resting on a surface. I tested it by adding boiling water and it never started to sweat and the outside did NOT even get warm. The top got slightly warm though. 2 hours after start and the water was still steaming and too hot to touch. 4 hours after start still steaming and too hot to touch without burning yourself. 6 hours after start still steaming hot, but barely at a point where you might be comfortable touching the water to your skin for a split second. 9 hours after start still steaming hot and too hot to comfortably touch for any extended period of time. 19 hours after start and still hot. 29 hours after start and hot/warm temperature for coffee. 42 hours after and still warm to the touch. Very nice.  Made in China.

title: Made in the USA - Wonderful Sentiment
text: This has a great sentiment.  Perfect for kids rooms. .  .. College dorms. .  . Offices. . . . and so on.  The letters themselves are 7” tall.  As you can see, they look like they are cut from a map.  Easy to apply. .  . adjust. .  .. and removed.  As with most RoomMates decals (though not all) these are Made in the USA.  They work not only on walls, but just about any smooth surface.

title: They work.  A little better than some of the other Franklin wristbands
text: Franklin Sports offers lots and Lots and LOTS of wristbands.  Many have sporting team logos on them.  These are their “generic” wristbands.  In all honestly, I think they are a little bit better than some of the other sports teams Franklin wristbands that I have.  Granted, at over thirteen bucks, I think they are crazy expensive for what they are. . .  nonetheless. . . I like them.

title: Runs a little small
text: This jacket is a serious winter weather jacket, but the sizing runs slightly smaller than listed. First, this is really two jackets in one. You can unzip the outer layer off. The outer layer is more heavy duty, the inner layer is made of thinner material and has a quilted look to it. The outer layer mostly pink and the inner layer is purple throughout. This coat is very warm and I like that the hood is removable as well. The outer layer has pockets that zip and the inner layer has pockets that do not zip. The bottom layer has one drawstring on each side so you can tighten the jacket around you to keep more warmth in. The outer shell also has adjustable Velcro straps around the wrist. If you live in a cold area or are going on a ski trip, this is a very good jacket to have.  Made in Bangladesh.

title: An Amazing Backpack
text: First thing you should note about the Osprey brand is that it has the "all mighty guarantee. any reason, any product. any era." There is a very solid frame built within this pack. When the pack is empty it will stand up without any extra support. As for the pockets, the design is very nice. The main pocket does not have the entire length of the bag, which is great. If the main pocket were the entire length then it would be an unpleasant task to try to access something at the bottom when you have a full pack. However, you are able to disconnect the separating piece of fabric so you can extend the main pocket all the way down. There are multiple straps that overlap at the bottom pocket, at the base of the main pocket, and on both sides that will allow you to tighten your items inside to minimize the dimensions. The removable top pouch is also a nice feature because you may not need to utilize all of the volume given so you can easily remove this piece. The top pouch has two separate compartments. There are so many straps, connections, and compartments that I will likely continue to find neat uses for them all to fit my needs. Great pack.  Made in Vietnam.

title: Three-Position Tee
text: This three-position tee can be adjusted for optimum practice.  Though you could simply move a single position tee from place-to-place. . . .  .This one makes it a little easier by moving the tee from one hole to another.  You can place the platform right in front of the plate, so you know exactly where the ball is landing. Granted, you have to make sure you keep the platform and tee together.  This is also a little more cumbersome than a single tee, and not as great for travel.  But still, overall, it’s a nice and affordable item to have to help improve your hitting.

title: I think the gel makes a difference
text: This might be a bit larger than it looks.  It covers your entire chest / stomach (above the belt) and around the sides.  It’s quite thick.  The adjustable straps make it work for most adults.  Because it has gel, I think it works a bit better than other foam only options I’ve tried.  It’s made out of “synthetic leather” (pleather) so it cleans very easily.  Ringside also offers some nice punch mitts.  Do a search for Ringside Punch Mitts, and you’ll find a few options.

title: Cook for kids and fans
text: Though this set is made more for indoor use, you still have to be careful.  The stick measure 20” and is padded.  The ball is soft and “squishy” as well.  The design / logo is nice.  The only thing is. . . You really need two sticks to be able to hit it back-and-forth and only one stick is included.  Cook for kids as well as fans of the team.

title: Ok as a "beginner" mask
text: This is an “entry level” mask.  It’s doesn’t fit as well as some of the more “high-end” Cressi masks. . . . but for what it is, it works ok.  Though it comes with a nice clear plastic case/box. .  ..the case is a bit too small for the mask.  If they had made it about a half-inch wider, the mask would fit much better.  The silicone strap is adjustable.  The silicone “skirt” is comfortable, but is not really a perfect fit for me.  This can depend upon the size / shape of your face though.

title: Comes with a nice case - Made in Italy
text:
This mask is Made in Italy and comes with a hard plastic case. One nice thing about the case, which I haven’t seen in other Cressi cases, is that there are holes in the bottom to let any excess water out. Though you can also turn it the other way around as well, and it will hold the water.

This mast offers quite large lenses. Nice viewing area. The silicone skirt is conformable. I have the all black version. Though I like it. . . . Sometimes a bit of color makes it easier to see others. The wide back head strap keeps the mask securely in place.

title: Some nice features, not found in other "generic" masks
text:
This listing is for several different masks. Though similar, some are different due to color and such. The mask I have is “blue”. Only the “frame” is blue. The rest is mostly clear.

This mask comes with a storage tub/box. This mask has more of a “glasses” look. The lenses are glass (as opposed to plastic). The lenses are nice and large. The “skirt” is silicone. This mask as multiple levels of adjustment for an overall better fit. It’s quite comfortable overall. Made in Italy.

title: Tablet required - Not included - Ages 5-10
text:
First and foremost, you need to be aware that you’ll need a tablet to use this item. Minimum requirements: Apple: iOS 10, 4.4 API Level19 “Kitkat," Kindle: FireOS 5.

This item is for kids 5 – 10-years-old. There is a 105# weight limit. It works well for kids in this age range. Though older kids / adults might like to give it a try, it’s really not recommend, as the board can be damaged.

The hope is that there will be more apps / content in the future. Still, it’s a lot of fun with what is currently offered. It gets kids up-and-moving. Great when it’s raining outside.

title: Great "Starter" Set
text: The viper Celtic blood darts are quite nice. I like the barrels a lot. They are not a knurled barrel, so they are not rough on your fingers. They feel nice in my hands and the tips are solid. The extra pieces (free parts) are always good to have on hand. Flights will chip and crack after a lot of use or bad (unlucky) toss. For the price you pay these are great to own. If you are not ready to invest over fifty bucks for a set then this would be a great starter set to move up from the cheaper darts that may have come with your board. Good set.  Made in Taiwan.

title: Some things I like even better than the 800
text:
This is your standard viper electronic dartboard. Although it does not cost as much as the viper 800 model some of the features are better with this cheaper model. The first thing that I like better about this is (vs the 800) is that you do not need to plug it into the wall. Yes, you will need to change the batteries, but you do not need to run an extension cord or be forced to install near a plug. Secondly, I like the colors better. The main thing you are missing from this board is the larger display/score board screen. One cool thing I really like about these viper electronic dartboards is the option to play against the computer. No, there is not a robot that throws for the computer, but depending on the level you allow the computer to randomly generate a turn. Large variety of games and variations. Installation instructions and hardware included. Great gift for you or someone else. Made in Taiwan.

[[ASIN:B00PHEP79S Viper 800 Electronic Soft Tip Dartboard]]

title: Classic Dartboard
text:
The dead-on viper sisal fiber dartboard is a classic dartboard that you will likely see in your local bar or pub. The spider, or the metal that separates the segments (numbers and colors), is angled on each side. Therefore, if a dart barely hits the side of the spider then it will be directed to hit the sisal fibers. The angled spider helps reduce the number of bounce backs. However, you should notice that the spider has "staples" that go over the metal bar on both sides. If you do not like this aspect of the dartboard then you can spend an extra $10-$15 bucks and upgrade to the viper spider dartboard. Either board is a great addition to your home game room or man (or woman) cave. Great board. Made in Taiwan.

[[ASIN:B000UV57DE Viper Razorback Sisal/Bristle Steel Tip Dartboard with Staple-Free Spider]]

title: Really Great Board!
text: The viper razorback dartboard is an official sisal fiber dartboard that will naturally heal itself after being hit repeatedly with darts. The board is constructed and made with care. If you only play cricket then you 15-20 and bulls eye will wear faster. No need to worry because the number ring can be turned to help extend the board life. It comes with mounting hardware and instructions for hanging on the wall. The razorback has a razor thin spider (the metal that fames out the numbers or segments). If you compare this board with the dead-on board you can see the difference. Each one is made to reduce bounce backs, but the razor gives you more target surface area. The razorback board definitely gets my vote.  Made in Taiwan.

title: Wish it included a sharpener, otherwise great set
text: This is a very nice set of darts. Although the case is not made out of expensive material with superior quality, it is a nice addition. It could close and lock better, but it does the job.  The darts are great. They are heavy enough to make you feel like you are throwing a dart and not a piece of plastic. The knurling is listed as heavy, but the grip is not rough on your fingers. I have felt some dart barrels that have so much gripped knurling it will wear on your fingertips. These have just enough grip without being overbearing. The best thing about them is that the flights are secure. The only thing that would make this set better is if they included a sharpener. Great set.  Made in Taiwan.

title: Snug and Comfortable
text: This is a very nice piece.  It fits snug, but not too tight.  Make sure you check the size chart (currently the fourth picture down on the listing) so that you order the size which will work best for you.  It’s fairly thick, but still lightweight.  It’s “tagless”, though there is heavy stitching all over.  It’s made of 80% nylon and 20% elastane.  Though the instructions show to hand wash in cold water, I have a front-load washer with a “quick wash” feature, and that works fine for me.  Made in Mexico.

title: "Started" type of item
text: I have the “blue” one, and it has very nice color to it.  But this is really more of a “toy” than something to be used in real play.  Yes, you can practice with it at home. .  .play in the yard. . .  but the ball is a bit hard.  I’m also not sure if it’s a NCAA “approved” ball.  But still. . .  To get young ones interested in the game of lacrosse, this isn’t a bad start.

title: Nice. . . Comfortable. . . Warm. . .
text: I really like this suit.  I especially like the thick zipper in the front.  Gives a more “secure” feel for me.  I have the black / azure combination (azure = teal).  It looks nice together.  Though the “azure” part on the arms is really more in the back.  It fits snug and comfortable.  Nice thickness for warmth.  This suit is Made in Cambodia.  The stitching looks to be quite good all over.

title: Works for my iPhone 6 Plus, without the case
text: I have an iPhone 6 Plus.  My phone does not fit, when I have it in the case that I use. . . but. .  .it will fit (snug) when I remove it from the case.  If you have a “regular” size phone, then it will fit without a problem.  The band, from one-end-to-the-other is 17.5”. There is some stretch to the band as well.  The height is 7”.  It’s a very nice-looking piece, and quite thin.  If there’s anything I wish it had. . . that would be reflective stripes on it for extra protection while running.

title: Embroidered numbers / letters - Nice touch
text: I found these to be a little bit nicer than I was expecting.  The numbers / letters are actually embroidered, which looks quite nice.  They are easy to attach and remove, with Velcro.  They are made out of “synthetic leather”, which I call “pleather”.  They have a nice black color.  They are Made in China, but the overall quality is fine.  Easy to clean as well.  They have a bit of an odor when you remove them from the bag, but it dissipates fairly quickly.

title: Your standard woven nylon rope. . .  I like the rubber stops
text: This tricep rope is rates for 300lbs.  It’s made of braided nylon, with rubber stops.  I like the rubber stops better than plastic or wood.  It’s 24” long.  I like just about everything about it, though I must say I think the price is a bit high being that it’s Made in China.  Nonetheless, it gets the job done.

title: Not bad for this type of paddle
text: I find that the handle on this paddles is a bit shorter than some.  The handle to the foam measures 3.75”.  The entire length of the paddle is 10” and the width is 5.75”.  It’s approximately ½” thick.  The weight is 6oz.  It comes with a nice case.  For a paddle in this league / price range, I like it.  It’s not too expensive, and a lot better than some cheap “throw-away” paddles.  It’s Made in China.

title: Wish it hat "tilt". . . but a really great rack.
text: This single bike rack has a lot of nice “bells-and-whistles”. .  ..  no frame contact.  . .integrated cable lock. . . locks to your hitch. . . fits up to 5” tires. . . and so on.  The one thing that I must say that I wish it had was “tilt”.  Several other Thule bike racks offer tilt, but not this one.  But the others are at a higher price point.  This is a single bike rack only and can not be expanded to add another bike.  Nonetheless, if you’re looking for one of the best bike racks around. . . then Thule is certainly the one!

title: Nice square protection
text: The first thing that I noticed was the warning "This product this contains chemicals known to the state of California to cause cancer, birth defects, or other reproductive harm. Wash hands after handling." Therefore, you should be aware while handling. You can smell the chemicals when you open the box. However, you should not be touching it too much anyway. If you are accurate then you will always hit the dartboard and not the backboard so you will never touch it :) This is the square one so you have more room to miss when compared to the circular one. The best part is that there is no assembly required. Just attach the pieces around the dartboard.  Made in Taiwan.

title: Nice, but it has quite a strong odor
text: This dartboard backboard is quite nice. The foam feels very thick and solid. Unless you are throwing lawn darts at this backboard then your walls will be safe. The best thing about this backboard is how easy it is to install. After you hang your actual dartboard then all you need to do is connect the 4 pieces of foam around it. No hardware or tools requires. It just grabs the board and holds on. The only concern is the smell out of the box. It smells like chemicals, similar to a new pair of shoes. There is a warning that "this product contains chemicals known to the state of California to cause cancer, birth defects, or other reproductive harm." Because of this I must give 4-stars.  Made in Taiwan.

title: Foam protector only - Dartboard not included
text: This dartboard backboard is a solid piece that is to be installed on the wall behind the actual dartboard. Therefore, the dartboard itself is installed on the backboard. You are given 4 drywall screws and 4 anchors. You will need a drill, 5/16 or 1/8 bit, measuring tape, pencil, phillips screwdriver, hammer or mallet, and a level. You will have a choice to install it as a square or diamond. The instructions give directions for each. The instructions also say you can use this behind a soft-tip dartboard, but since electronic boards vary so much this could provide some extra difficulty. I threw a dart as hard as I could and it did not penetrate all the way through. This has a very thick piece of foam over a solid piece of wood. Nice backboard.  It's Made in Taiwan, so it's currently a bit pricey for foam, but I like it.

title: About the size of an egg. . . And it works!!
text: These phone chargers are good item to have as a backup in an emergency, but you will need to make sure it is charged before you really need it. It comes with a retractable charging cord. Another good feature, is that it has 2 USB ports so you could charge to devices at once. It took about 4 hours to charge when plugged into the wall, and slightly longer when I used the computer. After the first charge the football seems to charge up faster. There is a light that will stay red when it is still charging and then it will eventually turn blue when it is finished. You need to make sure you hit the small button in the middle to turn it on. When you are using the football to charge the red light will flash to let you know the power is low and it is about to stop charging your phone/device. I was able to charge an iPhone from 6% to 100% and then a Samsung galaxy from 0% to 68% all in one football charge. It charges at a rate of about 2% per minute. I really like that it charges your phone very fast, but I was hoping to get two full phone charges out of one single football charge. The speed makes up for it, so I am pleased.  Made in China.

title: There is a less expensive option, but they are not real leather - See review
text:
First of all. . . . If you’re looking for a less expensive option, then Rawlings offers a bucket of 24-balls currently at less than half the price of this option. . . but. . . the main difference is that the less expensive balls are synthetic leather and not real leather. But if you don’t mind that, and want to save a few bucks, then I’ve added the link below.

This is a nice bucket-o-balls. They have different logos on them, but they work great for practice. As they are real leather balls, they should also last a good long time. Having the bucket is nice too. You can add additional balls to the bucket, as you wish, as it’s quite large and not completely full with the 24-balls included.

[[ASIN:B0015CFUZW Rawlings Official League Recreational Bucket, Bucket with 24 Baseballs, OLB3BUCK24]]

title: Check the color size combinations
text: I thought these shin guards were a little “thin”, in the beginning, but they actually do the job better than expected.  The wrap-around neoprene holds well, though it can be a little hot.  After selecting your size, make sure you check-out the different color options, as the price can change based upon the color you select.  If you’re not stuck on one color, then you can simply purchase the least expensive option, as they are exactly the same, other than the color.  They are made from imitation leather (pleather) and though they will not last as long as “real” leather, I think they will last a good while.

title: Really nice padding
text: The gloves have a nice look / feel to them.  The foam inside these gloves is “injected” so that the foam goes around the hand and gives more protection overall.  There is a thicker layer of foam this way.  These are lace-up gloves.  They are made of synthetic / imitation leather (what I call “pleather”).  The cost is determined by the color size, so make sure you check them all for the best overall price.

title: Check the color options / pricing
text:
Currently, the price of this item is determined by the color combination, so if you don’t mind one color combination over another, then you might just purchase whichever is the least expensive, as they are all the same, other than the color combination.

These mitts offer good padding. They fit fine, for my adult hands. They are “pleather” (synthetic leather). The seam to be fairly durable. They are slightly smaller in size than some other options, but the size is still fine for me.

title: Better than expected.  Quite a nice bag
text: I was quite surprised by this bag.  It’s quite nice. . . quite lightweight.  . .quite durable. .  .The traps are quite comfortable.  The stand works well too.  Multiple zipper pockets for all of your “stuff”.  I like that there is a nice “easy grip” handle on the top as well.  Makes it very easy to pick-up to take in/out of my car and elsewhere.  I like the black color, but the blue accent parts gives it a nice look as well.

title: Logo Only - No writing
text: This V neck shirt is good for game days. I wear it with leggings, shirt, or shorts and it looks great. This is a simple shirt that is easy to wear and will go with pretty much anything. One thing I really like about this shirt is the logo. The logo is a simple blue outline of a panther roaring. I would like to mention that this shirt does not say "panthers" or "Carolina" anywhere on it. The panther is the only thing on the shirt that is related to the Carolina Panthers.  Made in Honduras.

title: Distressed / Worn / Vintage Look
text: This is a great women's game day shirt to represent the Falcons. I am 5'2 and about 115 pounds and the size small fits great. It is comfortable and slightly roomy but not loose. This shirt washes and dries well. I really like that the material is 100% cotton. I also like the "distressed" look of this shirt and that it is black. It goes with pretty much anything. I would definitely recommend this shirt.

title: Nice, if you don't mind the extra weight of glass
text: This glass bottle is unique and durable. I like that this bottle is made of durable glass with a silicone protective cover. It is BPA free and contains no plastic. The lid is made of stainless steel with a silicone cover. The spout that you drink out of is round and has a lot of room. It would be a good idea to be careful when taking sips so you don't spill. I would also say that the bottle is very heavy so I would caution against carrying it around for long periods of time. I keep it at my desk at work.

title: It's nice. . . but. . . I really don't like that it's Made in China
text: The American flag TableTopit comes in a plastic non-resealable bag. It fits a 6 foot rectangular table very well. It is very well-made. The elastic bands are easy to put in place and holds the top down securely. There is no need to put anything else down or on the table top to keep it in place. The finish on the material makes water bead up on it.  If something is spilled on it, you can easily wipe it up. It states it is machine washable and wrinkle free. When it came out of the wash, I just hung it up to dry because  I did not see any directions stating whether or not it can be put in the dryer.  This is a good product for indoors because it is easy, and it is great for outdoors especially if the wind is blowing.  I must admit. .  . .The worst thing about this American Flag tablecloth. . . . is that it's Made in China. :-(

title: Not just for golf
text: If you’re looking for a backpack / tote which is specifically for golf. . . this is it.  Though to be honest, there is not a lot which really makes this a “golf-specific” item, other than a place for tees.  There is a clip on the back, so you can attach it to a bag or something else as well.  It’s a nice, medium size.  Not too bulky.  There are several pockets for bottles. . phone. . . other assorted items.  The basic black color works nicely

title: Reasonable "youth" glove
text:
I don’t show it listed anywhere . . . if this is supposed to be a “youth” or “adult” glove. I have the 12” and it does not come close to fitting my “adult” hand. I can only assume that it’s really more of a “youth” glove.

Though it shows that no break-in is required. . .It’s still a little stiff. It’s “pleather” (imitation leather) and has a very nice, dark, black color. It’s Made in Vietnam, and overall the craftsmanship is fine, for what it is. There is some fairly nice padding on the inside, and the thumb is adjustable for a snug fit.

title: Rich color. .  .Made in Honduras
text: This is a “V-Neck” shirt, and the neck is a bit wider than some of the other OTS tee-shirts.  So it comes down a little lower.  It’s 100% cotton, and made in Honduras.  I have the Indianapolis Colts shirt, and it is a nice, right blue.  The horseshoe is that kind of “rubbery” material, so you’ll want to make sure you don’t leave it in the dryer too long, and at a low temp.  The shirt is a little thin.  It’s “tagless” with print in the neck area.  A bit form-fitting.

title: It's "Vintage" / Distressed. . . Made to look worn
text: If you don’t read closely. . . You might miss the fact that this is a DISTRESSED tee-shirt.  The logo looks vintage / worn / old.  It’s supposed to look that way!  Hahahaha  If you don’t know that beforehand, then you might think something is wrong with this shirt. . . but . .  there’s not.  It’s Made in Honduras.  Though it’s “tagless”, there is some print in the neck area.  It’s 100% cotton, so you’ll want to be careful and not leave it in the dryer too long.

title: Make sure you read., . . DISTRESSED Tee. .  .It's supposed to look old/used/vintage
text: Make sure you know that this is supposed to be a “distressed” tee.  So it’s supposed to look old / used. . . and it does.  Some might call it a “vintage” look.  Several reviews have noted “bad logos”. .  . I don’t really think that’s the case.  I just don’t think they read the listing to see that this is a “DISTRESSED” tee.  If you know what to expect. . . and this is what you’re looking for. . . then it’s fine.  The neck is a bit too wide.  The tee is 100% cotton, so expect shrinkage, especially if you leave it in the dryer very long.  Made in Honduras.

title: Bad logo. .  .crazy expensive
text: This is a “V-Neck” t-shirt, but it’s not a “plunging” sort of “V-Neck”.  You’re “fully covered” with this t-shirt!  ;-)  I have the New Orleans Saints shirt. . . and it’s not good, for several reasons.  First, the logo is very small.  Second, the logo is not “solid”.  There are “specks” in the logo.  Third, the logo is not dark enough.  Fourth, the logo is make out of that “rubbery” substance that will crack / melt in the dryer.  Fifth, this shirt is thin.  Last. . . but not least. . . This shirt is Made in Honduras, so at the current price of twenty-eight bucks, it’s out-of-sight expensive.

title: High in price, but otherwise a decent tee
text: This crazy expensive tee is Made in Honduras.  The deep purple and orange are very nice.  It’s rather form-fitting.  It’s made of 100% cotton, so expect some shrinkage.  It’s more-or-less “tagless”, but there is printing at the neck which is ever so slightly rough, but not bad.  This is a V-Neck teen, but not a “deep” V-Neck.  The tee is rather thin as well.  There is nothing really “wrong” with this tee. . . I just think it’s a bit pricey.

title: To go with your Viper 800 Electronic Soft Tip Dartboard
text:
The viper sidewinder soft tip darts are a great set of darts for any electronic dartboard. If you have purchased the viper 800 electronic soft tip dartboard then at some point you will want to upgrade to a nicer set of darts. The darts that are given are very basic. The sidewinders feel great in your hand. The shafts have a softer smooth feel to them. Some dart shafts feel like metal sandpaper. These have grip, but not like sandpaper. Nice set of soft tip darts. Made in Taiwan.

[[ASIN:B00PHEP79S Viper 800 Electronic Soft Tip Dartboard]]

title: Lots of advantages over a cork dartboard
text: The viper 800 electronic dartboard will be a favorite for any game room or man cave. You may be inclined to purchase a real dartboard, but you should consider some of the advantages that come with an electronic. The best thing is that the board will keep score for you. No need to have a chalk board and a dusty mess when you want to toss some darts. You also will not have to worry about all those holes in the drywall or installing some extra protection from those stray shots you fire off after too many drinks. Also, the viper 800 arrives with the knowledge of over 50 games and even more variations. Some games allow up to 16 players! You will need to have access to a power source. Not battery operated. The instruction booklet gives information on each game and describes how to play. You will need a tape measure, tail or marker, screwdriver, and level to hang the board on the wall. It comes with a 6 flights (3 red 3 blue), 7 shafts, and many tips. If you want to upgrade your darts then you should consider the viper sidewinder soft tip 18 gram darts.  Made in Taiwan.

title: One of a few golf toss options offered by Franklin Sports
text: Franklin Sports actually makes a few of these Golf Toss sets.  If you do a search for Franklin Golf Toss, you will find them all.  They are similar, but each is made a little differently.  The poles on the bottom of this set are a little longer for better stability.  It’s very easy to set-up.  Easy to take along when traveling.  Not too heavy.  Made in China.  The difficulty level is not only determined by which level you shoot for, but also the distance away.  The further away, the more challenging.  Great for all ages, so it’s a nice family game.

title: Super smart looking / Very lightweight
text: This is a super lightweight jacket.  It’s 100% polyester fill.  It washes well, but if you place it in the dryer, you’ll want to use a very low setting.  It’s Made in Vietnam.  There are side pockets.  Works great for chilly days, and also for layering.  There is a zipper all the way up the front. . . and a carrying bag, so you can roll it up and place it in a backpack. The label in the neck even has a line for the child’s name!

title: Fun for all ages / skill levels
text: I think this game is more challenging than it looks.  The further back you stand. . . the more challenging it becomes.  Because of that, it’s easily “adjustable” based upon age / skill level of the players.  This is certainly not a “heavy duty” sort of item, but it doesn’t really need to be.  The “feet” on the bottom and included stakes keep it sturdy enough.  Easy set-up and break-down.  Made in China.  Fun for all ages.

title: There are better options if you don't need the collapsible / travel part
text: At 3.5#, this is a very lightweight batting tee. It’s collapsible, and fits inside a bag easily.  The tripod gives it a little more stability.  The cup on the top fits different ball sizes.  Adjustable height.  But. . . . Overall. . . It has a “cheap” look / feel.  I just don’t know if it’s really going to last.  If you don’t need the collapsible / travel part. . . then there are other, more “sturdy” tees available.  But if you’re not going to use this one on a constant basis, then hopefully it will last long enough.

title: Super Colorful Balls
text: Made in Taiwan. I’m not a great golfer, so I don’t need to pay for a great ball. These are apparently made by Callaway, according to printing on box end. Colors are medium blue, green, neon yellow and neon orange. Colors make balls easy to see for those of us who spend a lot of time looking for balls. When you aren’t great at golf, honestly, it’s not easy for me to tell the difference in quality anyway. Yes, they feel a little hard, but it may be the subliminal thing from reading other reviews. Just being honest. These balls work fine for me. Five stars for value versus quality.

title: Good when you compare price to quality
text: Made in Taiwan. The packaging and logo on balls make me wonder if they were’t designed by the same people that do WWE wrestling, but I don’t necessarily buy balls for the packaging and logo. With that, these balls seem to be of good quality and feel. Do they go far? Well, I’m not a great golfer, so I wouldn’t necessarily be a good judge, but they do as well as any I’ve used. With the fist logo, they should be pretty easy to differentiate from other balls on the course, at least until and unless they get more popular. They’re made by Callaway, so I assume they’ll be good quality. Five stars for cost versus quality

title: For younger kits, it's fine.  Not for teens / adults
text: If you remember playing tetherball on the playground. . . with a very sturdy pole. . . and firm ball on a strong rope. . . that you would really give a good wallop. .  .. then that’s not this item.  If you’re looking for a “basic” tetherball set, especially for younger kids, then this can work.  You need some firm ground to anchor the pole into.  “Soft” soil will not work.  It’s really not a bad set, as long as you know what you’re getting, and in the right setting.  But again, this really is not an “adult” item, or really even a “teen” item.

title: Nice set-up
text: This shaker cup is very sturdy and great for taking on workouts or just taking out and about or to work.  The shaker in the cup is does a good job mixing up shakes. The mouthpiece is kind of hard, I wish it was a little softer. My favorite part of this shaker cup is the storage compartment on the bottom. It is built right into the cup and is easy to take on and off. It is the perfect size for storing powered mixes.  Made in China.

title: Gotta Have It
text: This is a marmot 2 person tent footprint. It measures about 81 by 91 inches. This footprint is used to be placed underneath your tent when you are camping. It adds an extra barrier between the bottom of your tent and the ground. If you are camping on rough terrain then this will help prevent the base of your tent from ripping. Over time when your tent is pitched on top of small rocks or other items that are sharp and rough the base will slowly start to degrade. Each corner has a clip that will snap onto the corners of a two person tent, but the tent must have the male ends that will connect with the footprint. Each of the corner straps have holes so you can use tent poles to hammer them into the ground.

title: Sleeves are a bit long
text: This is a soft 100% cotton Kansas Jayhawks long sleeve t shirt. The colors are right on for the Jayhawks and the shirt is very soft. The only thing I would comment on is the sizing of the medium. The sleeve is about 27 inches long when measured from the top of the shoulder where the sleeve hem starts down to the base of the sleeve. In my opinion the sleeves are too long and feel like they should be on a large sized shirt. The body of the shirt fits right for a medium. If you do not mind a little extra sleeve length or you have very long arms then this is a good shirt for you.  Made in Honduras.

title: Soft. . . Thick Padding. . . Comfortable. . . Warm. . . .
text: The OTS Kansas City Chief sock is very comfortable. They have an extra thick padded foot that you can really feel on the bottom when you are walking around. In addition to the thick padding, they are very soft.  From the tip of the toe to the back of the heel they measure about 9 inches, and from the ankle to the top measures about 7 inches. If you are looking for a warm sock to wear to the game to tailgate, or just a soft cushioned sock to wear around the house then these would be a good option.  Made in China.

title: You'll be deligted with these darts!
text: If you enjoy playing darts then you really need to consider owning your own set of darts. Unless you or your friend/family own a dart board then you are likely to play using borrowed darts from the bar. The darts that are provided there are usually VERY cheap. Get yourself a set of these viper steel tip darts with an 80% tungsten barrel and you will be delighted. The grips are amazing. At 24 grams you will also be able to feel them in your hand, especially compared to a cheap 10 gram dart. It comes with an extra set of flights, shafts, and a wrench just in case something breaks.  Made in Taiwan.

title: Fits like a glove. . . as it should
text: This is the type of shirt one would wear out to wakeboard, water ski, or maybe kite surfing. It fits very tight on the body. If you normally wear a large size cotton t shirt that feels loose on your body then the large size of this Cressi shirt will hug you very tight around your body and arms. It is rated UPF 40+ to help keep you from getting burned by the sun without having to constantly apply sunscreen. It is made out of 80% nylon and 20% spandex and thus the fabric will dry very fast and help prevent your skin from becoming irritated.  Made in Mexico.

title: Expensive. .  and NOT made in the USA
text: The “patch” on the center is about a quarter-inch in thickness.  It measures about 6X7”, including the stitching.  Though I think this is an important piece of equipment to have. . . I think the current price starting at over sixty bucks is super crazy expensive.  FYI. . . The current listing show 100% made in the USA. . .  WRONG!  The items shows that it’s “Assembled in the Dominican Republic from US and foreign materials”.

title: Slick on the outside.  . .Fleece on the inside
text:
This hoodie has the Huntworth logo, stitched in pink, on the upper left, which does not show in the example pictured.

This is a pullover hoodie with a short 6” (plastic) zipper on the front. The wrists are nice and comfortable, not too tight. This item is very slick on the outside. Soft fleece on the inside. Large “kangaroo” pocket in the front. Made in China. Overall a nice hoodie.

title: takes some  getting used to
text: This certainly gets some getting used to wearing.  But safety first, so you have to grin and bear it.  You’ll want to wear it a lot to get used to it.  It’s quite snug, so it doesn’t slip-and-slide on your arm.  It’s fairly comfortable for what it is.  Note this is for one pad only.  It’s fairly lightweight as well.

title: Crazy expensive for Made in China.
text: This is a classic NFL Houston Texans sweatshirt. It is very soft on the inside and outside. Since it is a women’s size sweatshirt it is not super large. If you typically wear a small or medium, and you plan to wear multiple layers under the sweatshirt then a Large might be the right size for you. Or if you prefer to have it a bit looser for lounging around the house then you could go up a size without feeling like you are drowning inside. The big pocket in the front is also very nice. You can stash a book inside or just link your hands together to keep them warm. The logo is also simple and clean. Nothing too loud or gaudy. Fresh and simple. Nice.  It’s Made In China, so at the current price of fifty bucks, it’s crazy expensive.  You’re obviously paying a lot extra for the “official” logo.

title: Soft & Comfy
text: This t-shirt is made of 100% soft cotton. I really like this shirt because it is so soft and it is thin and cool for a hot game day. The neck is a scoop neck, but the "scoop" does not come down too low so it is not very revealing. The shirt is a very dark navy and the Virginia logo is a bright Orange that has a slight distressed look. The Virginia logo is very bright and stands out nicely against the dark navy background. I would recommend this shirt because overall it is a very comfortable shirt that is really soft.  Made in Guatemala.

title: Extra Long - Not USGA
text: This is a good driver that is not too expensive to add to your golf bag. I do not see any imperfections and appears to be made well. It is not real heavy and easy to swing. It is too long for official USGA, but I doubt your friends and local golf sharks are measuring. Use it to get some extra distance until you prefect your swing and move down to an official sized club. The grip is circular, not real sticky, feels good in your hands, and it has a length of about 10.25 inches. From the top of the handle to the base it measures about 46 inches. It comes with a blue cover to match the club.  Made in China.

title: Compact and comfortable.
text: This is a very nice pack for when you need to separate multiple items while camping, hiking, or traveling via plane train or automobile. If you are carrying a lot of weight then you can take advantage of the two straps that will cross the front of your body for extra support. It comes with a hard plastic insert in the very back that will keep the section that will touch your back straight and flat. This insert is rigid and sturdy, but the outside of the pack that touches your back has multiple cushions for comfort. It has two main zippered compartments. The smaller one has 3 separate slots. The larger has 2 deeper long slots, but they are not that wide. The best feature is the handle that is on the center of the front of the bag so you can carry it like a duffel bag. It has multiple loops for clipping items. Good pack.  Made in China.

title: Safety First!
text: The pro sternum shirt is true to its advertising selling points. The shirt is very soft, flexible, and lightweight. If the sternum chest support was not attached you would barely know you are wearing this shirt. The sternum support is also flexible. The padding feels like it is made out of an ultra-thick memory foam. If you press rally hard on the pads you can see them compress down and when you release the pressure you can watch the pad return to its original equilibrium position. I will not risk injury by actually taking shots to the chest, but from what I can see it will definitely lighten the blow. There have been occasions where a hard blow to the chest has caused a person's heart to stop and send them into cardiac arrest. Your health and safety should not be taken lightly.  Made in the Dominican Republic of US and foreign materials.

title: Pricey for Made in China.
text: This sweatshirt is made out of 60% cotton and 40% polyester. While flat on the floor, the large size measures about 22.5 inches from the bottom up to the collar and measures almost 20 inches across the middle of the body as measured from right above the pocket. It has a decent amount of stretch all over. The drawstring for the hood might need to be knotted up more because it could easily slip into the tunnel as it is. The inside is soft, but not the softest I have ever felt.  Made in China, so it’s quite expensive at the current going rate of forty-five bucks and up.

title: Cook Hat
text: This is a classic camo aka "real tree" NFL hat. The piece in the back to adjust the size is a simple the part threading like you would see on a backpack. Some hats have a clasp that snaps open to adjust and then down to hold the sizing in place, but not this one. There is a cut right next to the adjustable strap that you can use to feed the extra slack inside so it is not loose in the back. The strap measures almost 6.5 inches long. From the base of the hat to the top measures slightly over 5 inches. The embroidered logo is nice and I do not see any imperfections. All 6 panels are made out of the same material and there is not extra sturdy piece on the front two panels. All panels flex the same with the exception of the small area that is directly under the Viking logo. Made in Vietnam.

title: Nice!
text: This is your standard Houston Texans football team hat made by OTS all-star. It is a one size fits all hat with a Velcro adjustable strap in the back. Each of the Velcro straps measure about 3 inches long. The hat as it sits on your head is what I would say average height. If you like a hat that sits down close to your ears then this one may not be tall enough for you. It measures just under 5 inches from the base of the hat to the top. The stitching is good, and I see no spots where it is falling apart. The logo is also very smooth with no flaws. The hat is made out of 6 panels. The front two panels that have the logo are braced with a sturdy piece a material to keep the hat from bending. The back 4 panels are fabric and have more freedom to move.  Made in Vietnam.

title: Crazy Expensive for Made in China. . . But I like it.
text: This hoody is soft and comfortable. It is perfect for the fall and winter. I usually wear a size small, but I got this in a large and it fits great. I wanted a looser fit so that I could wear thicker t shirts under it if I wanted to. But it does not swallow me. It fits like a normal sweatshirt should. I especially like the "A" logo across the chest because it is substantial size and really is the focal point of the hoody. The pocket pouch on the front adds to the coziness of this hoody. The fleece on the inside is warm and soft. If you are looking for a warm, comfortable hoody to represent the Crimson Tide, this is for you.  It’s Made in China, so at the current price of fifty bucks, it’s beyond crazy expensive. . . but I still like it.

title: Super thin and oh so pricey, especially for Made in Vietnam
text: This is a super lightweight shirt.  It’s made of a very thin mesh material.  It’s certainly a warmer weather sort of shirt, unless you’re wearing it as camouflage over something warmer.  Huntworth calls this “disruption camouflage”.  Others have called it “digital” or “pixilated” camouflage.  It’s chemically treated for scent control.  It’s 100% polyester.  It’s Made in Vietnam, so at the current price of thirty-five bucks for such a shirt, it’s crazy expensive.  If it were less than half the current price, then I would like it more.

title: Nice gloves, but crazy expensive for Made in China.
text: These gloves are not only nice for hunting, but also for everyday.  Not really the type of gloves to use in the snow that. . .  but that’s not what they are for anyway.  They are quite soft and form-fitting.  My only real “issue” with these gloves would be the current price.  At forty-five bucks for Made in China, they are crazy expensive.  This same company (and others) offer similar youth gloves at a much better pricepoint.

title: Check the writing on front - Not the same on each hat
text: This is a “reely” neat hat with a picture of a reel on the front. The blue string that is on top of the bill is not “reel” tight so there is a chance it can flip up over the top. The hat is about 4.5 inches tall measured from the base up to the top tip. The bill arrived flat so if you like a flat bill then it should arrive flat. If you like to curve your bill then it is capable of being curved to your liking. The fabric is also very light and thin with a lot of move a flexibility. It is not rigid like a baseball hat might be. It is made with the understanding that you might be outside in the heat and under the sun. Nice hat.  It’s Made in Mexico, so at the current price of twenty-nine bucks, I think it’s quite expensive.

title: Add a little "flair"
text: First thing you should note is that this scoreboard does not actually keep score. It is a lighted board that comes with grease pencil for you to write. With that said, the board is pretty nice. The white parts (Cricket, 20,...3B) of the board light up brighter than I expected which are on a clear piece of plastic. The pencil markings do not glow as much as the pictures, but it is still not that bad. You will want to dull the pencil down so that you have thick broad stokes to make it easier to see. It comes with mounting screws and drywall anchors which are stored in the battery compartment. The grease pencil markings wipe off easily with a dry cloth. If you do not like the dust from a chalk board, and want to add a little flare (light) to your scoreboard then this would be for you.  Made in Taiwan.

title: I like it, but the current price is crazy expensive for Made in China.
text: Though this three-pocket detachable bag certainly comes in handy, it’s currently priced out-of-this-world at over sixteen bucks for Made in China.  It could not have cost more than a buck or two to make.  It reminds me of some pencil pouches for school.  As a matter of fact, it could come in handy for students as well.  Each pocket has a different depth.  The top one, which is the largest, is also lined with a soft, somewhat like felt, material.  The size is just under 8.5 X 6”.

title: Should last a season
text: This youth equipment rolls-up to be quite small, so it’s easy to put away.  But then it unrolls easily to take on-the-go.  It’s made out of fairly heavy / stiff canvas.  The zippers are not quite as heavy as I would like, but they work.  Not sure that you’ll get more than a season or two out of it, but overall it works.  It offers both a shoulder strap and handles on top.

title: IT works, but too expensive for Made in China.
text: I’ve used a couple of these tools, and this one is more “heavy duty” than the others that I’ve tried.  Certainly not something that’s going to break.  There is a little chain on the end, so you can attach it to your bag.  It’s Made in China, so at the current price of almost twenty bucks, it’s really crazy expensive.  The plastic ball markers don’t add more than two cents to the value.  I would like it more if it were more reasonably priced at around five bucks.

title: Ok but overpriced
text: This is a crazy expensive Made in China ball.  Though you could play with it in the street. . .  you’re certainly going to scruff-up the logo if you do.  So it’s really better as just a souvenir item or to toss around. It’s a bit “squishy” and kick and toss around inside.  But again, it’s crazy expensive at the current price of over eleven bucks, for something that cost pennies to make in China.

title: Comfortable Gloves
text: This pair of gloves have a very good feel. The two different materials used to make the gloves are both soft. The palms and inside of the fingers are a felt or leather like material.  This is to help with gripping and to keep your hands from getting scuffed if you have to catch a fall with palm of your hands. The backs of the hands are neoprene.  The fit is great for my hands. To give you an idea on the length, the large size has a middle finger measurement from the tip to the start of the palm of 3.25 inches. They are Made in China.

title: Could be better
text: I’ll admit that I’ve never owned a full-blown trainer watch before, so the only thing I have to compare to is a Fitbit Charge2 fitness tracker. They’re really two different kinds of watches, although they have some similar features. First, and I’m not really comparing to the Fitbit, I found the Suunto a little heavy, at 67 grams or 2.36 ounces. I’m not sure how that compares to other similar watches. I do, however, think I’ll get used to it. One of the main initial conclusions is that, while the buttons on the watch are fairly intuitive, trying to learn about the detailed features was not that easy. I want to the website and it was just a difficult experience trying to get to the info. I didn’t find a way to get a PDF downloaded for offline use, although there may be one. Conclusion on ease of website use is, it’s not easy to use. There’s a lot of info there, but it’s not that easy to get to the User Manual that you need, and once there, I really didn’t think the explanations were that easy to understand. The Movescount app wasn’t that much better. Although I set the Units to “Imperial” I still can’t get the Activity distance measurements off of Km  and onto miles. I like the alerts from phone to watch such as text messages. I don’t like the fact that, while this is a Heart Rate watch, you can’t seem to see HR on the watch unless you’re in an Activity mode. But when you are, the real time graph thing is pretty cool. I think that this watch will do a lot of things. I just don’t think it’s the most user-friendly total package that it could be.

title: Doesn't take up much room.  Simple mat that works
text: This is a nice portable putting mat that can be easily transported to a work office, or home office, or to use in a hotel room. It works great and the bottom is cover in foam and feels more like carpet than turf. It rolls out nice and flat and is very convenient to use. The end area is raised for an extra challenge.  It has cut-out area in the back to catch any wondering balls. It feels and looks like a mat of much higher quality. When you are finished, it can be easily rolled back up stored in a closet or any space that doesn’t need a lot of room. This gives the avid golfer the opportunity to practice even when the weather is wet, cold, and just generally undesirable.  Made in China

title: Crazy expensive for Made in China. . . but I like it
text: This is an excellent lock. At 1.5 lbs, it comes in considerably lighter than other locks that would be of similar security, like a U-lock. The fact that it folds so compactly is fantastic. It comes with a mount that can be attached to a water bottle mount on the bike for convenient transport. I’ve heard it said it folds up to the size of a water bottle. Actually, it folds up to about half the size of most water bottles. The strength and security of the lock are such that I’d be very confident of its performance in most circumstances.  Made in China, so at the current price of over fifty-eight bucks. . . it’s crazy expensive, but it’s a very cool lock.  Also. . . I have NO idea why they don’t list this as a bike lock in the title.

title: Super portable
text: This stability cushion provides many benefits. After I had my first child, I was looking to regain core strength and stability. This cushion is very helpful in this effort. I can use it anywhere in the house because it is compact and easy to take around with me. I can store it easily, especially if it is deflated. This cushion takes very little time to inflate. It comes with a pump and pin for inflation. Using this product has given me more energy and is helping to tone my body.  Made in China.

title: Comfortable jacket
text: This parka is a very good winter coat to have. It comes to about knee length on me (I am 5’2). The arms are just a little long on me. The coat is  loose fitting and goes over winter clothing comfortably. The coat has a hood that has a bill that can be flipped out or you can leave it buttoned down. The front zips up and there are also buttons that come over the zipper. This coat also features a drawstring around the waist and around the bottom hem of the coat and another drawstring for the hood. This coat is not too thick but it provides warmth. I have the “Brunette Brown” color but it is more like a camel color. It goes well with pretty much everything that I wear.  It’s Made in China, so I think the current price of over two-hundred bucks is quite excessive, but I really like it.

title: "Basic" weight set
text: This is a descent weight set. The first thing I noticed was that the 40 pound weight set includes the weight of the case. The breakdown is as follows: the bars (2 total) at 2.7 lbs each, the collars (4 total) at 0.5 lbs each, 5 lb weight disks (4 total), 2.5 lbs weight disks (4 total), and one case at 2.6 lbs. The collars spin on with ease. You could spin them hard and they will keep spinning through a few rotations. The one thing you should really be aware of is that the rubber washers on the bars are very loose. They will fall off without much effort at all so you need to be careful or you will lose them. You should also note that you have to take the collar off each time you want to adjust the weight. I am fine with all of this, but there is one thing I would change and that is the case. You have to take everything apart to put the items back in the case.  Overall, it is not bad. It definitely gets the job done.

title: Letters offered that work well with these decals - See review
text:
RoomMates offers lots of decals with different animals. If these are not to your liking, then you can simply search for RoomMates Animals and find more options.

If you would like letters to go with these animals. . . RoomMates offers that too. See the link below.

There are a total of thirty-six African animal decals in this collection. Made in the USA. They work with almost any smooth surface. But they don’t work on rough surfaces, such as brick, stucco and the like.

[[ASIN:B072WPTNGN RoomMates RMK3492SCS Tribal Alphabet Peel and Stick Wall Decals]]

title: Get off to a good start with these clubs
text: Your child’s first swing should be with the ORLIMAR ATS white and pink iron. It is light, flexible, and is ideal for first-time golfers and is tailored more to height, not age. The oversized head expands the hitting area for the ultimate in forgiveness. The molded training grip reinforces proper hand position, promoting a more natural swing. It helps to establish solid fundamentals of golf and makes hitting good shots easier. Flexible composite shaft helps increase swing speed for greater power. The white with pink trim makes for a very nice color combination. This iron usually works for 5-8 year olds that are 44” to 52” tall.  Nice starter iron and for a great price.  Made in China.

title: Nice clubs to start with
text: This is a great inexpensive way to get a child interested in playing golf an iron without investing your entire 401K and still be far superior to the basic beginner clubs. This lightweight iron with a flexible composite shaft promotes a high launch toward the green. This is a great way to prepare your youngster for fun on the golf course or in the yard. It has a nice rubber grip and the 5-8 year old size is suitable for children 3.8’ to 4.4’ tall. It comes in a beautiful cobalt color with lime strips. Nice clubs and a great price.  Made in China.

title: Great "starter" clubs
text: This club is designed to inspire the beginner to have fun and develop a great swing.  This iron is a step above beginners but would still be one to learn and practice with. It has a smaller rubber grip that is appropriate for 9-12 year old girls and the colors are fun and nice. This club will help kids progress from beginners to competition golf. It is made with high quality flexible composite shaft. This is a great way to provide fun and learning at the same time. The painted white shaft with sky blue trim is adorable and is a great start for a new golfer.  Made in China.

title: Nice but really overpriced.
text: If you are looking to backpack, need a pillow, do not have much room, and are trying to limit the amount of space and weight then this pillow is for you.  Super lightweight. Great not only for camping, but road trips, etc.  The pillow itself is very nice. It does a great job holding your head and giving you support. It is also very very soft. It feels better than some pillowcases I have had to use. It’s Made in Taiwan. . . . so at the current price of thirty-five bucks. . . it’s crazy expensive.

title: "Unusual", but really nice Bike Lock
text: This is a very nifty bike lock. It comes with a sheath that you can Velcro onto the frame of your bike. When the lock is not in use then you store it in the sheath, and it is very easy to take out the lock when you need to secure your bike. The only thing I am concerned about is if the lock will not stay inside the sheath after it gets older and time passes. It comes with two keys, but it would be really nice if they included a third key. That way you could keep one on your keychain, store one at home, and store one at work or wherever you ride and park the most. The entire lock is covered with a plastic or silicone type material so when it hits your bike it will prevent it from denting or chipping the paint. It will take some time to get used to the way it opens and unfolds if you are used to a loose rope chain type lock. The best part about this lock is the solid steel bar used to link the entire lock together. If you are worried about a thief cutting the lock off then this would be the way to go. If I were a thief and I saw this lock on a bike I would just keep on walking....I like it a lot.  Made in Germany.

title: Bike Lock
text:
First of all, this company really should say right in the product name that this is a BIKE LOCK. Nowhere in the listing at all does it say BIKE LOCK.

This bike lock and chain will definitely get the job done. The best thing about this set is that it comes with three keys. Of course you would expect to get two keys, but the third one allows you to keep on safely hidden at home or at work. If three people are sharing the bike then the third key is almost a must have. The lock mechanism is solid and it has a very soft barrier around it so if it happens to fall and hit your bike it will not dent and scratch easily. The chain is also covered in nylon to keep the chain from damaging your bike too. This one is listed as a level 6 security. The chain inside the nylon feels thick, but it is only a single link. Maybe if you move up to a higher level the chain links will double. With a single link it only takes one snap with the bolt cutters to drive off with your bike. Made in China.

title: Bag only - See review for bag with clubs option
text:
This bag, which is Made in China, comes in both blue and pink. This is the option of the bag without the clubs. . . but. . . Orlimar also offers the bag along with five clubs, if you prefer to purchase a complete set. See the link below. The overall quality for this sort of bag is fine. This is a “real” golf bag. You’ll find flimsy fabric ones, but this is the “real deal”.

[[ASIN:B07215SF1S Orlimar Golf ATS Junior Girl's Sky Blue Kids Golf Set (Right Hand Ages 9-12) (Sky Blue)]]

title: Nice overall young  boy's bag
text: This is a great looking bag that has design qualities and features of much more expensive and advanced players. It has the same number of compartments and storage pockets that you would normally find in an adult bag. The color is bright and vibrant and would accommodate a boy or a girl. The legs come out easily and keep the bag standing up. It has straps on it like a backpack that makes it easy to transport and walk on the golf course.  It is very sturdy and just a smaller version of an adult bag. The zippers work nicely and are well made. This is a nice bag and will easily meet the needs of the up and coming golfer. Made in China

title: When you're golfing on-the-go
text: The more you golf, the more you understand the importance of owning a reliable travel bag for your clubs. It doesn’t matter if you are an amateur player who might enjoy hitting the links during a vacation, or one that makes it a point to compete in several tournaments a year, either way, an appropriate travel bag becomes a must. This travel bag is made out of some type of polyester, nylon, or other type of durable material that weighs fewer than 10 lbs, which renders it easier to haul on your shoulder.  This fabric bag is also more flexible than their hard-shell counterparts, and they are designed with an array of compartments, which is great for accessing minor items on the go. This bag is reinforced on the bottom and has wheels making transporting a breeze. It comes with a crossbar that helps protect your clubs and collapses when not in use for easy storage. This bag will accommodate tees, balls, and other handheld items. This travel bag keeps out dust and dirt, holds most standard sized golf bags, and has a budget-friendly price. Made in China

title: Compact Set
text: This is a solid set of resistance bands. The best thing about them is that they come with instructions and the option to read more online and watch videos. If you are not used to or have never used bands like this then you should check out the videos. Otherwise, you should be fine with the printed instructions. The bands themselves are very soft. They do not pinch or rip your skin when you are using them directly on your skin. However, if you use them a lot then they could give you a rash or a sore if you are not careful. You can easily tell the strength of the band by looking at the thickness. So you do not need to remember what color is what. It would be nice if they printed the approximate tension on the bands. Overall, good set.  They all fit in a very small pouch, so they travel really well. . . . You can also keep them in the office. . . or just about anywhere.

title: Crazy expensive for Made in China, but I like it
text: This game was designed and advertised as a tailgating game because it is easy to set up, lightweight, and fun to play. It has a screen with seven openings of varying sizes for the purpose of tossing a football or a disk (that looks like a Frisbee) through it. The smaller the opening, the more points you get.  The game comes with four footballs and four discs making this a great game to have around for Sunday BBQ, family get together, or just a good way to get the kids outdoors. I have a 5 year old that just finished his first season of pee wee football and he loved it. I wanted him to have this to give him the opportunity to practice throwing the ball at a target. The back of the openings have netting in them to catch the ball and discs when they go in. It is a great way to have fun and work on his aiming skills at the same time.  The assembly and break-down is easy, but it is sturdy after it is put together.  This is a great game for kids and adults alike.  It’s Made in China, so the current price of sixty bucks is crazy expensive. . . but I like it.

title: Love It!
text: The “SHOCK DOCTOR” mouth guard has the mandibular orthopedic re-positioning appliance (MORA) setting and properly aligns the jaw.  This mouth piece is hardcore and finally a company that takes hits to the mouth seriously.  It is made lighter, lower profile, has gel-fitting comfort, and multi-layered protection. The design makes it easier to breath and in my opinion, increasing performance. Nothing is more distracting than a poor fitting, uncomfortable mouth guard that chokes breathing and limits communication with team mates. This is a performance mouth piece and worth every penny.

title: Two books really for professionals
text:
THE MODERN GUIDE TO GOLF CLUBMAKING -BY JEFF SUMMITT-CALIFORNIA
This is a book about custom clubmaking and the craft of building a set of golf clubs from scratch. This is a very technical book that reads more like a text-book on college physics. The book takes you from how to get started to the final steps of assembly of the clubs. It covers in great detail how to set up your shop, materials inventory, to the actual manufacturing. I would not recommend this book to the person that has never built or assemble golf clubs before. This is for someone who extensive knowledge, abilities, and tools for building custom clubs and you are already in this business. A person wanting to hone their skills and learn some new techniques would find this a good reference guide. This is for the seasoned clubmaker that already possesses advanced principles and knowledge of golf club assembly.
THE MODERN GUIDE TO GOLF CLUBFITTING-BY JEFF SUMMITT-CALIFORNIA
This book along with the “MODERN GUIDE TO GOLF CLUBMAKING” come as a set and complement each other on the art and science of club fitting. It is a detailed concept book that gives the methods and parameters that works to give the custom customer their personal best with the equipment that was fitted for them. This book is based on the fact that every person is different, each swing of the club is different, the tension in the grip, and the angle of impact is unique to each individual. This book is completely structured to fit the avid golfer with the clubs that are designed and manufactured with him or her in mind. These are highly technical books and not for the enjoyment of reading but for the person who already had extensive knowledge of the sport and club building. This is a reference book with a high degree of technical information and for someone with a high degree of knowledge about this subject to begin with.

title: Improve your game
text: This is a high-tech swing analyzer for people that want to study and improve their tennis game. This works on any racquet by placing it on the end of the racket and turning it 180 degrees. The ZEBB tennis 2 tracks key performance for each swing including: stroke type, ball speed, ball spin, and more. You can track practice and match statistics, and compare against other players and records information about your performance instantly. ZEBB will provide a separate performance report for each stroke indicating areas for improvement.  It gives you the ability to track where you make contact with every ball on the racquet and helps to increase accuracy and gives detail that is not possible with video alone. It also has the ability to track ball speed. It will generate a game report to show winning and losing factors. This is a great way to make adjustments and improvements to your strokes, accuracy, and your game in general. Made in China.

title: Pricey for just fifteen
text: These are pre-moistened wipes that are a little larger and a little thicker than baby wipes but a very similar concept. If you are on the golf course and need to clean or wipe down your grips while you are playing, these are very convenient to have in your bag. The price of convenience is usually expensive and these are no exception. The package contains 15 wipes and it dries within minutes. They are easy to take along on your golfing excursion; they come in a resalable package, and will clean all of the clubs with one wipe. I would not recommend KARMA GRIP WIPES be used at home when other less expensive cleaning options are available, but to have an easy to carry, exceptional product, for emergency use is worth every dime. Golf is an expensive sport and this is a small drop in the big bucket to keep your clubs clean and in good shape while playing.

title: Pricey
text: I really think of this more as a “souvenir” item than an actual street hockey puck.  It’s quite light.  It shows that it’s “ideal for smooth surfaces”. .  but that’s not my street. . . or any street that I know of.  At the current price of ten bucks, for Made in Thailand, it’s also crazy expensive.  We slap it around on the garage floor and it works ok for that.

title: Not great
text: This is a small Table tennis table that is ¼ the size of a regular Table tennis table. The side aprons are lined with magnets that allow it to connect to another JOOLA table.  The combination of four of these will be a full size Table tennis table.  It is sturdy, easy to set up and take down, making storage in a closet much more convenient. It comes with a itty-bitty net to fit the itty-bitty table. They come in different colors and can be made into different configurations other than rectangle.  I did not enjoy playing on it because it was too small and I spent more time chasing balls.  Three others can be purchased and fitted together to make a regular size table, but by the time you purchase four of these tables, you can buy a standard size table. It is a novel idea, but just give me a regular “no gimmicks” type of table.  It’s Made in China. .. so at the current price of a hundred bucks for a single table. . . it’s crazy expensive.

title: Beginner or pro. . . .You'll like this exercise rope
text: This is what we call a “Battle rope” in the gym and it is another fitness tool.  It has become integral part of fitness and training. You’ll usually find them anchored to a wall or sturdy beam or pole, and while they may vary in length (they can be up to 100-feet long), weight, and thickness, all battle ropes serve the same purpose: Providing a killer workout.  This is a supersized rope that is very heavy which adds resistance to work your muscles like never before. When used properly it strengthens arms, abs, and shoulders and you will get a conditioning workout all in one. High-impact activities can put a major strain on your body.  It is better to wave, slam, and whip these hefty ropes and still reap serious fitness benefits. They work every muscle group simultaneously and allow freedom of movement. They can also be catered to your fitness level—whether you’re a beginner or a pro athlete. This is a super rope and I’m looking forward to some serious training.  As it’s Made in China. .  .I wish it were a bit less expensive.

title: Bucket-O-Balls
text:
FYI . . . I know that some reviewers say they only received six balls. I received a bucket of 36 balls as described.

This is a bucket of 36 LACROSS balls that meet official size and weight of NOCSAE standards. The National Operating Committee on Standards for Athletic Equipment (NOCSAE) is a non-profit organization operating in the United States, whose mission is to reduce athletic injuries and death through standards and certification for athletic equipment. They meet NCAA, (The National Collegiate Athletic Association is a non-profit organization which regulates athletes of 1,281 institutions, conferences, and individuals, NFHS, (The National Federation of State High School Associations is the body that writes the rules of competition for most high school sports and activities in the United States and SEI (The Safety Equipment Institute is a private, non-profit organization that administers a non-governmental, third-party certification program, and tests for public safety, and certifies a broad range of safety and protective products used occupationally and recreationally) standards. Consumers are assured that products bearing the SEI label have been manufactured to meet the level of quality and performance of the most current comprehensive standards existing for the product. Having a large number of balls makes it easy for coaches to quickly run drills without having to stop and wait on equipment. These balls have superior handing and accuracy and the bucket makes transporting them to the field easy and convenient. These balls are Made in China, so they are kind of pricey.

title: Kind of pricey for Made in China
text: This is a set of small (4 x 3 feet) soccer nets. They are perfect for a younger, newly starting out player or for kids that would like to get out in the yard or go to a park and play for a little while.  The package is well secured and contains two nets. They are very easy to set up and break down. They come with a carry-bag making them easy to transport and perfect for storage. These are for beginners or younger children but they work great.  Made in China, so at over thirty-five bucks, they are quite expensive.

title: Both Lime Green and Blue Version Offered
text: If you have a child that is thinking about learning to play golf or taking up the game, this is the club to help them get started the right way. Kids just wants to have fun and start to learn some of the in and outs of the game. Two common problems juniors have are directly related to equipment. First, they're using clubs that are too long, too stiff and too heavy and this club is flexible and light and better at meeting the needs of the younger player. Having a club that is mis-sized will hurt the enthusiasm for the young golfer, and these clubs are specifically made to meet the needs of and aspiring star. Made in China

title: Great HITCH Bike Rack
text: This rack is well designed, light weight (for a quality bike rack), and easy to use. It makes loading and transporting bikes so easy. I use it when I travel with my bike on vacation but I needed something easy to take on and off. This is a perfect rack for carrying bikes to the beach or the mountains.
