I recently went on vacation with two mountain bikes secured to my carrier. The bikes did not sway at all and the straps were as tight upon arrival as when I cinched them down when I left. The rack adjusts to fit all bike frames up to 60 lbs. each. Ratcheting straps keep any size bike safe and secure. The Cuscino,(which is Italian for pillow, was designed by Fabio Pedrini) was made to protect your bike during transit by holding down gentle enough for a carbon frame.  This is the nicest bike rack that I have ever owned and I no longer have to worry about my bikes slipping or getting damaged during transport and that gives me peace of mind.  I also LOVE the fact that it’s Made in Madison Wisconsin!  Make sure you understand that this is a HITCH rack. . . so . . . if you vehicle doesn’t have one. . . you’ll either need to get one.  . .or check other options.

title: Fairly easy to use
text: This is a pack of 15 individual strips of solvent-based grip tape that are 10 inches long and 2 inches wide. This is the perfect item for golfers wishing to re-grip a full set of golf clubs. You need grip solvent to activate the “grip” because water is ineffective. The package contains enough to re-grip one full set of golf clubs, plus one extra for another club or in case you make a mistake. These strips are the perfect length and width for your clubs making is easier and simpler to keep your clubs in great playing condition. Peel the liner, stick it to the shaft, and allow ½ inch to extend below the butt end. This is a slightly thicker grip tape than what some of the competitors are selling. These pre-cut grip tapes take a lot of the work out of re-gripping your clubs and would recommend.

title: Great Girl's Jr. Set
text: This adorable set of clubs and bag is the perfect way to inspire a young person to play golf and have fun at the same time. Designed for beginners to learn the game and develop a great swing. The bag is white and trimmed in pink. The quality is very impressive considering that it is made for a child. These clubs are made for beginners but are nice enough to advance to the junior golfer. They are great junior golf clubs with composite shafts. The lightweight club head and other design features mean younger kids can be taught a proper swing technique from an early age. The set is made up of a Driver, 7-iron and wedge, Mallet putter with insert, Retro head cover and Lightweight stand bag with a padded carry strap. This is a fantastic set and well put together.  Made in China.

title: Not great quality - But works on-the-go
text: This is a multi-use, multi-sport net that can be easily set up for temporary situations such as picnic in the park, volleyball at the beach, or badminton with the family. It is not the best quality and would not withstand strong wind gust (like at the beach) or much abuse (say a bunch of teenage boys), or leaving out into the weather. But if you need a quick set up or something portable for tailgating, this would work fine. It has a nice nylon carrying case and includes a rope to mark off a court or playing area.  It is made for family fun at home or on the go. It is not the most study, but you can still enjoy it and have fun.  It’s Made in China.

title: Made for small / average-size people
text: A quality stadium seat allows you as a sports fan to focus on the event at hand without being distracted by a sore back, numb legs, or poor concentration caused by uncomfortable seating options. This stadium seat cushion is ergonomically designed to provide optimal support for the spine and hips. It also takes the pressure off the legs, help achieve a good posture, and provide sufficient padding for the buttocks. The entire thing folds up flat when not in use, and it also has convenient storage pockets to hold all of your snacks, sodas, and sunscreen. It has a durable canvas back and padded seat. Once the season is over, stadium seats can be used anywhere portable support is needed, such as barbecues, concerts, camping trips. The convenience of personal stadium seat cushions is a very nice benefit and the RIO is one of the nicest, most comfortable ones that I have used.  I will admit that I'm a smaller person.  Someone who is a  bit larger might not be as comfortable, and the padding might not be enough.  This item is Made in China

title: Necessary item when traveling
text:
Make sure you understand that this is the crossbar only. . . bag is not included.

This is a support bar that you place inside of a golf travel bag that is designed to help mitigate damage to clubs when traveling. The aluminum rod system is telescopic and adjusts to three different lengths. It has a plastic cap that fits in the top of the bag and extends snugly to the bottom. Golf clubs are a major investment and this is a small price to pay to help protect them. I say "small price". . . but it is Made in China. . . so it's still a bit pricey.

title: Mine was as described.
text:
I know that some reviews show that they received a different tee from that which is pictured. I actually received the one which is pictured.

This is for the baseball enthusiast that wants to work on hitting drills and this allows you to do that anytime, anywhere. This tee is easy to handle and easy to carry to the park or from the garage to the yard. The top is flexible to better allow you to feel the ball when you make contact. It is great to use for both high and low drills. This tee is designed to help improve a hitters swing and eye-hand coordination skills. The unique cone shape top allows hitters to monitor their swing during contact. All it takes is a quick turn of the stem from the base, and the PRO-T detaches allowing for greater portability. Great quality and design. It's Made in China, so at the current price of just over forty-eight bucks. . .it's a bit pricey.

title: Made in the USA!!!
text: These are the newest, greatest thing in shin guards. The old hard plastic ones were uncomfortable, difficult to stay in place, and hot. These are lightweight and breathable. They have air-vents designed in the pads that let heat to escape. This prevents excessive sweat buildup. The shin guards are sewn right into the compression sleeve so there is no more constantly having to make adjustments to them or tape them to your leg. They are comfortable, ultra-thin, and still provides impact protections. Unlike the old-style shin guards, these are completely machine-washable. These are flexible, but have new technology where they harden on impact. This keeps them comfortable, but provides the standard protection as well. I really like the new innovation of improved movement and flexibility.

title: Great in more ways than one
text: These shin guards are all one piece unlike the old traditional ones where the sleeve and guards are two separate pieces. The guards are sewn into the sleeve and it is soft and flexible, but hardens on impact. The flexible guard is more comfortable to wear and feels like wearing no guard at all. It is less distracting during play since it stays in place with no tape or additional sleeve required. These give players better mobility due to their low profile, giving improved knee and ankle movement. Shin guards should be worn facing forward. Because they are made directly into the sleeve they can be more difficult to remove than traditional guards.  These can be machine washed and lined dry. This keeps the bacteria down and the guards fresh and clean for each use. They meet the National Operating Committee on Standards for Athletic Equipment (NOCSAE) standard and they are made in the USA. These are definitely winners for me.

title: Wish the balls were foam
text: I wish the balls had been foam.  That would have been a much better option.  The overall quality is “flimsy”, but that’s kind of what you would expect from such a game.  It hangs on a door, so it has to be lightweight.  It’s very easy to store.  It’s Made in China.  At the current price, I think it’s a bit pricey, but it’s fun to play with.  You might want to put something over the door so that it doesn’t scratch, and also stays in place better.

title: OK for a "disposable" set
text: If you’re looking for a an inexpensive set of paddles / balls. . .. this might work for you.  But if you’re looking for a quality set that is going to last, then you might want to pass on this one.  They paddles are wood and quite heavy.  Kids are going to have some “issues” with the weight.  I will say that I like the color / design of the paddles though.  But there are other options if you’re looking for durability.

title: "Brown" Football
text:
There are three different styles of footballs for this listing. I have the generic “brown” football. Because of the different in price. . . if the color really doesn’t matter, then I would go with whichever currently has the best price.

This is a “junior” football, so a bit smaller than full-size. Easier for younger kids to grip. It has a nice feel / texture to it. It does not come with a pump. I’ve had other balls where the laces were not “real” and just painted-on. Not so with this ball. The laces are “real”.

title: Whiffle Balls
text: We always called these “whiffle balls”.  I’m not sure why Franklin is not calling them that.  I use these not only for baseball, but also for playing pickle ball.  So far, they have held-up better than some other whiffle balls I’ve used.  Granted, they are Made in China, and I still think that the current price is expensive for Chinese plastic. . . but. . . they work.  Any you also get a handy drawstring bag!

title: Some might find it helpful
text: This is a plastic mold that fits over a golf ball that has cut outs for different markings. This could be helpful if you are playing with several people and wanted to place a star, triangle, square, or arrow on your particular ball so that you could easily recognize it. There are also slots for marking the golf ball’s center which would be a good training tool for someone new to the sport. It comes with a green “SHARPIE” for the actual marking. In reality any color marker would work. This is not something that I found helpful because I don’t want to stand around and mark my balls, plus I found it distracting to have symbols on my golf balls. Personally, I like a clean white ball. Someone else may find this helpful, but it seemed more like a mimic to me.  Made in China.

title: Run really small
text: Harbinger has always been one of my go to companies for anything fitness. They do a great job of making quality merchandise for whatever level fitness that you are involved in. It has been my preference to use an open-finger gloves for working out, but I have wanted to give the palm grips a try. The top has a nice suede feel and a double Velcro wrap at the wrist. They work by sliding the straps over the two middle fingers, placing the leather across the palm of your hands and securing it around the wrist with the Velcro straps. It worked really well when gripping weights, bars, or kettle-bells. I had a solid grip, but they were not a great help with the calluses. These grips are running small. My hands would easily be a medium size and the large is small on me. I have thin fingers and the holes are tight. The holes might stretch out, but I like for things to fit and be comfortable the first time that I put them on. These are nice grips, well made, but run very small.  Made in China.

title: Pricey, but can be used again and again
text: This is a plastic tee that has three different components to it. It has a built-in top so it is the same height for each tee shot. This allows for consistency and accuracy. The top part of the tee is flexible and pops back up after its been hit. This eliminates tee breakage and it simplifies the number of items that has to be carried in the golf bag.  If it gets knocked out of the ground the red top makes it easier to find. The top has an extension of about an inch with a white line on it that helps aim and aligns the ball to the target. It is a great practice tool. It seemed pricey to me at first, but the re-usability and score improvement made it seem like a bargain. Made in Taiwan.

title: For what it is. . . it works
text: This is a good way for someone to practice soccer without having to spend a ton of money or take up a bunch of space.  For smaller kids just starting out this is an easy to see and easy to set up goal. This goal makes it easy to practice or have some fun if you are just kicking around. It come with 3 pegs that secure the goal on each side and one in the back. It come with a carry bag, but once it is set up, it is very difficult to get into the bag. It can be set up in a matter of minutes. It can it also light enough to move to a different location if you want to take it to the park. It is a nice goal, sturdy, and functional.  Made in China.

title: "Vintage" Headcovers
text: These vintage headcovers are amazing looking and work amazing at the same time. They have a polyurethane construction, but looks like embossed leather. The interior is velour-lined and very soft. The front has racing strips and the back is solid black. There is some stretch in the back giving the cover a secure fit.  Each cover comes in its own individual zip-lock bag. These come in a pack of four that includes the driver, #3, #5, and one Hybrid headcover. They look really sharp in my golf bag and protect my clubs from scratches.

title: Nicer than expected
text: I was very excited when I saw this bag.  It is much nicer than the price point indicates. I hate having an old beat-up golf bag and I really think that it helps my game when I have a nice new golf bag to haul my clubs around in. This one is really jam-up. The design is impressive with the solid black and bright orange accents. It is lightweight which is something that I look for in a bag these days as I am not getting any younger. It also has extra padding in the carry sling. The 7-way dividers on the top is padded to protect your clubs and lined in the orange color making it easy to see the pockets as well. It has 7 large storage compartments, a towel ring, and even an umbrella holder. This bag has it all. I am very impressed with the design, look, and how well thought out this bag is.  Made in China.

title: Super Bright Red
text: I love everything about these gloves. The first thing that you notice (besides the bright red color) is the smell of leather. The inside is a smooth suede material that feels great next to my hand…..instant comfort. The palm of the glove is textured leather that assists in gripping and holding the bat or whatever items that you don’t want slipping out of your hands. The top is a combination of a leather and nylon which gives the fingers and knuckles flexibility and added comfort.  The fingers on the top and the bottom have tiny holes to wick away perspiration and sweat from your hands. They fit well over the hand with the wrist strap falling above the wrist bone. The wrist strap has a Velcro strap that stays tight and there is some padding underneath. There is FRANKLIN logo in plastic (but looks like chrome) on top of the hand and a major league baseball logo on the wrist strap. I am rocking the red color.  These are the gloves if you want a glove that has comfort, function, well made, and great looking.  Made in Vietnam.

title: Beyond Crazy Expensive for Made in China
text: This is a 24’ X 1” continuous roll of Velcro. It is white in color (not the typical black) and has the FRANKLIN logo stamped on it in black.  It is heavy duty and water-proof since it is designed to repair outdoor soccer nets to the frame. As a high school athletic director, sports equipment gets torn and abused every day.  The cost to replace each and every net or item that gets torn would be astronomical and this Velcro strap is just about as important as duct tape. It allows intramural teams and practice equipment to last a little longer before replacement.  This is a solid roll of 24 feet so you can cut it to the length that works best in any particular situation. This has many uses besides extending the life of soccer goals.  This will also work for anything that needs custom Velcro straps. It does cost more than the generic black stuff sold at hardware stores, but this is very heavy duty and water-proof. It is a staple with the coaches.  It’s Made in China, so at the current price of forty bucks. . . it’s beyond crazy expensive.

title: Oh so pricey
text: You certainly are paying a premium for these wristbands.  They are Made in Taiwan, and could not have cost more than a buck to make.  It all depends upon which team you choose, as to the cost.  I have the Chicago Blackhawks, and the current price is over thirteen bucks, which is outrageously crazy expensive.  Though the stitching of the wristbands themselves isn’t great (loose threads) the colorful embroidery work is actually quite nice.

title: Not really for larger faces / heads
text: This is one of those things where it’s so difficult to know whether this mask is going to fit your face. . . until you actually try it. Though it shows that this mask is supposed to be “great for wider faces”. . . I didn’t find that to be the case.  It did not fit my (adult) face very well at all, but it fit a teen’s face without a problem.  Again, it just depends on the size / shape of your head/face.  This item is Made in Thailand, so at the current price of over fifty bucks, it’s quite expensive.  It comes with a clear plastic case.

title: Simple. .  .Easy. . . Breezy. . .
text: I really like this jump rope. I'm still working on my technique and haven't been using a speed rope that long, but I'm familiar enough with them to know that the bearings in the handles of this rope make it very smooth. The textured handles feel very good in the hands. The rope is easy to adjust with a screw clamp that fastens the rope in place once it's trimmed to size. Very durable, smooth, and comfortable to use.

title: Not a winner for me
text: I have been lifting weight for over 30 years and have used many different types, styles, and brands of gloves. It is a great sport for the body, but very hard on the hands. Gripping and lifting iron weights can cause major calluses across the palm of your hands. They hurt and look unsightly at the same time. Weight lifting gloves can minimize or eliminate the possibility of getting painful calluses. I had never heard of SPRI FITNESS GLOVES, but was very excited to give them a try. At first glance the look and styling is very sharp with the black glove with the simple red accent color. I usually wear leather work-out gloves and these are made from a foam/rubber material.  I am not crazy about the smell. They have a wide Velcro strap across the top of the hand that makes it easy to get them on and off, but I find it unusual to have that strap on top of the hand instead of on top of the wrist. I’m not sure if it was uncomfortable or if I am so used to having gloves that secured around my wrist.  I also like the support that you get from having gloves that close over the wrist, which these do not. They appear to be cheaply made in that the finger-tips look like they were cut off with a pair of scissors. The quality, material, and the fit are not to my satisfaction, not to mention the smell. They might break-in with repeated use, but I want a glove that is comfortable, functional, and fits well the first time I put them on.  On top of everything else. . . They are Made in China and a bit expensive.

title: Great vest for bike riding
text: Made in China. I do 90% of my riding and running at night. Have for 15+ years. I've used a lot of Hi-Vis equipment over the years. This vest is really lightweight and very bright, both for the yellow color and the reflective. The vest comes down to about just below my ribcage, so it's fairly minimal in size, but not minimal in reflectiveness. The large patches of reflective material on front and back are very bright at night. There is enough adjustability in the velcro straps that come around the sides that you can make it loose or snug, whichever you prefer. For the price and how well it works, it's a great vest.

title: Nice.. but just too expensive
text: This shirt is a 70% cotton and 30% polyester.  It has a very good, soft feel to it.  The lettering is all “rubbery” That means you have to be very careful when washing, because otherwise all of the lettering is going to “crack”.  The shirt is “tagless”, which I really like.  At the current price of thirty bucks, it’s very expensive.  It’s Made in Peru.  The fabric is quite thin, which . . . in this case. . . is not really a bad thing because it’s the type of shirt you’ll wear in the Summer.

title: Great Feel
text: I am getting older and everything in my life is about comfort and proper function and these gloves are the epitome of both. The leather is so soft and beautiful and feels very snug on my hand. Most golf gloves are very thin and I can easily go through several in a year, but these are thicker and actually lasted longer. There are nylon panels in the knuckle areas and places where you bend your fingers and hand that helps with grip and flexibility.  The panels help your hand breath and maintain better control. This looks and feels like a superior quality glove. I love the new dexterity zone in the thumb area that helps with control and fit and the extra support from additional padding on the palm. This is a high quality glove and price is worth it. Made in Indonesia

title: Good exercise . .  .and kind of fun too
text: The swing trainer is a tool for a beginner or novice golfer that needs to improve core strength and improve upon technique. This piece of equipment is inexpensive, easy to use, and can be used in your yard without tearing up the grass or your golf clubs. The strength and flexibility of the core muscles are an important part of a good swing. This swing trainer is weighted on the end and covered with rubberized material. The pole is flexible and really stretches out your obliques and helps with follow through. This is a great way to create muscle memory for when you want to actually play golf. The CLUB CHAMP is very affordable and an easy way to improve your game.

title: It Works!
text: I live in Georgia and I am sure you have heard the phrase “hotter than Georgia asphalt”. That is the way my car feels when I get in it every day after work. Unfortunately the sun shines right down into my car during the day and there is not much you can do to protect it. I use the BOATERS EDGE on my leather seats and dashboard to get the UV protection that this product provides. It made them look clean and nice without looking slick and shiny. It has a fresh smell and comes in a box with a sprayer. I am very pleased with the performance and ease of use of this protectant.

title: Might be a bit tight for some
text: These wrist bands are nice and thick and comfortable. When using them I quickly forgot that I had them on. Now, I don't have a huge wrist, I'd say average, but they fit me pretty snugly. If a person had a larger wrist, they may be a little tight. The "X" on the band adds to the styling. They did soak up sweat and, I'd say, did a pretty good job of keeping the sweat off the grip.

title: Not seamless. .. but they haven't cracked. .  . yet
text: I really like these balls. I did weight them myself and they were 26 grams on the nose. Some say they are unresponsive. I say, they allow good hard hits with better accuracy and they stay in bounds better. I also found them to be very durable. I'm certainly not a seasoned pickleball player, but the feel off of the paddle was very good. Now, they say they're seamless. They do have a seam, and I have definitely found some balls that quickly cracked at the seam. These didn't seem to do that.

title: Might also check-out the Viper Carbon Fiber paddle
text:
This paddle really feels light, and at 7.75 oz. it is one of the lightest paddles I've tried. The grip is very comfortable, although it may be a little short for larger hands. I have a Viper paddle that has a grip of longer length, so the X-Factor is relatively short. The paddle performed well with concern to sweet spot size and responsiveness of the ball coming off the paddle. The single thing I like best about this paddle is the weight. For the money, I don't think you could go wrong with this paddle.

[[ASIN:B01HCV0ANQ Pickleball-X Viper Performance Carbon Fiber Paddle]]

title: Nice paddle for the money
text: This aluminum core paddle weighed in at 8.5 oz. on my scale. It's a very well made and comfortable paddle. The grip feels very nice in the hand. Initially, I used it without gloves, but after about 15 minutes of play, the base of my thumb began to get a little sore, so I put the gloves on. That's fine, I like using gloves anyway. The paddle feels very well balanced and seems to have a pretty large sweet spot. I feel that the accuracy with which I'm able to hit the ball is very good with this paddle. Honestly, I think this is an awesome paddle for the money.

title: Indispensable
text: I like this balm in that it comes in a container like you'd use for deodorant. It is white in color, but when applied it's clear. It's easy to put on and doesn't stain at all. When the balm mixes with sweat, it becomes more slick. I had no chafing whatsoever after some pretty long rides. I found that the ease in application and the longevity of effectiveness very appealing. Not having to squeeze cream out of a tube and apply with fingers, and all the mess that goes along with it is very nice.

title: Not the easiest board - Ok if you're looking for "old school"
text:
I have the “Rasta” version of this board, which is black. . . green. . yellow and red. It measures 22.5 X 6” at the widest point. It’s kind of shaped like a fish, and the top even reminds me of “scales” with the diamond pattern.

This is certainly an “old school” board. The type to take you from point A to point B, but not really for tricks and such. Honestly, I don’t think it’s the easiest board to ride. More “up-to-date” boards and/or longboards are going to be much easier.

title: Nice silicone kids set
text: Though Cressi makes adult sets. . . This is their kids set. . BUT. . . if you’re an adult, and you have a smaller face, this might work for you as well.  Though I like the Cressi adult model, it can be a bit large for some people.  I’ve tried this set for both eight and ten-year-olds, and it works great.  The mask is made of silicone, which is much “softer” than other plastic, and also helps it to fit better.  I also like the color combination.

title: Work great for mixing-up my workout
text: I think these because they are simple and easy to use. . . without having to go with “real” boxing gloves.  This way you still have your fingers to pick-up something. . . to put the gloves on and take them off (without having to have someone else to help you). . . and they feel good.  Granted, if you’re a professional boxer, these might not be for you. . . but I simply like to mix-up my workout, and these work great for me at a very affordable price.

title: Pricey, but I like it
text: This is a two-piece set, consisting of the snorkel and mask.  The third piece shown in the picture is a carrying pouch.  The carrying pouch has a handle at the top and closes with Velcro.  The mask is made mostly of silicone.  It’s “softer” than some other plastics.  This is a larger mask, and can take some getting used to, if you’re used to smaller masks.  I’m really unsure as to why this set is over a hundred bucks.  It’s Made in Italy, and I’m sure that’s part of the reason, but otherwise, it’s not like it’s golden or anything.  I do really like it though.

title: Blocks instead of loose
text: There are a lot of weight lifters, body builders, and gym rats that think wearing gloves to work-out in is something a “girly-man” would do. But their hands get wet and sweaty and the weights can easily slip out of your hands or lose grip while lifting or doing pull-ups. Gym chalk is what they use to keep their hands dry and maintain their grip. I have never seen gym chalk in blocks before. It usually comes loose in a bag and you toss the bag between your hands to get the chalk on it.  I have also seen it sitting in a bowl or tray near the dumbbells. The RAGE GYM CHALK comes in solid blocks that can be rubbed across the palm of your hands or you can break it into pieces. It is very effective in its use, but does make a terrible mess. It can be used in other sports like baseball or gymnastics or any sport where gripping is important. It is comparable to other gym chalk that I have used, but it is in blocks instead of loose.

title: Nice overall, though a bit pricey for Made in China
text: Though it’s not listed as such, but this is a Youth Batpack, which is how it is listed on the packaging.  I don’t think it would be so great for adults.  It looks to be made of vinyl.  I like the fact that all of the zippers have “tags” on them, so it’s easy to pull them open / closed.  There is a nice bit of room inside, though not a huge amount.  For example, you’ll notice that even in the picture the person has their glove on the outside at the top of the bag.  Note that this listing is for the batpack only.  Any other “accessories” shown are not included.  I believe this item is Made in China, so at the current price of twenty-five bucks, it’s a bit pricey. . . but you’re also paying for the MLB logo.

title: Pricey, but nice glove
text: This is a very comfortable glove that has a Velcro closure that fits a little higher on the wrist than some gloves I've owned. That actually adds to the comfort as far as I'm concerned. There is an added padding in the thumb and forefinger that is very nice. The palm appears to be a synthetic leather. The overall grip on a good paddle grip is excellent. The material is of good quality and seems to be very durable. Made in Vietnam.

title: Not sticky enough. . . but super glue will take care of that.
text: These are half-inch squares.  They do not come separated, so you have to take a sharp knife, or scissors to cut them apart.  Each square has a weight of two grams.  I found that they don’t stick that well.  So you might need to use some super glue if you want them to stay put.  But make sure you know exactly where you want them to go before you do that.

title: Great Protection
text: These shin guards are fantastic. I love the way they protect my legs and feet.  I am not a combat boxing person, but do love the work-out that you get from the MMA style training. These pads have an extra firm padding that cover the shin and enables me to kick harder without the stinging effect that you get from the repeated blows to your legs and feet. There is a Velcro strap behind the knee that help to secure the fit and hold them up after wearing them for an hour or more. The back is a stretchable, breathable material that is helpful in putting them on, wicking away moisture after you start sweating, and getting them off which can be difficult. These are great shin guards, awesome padding, and very functional.

title: Neck is a little bothersome. . . otherwise I like it.
text: This is a well-made quality constructed wetsuit. I live and grew up on a lake that was made by damming up a river so the water flowing into this lake is cold. It is a blast to ski, swim, and tube but the water can be freezing and cause you to have to get out of the water more often to warm up or shorten the time in the water. This wetsuit allows you to stay and enjoy the lake for longer periods of time and also protects your skin from UV rays at the same time. The fit is tight and zips up the back. The zipper is large and works great which is something you want when getting in and out of this suit. I found the neck to be more constrictive than it should have been and it began to bother me in a short period of time. Other than that it is a very functional, well made suit.

title: Nice Bilge Cleaner
text: This is the best and easiest way that I have found to clean the bilge from the bottom of the boat. The oil that gets mixed in with the water can make an ugly, nasty mess and can be difficult if not almost impossible to remove. STAR BRITE does a great job of making products that keep your boat or RV not only looking good but functioning great as well. I am personally not a fan of cleaning products that smell like citrus, but this one is not too bad. This cleaner did a nice job of cleaning up the bilge, but be careful to use as directed.

title: You really need one for each wrist
text: For the boxing enthusiast this is the way to go. This product wraps around the wrist on the outside of your boxing gloves and gives you a detailed view of your punch count and type of punch for each session. It measures your G-force at impact, the speed of the punch, and your reaction time. This program allows you to interact with others so you can see and compare your speed and punch force to others. The band that wraps around the wrist has sensors in it that is sweat proof, shock proof, and very light weight. The information and details given to you by this PIQ will allow you to log your performance daily, weekly, or monthly. If boxing is the means to a cardio-workout, this device will track and count calories burned during your session. I like this product a lot, but wish that it came with two devices per box. It is much more helpful to track both hands and not just one. You need to purchase two to really get the maximum benefit.

title: Not a flotation device
text: It’s very important to understand that this is not a flotation device / life vest.  It’s a neoprene infant “wetsuit”.  It’s made for use in the water, with adult supervision, when learning to swim.  It’s easy on/off using Velcro straps.  It’s for both warmth and comfort.  Overall it works as described.  Though Cressi is an Italian company, this item is Made in China.  For that reason, it’s a bit pricey, but it’s in line with other, similar products.

title: Runs a size small.  Full-finger gloves also offered
text:
I have been lifting weights in a gym for more than thirty years and have always worn fingerless gloves to keep calluses from forming on the palms of my hands. The BEAST MODE gloves are by far the nicest work-out gloves that I have ever used. The whole point of using gloves for me is to be able to grip iron dumbbells, bars, and machines without having to release early due to my hands hurting. These gloves have ergonomic padding specifically in the areas where you are more likely to get calluses or bruises from the weights. I like the wider Velcro closure at the wrist. It allows for a secure fit while in use and easy removal when the workout is over. The palm of the glove is textured leather that is also beneficial for gripping. The top is stretchable and breathable. If you are serious about your weight-lifting routing, but still want to have smooth hands, these are the gloves to have. The sizing runs small though, so you might need to go up a size.

This same company offers full-finger gloves, if you prefer, but be advised that they also run small.
[[ASIN:B01MR28RSS The Official Glove of Marshawn Lynch - Bionic Gloves Beast Mode Women's Full Finger Fitness/Lifting Gloves w/ Natural Fit Technology, Black (PAIR)]]

title: Sizing runs small - Fingerless is also offered, if you prefer
text:
If you like to use a full glove for working out this is a top of the line glove. It has padding specifically on the areas of the fingers and palms where you would normally get calluses. The bottom of the glove is made of a textured leather in addition to the padded areas for protect that are vulnerable to injury. The wrist area is wider than most gloves and the Velcro closure allows for a nice secure fit. The top is a stretchy nylon material but also has areas that are vented for better flexibility. I personally have never washed a pair of training gloves. I wear them out and then throw them away so I cannot comment on how they hold up after washing. The sizing runs small. I normally wear a medium in work-out gloves, but found that size to be a little tighter than I would prefer, especially in the fingers due to the extra padding. The overall glove is superior, but be sure to order a larger size than usual.

This same company offers fingerless, if you prefer:
[[ASIN:B01MSPFPOX Bionic Women's Beast Mode Fitness Fingerless Gloves, Large]]

title: Works better than expected
text: When I first looked at this item I thought it was the dumbest thing that I had ever seen, but then I used it and was amazed at how great it worked. When used properly, it really takes the sting out of hitting the ball and actually helped to improve my grip.  It is made of silicon rubber (from China) but is soft and made hitting a lot more enjoyable. It is a small inexpensive tool that every baseball player needs to add to their equipment.

title: Not so easy to remove, but overall nice
text: I use the guards for training and working out and want to keep my shin and feet protected. I have found these to be some of the best ones that I have used due to the flexibility and fit. They are easy to slide on but they are a booger to get off especially after a hard workout and they get a little sweaty. The back is made of mesh and lycra panels that help with the evaporation of sweat, but they still get really hot as expected.  The guards have a Velcro band at the back of the knee to keep them tight and additional padding down the shin bone which I especially like. These have extra padding and flexibility over the foot area. There is a strap that goes under the arch of the foot to hold them in place.  I do not spar and strictly use them for work-out training, but the quality and function is superior for my needs.

title: Fit like a glove. . . . for your feet!
text: I have always been a very active person and I am now a senior citizen who wants to continue to exercise daily, but finding myself with more injuries and prone to get hurt because my mind thinks that I am younger than my body actually is. I love all of the new compression clothing and these socks are no exception.  My Achilles will become inflamed just by walking around in flip-flops for a day, so then I spend the next six weeks using my compression socks to increase circulation and help during the healing process. I have skinny legs and the small fit me perfectly. I put them on as soon as I get home from the gym and then again when I get home from work.  One thing that I really like about the sock area is that they are specifically made for the left and right foot. They fit so well and feel good around my feet and toes. Whether you are an athletic or someone that stands on your feet all day long, these are fantastic for tired sore legs. I love them.

title: Nice, simple bag
text: This bag is well made with an adjustable length carry strap. There is a hanger loop at the top and a plastic hangar clip at the bottom. I put two pickleball paddles inside it, a Franklin X-Volt wooden paddle and a Franklin X-Factor carbon fiber paddle. The Volt is longer and narrower than the Factor, but both fit snugly and easily into the bag. The zipper appears to be of good quality and, at least with these two paddles, I don't think the zipper would be stretched beyond limits to accept the paddles. The padding is very adequate to protect the paddle from average bumps and knocks.

title: Like the reflective piping
text: This is a very good looking bag. One of the first things I noticed about it is the significant reflective piping on the outside of the bag. As a person who tends to engage in a lot of my workouts and exercise before or after sunrise, I'm very aware of the need to be seen. This bag is predominantly black, but with the reflective and the fluorescent yellow zipper material and other yellow on the bag, I think it could be easily seen. I was able to easily fit four pickleball paddles in it and at least four balls. There's also a very nice soft-lined pocket to contain a cell phone. It has a single adjustable sling strap that has a nice plastic clasp that unlocks. This is a bag that could easily be used for a lot of other things besides just pickleball.

title: Why the headband is so short. . . I'll never know.
text: Though this is supposed to be an adult snorkel. . . .it’s probably better for teens, at least as far as the headband goes.  Too small for my adult head.  I’m not sure why they didn’t make it larger, and then it could have been adjusted for smaller heads.  It’s Made in China, so perhaps that’s the reason the band is so short.  The snorkel itself is fine though. Note that the same company also offers a snorkel / mask combo for just a few bucks more.  One annoying this is that there is a QR code on the package. . . and it does not work.

title: Great fingerless gloves
text: These are by far the nicest work-out gloves that I have used and I have been training for 30 plus years. When I was younger and thought that I was a “tuff-guy”, I did not wear gloves in the gym. I had painful, thick calluses along the bottom of my fingers. I decided that it was more important to grip the weights and not have sore hands all the time so I finally after many years started using fingerless gloves. The BEASTMODE are the best quality gloves that I have found. They have strategically placed padding to save the palms of your hands from bruising and calluses. They are made from textured leather on the bottom and a very stretchable, breathable nylon on the top. There are additional areas that are made for comfort and flexibility.  They have a Velcro closure that makes it easy to put on and take off. The fit and sizing runs small. These are high quality gloves for the serious gym rat.

title: Not sure it's worthwhile
text: This “Bat Nub” is made to help absorb some of the shock and vibrations from hitting the baseball. It comes in a variety of colors and looks cool on the end of a bat. It has a very spongy feel should be placed on the bat by pressing the small opening over the end of the bat and NOT the larger opening. It is very easy to do the opposite, but if you put it on incorrectly it will not fit or stay on the bat. This Bat Nub works best for the younger player and is not very durable.

title: Nice Protectant
text: I don’t have a boat, but I do have a car and a truck that I like to keep clean and waxed. I was very interested to see how this product compared to a regular car wax so I tried it out on a section of the truck first. To my (pleasant) surprise it gave a great shine to the area that I used it on. It goes on just like any other liquid wax. I made sure the area was clean, poured some of the STAR BRITE on a soft cloth and applied it in a circular motion to the area that I wanted to shine up. I allowed it to dry until it was chalky white in color (about 10 minutes) and then I rubbed it off. I was truly amazed at how great it looked. Both of my vehicles sit out in the sun during the day and I am super excited to have a product that has UV protection for the paint. The really adds to the life of the car. I had never used this product before, but I am very pleased with the ease of use and the ultimate outcome.

title: Great all-around mitts
text: I have taken some self-defense classes and we use punch mitts in every class that I have attended. These are more comfortable and durable than any that I have worn and used. These mitts are well made with very nice leather. There is a mound on the inside of the glove that fits perfect to the palm of the hand. They have a slight curve to them which makes it nice for the hitter and the defender. These are great quality, really good looking, and very nice padding.

title: Great Gloves!
text: The construction and leather on these gloves is amazing. They are really nice and comfortable for a less expensive glove. They are well made and have a nice tight fit. They are black leather with the COMBAT logo across the back of the glove. They Velcro at the wrist and additionally they have a lot of flexibility in that area. This glove can be used for different styles of training. They have great padding for superior protection. These are solid in construction, bold in design, and have great shock absorbency.

title: Nice, but not really a fan of the "non-slide grippers"
text: These are wrist straps used in a gym setting to assist someone with pull-ups or to wrap around a bar when doing “dead-lifts”. If you are doing a regular pull-up wrist-strap are probably not needed, but if you are dragging weights around your waist while doing pull-ups then the wrist-straps can be a great tool. In this particular situation, the hands or writs will probably give out long before the back will. The wrist-straps will give you the extra grip that you need to complete the number of reps in the set. Wrist straps have a small loop in one end that you run the opposite end through making a circle to put your hand in. You then tighten the strap to fit your wrist. The FITNESS FIRST WEIGHT STRAPS have padding on the back side of the wrists which give some added support. I know all you tough guys don’t need no stinking extra support, but take care of your joints while you are young and you might be able to lift when you are 62 or older…. The other new addition to these straps is the Silicone non-slide grippers on the underside of the straps. This did not work so well for me. I like to pull the straps really tight just before my lift and the Silicone grippers do not allow for that. They keep you from slipping during the lift, but I just couldn’t get them as tight as I am used to.  I like the extra padding at the wrist, but was not a fan of the non-slide grippers.

title: Very Cool Punching Bag
text: This is an excellent alternative to the conventional heavy punching bags. It has quality stitching and leather made to last. This is a serious bag. It is super dense for great shock absorption and helps to protect your hands and absorb punches. The angles of this bag make it perfect for a full bag workout, you can jab, hook, or uppercut. This bag makes for the perfect training partner by combining the techniques of the maize ball and the floor to ceiling bag. It has nylon straps on the top with a metal rings so that you can hang it easily. This bag really helps to increase accuracy and skill and due to its similar shape to the body. Great quality, great function and would recommend for any home gym.  It is Made in Pakistan.

title: Nice gloves at a reasonable price
text: I am very pleased with these gloves. I started out with another brand and was actually very satisfied with them, but they were getting quite worn and thought that I would give the RINGSIDE a try. I was very surprised at how much more comfortable the glove felt on and the additional padding they have.  I really like the Velcro straps at the wrist that enables you to get a snug fit. These are perfect for beginner or recreational boxer. They are nicely made and I love the color combination.

title: Expensive. . . but durable
text: This is a very nice heavy duty “home use” home plate. I use it to play pitch and hit with my boys so that they will have a sense of where the ball needs to be thrown or hit. It is a full, regulation size plate and sits about an inch above the ground so it is easy to see. This plate is sturdier and thicker than other home base sets that I have seen.  It is made in Taiwan and is very durable. For the family that is serious about their baseball, this is the way to go.  As it’s Made in Taiwan, at the current price of twenty-five bucks, it’s very expensive.  For this price it should have also included the three bases as well, but it doesn’t.

title: Easier to replace the net. . . rather than the entire goal
text: Soccer nets take a beating (literally) from the balls hitting them, from being outside in the weather, and from kids hanging onto them. This FRANKLIN net spruces up an old ratty looking soccer goal for a minimum cost. Most of the time the metal post are still in good shape and just the nets have gotten torn and worn. The clean white net make the entire goal look great again. They are made of a twisted nylon and are not very difficult to replace. Overall this is a much better option than replacing the entire goal.  This net is Made in China, so at the current price it is quite expensive, but it works.

title: Make sure it will work for your vehicle before purchasing
text: This is back rack number 171Z.  This bike rack is made to fit different types of vehicles such as cars, vans, and hatchbacks. It also and more importantly does not fit cars manufactured in the years 2008 and below. I HIGHLY recommend you contact Graber and ask them if this rack will fit your car before purchasing.  Even their website does not show which cars this will and will not fit.  If you go to the Graber website and click on History at the top, you will find their number.  This is not a universal rack and there are many other vehicles this rack will not accommodate so be sure to read the specifics before purchasing. It has multiple straps so that it can be adjusted to the size and recommendations of your automobile type. Considering the rack’s ability to fit (or not fit) different vehicles, the instructions are confusing. It is a lightweight rack and holds up to three bikes. It comes off a lot easier than it went on. The metal bar areas that press against the car are covered in padding so that your car does not get scratched or damaged. It is a reasonably priced rack and seems to be good quality (not great). It was not practically easy to get on, but was very easy to get off. It works great for transporting short distances, but not sure that I would trust it for an extended trip as the straps could work themselves loose.

title: Great rack. . . Made in the USA!
text: This bike rack is made to be inserted into a towing hitch, so if you do not have one on your vehicle, this rack is not going to work for you. It is made very solid and I had no problems with the pins lining up with the hitch. The metal is powder coated and holds up really well to the loading and unloading of your bikes. I wrapped the bars where the bikes were resting with towels to keep from scratching my bikes. The arm folds out away from the vehicle so that you can still have access to the trunk or open the rear door of an SUV. It has a cable system so that the bikes can be securely fastened in place.  It was simple and easy to install, but did take longer than the advertised 5 minutes. Overall this is a well-made, very functional, heavy duty bike rack and well worth the money. This bike rake is made in the USA and I always enjoy supporting our American manufactures.

title: Handy tool
text: I use this on my practice clubs for re-grooving and extending the life of my old clubs. I don’t use it on my playing clubs because it takes off the protective coating and causes rust.  The tool is only about 5 ½” long and comes in a clear plastic tub for storage.  The top is in the shape of a star and has 3 cutter heads for “U” grooves and 3 of the cutter heads for “V” grooves. It is a light, handy little tool that is easy to toss into the golf bag and have on hand when needed. Be sure to keep it in the tube that it comes in or the sharp cutter heads will tear your bag up. I’m not sure where it’s made. . . though probably China. . . . so it’s a bit expensive for what it is.

title: Takes some getting used to, but I really like them.
text:
These goggles are Made in Thailand. I like the color combination, as it gives them a little more “zip”. But if these colors are not your thing, Speedo does offer the same goggles in other colors.

These are “larger” overall from more “traditional” goggles. So it might take some getting used to. But after wearing them for a bit, I found them to be quite comfortable.

These are clear goggles, though Speedo does offer similar ones with mirrored lenses.

title: Might be long on some boys
text:
These shorts are going to be loooooooooong on some boys. They have a length of 18.75”.

I’m not sure if these are supposed to be shorts. . .or swim trunks. .. I’m assuming both. They are very lightweight. There is a “liner” which goes about ¾ down the leg, and it’s red. .. but. . . the liner is not attached, so it can ride-up.

There is no “fly” on these shorts. There are no pockets on these shorts.

There is a full elastic waistband. There is a string tie on the inside of the waist.

Made in Vietnam.

title: Currently at quite an affordable price for a fun outdoor game
text: I’m SO glad that this item has comedown to a “reasonable” price of just over seventeen bucks for a Made in China. Item.  It’s actually build quite reasonably.  It’s also fairly easy to put together.  I wish that the bars were different colors instead of simply having a different number of rings on them.  Being that the bottom pieces are a “triangle” design, the unit can topple-over, if you throw the “golf tosses” too hard.  But I haven’t had that much of a problem, as you really don’t need to throw them that hard.

title: Might want to go up a size
text: I love the look of this glove. The black and white theme is very good looking and it is a great functional glove as well. The leather is very soft and has synthetic  stretch material between the fingers that help make this glove comfortable. It has a Velcro catch across the top that make it easy to get the glove off and on. The leather is very thin, subtle, and has small holes in the fingers that make it breathable. I am a small person and have long thin hands and the medium is a little tight and short on my finger tips. The fit is not so tight that I can't use it, but next time I will go up to a large. Overall a gorgeous glove and does a great job.  Made in Indonesia.

title: Comfortable and stylish
text: The first thing that I noticed about this glove is the stylish design and the updated look to what is traditionally a clean white golf glove. The black synthetic material across the top of the knuckles combined with the PUMA LOGO WRITTEN IN SCRIPT makes this a great looking glove. The black material extends down the inside of the fingers as well. There is a pouncing PUMA LOGO on the Velcro closure. This overall design is nothing less than awesome. Even though the aggressive design caught my eye, it is the overall functionality that of this glove that makes it worth the purchase. The palm of the glove is a textured rubber material that gives a fantastic grip. The top of the glove has Lycra (the black material) across the knuckles for easy movement, helps the hand stay cool and dry. There is perforated leather on top of the fingers that again add to the comfort and the ability to wick moisture away. These are great looking, great performance, low cost, and a great junior starter glove.  Made in Indonesia.

title: A little large (and expensive) for me. . . but they can come in handy.. .  .not only for golf
text: These are actually mittens and not gloves. They are one size fits all. I am a medium and they seem really large for me. They are made to keep your hands warm during a golf game and be able to get them on and off quickly and easily.  They meet that function requirement with no problem. There is elastic at the wrist so that they will stay on even if they fit a bit too large.  The palm area is rubberized so there is some grip capabilities, but the overall glove is so large and bulky that picking up something small is not going to be realistic. The outside feels like wind-breaker material and should help in a drizzle, but they are not waterproof.  The inside is a nice warm fleece material and very comfortable. They have a clip where the gloves can be attached and kept together when they are not in use. I love this small, but important feature.  Though they are called “golf mitts”, they could be used for just about anything where mitts would be handing. . .  .Including just keeping them in your car.

title: Expensive. . . but I like it.
text: I am not a spear fisherman, but I do live on a lake and enjoy swimming and other water activities. The O.M.E.R. snorkel has added an entire new dimension to our summer fun. We have used it in the lake, our teenagers have used it in the pool, and we are planning to take it with us to the beach later this summer.  The mouth piece is a flexible, soft rubber type material and takes some getting used to. It was a little uncomfortable to me, but I have not had a lot experience with snorkels in many, many years. It is made so that it fits to the side of the face and does not get in the way of your vision. The tubing is a hard plastic and also has an attachment that allows you to clip onto your goggles. It is a nice snorkel and definitely an upgrade from the ones we used as a kid. At the current price between thirty and forty-three bucks (depending upon color) it is crazy expensive. . . but. . . I like it.

title: For Right-Handed Golfers Only
text: This is a training tool to improve and strengthen your golf game. It specifically targets muscles needed and used to play golf. It builds forearm and grip strength while helping with abdominal muscles. Assembly took about 20 minutes. This can be used as a warm-up before play or as a training tool that uses air resistance to improve many aspects of the game. This can be used by the experienced golfer or by a novice. It is definitely worth a try.

title: Golf & Games Too
text: This is a great product that is fun and useful to the avid golfer or to the person that just likes to spend an occasional afternoon on the golf course. The mat itself is very soft and feels like a quality piece. It measures 10 feet long and 2 feet wide and has the ability to make custom putting breaks and wedges. It has visible ball traces so that every putt can be evaluated. This can be fun for the whole family with all of the games ideas included in the instructions. This is a durable, functional tool that is easy to set up and easy to roll up and put away when finished.  For a hundred bucks, it is quite expensive.  I’m not totally sure where it was made, but I suspect China.

title: Works for its designed purpose
text: This is a lightweight bag that is specifically made for travel or an afternoon on the driving range. There is a pocket for some balls and a small zipped pocket for tees, but that is the extent of storage area. This bag will hold 6 to 8 clubs without covers. For a spring or summer golf trip  with friends and this is the perfect bag. There is a removable caring strap on the bag and a stand for keeping the bag upright. The bag is well made and very functional, but the stand appears to be a bit flimsy. The stand does not look like it would hold up under a lot of use, but if used as designed (travel and driving range practice) maybe it is more durable than it appears to be.

title: Lightweight with a nice grip
text: This is a nice, lightweight aluminum paddle.  I have a couple of different Franklin Sports pickleball paddles.  They make a wooden one, which is a lot cheaper, but I really don’t care for it.  The grip on this one is much better.  It’s Made in China, as is everything from Franklin, but this paddle is put together quite well.  If you’re just starting out, and you don’t want to sink a ton of money into a paddle, then this one is certainly one to consider.

title: Overall nice gloves
text: These are nice looking kids gloves.  I have what I would call the “action hero” gloves.  I’m not sure who the “action hero” is supposed to be, if anyone.  I think the company just made up their own.  But the red/blue combination works.  There is a nice amount of padding.  I like the Velcro around the wrist which gives ample support.  They come in a handy mesh bag, with RDX on it.  The bag is not shown in the pictures.  They look to be fairly well constructed.

title: For "light use" only - Also fun for "bowling"
text: This is the sort of device which is really only for stick handling practice, and not for actually “whacking” it, or hurling it against a wall.  It’s far too “delicate” for that.  It rolls well, and is actually fun to play with for other things like “bowling” indoors with empty soda cans.  So you’ll find some other fun options for it as well.  But if you’re expecting it to be firm, like a regular hockey puck, and take a beating. . . you’ll be disappointed.

title: To my surprise. . . . it helps!
text: I was disappointed with this guide originally, but wanted to give it a fair shake.  Since I am not the most impressive golfer in the world I figured what could it hurt? It seemed too simple of an idea to actually work. But for kicks and giggles I took it out to the course and did some practicing by myself. There are four slots on each corner of the putt gate where you put the tees to hold it in place. The ball is placed between the tees and forces you to focus on properly putting the ball. To my surprise it was quite difficult and challenging. It turned out to be a very helpful tool and I plan to use it again. I am not sure that it helped my game in one day, but I think that that with consistent use it will help me get better and more solid ball contact.  I will say that at the current price of eighteen bucks, it's quite expensive for a piece of plastic.

title: Great Kids Goggles
text: These are so cute and very functional at the same time. My granddaughter loves everything water, be it the tub, swimming pool, beach, lake, or just the sprinkler. These googles are perfect for her to wear to protect her eyes when she is playing and swimming (sort of). The straps are adjustable and fit even her tiny head. The googles are much higher quality than you would expect considering they look like a “child’s google” with the sea monster across the bottom. They work the way that an experienced swimmer would want from their equipment. They fit snuggly, no fogging, or leaking around the face and eyes. Anything that makes my granddaughter’s water experience safe and more enjoyable is exactly what I wanted.

title: Comfortable and look nice
text: These are some really nice gloves. The combination of leather and fabric makes these comfortable and flexible.  The gloves look thick and bulky at first glance, but when you put them on your hand they really feel and fit great. There are small holes in the fingers on the top and the bottom to help the skin breath. The embossed leather on the palm of the glove increases grip and reduces sting from the ball hitting the bat. The material inserts across the knuckles increases joint movement in the fingers. These gloves are well made and I am impressed at how comfortable they are. They have a Velcro strap across the wrist that adjust to hand and wrist size and also allow the gloves to go on and take off easily. These gloves are specifically made for baseball, I could see them used for other uses around the house, construction, or gardening. These are well made, durable gloves.

title: It's simply uncomfortable for an adult to use
text: The design and idea behind the functionality of this swimming tool is spot on, but in reality it has a major flaw. It is made to help a swimmer increase upper body and core strength without incorporating the legs.  It helps with body position in the water and has buoyancy to help sustain the legs in the locked position. The sides can be switched to get more or less resistance as needed. It would be a fabulous tool if it were comfortable to use. The material is so small and hard on the ankles that you can’t concentrate on swimming because all I could think about was how badly my ankles were hurting. I think this is one of those ideas that looks good on paper, but the reality is that it is too painful to use…..And that is the one detail that makes all of the difference in the world.

title: Something different for a water workout
text: The push plate is well designed and well made. The deeper you go in the water, the greater the resistance so that is a way to adjust the difficulty level. The push plate is fun and adds an extra dimension to what can be a boring workout. Plus it is a way to take your water work out to the next level. This is a great way to add versatility, stability, and resistance. You can count on SPEEDO to continue to innovate for the fan of the water, be it a novice or experienced swimmer.  I’m not sure where it’s made.  I’m can only assume it’s probably Made in China. . . in which case. . . at the current price of over forty bucks for plastic, it’s quite expensive.  But I hope / think it will last and be a nice asset to a water workout.

title: Quite heavy duty
text: This tee is simple to put together, sturdy, and the perfect assistant to help teach a child to hit a ball or an experienced player practice. It was ready to go in a matter of a few minutes right out of the box. I am not a very technical person, but this is so easy and straight forward that even I could put it together. I wanted to teach my granddaughter to hit a ball because she did not have the coordination to play with her brothers.  This turned out to be the perfect tool to help her learn and the boys wanted to play with it too. It worked well for my 4 year old and her plastic bat and when the “big” boys wanted to play they adjusted the height and used their real balls and bats. It worked great in both situations. The tee is built very sturdy and the 4 year old never knocked it over even though she hit the pole repeatedly. The older boys did not hit the post as much, but did on an occasion knock it over, but they were swinging pretty hard. It was easy to pick up and ready for the next hit. This is a heavy-duty tee that takes repeated abuse.  It comes apart and as easy as it went together. There is a nylon bag that comes with it.  This bag is a nice feature if the kids want to take the tee to the park or to a friend’s house.  According to my grandchildren, it is awesome!  It’s Made in China, and at the current price of thirty bucks it’s not cheap, but it’s quite “heavy duty”.

title: Might be more for "guys" than "gals".
text: This piece of equipment is for water aerobics or for general exercise in the pool. The gear emulates exercises that are done in the gym such as cable cross-over, chest press, and dumbbell flies. It is not geared specifically to swimmers, but they could use the GRIPTIDE to increase upper body strength. These are great for someone that wants to supplement or change-up their regular gym routine or for a person that has an injury and uses pool to exercise because it is easier on their joints and body. The GRIPTIDE provides resistance training for the chest and shoulders by moving your arms through the water. It is made from a type of molded foam that fits over the hand and wrist. There is a bar on the underside for gripping and it extends over the wrist to reduce pressure on that joint. They are very large, 16.5”, and a serious piece of equipment.  My husband works out in the gym tried them and thought that they had significant resistance. He could use them, but it was definitely challenging.  It is a well-made sturdy piece of water work-out gear.  I let a friend of mine, who is a smaller woman, also try them out and she found them difficult to use.  But for me. . . I like them.

title: Nice, but feel a bit uncomfortable after about an hour
text: These goggles have some nice features.  There is a lever on the on the side that releases the straps so that it can be adjusted for the perfect fit and then secures closed.  The headband material is soft and goes on and off without pulling hair. The lenses are tinted which is a wonderful option for outdoor swimming, (pool or open water) but indoors it made it too dark and difficult to see.  They fit airtight and cover the eyes properly without leakage or fogging. The strap across the nose is soft and flexible, but started to feel uncomfortable after about an hour in the pool. (Fortunately that is about as long as they were needed) The design and material of these goggles make them an excellent choice for anyone that spends a great deal of time in the water.

title: Fingers are a little short for me
text: The leather that these gloves are made out of are is extremely soft and supple. There are small holes though out the top of the fingers and hand part so that they breath. An additional feature of this glove is the synthetic leather on the areas like the palm that tend to wear quickly. The Velcro closure makes it easy to get it on and off easily. It has black accents and the "SRIXON" logo on the top. These is a beautiful, yet functional golf glove. I normally wear a medium and found the length of the fingers to be a little short for me, but I do have long fingers.  It’s Made in Indonesia.

title: A little small - Go next size up
text: The leather on this glove is beautiful. It is so soft and comfortable and just feels good next to the skin.  It has a Velcro catch across the top of the hand that makes the glove easier to get on and off. There are small perforations on top of the fingers that help the hand breath and reduce moisture. The glove is very thin and really provides a secure grip.  The size runs a little small, but will have some give and stretch. I would normally wear a medium glove and it feels a little short and tight.  I would go the next size up.  Made in Indonesia.

title: Kind of pricey, but I like it
text: I work for a high school that uses this bat grip to keep the bat from flying out of the kid’s hands when they swing. Their hands can get sweaty and cause the wood to slip out and it is a safety factor. It is makes hitting the ball more comfortable as well. It really stings the hand when the bat makes a connection with the ball. So this grip not only helps keep the bat from sliding, it also absorbs the shock. The back of the packaging has easy to follow instructions if this is your first time to use the grip. It is sticky on the backside and adheres to the wood. Our team does not practice or play without it.

title: Comfortable & Affordable
text: This is a great looking seat with the cobalt blue running along the sides, the black top, with the white stitching. It has very soft padding and the middle of the seat is open for comfort and keeping cool. I am not an avid biker, but I take mine on vacation with me and ride extensively for short periods several times a year.  I did not realize how uncomfortable my old seat was until I replaced it with this new one. I am very happy with the comfort and the look of this seat.  Changing the seat was very easy. I am not a mechanically minded person and thank goodness you don’t have to be to take the old seat off and put the new one on. The package contains a small wrench, but you may want to use your own tools, if you have them.  I did however, put the wrench in my bike pouch just in case I needed it while I was out on a ride. This was a great choice…..very comfortable.  It’s Made in China, but for the current price of just over thirteen bucks, it’s at the right price.

title: Inexpensive - Why not buy several!
text: This mouth guard is an easy efficient way to protect your teeth from grinding or clinching while sleeping at night. It is inexpensive, can be individually molded, and can be tossed and another one purchased without a huge investment. My husband is involved in high school athletics and Franklin mouth guards are used in a number of sports. Parents and participants alike are becoming much more consciences about protecting their mouth and teeth. These are so affordable that there is no reason not to have mouth protection. They come in a variety of colors and all that needs to be done is toss it in boiling water for about 10 to 20 seconds. Let it cool and then place it over your upper teeth and bite down to get a custom molding of your teeth. That’s it, ready to wear. When it wears thin or you feel it cannot be properly cleaned, get another.

title: I like them, but they run small
text: This is a gorgeous white leather glove for the golf enthusiast. It soft, thin, and has a Velcro catch for ease of getting them off and on.  The leather is very supple and allows for an excellent grip. I have long fingers and the medium was a little small for me. My hands are somewhat long and thin and would have been more comfortable with a large. They felt tight and too short for my fingers. They might wear-in given a little time and due to how nice the leather is, but to be on the safe side, I would go one size larger than I normally wear. Other than the size being a little tighter than I would prefer, the quality and look of this glove is fantastic.  They are Made in Indonesia.

title: Made in China - Poor Quality
text: These are 8 bean toss “type” bags to be use for different outdoor games and activities. Four of the bags are red and four are blue. I plan to use them for “Corn Toss” but the bags are considerably smaller than the ones that I currently have.  They are 3 ¼ X 3 ¼ and feel very flimsy and cheap.  They are sown together poorly and some of the threads were coming out when I first took them out of the box.  It only takes a little while of tossing these bags until the insides start falling out.  I am hard pressed to recommend due to the poor quality and small size.  They are Made in China

title: For the price, it's fine
text: This is a mediocre bait casting reel. It is certainly well worth the price for the quality but it takes some adjusting and getting used to the drag and tension. I had to keep a finger on the line to keep it from getting tangled up, which I’m OK with. I found it to be somewhat difficult to calibrate the tension wheel and it is not super precise.  It is sturdy and would be a great learning reel.  It is a very functional and cast easily. It was relatively quiet and smooth considering its size and price. It is lightweight, but strong and has a 3 year warranty. This is a freshwater reel which is perfect for my area. I taught my children to fish with a very similar reel and it was a summer of great fun for less than the cost of a fast food dinner.

title: If you're looking for cheap shuttlecocks. . . This might be it
text: I have played badminton since I was a kid and for those “old school” players like me the shuttlecocks were called birdies.  I am too old to play now, but my children and my nephews still play every summer. The rackets and the net always seem to make it from one year to the next, but the birdies…not so much. They get caught in trees, hit on top of the house, and sometimes they just get hit so hard or so many times they just break. These are great replacement birdies that are better quality than what comes in the pre-packaged set, but not for the serious player. If you are looking for just some good ‘ol summertime fun and need extra or replacement birdies, these are the ones.

title: The newest model from Srixon Z-Star
text: This is the latest incarnation of the Srixon Z-Star premium golf ball.  With each new design they try to improve over the last model, of course, and with this 2017 version, I think they have.  It’s a three-piece ball.  The core is soft-to-hard to maximize energy transfer and give more distance.  Even the dimples are different sizes to increase lift, but decrease drag.  Overall, it’s quite an amazing piece of equipment. . . and it’s just a golf ball!

title: Go Cougars!
text: This head cover is an absolute hoot! It is a conversation piece as well as a very functional piece of equipment. The quality is superb and a great way to protect expensive golf clubs. The cougar is well made and has faux sheep skin looking material for the interior lining. There is elastic sewn into the lining to keep the head cover securely on the club. The dimensions are 11.75 inches tall, 6.5 inches wide and 7.5 inches deep. It looks more like a stuffed animal because of the detail in the cougar’s face. My only criticism is that the neck and chest is white and shows dirt, but other than that, it is a great protection for clubs and they have a lifetime warranty.

title: Fits Great
text: This is one of the best feeling and fitting t-shirts I've ever worn. the texture and feel is very comfortable and it has a stylish logo on the left chest and the left arm. The sleeve length is perfect. As a person with a relatively long torso, I often find t-shirts to have a short waist length. This shirt has a very good waist length that stays tucked, yet I don't believe would be too long for someone with an average torso length. Seems like lately a lot of shop-printed t-shirts are almost too stretchy. This one is perfect. Stretchy, but substantial, not flimsy feeling.  It’s tagless, which I like.  It’s Made in Honduras, so it’s a bit pricey for a single t-shirt.  It comes wrapped in Champion tissue paper, and in a very flimsy box.  They could have either done without the box, or used a better box, because it’s not strong enough to use if you’re going to wrap as a gift.

title: Just for "show".
text: These have to be some of the least expensive wristbands ever.  I believe they are Made in China, but I’m not 100% certain, as the label is covered.  No matter where they were made, they couldn’t have cost more than a few pennies to make. I have the Dallas Cowboys version, and at the current price of seven bucks, they certainly are not worth it.  If you’re simply a Cowboys fan, and want to wear them while watching a game, then go for it.  If you need some “real” wristbands, then I would look elsewhere.

title: Cool Ball
text: This is a quality, well made ball with bright blue and green colors.  It has the MLS (Major League Soccer) shield on the front. It has panels sewn on the surface of the ball that give it spin when it is kicked. The shield panel is helpful to a newer player by providing a target area to focus on when learning to kick. The surface of the ball is embossed with additional panels that help with control. This ball has great design and durability.  It’s Made in China and comes inflated.

title: Simple, and it works
text:
This is a “reasonably priced” (for Made in China) agility ladder, which slides together and folds-up easily. Very compact. It’s adjustable so you can use as many rungs and you want/need. There are loops in the ends so you can use stakes to hold it in place, when using it outdoors, though the stakes are not included.

I think it’s kind of “assumed” that you will know what to do with it, as there are no instructions. But if you are looking for options, there are lots of instructional videos online. Just search for agility ladder.

title: Fun item that works decent
text: This is such a great golfer gift.  It’s fun, but also functional.  Having said that, I wish that a pair of tongs had been included.  The “clubs” are nice and long.  They are fairly well made, and not too expensive for what they are.  Though I will say I have other grilling tools I like better, these still work fine for the occasional use.  They would make a nice gift for a golfer as well.  I wish they had a ring or cord on the end to hang them.

title: Three C Batteries - Not Included
text:
First of all, you’re probably going to need more balls. Six are included, but you could easily use a dozen more.. . . .and they can be found at the links below. It pops-out a ball every five seconds, so with just six balls, the time goes by fast before you have to reload.

Note that this device takes three C batteries, which are not included. It would be nice if there were an AC adapter, but there’s not.

It’s a “flimsy” device. . . but it works. As long as you’re not rough with it (and there’s really no reason to be) then you should be ok.

Overall, for the current twenty buck price, it’s fine.
