I would agree in that the last graphite shaft I hit was a light stiffness and I had to exaggerate my slow down much more than with this club. When I hit it like my steel-shaft driver, I sliced terribly. When I "eased off" a bit, the ball straightened out.

title: Very expensive, but I like it.
text: This lime green cushion is covered in a removable / washable microfiber cover.  Though this cushion is billed as a “meditation cushion”, it certainly can be used for kids to be more comfortable while watching TV and so on.  Overall it’s a nice cushion, but at the current price of fifty bucks, and being that it’s Made in China, it certainly reaches the level of “crazy expensive” in my book.  I also wish it came in other colors, but lime green is certainly a unisex color, so it works well for both boys and girls.

title: Expensive, but I like it.
text: I like using this wedge while sitting / stretching to take the pressure off my tailbone.  I have used cushions in the past, but this wedge really works better for me.  It’s firm, though not hard.  Overall I really like it.  But I must say at the current price of right at fifteen bucks, it’s very overpriced.  Having said that, it fits my need perfectly so I’m still giving it four stars.  I also wish it came in other colors.

title: A bit pricey, but it works for me.
text: This is a nice, medium-quality bag.  It works with sand, though you can also fill it with whatever you have such as birdseed, rice, potting soil, etc.  I wish that the edges / seams were reinforced with additional stitching, which would give me a higher comfort level.  It just feels a little “fragile” when it’s filled.  Nonetheless, overall it works fine for my basic needs.  I think it is a bit expensive for Made in China, but it doesn’t reach the level of “crazy expensive”.  I think two could have been included for the current price.

title: Ok ok. . . but not a huge fan
text:
This game is Made in the USA. I really like that part. But . . . after that. . . I’m not a huge fan, and here’s why.

#1. You have to have four players. No more. . . No fewer.

#2. It doesn’t come pre-assembled, and should have been.

#3. The rules are kind of “crazy”. I think you’d be better off keeping it simple and making-up your own rules. I HIGHLY recommend you go to the makers website to see exactly the rules they show. There is a demo video which will explain the rules.

#4. At the current price, it’s crazy expensive.

#5. It’s not really a game that adults and kids can play together as easily as some other games.

If you like outdoor games. . . you know you’ll always have four people to play. . . . and you don’t mind paying the price. . . then go for it and give it a try!

title: Lots of "perks" with this device.
text: I found the set up out of the box very easy. Getting the device attached to the club is relatively easy, although you do have to use good sense in sliding the device onto the club clip, as the actual fit of the clip on the club has bearing on how tight the device fits on the clip. The pieces seem pretty durable, but you’d still want to be careful. I’m thinking there could be more convenient way of attachment to different size club shafts without actually having to change clips. The device does fit securely onto the clip and I had no indication of movement whatsoever. Initialization of the measurement process is very easy. While there’s an indicator light on the device when it’s ready for you to swing, the audible signal in the app is very useful. I used the app for iPhone. Once the swing has been made, then comes the analysis. The Help menu does a pretty good job of explaining things in the app, and the Description. Being able to manually toggle the “motion” views in the app is very cool. Various views available are also cool. All in all, I really like the device and the app. The ability to make notes on individual swings is very nice. I do, however, hope that Epson comes out the an iPad specific version of the app. I think that would make the app use experience better over just using an iPhone version on iPad. I’m in hopes that this device will help me to make some headway on my own in making improvements in my game. I really think it will.

title: A Video Would Be Helpful
text:
This item certainly adds resistance. . . but. .it’s not the most comfortable thing in the world. Hopefully the most I use it . . . the more I will get used to it. It doesn’t take-up that much room, so it’s great not only for home use, but also on-the-road.

Cost wise, I think it’s a bit expensive for Made in China, but not “crazy expensive”.

I wish SPRI would create a video for proper use. I haven’t been able to fine one yet.

This listing does not show anywhere that this product is for bikes. . . . but as you see on the label, that’s exactly what it’s for. I have no doubt that you can also use it on other matter surfaces.

title: Just OK
text:
This is an overall “decent” kick shield. I’ve used it more for football conditioning. There are handles on the back and sides which work well for my use. It’s hard, but lightweight.

Overall it’s not bad, but it’s quite overpriced for what it is, and how it’s made. There are better, lower-priced options out there. The listing shows that this item has been discontinued by the manufacturer, so perhaps better prices are coming.

FYI, the picture shows two. . but rest assured. . . You receive only one.

title: Expensive. .  .Assembly Required. . . Made in China
text:
Though I like some SKLZ products. . . . .This is a VERY expensive one Made in China. Assembly is required. . . and at this price. . . it shouldn’t be. It should have come pre-assembled.

As a “rebounder”. . . . it’s not perfect. But then who hits the net all the time? If you hit the net. . . then it works. . . If you don’t. . . then it doesn’t. But for those times you do. . . then it helps.

As for passing.. . . . If you’re shooting alone, then it’s better than nothing. It’s not going to have the right spin but again. . . if you’re alone. . . then it’s something.

It’s fairly sturdy, and doesn’t really move, though it certainly looks like it would. So that part I like.

Overall I like it. . . but. . . I just can’t get over the current price for “assembly required” and Made in China.

title: Case Included
text:
These goggles come in a reusable plastic storage case, which is a nice perk. These are swim goggles, and they work great for that. They are nice for those of us who prefer something larger than the one that just cover your eye sockets.

These goggles could also be used for other “light” work, like mowing the lawn and such, but they are not made for anything like construction.

They are Made in Italy, and at the current price (just under thirty bucks) I think they are very reasonable / affordable.

title: "Reasonable" quality
text:
This is a “medium” quality set. I can’t say that it’s “tournament quality” in the least. I think that some improvements have been made from a few years ago, when I look at past reviews.

This is a open-and-play game. You don’t have to put anything together. There are four beanbags of each color.

It’s large and fairly heavy. If you’re planning on taking it with you somewhere, you’ll need a larger vehicle.

Overall it’s a “reasonable” game. . . but. . . .it’s quite expensive for what it is at the current price.

title: Strong odor might not be good for some
text: The bar has a very strong rubber smell that is transferred to your hands when using the bar. However, washing it does seem to have reduced the smell, but not completely eliminated it. If you're extremely sensitive to the smell of rubber, you may not want this device. The texture of the device is soothing to the hands. Spending much of the day typing on a computer, this alone may make it worth having. The included instructions are pretty minimal. All in all, as I said before, I think the massaging effects of this device make it worth the cost.

title: Orange - Looks Better In Person
text:
This listing is for two different color combinations. The glove that I have is the Black/Orange.

The pictures on Amazon look a bit “washed-out”, so I’m uploading one, in hopes that you will be able to see the vibrant colors of the glove. It’s indeed bright orange.

One of the reasons that this glove is “RTP” (ready-to-play) is the material. The outer part is mostly cloth. The inside is “pleather” (faux leather). But this is not an expensive glove, and unlike an adult glove, it’s not going to be used for years and years by the same person. So overall, I think it’s a great glove at a reasonable price.

title: I Like It!
text:
This putting green comes rolled. Put something heavy (books) on the end, and it will flatten-out in a day or two. . . but. . . if you roll it up to put it away, then you’ll constantly be putting something heavy at the end. If you have a flat place to store it, like under a sofa, that certainly would work a bit better.

This device works as expected. Having a non-electric ball return is nice as well. Every now-and-then a ball will get “stuck” but that’s usually taken care of the next time a ball goes in and taps the “stuck” ball.

It’s Made in China and priced a bit high at the current price. . but not crazy expensive. Overall you should get a lot of practice and enjoyment out of it.

title: "Goop" Lacing System
text:
This is a nice “starter” type / size football for young people to begin with. It’s “squishy”.

The one “funny” thing is the “hype” about the “Spacelace lacing system”. The ball that I have doesn’t look like the picture at all. I would call mine “Goop lacing system”. See picture. I can certainly say that “Spacelace lacing system” is quite bogus.

This football is Made in China. At the current price it’s overpriced, but not crazy overpriced. Personally, I prefer the Wilson Junior Footballs.

title: Let's Get Ready to Rumble!
text: This is a fairly well made toy.  Nice size and gear.  It’s a little on the “pricey” side for Made in China, but you’re paying for the name, of course.  I’m not a fan of this guy, but of course you have to have the “bad” with the “good”.  This figure is also one of the lease expensive ones, at current pricing.  The packaging is nice, just in case you’re giving it as a gift.  The different body parts are removable.  I’m not exactly sure why that’s a “good thing” but just in case you want to pretend he loses a leg. . . you can.

title: Cena Rules!
text: This is a fairly well made toy.  Nice size and gear.  It’s a little on the “pricey” side for Made in China, but you’re paying for the name, of course.  This particular one also looks a little more who it is supposed to than some of the others.  The packaging is nice also, just in case you’re giving it as a gift.  The different body parts are removable.  I’m not exactly sure why that’s a “good thing” but just in case you want to pretend he loses a leg. . . you can.

title: Redesigned fanny pack
text:
This “crazy expensive”, Made in China (I think), modern fanny pack is very lightweight. There are two zipper pouches to hold your belongings. Though they don’t offer a lot of room, they should be enough if you’re taking a short walk or run. Keys, cell phone, etc.

The water bottle, in my opinion, is crazy small. 10oz is 1 and ¼ cups. Unless you’re just walking around the corner, you’re going to need a lot more than that. If hydration is what you’re going after, then you can purchase a Camelbak for less money than this item.

title: I think this might be the perfect kid bottle!
text:
These are really nice water bottles. They are a bit pricey, but they are designed really well, and worth it in the long run. With the simple press of a button, the spout pops-open. Easy to press it back down to close it. Great that there is a handle also, so you can attach it to a stroller, etc. Leak and spill-proof is a BIG plus.

This company make several different styles of this bottle. . . From the very “plain” to the more elaborate with pictures. They also make stainless steel models, as well as models for “adults” which are VERY cool. Click the “Contigo” name at the top to see all of the different options.

title: Fun. . . Easy. . . You can play just about anywhere
text:
This kind of reminds me of when I use to play tabletop “football” in school with a triangular piece of folded paper. Just something kind of fun to sit around and do that doesn’t take a lot of effort or set-up. . . Just about anyone can play. . . . You can take it anywhere. . . etc.

The longer the table. . . the more challenging, of course. I live in a condo and I really don’t have a long table. . . but. . . the “work around” is to put one board on one table and the other board on another table. . . and then you can move them as far apart as you wish.

I really wish they had made the colors of the beanbags different. They are two light pastel colors, and they look a lot alike. It would have been better to use two primary colors.

At the current price it’s a little high for Made in China. . . but. . . it’s not “crazy expensive”. . . and overall I like it.

title: Probably works best on larger bikes
text: This bike seat has some nice features, but there can be some “issues”.  A lot of things depend upon the bike you’re going to use it on.  It’s nice that the footrests are adjustable, but when they are all the way down my heel hits them.  It’s fairly easy to install, though I don’t count myself as a “handyman” so it probably took me longer than most.  Of course the seat itself is just molded plastic, but it works.  Not a lot of padding, but that’s not much of an issue for short rides.  It would be nice if there were a way to swap it between bikes, but I don’t see that’s possible, but I didn’t contact the company to fine out.  The current price is a bit steep, but not crazy expensive. . . especially when compared to other brands.

title: Nice Quality..  ..  .Affordable Price. . .
text:
With a project such as this, the #1 thing you have to do is. . .. Find the right trees!!! They have to be the right distance apart. . . .They have to be trees with deep roots. . . . They have to be in good health (and not fall over).

This is a good quality set that comes with really all you need, including a bag to put everything in. I like the fact that tree protectors are also included. The ratchet works well, which is something you certainly need with an item like this.

There are several sets which are more expensive than this one. . . and a couple just a little less. . . but overall I think the quality is great and it’s quite affordable, especially for someone who is just getting started and wants to have some fun without breaking the bank! Great gift for an active young person you just never know what to buy for them.

title: Better Protection than the Original Model
text:
This is the “new-and-improved” braces mouth guard by Shock Doctor. It has some nice “features” over their “older” braces mouth guard.

It fits snug. . . There are no problems after adjustments to the braces have been made. . . . It can be used strapped or strapless. . . . There’s no heating to make it fit. . . It has “three layer construction” and though it feels a little “bulky” at first, it’s rather easy to get used to. I know that “one size is supposed to fit all” with these things.. . but that’s not always the case. It can depend upon many factors. If you’re having “issues” with this one, you might want to try the “original” Shock Doctor model. There are two listings, one for the “strapped” model and one for the “strapless” model. It’s “slimmer” and not as “bulky” as this one. .. but this one offers better protection.

title: Form-Fitting - Variety of Colors
text: If you’re looking for a lip guard. . . . especially for sports which do not use a helmet. . .  then you’ll certainly want to give this one a try.  You need to follow the directions carefully for fitting, but if you don’t have a comfortable fit the first time, you can try it again.  The information I have shows that it can be used with braces, but Shock Doctor makes other guards specifically for braces.  The one thing I wish Shock Doctor would add to this product is the option of “flavors”, which they offer with some of their other guards.  A little bit of flavor makes having a guard in your mouth just a bit better.

title: Great Stand ...Eepecially When You Don't Have a Garage & Have to Store Your Bike Inside
text: The Saris Hottie Bike Stand is very easy to assemble. There are minimal parts involved. The holes drilled in the parts for screws were very accurately placed, making assembly a snap. As with all Saris products I've owned, it is built with very high quality parts and is aesthetically pleasing enough to use indoors without being ashamed for it to be seen. The only difficulty I had in assembly was installing the lower bike supports in the mid-position, which actually straddles the upper and lower sections of the rack. I wasn't that surprised that I needed to use a plastic mallet to settle the supports into place. All other pieces were very easily installed. The rack is very substantial and I would have no reservations about the security of it's ability to hold two bikes when on level ground. The rack comes with one shelf that will hold several accessories including helmets in the special slots made for the clasp to slide into. The current price tag certainly would make one pause, but in my opinion, if you invest a significant amount of money in a good quality bike, you probably wouldn't mind investing in a good quality rack to securely hold your bike.

title: Very sturdy. Non-slip bottoms are a big plus

Non-slip bottoms are a big plus.  Lightweight.  Fairly inexpensive, though could be a little less, being that they are made in China.  Not to be used for weights over 300 pounds.  Certainly helps to take pressure off your wrists by using the stands rather than without.

title: A new design on such a divice.
text: Overall, this is a well made item.  There are measurements on the side, which is nice.  The "agitator" works as it's supposed to.  Having said that, it can be a bit annoying when it flops back-and-forth when you're drinking something.  Also, I've had to be careful that it doesn't go down the garbage disposal.  You have to make sure that you put everything back together after you wash it.

title: This is the brightest flashlight I've ever owned!
text:
In the past, I've mostly used Maglite. But this little beauty really puts any Maglite I've had to shame. Honestly. . . I don't know a lot about "lumens". . . but I just know that this thing is BRIGHT. When it says that it's a "focusing" flashlight, that means you can put a spotlight one sometime. Depending upon how far away the item is, you pull the ring on the light end out to where you want it to be for your spotlight. Using this feature will cut-down on your battery life, but the batteries last from 5.75 - 10-hours, so quite a long life.

Please see the other coast flashlights as well. They make them without the "focusing" part, if you wish, but there is so little cost difference that I think it's a nice feature to have.

The packaging is really nice. A slick box. The flashlight comes with a nice carrying case, as well as strap.

It feels really durable and sturdy in your hand. Small and compact.

The on/off button is on the back end. At first I thought I wouldn't like that so much, but now it feels fine. It just depends upon what you're doing, because if you're holding it pointing down, the you can use your thumb to turn it on/off. If you're holding it out, then depending upon how coordinated you are, you might have to use two hands to turn it off.

This flashlight is an investment. It's not something you're going to get at the 99 cent store. But it should last you a very long time.

title: Good, but not great, and expensive
text:
I like it ok, overall. I've never used a trailer before so it takes some getting used to in how the weight pulls on the bike, etc. I put three twelve-packs of Coke on it and pulled it around the neighborhood. Up hills, down hills, on sidewalks and all. Pulls good. Folds up nicely and I like the bag and straps that come with it. Seems easy to pull up stairs if you need to. Hitch for bike is nice and easy to use. But there are a few "issues".

For an item made in China, it's very expensive. The design could have been a lot better to allow you to also carry things in it like groceries. Instead, they offer a separate, very expensive, "shopping bag" as a separate option/purchase.

I honestly don't know of anyone who rides their bike to work with a large suitcase, kind of like what is shown on the video. If you're traveling with your suitcase, then you're probably going to the airport, and not on your bike. On the other hand, I think it would work well for golf clubs if you were going to play a round somewhere. Pulling it through an aisle at a grocery store, or pulling it through Wal-Mart is just crazy. If it had "wings" that folded-open to form the sides, and then a "mesh" on the front . . . then I think it would have a lot more versatility.

In the end, I just don't know how useful it is for most people, especially for the price. If you're looking for something more affordable, simply to carry things around, you might try the Aosom Bicycle Bike Cargo Trailer.

text: Overall, this set is nice. The shape of the weights make them really easy to use since they don’t roll around. There is a nice mix of sizes to accommodate different training needs and levels. The idea of being able to convert the dumbbells into one longer bar is great but the execution is lacking a little. When you put all of them together it leaves two spaces for your hands that are awkwardly placed and not usable for someone with larger hands. My husband can’t use it at all that way, which is a huge bummer since I ordered this set for him. Also the locking nuts are plastic and I can foresee them stripping out over time. This will get some use now but will be replaced soon since it doesn’t suit his needs.

title: Beautiful, high quality glove
text: This is definitely my favorite of all the gloves I’ve owned. It’s beautiful and the quality is superb. I love the strap closure that lets you get a tighter fit and also makes it easier to get on and off. This glove is very stiff and required a fair amount of break in before I could use it but it was well worth the effort. This is a glove that will last a long time.

title: Excellent bat!
text: This bat is seriously awesome! It sends the ball flying. It feels balanced and the grip is comfortable and absorbs all the shock. I’ve used a lot of different bats over the years I’ve played but this one is definitely my favorite.

title: High quality glove
text: I love that this looks like a regular glove instead of the typical gloves for kids. It’s very soft and needs no break in time. It’s lightweight so it’s easy on little hands and the notch that helps it close is an awesome feature. This is by far the best youth glove I’ve seen.

title: Excellent helmet offers great protection
text: This helmet is such a pretty blue color and is very nicely made.  It offers excellent protection and fits well. It comes with a chin strap that can help stabilize it and make it fit a little better if it’s loose. The face guard is sturdy and well placed so it keeps your child safe while allowing them to have full visibility. It’s an excellent batting helmet.

title: Great for family camping trips
text: I just got back from a little camping adventure with my family and this tent was wonderful! It was quick and easy to setup and it has plenty of room. We’re a family of four with a large dog and we had tons of space to stretch out. The quality is great and I think you’d have to try to rip it. The floor to ceiling windows were a life saver this weekend. It was pretty hot and those windows let air move through so it’s comfortable to sleep. It’s also great for someone like me that’s watched way too many horror movies and likes to see what’s going on outside my tent. I really love how easy it was to pack up when it was time to leave. It was just as easy as setting the tent up. Whomever came up with this design is a genius because no matter how I rolled up my old tents I could never get them back in the bag correctly. I have so many memories of camping trips when I was growing up in our Coleman tent so I’ve always had a fondness for this brand. It makes me really happy to make new memories with my own family and they wouldn’t be quite complete without a Coleman of my own. Excellent tent.

title: Fun and doesn’t take up a lot of space
text: This is a great way to enjoy air hockey at home without the need for a game room or a lot of extra space. This isn’t a full size table but it is a fun and affordable option for your home. Assembly was easy and it was ready to go pretty quickly. The blowers are powerful and consistent. When you score it sometimes takes a second to count it but it always shows it correctly. The pushers are easy to hold and I like that there’s a place to store them. You can fold this table flat to put it away if you need to or you can leave it up all the time like I do so it’s ready whenever I feel like challenging someone. We have a lot of fun with this table and I highly recommend it.

title: Nice board, not so nice darts
text: This is basic dartboard and it’s nice. It’s nothing spectacular but I ordered it to hang out in our garage and it works great there. The darts aren’t very nice. The flights started coming off during the first game. They aren’t all that comfortable to hold either so it was easier to just buy new darts. Now that we have good ones we have a lot of fun with this board. So I do recommend the dart board but suggest having backup darts on hand.

title: Solid and versatile reel
text: I’m not into fishing but my husband enjoys it and loves his new reel. It’s very well made and versatile. We rarely go to the ocean but this reel will work in saltwater as well as fresh. He’s brought in a few massive fish using this reel.

title: Well worth having on camping trips
text: This is a wonderful addition to my camping supply stash. It weighs very little and folds compactly so it’s great for backpacking trips when weight matters and won’t take up much space in the car on a camping trip. It’s well made and fits right over your sleeping bag to provide a thin, waterproof layer to keep you dry. If you’ve ever camped and woken up in a damp bag you’ll understand how important it is to waterproof. If you have never had to deal with that uncomfortable situation, you can save yourself from every having to by getting a bivy bag like this one.

title: Lightweight outdoor blanket
text: This blanket is super lightweight but also provides a nice amount of warmth. It would be perfect for backpacking since it weighs so little and folds down to fit in a small bag. It’s also great just to keep in the car for outdoor or emergency needs. It’s well made and the red is nice and bright. This is the first product I’ve owned from this brand and I’m very pleased.

title: Excellent bat!
text: This is by far the best bat I’ve ever owned. The grip is comfortable and absorbs vibration. The bat is nicely balanced and packs a serious punch. I’ve never hit the ball so far in my life and it was good to go on the first swing. It’s an attractive bat too. If you’re looking for an awesome bat, this is it.

title: Nice but rods are a little awkward to use
text: My husband is really into survival gear so I thought this set would be a nice addition to his collection. The rods are really nice quality. The handles are smooth and easy to grasp. The rods work but they’re a bit awkward to use because they’re so short. If they were just a couple inches longer they would be perfect. They are still nice to have though. The multi tool is kinda useless but I’m sure could serve a purpose in a pinch.

title: Lightweight backpacking tent
text: This tent is really nice quality, which is something I’ve come to love about Ust products. It’s really lightweight so it’s perfect for backpacking and has enough room for two people. I didn’t have any trouble setting it up and really like that it’s waterproof and brightly colored. I have loved everything I’ve used from this brand and highly recommend it for outdoor products.

title: Lightweight with nice grip
text: This pair is really lightweight. They’re easy to get on and off quickly and stay on well. The crampons are great and give a nice grip. I took off one star because I don’t see these holding up. I ordered these to use in the woods and hills around my home, which are rocky and rough in spots, and the material these shoes are made from just isn’t going to take that kind of abuse. I think there would be fantastic for better ground though. They’re so light that your legs don’t tire quickly and  they are well made.

title: So much better than sleeping on the ground!
text: Wow do I wish I’d had one of these on all those camping trips when I slept on the ground. This mat is NICE! It’s lightweight and fold up pretty compactly. It’s not something you would take on a backpacking trip where weight matters, but that’s not what it’s designed to be. It’s easy to throw in the trunk when you’re ready to go and inflates quickly when you need it. The valve is interesting. I’ve never seen one like it. You simply flip the disk around and it self inflates while you’re working on something else. It was good to go in a few minutes. When you’re ready to roll it back up, flip the disk to the deflate side and start rolling the mat up. This is a really well made sleeping mat that keeps you several inches off the ground and gives you enough room to be comfortable throughout the night without rolling off. The material is nice and soft and it looks really cool too with the bright colors. I own a few other products from this brand and I’ve been happy with them all. Ust has definitely become my go to for camping items and I highly recommend this mat.

title: Large sleeping bag with nice features
text: This sleeping bag will be really useful when we start camping again in the spring. I’ve never owned a double bag before but I can see why they exist. There is so much room! My husband, myself and our toddler can all fit inside it if we wanted, which would be useful on cold nights. I really like that the bottom extends up further for your head. The outer fabric is slightly noisy but not bad. The inner fabric is much smoother and softer than other bags I own. It’s a nice feature that this unzips on both sides so one person doesn’t have to freeze if the other person needs to get up. It also lays out for a large pad. I think this sleeping bag is great.

title: Perfect for backpacking trips
text: This is the perfect mat to pack when you’re going on a backpacking trip. It’s very lightweight, weighing in at just over a pound, and takes up very little space. It inflates with a pump sack, which is something I’ve never seen before but is really cool and efficient. It saves space since you don’t have to carry a pump and time and lung power by not having to blow it up. The mattress itself is comfortable to sleep on and is sized to save space since on a backpacking trip you’re likely to carry a small, lightweight tent. My husband is 6’0” and 200 lbs and this mat is great for him. If you’re looking for a more luxury camping adventure this isn’t the mat for you, but that’s not what it’s designed to be. It’s made for situations when you need something that doesn’t weigh you down or take up space in a bag or tent, and it fills that niche well. The quality is great, which is what I’ve come to love about ust. You can pretty much outfit your camping trip with their products and know that the money you’re investing is well spent. Highly recommended!

title: Disappointing but still kinda fun
text: I’m a lifelong ski ball fan so I was ecstatic when I saw this. I couldn’t wait for it to arrive and when it did I was like a kid on Christmas. My excitement started to wane a bit while we set it up, because it is rather flimsy,  then took a nosedive after I rolled the first ball. Then the second. Then the third. And none of them came back. The ramp is made of fabric and it’s too loose to form a flat enough path for ball return. I was disappointed, largely because my excitement bubble had been popped, but then I started thinking rationally and assumed it was just wrinkled from being in a box and would settle and be fine. Well three weeks later and that hasn’t gotten any better. You have to reach underneath and tap the ramp to make the balls roll back. The rest of it functions well. It folds up nicely snd takes up little space. The scoreboard works but it doesn’t save scores beyond the game you’re playing, which makes no sense to me. How am I supposed to claim I’m the queen of ski ball when I can’t prove it later? I just feel there should be more features or at least better a better build quality to account for the nearly $220 price tag on this game. Is it fun? Yes. Mostly. Is it worth that much money? Probably not.

title: Nice addition to workout routines
text: This is a nice set of resistance bands that are well made and come in a several different weights. I didn’t realize how versatile these were until I tried them out. My husband stacks several of them together and hooks them to his bench in place of free weights while I use the ankle straps and handles (with a lot less weight) for stretching and lighter workouts. They’re easy to travel with and take up very little space when not in use, which are big pros over weights. These have been great to have since I’ve been spending so much time at home recently. There are tons of workout videos available using resistance bands and they also work nicely when used to amp up your regular routine.

title: An absolute blast to ride!
text: I’ll admit up front that I ordered this for myself. I’m a mother of a teen and a toddler and sometimes I just need to have fun, and this hoverboard has been blast. It’s beautifully made and works flawlessly. It arrived almost fully charged, so I didn’t have to charge it long before I was able to try it out. It took me a few tries before I caught on to how it works. I thought you tilted your feet forwards or backwards to get it to move, so I really only managed to spin in circles. Then I decided I should probably read the directions and realized the direction it moved is determined by your center of gravity. A sight shift in any direction will send you that way.  Now I’ve got it down and wow is it fun, even when I’m just hovering around the house. I’m even more thankful we opted for hardwood and tile in the main areas of my home. This is my first experience with a hoverboard and it’s been amazing. I highly recommend it, whether you’re getting it for your child or you just want to let loose and have a little fun yourself.

title: Lightweight and easy to setup
text: This is a nice hammock that has been a great addition to our camping collection. It rolls up compactly into an easy carry bag and is lightweight. Setup takes minutes, with finding two trees at the right distance being the most difficult step. It’s comfortable to lay in and the tie outs add some space. The big netting is an excellent addition that keeps you from being eaten alive by mosquitos. I’ll definitely be picking up a couple more of these so we all have one. Highly recommend!

title: Huge tent with plenty of ventilation.
text: This tent is huge! When it says six people, that’s six people comfortably. It arrives in a nice, adjustable duffel bag, which I really appreciate because I can never roll them up as compactly as they come. There are minimal instructions but tents are essentially all the same, so if you’ve put together even one you can likely figure it out pretty easily. There are five poles in three color coded lengths that go across the top and arch down over the sides. Then you stake it down with the metal stakes and you’re good to go. Both ends have a large opening and there is a window on each side, so there’s plenty of ventilation. The hanging accessory pouches are brilliant for keeping track of small items. I set this tent up outside right before it rained to test the waterproofing and it was sound. This is not a tent you would take out in cooler months but it’s awesome for warm weather. There’s a ton of space and the quality is great.

title: Perfect!
text: This is a beautiful, extremely well made leash. The color is nice and vivid. The weaving is perfect. It’s very strong but also lightweight. The length is ideal for walking with my German Shepherd: I can give him a little room to explore while also keeping him close. The hook is more like a carabiner so it can be attached quickly and securely. I’m a huge fan of this leash and highly recommend it.

title: Very well made
text: This is one well made harness. The weaving is perfect. The colors are bright and beautiful. It’s nice and light so your pup won’t get hot or feel bogged down. I have a German Shepherd, so I ordered a large. The harness came and I immediately went to adjust it for my boy but it didn’t fit at its largest size. It’s actually a medium, which was disappointing. It’s a beautiful harness though.

title: Perfect for camping!
text: Coleman has always been the brand I first think of when it comes to camping supplies. As a child, I remember my dad buying everything from this brand for our trips and some of those items are still at my parents’ house years later. This sleeping bag is consistent with expectations from Coleman: it’s high quality and perfect for outdoor adventures. I haven’t had the opportunity to test it in temps below 50°F, but I found it to be quite warm and very comfy. Sleeping on the ground can be rough on your body but when I used this sleeping bag I woke up without any back pain. The sizing is correct.  I’m 5’9” and had a few inches of room, so someone at or above six feet should probably get a larger bag for comfort. I’ve really enjoyed having this Coleman bag on my recent adventures and am looking forward to many more nights under the stars being spent in warmth and comfort.

title: Great addition to my routine
text: This is a very well made yoga ball. It feels very durable and is the perfect size for me. It was really easy to inflate with the included foot pump. It’s been a couple of weeks now and hasn’t lost any air at all. The small ball has more of a grip to it, which is great for keeping ahold of it during workouts. I’ve been using both of them in my morning routine and they’ve been wonderful additions. I also use the bigger ball in the evenings to stretch out my back, which is an amazing feeling after a long day.

title: Nice and useful
text: I’ve wanted one of these for a long time and finally decided to pick one up. I had some difficulties getting it inflated though. The directions state to fill it partially, wait 24 hours then fill the rest of the way. I did that but the next day it was flat. Unfortunately, there was a hole in it. I patched it with shoe goo (who knew that stuff had so many uses), let it sit for a day then proceeded to start the inflation process again. It is really difficult to inflate it completely because when you take the pump out air immediately starts escaping so you have to be quick with the plug. The ball feels well made and sturdy. It’s nice and big so it accommodates my 5’9” body well for stretching. Sitting on it felt awkward, but after a week I find myself being more comfortable on the ball than on a chair. It’s helped tremendously with my back pain and I’m starting to feel much more flexible. I’ve been incorporating it into my exercise routines too. I’m really happy with this product.

title: Five Stars
text: BEAUTIFUL and very nicely made. Need sharpened though.

title: Super Pickleballs
text: Very happy with these Fostoy pickleballs. I have started this sport just a few months ago and I love it. These pickleballs have a lot of bounce and are great to use. I appreciate that they meet USA pickleball standards. Love the bright yellow and orange balls. Appreciate the mesh bag so that I have a place to store the extra balls and the fanny pack type bag for taking a few pickle balls with me to the pickleball court.

title: Great Golf Balls
text: Very happy with these Truscope colored golf balls. I really love to use orange and yellow golf balls. Better for visibility for me. I played golf this weekend and while I am not a fabulous golfer these balls do go a great distance when I am playing well. Great to use even when practice putting. Great quality and definitely helping my golf game.

title: Superb Meditation Cushion
text: Very happy with the MONAHITO meditation cushion. Good size for me. Very comfortable cushion. I place this on top of a larger cushion for my meditation and yoga. Appreciate the side cloth handle making much easier to carry. The embroidered symbol on the pillow is lovely. This is an elegant pillow for meditation.

title: Great For Exercise
text: I enjoy using these PodiuMax adjustable sports training hurdle. I need to work out and these are perfect. Whether I jump over the hurdles and weave between them I appreciate that they collapse easily so I don't get injured. Easy to open and close and store.

title: Great Outdoor Pickleballs
text: These XZAKTLY pickleballs are super with plenty of bounce and a little quieter to use. Some places that I play the homes located nearby do not like the noise of pickleball so it is great these are quieter. Appreciate the net bag the balls come in.

title: Quality Pickleball Paddle
text: Very happy with this PICKLETECH Immersion paddle. I love that it is very lightweight.  The design makes it a delight to play with. Very cool design and love the blue color. Definitely helps my game. Really enjoy playing with my new paddle.

title: Works Great
text: This CLOLOP bike floor pump is super for filling my bicycle tires. Easy to pump up the tires with the foot pump and fills them fairly fast.  Easy to push together and store in my shed. Does the job well and I am very happy with this floor pump.

title: Cute Bucket Hat
text: Really like this Chudapanthaka bucket hat. Hat fits well and is so cute. This is great for wearing to the pool or relaxing in the backyard. Shades my face nicely and I love the cactus print since I live in the southwest and appreciate anything with cactus on it. I always wash new clothing and this washes up quite nicely.

title: Perfect Size Backpack
text: I really like this Donason Crossbody Backpack. The size is just perfect for those light days when I just don't want to sling a purse over my shoulder and fill it up to the max (like I usually do). Sometimes I just want to carry the minimum and this small backpack will hold a wallet, keys, phone, glasses and a small paperback book which is all I need on light days. Or if hiking I could fit a couple of small water bottles in this pack. Well made and I can wear it front or back. Perfect for my needs.

title: Perfect Camping Table and More
text: Love this ABCCANOPY folding camping table. I definitely will be using it for camping. Very simple to take up and down. Also great on my patio. Love the drink holders. I also used it when cleaning out my shed to pile cloth items that I didn't want to place on the ground. Compact with a nice carrying bag this will be going to dog shows also with me. Just the table that I needed.

title: Roomy and Comfortable
text: I am really happy with this Kingcamp loveseat camping chair. I am using this chair on the patio right now but  will also be using it camping and at dog shows. Very easy to open and folds up quite nicely and small enough to fit easily in my small suv. Comfortable and holds my ample weight easily with room for another person or more likely my dog sitting next to me. Comes with a cover and I love relaxing in this chair.

title: Perfect Organizing Rack
text: Love this Keenature camping folding storage rack. I needed more space in my kitchen. I don't have a large kitchen and I wish I had more counter space. I placed this storage rack where I don't have cabinets overhead and filled it with plants and assorted kitchen necessities.  The storage rack was super simple to set up and the shelves are quite level. The shelving itself is not too large but just perfect for my needs.  The wood is lovely and the same color as my cabinets. I may find other uses for these shelves but right now they look fantastic in my kitchen. Perfect.

title: Super Set of Utensils
text: I am absolutely pleased with this Travel Utensils Set.  Sometimes on a break at work food is brought in and we are out of plastic utensils. This set came in very handy, at least for me. Great also to have this set for camping. I love that it has it's own case with the metal straws and cleaning brush included. Good sized silverware even for everyday use. Very happy with this set.

title: Very Useful Emergency Kit
text: This Stanford Vintage Emergency kit is just perfect for me. Some of the items are quite useful for camping and most of the items are perfect for everyday needs. The string saw and firestarter are great. Love the multipurpose knife with screwdrivers, pliers, file, knife and can opener. Just enough bandaids and wound dressings to take care of a quick emergency. The multipurpose pocket survival tool (safely enclosed in a plastic cover) is a super additional tool. Compass and whistle quite useful for me too. The tin is small and easy to carry in my purse or backpack. Overall a lot of useful tools in a small convenient tin.

title: Cooling Towels Work Great
text: I absolutely love these microfiber cooling towels. Living in the southwest it is already reaching into the 100 degree days. Whether I wear one in the backyard to trim the plants and lower branches of my tree or setting up an agility course at my friends house late afternoon before evening classes I definitely wear one of these cooling towels around my neck. I just drench a towel in very cold water and tie it around my neck. These towels keep me from overheating. Great for golfers and runners also. Washable and easy to stuff in my purse or backpack. Super cooling towel. Highly recommend.

title: Super Chair
text: Very happy with this ABCCANOPY folding directors chair. First of all very comfortable. Love the side table with the drink holder and the pockets on the other side. This is great for taking to dog shows and outdoor events. Folds up nicely to fit in my small SUV. Included also is a nice canvas bag to carry the chair in. Really great product. Love it.

title: Great Workout Machine
text: I am very happy with this WONDER CORE Sway N Fit machine. First of all I appreciate the minimal assembly right out of the box. The seat is large enough to hold my ample bottom. Slides easily back and forth. Great to work on my love handles and oblique abs and most importantly to loosen up my lower back. My lower back has been a little tight in the muscles and this machine is really helping with that. Also with the resistance bands I can also work on my arm muscles. Great machine and stores nicely.

title: Great Putter
text: I really enjoy playing golf and where I live there are plenty of lovely golf courses. My weakness is putting so I have a lot to work on. This GoSports GS2 putter really is helping me with my game whether playing golf or practicing at home in the backyard. Well made and love the oversized grip.

title: Super Collapsible Water Bottle
text: Love these Beautail collapsible water bottles. I put them in the dishwasher right after I received them and they did quite well. These bottles are great for jogging, when the water runs out just collapse and put it in my pocket or small backpack if I am going for a longer hike.  Also for taking water for my dogs. Easy to sip from and just the cutest colors.

title: Perfect Camping Light Bulb
text: Love these Camping Light bulbs. First of all they need three AAA batteries, not included. Bulb is quite bright and I have so many uses along with camping. The clip on the bulb is so ideal for clipping to the top of the tent or when I go to dog shows great for attaching to the canopy. It has a bright light, softer light and a flashing light. Cute and very lightweight. These camping lights would be fun for children making little forts in the living room to have a little safe light. Multiple uses, safe in my estimation and cute colors. Great and fun product.

title: Super Resistance Bands
text: These Gaiam resistance bands are superb. At my age I am a little lazy about working out. These resistance bands are just what I need. I am working to build muscle and increase flexibility. These bands are thick and well made and I do appreciate the enclosed instructions. Great set and made to last and perfect for working out at home.

title: Super Camping Chair
text: Really love this TR lightweight Directors chair. Very well made and solid and definitely supports plenty of weight. Love the side table. I am using this not only camping but on my back patio just to relax and read in. Love the soft tan color. Folds up nicely and does not take up too much room in my suv.  Definitely heavy duty and made to last for a long time. Great looking and very useful chair. Highly recommend.

title: Super Tee Shirt
text: Love this Houston baseball fans tee shirt. First of the the graphics are great. The tee shirt definitely fit true to size. The best part is that the shirt is 100% cotton which is what I really prefer in a tee shirt. Good rich color and so comfortable to wear. Quality shirt.

title: Great Trekking Poles
text: Really pleased with these Hiipeak trekking poles. They adjust easily for my 5'6" height. The handholds are quite comfortable. The extra tips included are quite useful. Took a long hike yesterday and was a lot more comfortable on uneven ground. Great product.

title: Great Cooler
text: Love this LOOMLA portable cooler bag. Still fairly warm in the southwest and I need to take some pop and water to my dog training class. I took the cooler and I really like using the shoulder strap which I prefer. This cooler kept my beverages very cool and did not leak. Good looking cooler and zips up very snug. Quality product that I am very happy with.

title: Fantastic Collapsible Sinks
text: I am super pleased with these AUTODECO collapsible sinks. I received two along with a decent sized towel. These are not only great for camping but I have many uses for these. I like having it in my car to place groceries in that I don't want to tip over, washing vegetables, collecting dog toys and many other uses. Collapsible and easy to store. Really perfect for my needs.

title: Great Disposable Towels
text: Love these VanFn disposable towels. I have plenty of uses for these towels.  I love that they are compressed and easy to carry in my purse. When I go to a friends house with my dogs I like to wipe down the outside chairs in the yard that get full of tree sap and dirt. Rather than waste multiple paper towels just one of these  compressed towels does the job. Also great as a washcloth when I am out and about or wiping down the dogs paws when they get muddy. Multiple use and very portable. Love them.

title: Impressed!
text: I am really impressed with this Telescopic lightweight stool. First of it is quite compact. Very easy to carry for camping or possibly if I have to wait in line somewhere.  I can see so many uses for the stool. Very simple to set up and take down. It easily supports my overweight self.  Of course it is a hard seat but when you need a place to sit it is just fine. Love it!

title: Colorful And Useful Blanket
text: I really love this Makuzo Mexican Blanket.  Super colorful and right now resides on the back of my recliner. Brings a lovely pop of color to my living room. Great for throwing over my shoulders when I am chilled. Also love the bag the blanket came in. I am using it for groceries. Colors are so cheerful and nice blanket. Perfect.

title: Super Camping Cot
text: This WAKEDALE adult folding camping cot is quite comfortable.  Fairly lightweight and folds easily. Does not take up much room in my SUV when packing for camping. I am overweight and this cot holds up nicely and feels solid. Great product. Love it.

title: Very Comfortable Pillow
text: This ZOOBELIVES camping pillow is just perfect. Being down filled makes it so comfortable and I love that it is so easy to roll up and pack up into my backpack. I have always loved that down pillows can be squeezed and shaped into the perfect comfortable shape for sleeping. The size is just right and the suede cover is so nice. Love it!

title: Great Collapsible Buckets
text: Love these collapsible buckets. I have so many uses for them. I use them for gardening, water for the dogs when we go to lessons, washing the car and more. Being collapsible they store easily under the sink or in the shed or I collapse one and put it in the back of the car. So useful and the perfect size.

title: Very Complete First Aid Kit
text: This is a superb first aid kit. For me it is perfect for camping as it has everything I need. I do like also to keep it in the car for emergencies. I find with what I call my old lady paper skin all I have to do is bump my leg on something and it bleeds. I always need a first aid kit nearby. Plenty of gloves, bandages, alcohol wipes, antiseptic wipes, ace bandages, band aids and more. Great size and case.

title: Very Large Towels
text: Really Impressed with these Aimisin  compressed disposable towels. I opened one up and was amazed how large and absorbent the towel is. I will be taking on with me camping and keep one in the car. The towels are just thick enough and I really like them.

title: Great Camping Food
text: Very tasty. While I will be using these for camping I had to try the breakfast egg and potato. Very simple to make, just add a half cup of water. It was delicious and I expect the rest of the meals will be too. These pouches do not take up much room in backpack and will be a delight while camping. Love them.

title: Super Tent
text: I absolutely love this Gonex Pop Up Beach Tent.  Just so simple to set up. Just pops up in seconds. Great size in height and width.  I am using this for dog shows where I can easily fit three large crates in this tent. Plenty of extra shade for me to put a chair in front of the crates.  Very lightweight and simple to store. Hardly takes up any room in my small suv. Perfect tent for my uses.

title: Super Meditation Mat
text: This Monk and Llama Zabuton meditation mat is great. I love that two covers are included, both a gray and a tan color. The mat itself is large and comfortable. Just enough cushion for me. title: Looks nice, feels very soft, not set on 4 or 5 stars
text:
My niece is in her second year at Michigan, so my wife and I have been cheering for them. When I saw this Double Sided Cloud Soft Plush Throw Blanket 60"x70" (Michigan Wolverines - Blue,) I decided to grab it for when she visits and for around the house when we're watching football. So far we really like it, we are impressed, but we agreed, we cannot decide if it's deserving of 5 or 4 stars... here's why:

It arrived in a typical bag, so nicely folded and showing off the bright, brilliant colors. This was a plus. When opening it felt super soft instantly and we were thrilled. She's going to love it when she's here. My wife will love it for game days.

The material is great... but we cannot tell if it'll be one of those kinds that sheds or pills after (during) washing. We are not interested in washing it until it needs it, so we're not going to know until then. On the other hand, we shook it out and threw it a few times across the bed and shook it to try and see if something flew off - nothing did. So cool, all is well so far... Then why the continued concern? The stitching along the sides is average at best, really not great overall. For something we should be thrilled with, this weak spot was enough to not sooth our concerns. I try to show this in a couple pictures - all the way around you can see the batting sticking through - why is this and does this lessen the quality? Now you understand why we gave it the 5, but are giving the heads up on a possible 4.

The colors and design are wonderful - it looks great across the bed. And the reverse is just as nice looking. There is a "shadow" blue to the M which looks a bit... weird, but other than that - and it really doesn't dominate - it looks so cool.

So in the end we went with 5, we love the feel, my wife can't wait for cold weather, and my niece will love it ( and yea, don't say anything, but we'll likely get her one for Christmas.

title: Works great in my wife's office space
text:
[[VIDEOID:9cd18f2d8b61d1fb4584e3a87364b212]] My wife and I work at home and already had a stepper unit, but she had been wanting one for her work space, rather than have to carry the slightly larger and bit heavier one I use in the main area of the house, back and forth to her space. So when I had the chance to grab this Niceday Steppers for Exercise, Stair Stepper with Resistance Bands I took it and so far, she's very pleased.

The Niceday Steppers for Exercise, Stair Stepper with Resistance Bands comes pretty much assembled. There are the handles at the end of the resistance band you can place onto the unit (so far she has not done so), so there is that "assembly," but for stepping it's pretty much out of the box and go. You do have to adjust the resistance - we seems more about the height of the steps rather than how much resistance it gives you, but that is easy enough - turn the orange dial underneath either clockwise or counterclockwise to where you're comfortable. I will say, it took a few tries - the steps are set VERY high out of the box, so we played with and got it adjusted after a few tries - to our preferred setting. Again, she is set to use this as she works at her home office adjustable height desk, so that's in the corner of the bedroom - already a full space - and has it tucked in a corner when not in use. The weight of the unit is good and easy enough to move. It is indeed lighter than the other one we had that she formerly had to move back and forth when she wanted it - again, for space we were not keeping it in there as well as for use while working out in the other room. She hasn't used the handles - which we both feel like they are good, but could be better. The handles themselves are thinner and not 100% comfortable for longer sessions. They are compact and don't take up much room, but she's planning to use this while working, so no real need for them, but also, not sure she'd find them comfortable - but this is based on simply holding them in the hand, not actual use. The surface of the Niceday Steppers for Exercise, Stair Stepper with Resistance Bands is raised in bumps for traction. I tried it with no shoes - it's doable, but I'd say not for a full workout. My wife tried the first time in slippers and was fine. She does use shoes for any workouts. The traction is good all around. The steps give a solid, good amount of resistance and give one the burn you're looking for. There is a battery included for the timer/counter, but we both realized later it was still sitting where we placed it to not loose it and the stepper was keeping track - so it came with one in it. The stepper makes next to no noise so there is no worry about having to talk over a phone call. The one thing that my wife and I disagree on between the unit we had and this one: the track of the step. On the previous stepper we already had, the track of stepping traces a path that moves the foot outwards at the bottom, inwards as it goes up. I like this for the way my step/hips work - she does not. This Niceday Steppers for Exercise, Stair Stepper with Resistance Bands tracks the steps straight up and down, making it more comfortable for my wife, less so for myself.

In the end the Niceday Steppers for Exercise, Stair Stepper with Resistance Bands is a nice stepper, has a good solid balance, feels high at first, but can be somewhat adjusted, and steps well. The workout is good. We have different feels on the track, but for my wife, this Niceday Steppers for Exercise, Stair Stepper with Resistance Bands is right on the money. We are happy to have it.

title: Will be nice for the beach, fairly easy set up, but what about sturdiness?
text:
My wife and I are not campers, but when we get out to the beach and parks we like to have something that provides shade and privacy. Where umbrellas and some sun shades are good, we'd been keeping our eyes open for something that might go on the car - expanding our options - and so when I had the chance to grab this SUV Tent Car Camping Car Tent I took it. So far we are pleased... but have a couple... concerns.

It's been a few weeks since we got this SUV Tent Car Camping Car Tent and after having several plans and attempts at even just testing it derailed by weather and wind, we finally had a chance to set it up in a parking lot - not at all ideal, but we at least got to see if it's what we were hoping for. With the weather changing we should be out on the beach sooner than later and we ARE feeling positive this SUV Tent Car Camping Car Tent will be a great addition to our gear.

1. It comes in a nice green bag to fit the tent and support items (poles, stakes).
Pro: It's a great bag to a point, matches the tent, and should make it easier to get this thing around.
Con: It JUST fits the gear so you have to get that tent back down tight. The tent set is heavier than we expected. Not so much we can't get it to the beach - but in that case we'll be with the car - in other words, you'll notice the weight. We do have a wagon we use for longer hauls.

2. It is mainly for the car or truck attachment, but we think we could use it on its own.
Pro: It would be nice to have it stand alone for those times we don't have the car access, and we THINK we could do that.
Con: There is a big hole where it would attach to the car. Would be nice if they had another layer similar to the front awning that you could use - or like the netting - and allow you to enclose the back as well. But alas, it's going to be open.
We are not sure how strong or sturdy it'll be without the car to support it - especially in any kind of wind.

3. Putting it up: not too bad.
Pro: Instructions are average, but there is some level of initiative here that helps get it up.
The poles are easy to put together
The poles are - mostly - easily inserted into the tent and - with two people.
The tent is made sturdily enough that it should last a decent amount of time - holding the poles in their track and forming the tent.
There seems to be enough pieces to give it good form and maintain that.
The straps to hold it to the car are pretty good and one can adapt - for example it says to attach to a roof rack, which we do not have, so we went with putting them into the door of the car and this held them securely and easily.
Con: We had both looked at the pics on the product page so knew what it should look like, but the instructions are average at best.

NOTE: We (again) were unable to get to the beach or park to try this, so it was set up on the edge of a parking lot with fairly bad grass. So we did NOT actually extend it 100% and lock it down nor did we step inside so as not to damage it. But from all we did do, it DOES appear like it will be a great option for us and that it will stay upright.

4. Laying it out & materials
Pro: In a parking lot it was fine, but of course we were being kind to it, trying not to damage it. The materials seem strong enough to take that kind of set up, but would be nicer all around on grass or sand.
The materials of the tent are nice - we like the bright green which will make it easy to spot.
The poles seem well made.
Con: While the tent, poles, and stakes seem like they are well made and with decent materials, we noticed that upon returning everything to the bag, the bag's stitching was already tearing. This was NOT there when we began and my wife felt popping as she pushed everything back inside, meaning it happened at this point.
So what do that mean for the tent? Is it the same materials? Will it last better? Will that stitching pop?
The bag is a pretty important part to this set as you're going to want to store and carry this SUV Tent Car Camping Car Tent within it. So... it does concern us. BUT we THINK the tent itself is a better quality of stitching. Time will tell.

5. Ready for use
Pro: We both felt like the inside had some great room and that once we can step in, we're going to find it gives us everything we need and are looking for. Again, on this pavement and grassy area we used we did NOT want to cause damage - it also made us discuss having a ground cloth under it to help protect the tent materials.
So looking inside, spending some time discussing it, we feel like we're going to have the privacy we want, the shade we need in the summer sun, and the size that allows us to have chairs, food, and whatever we want.
The tent also gives us an option for car camping. We are NOT campers, but sometimes talk about going with my sister-in-law and her family and with the right mattress in the back of our Prius, we think it might be fun. This tent would give us that privacy and space for day time, but also something around us for nights. We actually are talking about giving it a try.

title: Giving us a new way to practice in a fairly compact tool
text:
[[VIDEOID:8f817e3757cba9acee2517fb67b2d7f0]] This Franklin Sports Automatic Pickleball Launcher Machine seems like it's going to be a good tool as my wife and I as we look to improve our game together or independently.

Every product we've gotten from Franklin has been a good one, so when we had the chance to grab this Franklin Sports Automatic Pickleball Launcher Machine we took it. Not only is the brand - to our experience - good and reliable, it has good longevity. So would this Franklin Sports Automatic Pickleball Launcher Machine stand up to that expectation? So far it seems like it will. We've only had it a short time - and due to weather, only recently gotten to actually try it. But what we are experiencing is impressive.

1. It comes in a great box (good enough for gifting), unassembled. You'll find the base in tact, but the scoop track for holding balls will need to be put together. As I have little to no patience my wife is the one who usually assembles in our house - I'm on stand by for instruction deciphering and a lending hand. In this case we both found the print a bit small - in fact, an issue many manufacturers are having seems to be providing large enough print for even the best eyes - so we have learned to take pictures and blow them up. In this case, we found the instructions average at best. We figured it out, but it took too much time for what we consider "good instructions," and the size (which yes, it does matter - especially in a sport taken up by so many GenX and Baby Boomers). Lastly, there is nothing that really talks about HOW the unit works and WHAT you can do to help improve your game with it. Again, many over 40 are taking up America's fastest growing sports - it would be nice if Franklin considered the demographics for future improvements.

2. The battery compartment: you'll need a tiny Philips head screwdriver to undo to the two tiny screws. There is nothing included. We also wish companies would consider that this kind of access is difficult and annoying: 1. you'll need a very specific, small size of screw driver, 2. the screws were VERY TIGHT in there and we needed to use a kitchen gripping rubber cloth to even undo the screws, 3. WHY can't it be the same kind of slide on cover often found on things like TV remote controls for easier access?

You'll need 4 D sized batteries and while we've only just gotten to use this Franklin Sports Automatic Pickleball Launcher Machine, we are guessing we'll be switching out new batteries often enough that this type of access will grow tiring - quickly. This is our big CON for this Franklin Sports Automatic Pickleball Launcher Machine - a FAR BETTER battery compartment design for access would make this a TRUE 5 STAR - though we decided to give it the fill 5 anyways - this IS enough to warrant us considering dropping it to 4.

3. The unit has two on/off switches - we are assuming one for each motor, with one being on each side of the shooter.

4. There is enough room for a good amount of balls. As you can see in the pictures, you won't be refilling too often, but we can see where even for two people using it, one can refill while the other practices.

5. There is a slight "noise" to the motors, but nothing annoying or loud - meaning you won't disturb the neighbors.

6. It takes several seconds for the ball to shoot once engaged with the launcher, but once it goes... look out! It's got some great power! We've only used on one speed-setting, but it was fun.

7. The unit overall is not too heavy nor takes up too much space. Meaning you will likely find it easy to carry with to a court and for storing won't need that much room. At the same time, it is sufficiently heavy so as not to be even remotely worrisome that it'll fall over or easily be knocked over. And while it will take up room in our closet or porch, it'll set out of the way as well.

8. There is a cord included for plugging it in and skipping the 4 D's, but we're trying to figure out where in the world that would work. Maybe an indoor facility. Maybe if you have an at home court. But not likely for taking to the community or park or the like. But it is a great feature and one we'll - hopefully one day - take advantage of on our own home court (one can dream).

In the end we are impressed by the Franklin Sports Automatic Pickleball Launcher Machine and feel like we're going to get some great usage out of. We were getting frustrated as we waited to have the chance to use it, and once we got out there, we were proven correct: it's fun and it'll be a great addition to our learning and improving our pickle ball game. Who do we think it's for? Anyone, young or old, beginner-intermediate-even advanced level, allowing for one to improve their game while having fun, alone or with a partner. Yes, we're happy to have this Franklin Sports Automatic Pickleball Launcher Machine.

title: Really like the ergonomic structure, but there are two things...
text:
My wife and I prefer weights as a workout, but both of us find the handles our community provides for the lat pull to be uncomfortable. The community provides the bar and nylon strap options, but 1. even with leather gloves they are uncomfortable, and 2. as a shorter guy my arm span is not such that I can get and maintain a comfortable reach (I can't hold the rubber grips on the bar), so for safety and comfort, I'm outta luck. But when I saw this YODOTE Ergonomic Tricep Rope Cable Attachment for the gym I thought it might help me with comfort and safety, and be something she and I could both use to help improve.

The YODOTE Ergonomic Tricep Rope Cable Attachment is as easy as any attachment for the lat pull to get on and off, fitting the community's machine easily. There is a concern we have, but only time will tell if it plays out: the connection has a plastic exterior over what appears to be a metal disk, but we cannot tell how far that metal extends. It SEEMS as though it is only a disk and that the majority of the top piece is plastic. So we are not sure for how long or how much weight this connector will last. It is not that we have "proof" of it being subpar, just concerning by appearance.

The material of the rope itself also seems, not as overall strong, but as we are not at all experts in these materials or what is common in most of the heavy work gyms, we have nothing to compare it to. So we are going with it being an appropriate set up and provided materials. For our level of weights, even as I get stronger, we don't see it being at all an issue.

Lastly is the YODOTE Ergonomic Tricep Rope Cable Attachment's handgrip, where you get that ergonomic element. I attempt to show in the various images how it is structured, curveted for the hand to rest within, allowing for a strong and comfortable grip. Again, I'm a shorter guy, so I also have a smaller hand. My wife's fingers are slightly longer than mine. We each find that the grip is both good and bad. We can each grip it and feel we have a secure hold. We feel safe. We feel a great pull. However, we each have a spot on the grip where it cuts into our finger/hand and begins to rub. In two images I show 1. the grip itself as I hold it up, then 2. my thumb over the top - it is at this point for me where it rubs and begins to feel like it's cutting into the thumb. Again, it is my hand size. My wife's issue is in the palm. She can fully and comfortably grip the handle, but at the base of the palm there is a cutting pressure.

So, do we like the YODOTE Ergonomic Tricep Rope Cable Attachment? Yes, very much.
In spite of the issue and admittedly, with only using it twice for our full reps, we do like it. I will add, we have not worn our gloves during these workouts. We normally do, but circumstances had us in there without them, so using our bare hands, we did come up with discomfort whereby we got through the workouts, but didn't go full out as the discomfort grew. BUT, we both feel like once we have on the leather gloves the issue will at the least decrease greatly enough so as to allow us a full on workout and be okay. I will update if that does not pan out. But for each of us, the better grip and the overall feel of the YODOTE Ergonomic Tricep Rope Cable Attachment as far as what we can do, how safe we feel, and even comfort to the greater part of our hands is enough. We went with the 4 star because of the issue, but WE THINK THAT if they were to add a more comfortable cushion (rubber, something) to the grip, this would be a great 5 star grip.

We’d like to get out there before the season is up, but the way things are going... until then, it did give us a break and made pumping up the single SUP (we have two) far easier than hand pumping, so for that alone we are grateful. The end piece worked - there are several options for you to try, suggesting that most any valve would have a potential option here.

The 25PSI Rechargeable Sup Air Pump The Manta Paddle Board Pump includes a nice bag to carry the SUP pump itself as well as the range of valves. The cord also fits fine.

In the end we are happy to have the break from the effort needed to pump up a single SUP let alone two before getting on the water. But I want to see how it plays out “in the field” before I commit to a 5 star - or lower if it doesn’t go well. I cannot speak to when we will get out there, but once we can, I’ll update.

title: This bag worked out great for our eScooters
