title: We’re not experts, but this is a great tent
text:
First, we are not tent experts. While my wife and I have slept in tents as kids, as adults we have no experience. We decided to try this tent; 1. for use at the beach, 2. because we have been invited to tent camp and MIGHT try it, 3. it comes apart into 2 pieces and allows for different uses.

We had never even considered it until we saw this pop up kind. We had no interest in trying to figure out how to put a tent together. But this one... turns out it works great! We decide to take it out this last weekend - of course it was hugely windy - but we gave it a try. While yes, the wind made it an adventure, it still worked well. As we followed the steps we pulled out the tent, opened it, and the pop up portion went into place. We didn’t figure out right away there was a “lock” position - the picture above shows it BEFORE we popped it into that lock position and during the wind so it is blowing a bit - but even before the pop, it was “fully,” but once it was popped, it was perfect. Taking it out of the locked position was easy and quick. It took 2 tries to get the thing down correctly and folded - step by step with the instructions finally worked. But the instructions were done so we could finally figure it out. The tent has a ground cloth for under - it says if you’re just doing the outer part, but I think we’d use it for both the tent and outer cover. There are two parts to the tent - the enclosed tent and the outer top shell - you can use them together or separately. The sides have venting windows, and there are both front and back “doors” that have both a screen and solid cover. The materials seem good to us - however we both feel like we’ve seen/felt thicker or at least a different material on other tents, so we do wonder the longevity and quality while feeling like this is a good tent. Again, we are not experts, but for taking to the beach, we feel like we’ll have a nice tent and cover to make for a nice day. We’re not sure we will tent camp, but the next time we’re asked, we’ll be ready to maybe give it a try for a night. This seems like a good tent and we are glad we grabbed it.

title: Really like this hat for sun protection
text: This Fishing Hat Sun Hat with Sunscreen and UV Protection is a nice hat and one I’m glad to have. We live in a warm weather state and time at the pool and beach is a must. title: This turns out to be a great kit overall
text:
I'll be honest, I was not sure - as I always am - about how this kit would turn out: would it carry my weight, be strong enough, give a good enough workout, and be of quality. I come away thrilled. The Ab Roller Set,9-in-1 Abs Workout Equipment,Home Gym Kit is really well done and I'm glad I grabbed it. My wife and I try to stay healthy and have been working out for over a year now (pre-Covid) and didn't want to loose during the pandemic. We have slowly added to our equipment, but I had resided an ab roller. I saw this kit and thought I'd finally give it a try, and I'm thrilled I did.

1. The ab roller comes unassembled. It took maybe 3 minutes to put it together including reading what to do. Once together it is strong. I am over 200 still, but I feel comfortable. I think the rating it up to 400 (please reference that materials for what they say). I have to admit, I am personally not sure if I was over 250 how comfortable I would feel. I can feel a slight dip to it when I'm doing it. I do not want to put anyone off - I think it's a good roller, but am suggesting perhaps giving it a try to see how comfortable you are over that 250 mark.

But it works well, rolls well, and I was surprised and thrilled how quickly I was doing it and feeling it. I've gotten my core muscles decent, but didn't know if this would knock me out - it did not, but it sure works me well.

2. There is a knee pad that comes with for the roller - it's ok. It works and it keeps my knees from hurting on our hard floor, but it could be a little bigger. It's not a deal breaker.

3. The wrist gyro scope thing is awesome. Never heard or seen this kind of thing before. If you use it is seems like it needs to regroup to start again - I can never use it and then let my wife use it right away - it won't tighten the same. But after a bit it's right there and ready to go. You push towards the direction of the arrows, when it's tight you hold from 'the bottom' and start to spin your wrist. The more you spin - the faster or harder you spin, the harder it works your arm. I come away from doing this thing alone with a nice sweat and my arms feeling it, but feeling good. I work my arms often and this has been a nice addition.

4. The wrist wraps are great. Again, thought they'd be average, but they are as good as the ones we bought on their own. They are a nice material, good thickness and strength, and work well protecting my wrists after years of sports. I'm really impressed.

5. I have only used the handles twice for push ups, but so far they worked great. I will use them more and am pleased.

6. The other items we have not used yet. I have a jump rope I use that I love, we have some bungie and other resistance bands we use and love. But, we will keep these and eventually get use out of them. We just really like what we have. But, it's nice they are included and if you do not have something, I think these are great ways to get started.

Overall this is a really nice kit and for the price, I think you're looking at getting yourself going on a good foot. The items we are using I'm using almost every day (rotating for various focus muscle groups) and thrilled with how they feel and work. I know we're going to get some good use here and I'm happy I grabbed this set.

title: This is a great, fun set and we’re thrilled to have it!
text:
If I could give this JAPER BEES Bocce Ball Set a 10 star rating I would! My wife and I are thrilled to have it! A few months ago my wife several broke her foot and has been off it. As the doctor lets her get back on it - and encourages slow exercise to help her rebuild leg muscles, I wanted to find something for her to do that would get her up, but not over do it. Bocce Ball can be played over a very large area - we controlled it by just going back and forth - but it got us outside, into the sun, and moving. She could take breaks and we had a blast! 1. It comes in a great bag - the full set fits well into the bag, which is well designed and built. It’s a strong material, looks great - with the logo - and the zipper is strong. This is a pretty heavy set of balls and this bag holds up well. It looks great out there too.

title: This is a great backpack - easy to store away, pull out and use, but...
text:
Out of the starting gate, I will say, I did consider giving this backpack a 4 star rather than 5 based on the shoulder straps. They are not that thickly padded, so that is something to seriously consider, but that said, my wife and I do like this bag and so far feel like we’ll get great use out of it. But because the straps are not that padded we would use this as our backup pack on longer days and trips - rather than the main one. The bag itself does give us the space we want and need, but the straps really should be thicker for more comfort.

So...
1. We like the color - it’s a nice blue and works with our gear.
2. We like that it can fold down literally into itself - it is a bag that opens and has the backpack attached then folds back down into itself. It’s great and easy to store or take inside another bag.
3. It opens and closes down easily and quickly - well, it takes a couple times to figure out how best to close down into itself - but once you do it, you’ve got it.
4. It holds a decent amount of stuff. If you’re doing a day hike, like to just get out from time to time, even for those days with the family (theme parks, parks, beach, etc) you can find this as a very nice bag to carry that extra stuff you want and need.
5. It has some nice smaller sections to put those little things you don’t want to loose.
6. There is one of those headphone holes. I seriously have no clue what people do with those. We use wireless headgear, so we don’t have the cords to attach - I think I’d forget I’m connected THROUGH that hole and rip the thing off my head if I took that pack off and it was attached. So for me - I have no need. But it is there if you want it and we think we figured out the little pouch you’d put your phone into. But even there - I wouldn’t want my phone inside the bag - I’d want it on the outside, easier to get to. But that’s me.

Overall this is a nice, lite easy to pack backpack. No, it’s likely not one you’re going to use if you’re into major hiking or camping. But it’s one you’d take with for once you’re out there, you can pull this out and take your day hikes with it. There is no frame - we are not campers or major hikers, but I understand frames are often wanted/preferred. We do like this and will get use out of it. Happy to have found.

title: Good net - we think.
text:
Haven’t had the weather or chance to get out and test this volleyball net until now - weather and my wife’s severely broken foot kept it in the box. But we got out today and turns out - we are pretty sure it’s a good net.

1. I ended up giving it a 4 because the bottom of one of the two poles - the foot - is bent. While we are sure it’ll be fine as far as standing, still, it should not come out of the box bent - especially that badly.
2. It’s a nice looking set - the pieces look nice coming out of the box.
3. It includes a ball and pump. We were not going to play today - my wife continues to heal and only just now allowed to walk - but wanted to set it up to test. So didn’t inflate the ball - but it looks nice. If it doesn’t turn out to be great, we have a volleyball.
4. We didn’t end up fully setting up due to wind that would not calm down. Anything over our heads was bucking too much - it wasn’t safe. But it was interesting... the ‘instructions’ offer very little (read pretty much no) help. The good thing is - it turns out to be pretty intuitive.
5. You’ll slide the middle piece (has a single hole) into the bottom piece (footed pole) and lock it into place, then the top piece (multiple holes) in and again, lock it into place.
6. The net is very much full size. Here is where we had to stop - due to winds - but at these 3 height options you should be able to play full on volleyball for any adult. We THINK at this point you’d lay the poles down, lay out the net, and attach the net, then raise the whole unit, secure it to the ground with the included securing ties. If the wind had been slightly less I would have tried, but my wife was only able to help so much - and the wind was brutal.

At this point everything with this volleyball net seems to be great. We will eventually get out there - when my wife is cleared for that kind of activity. I think where we are both impressed is the height - we’d tried another net that ended up being for kids and came to notice many options out there are too short - that this one has such height is great. I had to go with the 4 stars rather than 5 due to the damage it arrived with - the box was fine, so it was prior to packing. But everything we were able to do worked fine and I did it alone - so was not needing a second person - thought actually raising it up and securing would need two. We are happy so far and think it’ll be a great way to enjoy a sport we both love.

title: This is a great Plate for Exercise!
text:
I’ll be honest, I’d never heard about exercise plate machines until I saw this one. I looked it up and according to the articles I was reading, this is an under used exercise machine type and actually does help loose weight. So I decided to grab this LifePro Waver Mini Press Vibration Plate Exercise Machine and try it. I come away surprised, but happy - it does help me. My wife and I have been active in living a healthier lifestyle and approach with a variety of activities, from kickboxing and walking to weights to... well, this thing. My wife is still sidelined from her severely broken foot, so she has not tried it yet, but I have and I’m blown away by how it works.

The machine arrives in a box that is easy to remove from - all the parts are fit correctly and easy to get out. It is slightly heavy - nothing one can’t move, but it has some weight to it. I’m not sure the actual size, but we can’t fit it under our bed, so we’re still working on where to keep it - but that’s not an issue. There are instructions - I would suggest also doing a little research. I learned a few things from articles I was reading. There are also resistance bands and for your arms resistance ropes as well. The instructions are well done and offer ideas for working out as well.

The unit has a remote so you don’t have to get off or bend down to alter things. I have used it every time - I will increase or decrease the various options while still on it. This comes in handy for severity of the vibration as it is intense and I’ll inch it up or down during the workout. I have not gone very high - I want to say around 15 - and appreciate being able to try things or adjust as I need.

ONE CON: The power cord is short. I have to use it primarily in our bedroom where my wife is currently working from bed, so that limits when I can use it. If it were at least another 2 - 3 feet long it would be perfect. I’m going to move some things around and try to make it work in the living room, but if not... anyways, if they changed that this would be a perfect unit.

I really love the workout. It is... (not) easy. I mean you’re standing on this vibrating plate and you do feel it. The level, the time, going up and down, the truth is, your body works to stay there. I’ve only stood on it and done planks, and both were workouts. I got off sweating. I’ll say, standing on it is less of a vibration to my head than the plank - I can’t go as long or as high at a single time because in the plank position I feel like my head will vibrate off. But I can feel my core working.

I like this unit so much that when I saw a foot massager from the same company I grabbed it. While you can use this as a foot vibrator, I thought to help my wife heal - when cleared by the doctor - she might be able to use that foot massager to advance her healing - but again, I grabbed that because of this company - I was that impressed.

Overall the LifePro Waver Mini Press Vibration Plate Exercise Machine is a great workout tool and we are happy to have it. I feel like it has added to my workout and will aide me in getting into the shape I’m working towards and my goals.

title: What a great way to help workouts
text: We prefer working out at home, but that said, we’d been working out at a kickboxing studio (pre-covid) and liked their system for counting down sections of the workouts. When saw this I had to give it a try, hoping it would help us time and balance our workouts - plus my wife in particular loves the challenge of the timer countdowns. I am thrilled with this sign and it’s help in my workouts. As my wife continues to recover from a severe broken foot she has not tried it, but what she’s looking forward to most is the quick countdowns - something you can use for that HITT type of workout. There are several options from your own countdowns to their preprogramed options. I’ve not used many yet, but I like that I can have a timer and not fiddling with my watch as I’m doing things: it’s far easier to see this and the remote is great to work with. Overall we are both thrilled - me for already having experienced it, my wife for what it promises it can do. We do keep it inside, but will take it onto the patio - so we do not have it anchored to the wall.

title: Really nice set - solid amateur level complete set
text:
My wife and I took up pickle ball last year and have come to really love it. I put us solidly in the serious amateur club level - not pro, but better than beginner. We really like this set: 1. look 2. weight, 3. grip, 4 as a set.

1. This is a nice looking set. There were 3 options on design, but we both really loved this option (we did like the other 2, but this one stood out for us). It looks as good or perhaps even better in person - in other words, it looks great.
2. The weight is good. We are still learning the options and what’s what with how best to choose a paddle, but for us this is a great option and we both feel like the weight is good for our level of play. There is a nice balance to it as well, making it an easy paddle to swing, hit, and adjust with and to.
3. The grip is really great. We each have a different hand size and way of gripping and both of us are comfortable and like this grip. We both love the feel of the grip and find it works for us.
4. As a set this is nice. I’d put in in the middle of options - you get a nice set of items for a good price point. The set includes the 2 paddles, 4 balls, and a bag. The bag fits the pieces well. It does not have any head covers, but we don’t see that as an issue. It’s a smaller bag, but it holds all the items very ell and it works perfectly for what you have to carry. Not a lot of extra room, but enough to throw keys or a wallet in there.

Overall this is a nice set, good paddles, and not already mentioned - the balls are great. We are both thrilled with it and feel it would work very well for families, young people, or adults into the paddleball scene/club scene. We are very happy with the choice. Happy to recommend.

title: We love this bag! If I could, I’d give it 10 Stars!
text:
In several decades of athletic activities and teams this is the BEST bag I have ever had! This is the most well thought out, designed, and executed sports bag I’ve seen. We are thrilled to have it! And it means I will be looking for and paying attention to Franklin bags in the future.

1. It is a gray and peachy orange - these are handsome together and stand out.
2. The design... I cannot emphasis this enough: this is a very well thought out, designed, and constructed bag!
There are so many slots, pockets, and places to put things, great sizes, 2 different interior materials (to choose from for various items to be stored in).
3. There are so many pockets, I could not find the place for the fence hook - it’s hidden in behind zipper behind the straps you pull out.
4. The zippers are great, feel solid, and like they will last.
5. There are backpack straps and a handle...
6. There is fleece material on the inside of a couple pockets.
7. LOOK IN THE POCKETS AND SLOTS!!!! There are some SO deep and go behind things you MIGHT loose things! A great ‘problem’ to have!
8. The fence hook feels really strong and secure - it’ll last
9. This is designed for carrying multiple paddles and balls, plus shoes, clothes, and more.
10. There are many spots for safety storing: wallets, keys, phones...

Over all this is an outstanding bag and for anyone who loves Pickleball, you’ll find this to fit all your needs. There are two of us and we are already talking about taking at least 4 paddles each time we go to play. It’ll just be fun filling this thing! But we will also be looking at Franklin bags again because of THIS bag! It’s so awesome! I cannot be excited enough by this bag....

title: This is a great stepper
text:
I had a stepper back in the 90s that I liked and used often, but it grew tight, hard to step (they tightened), and I ended up dumping it after only a few months. I wasn’t sure I’d ever get another stepper because of this, but as I’m trying to get in exercise even when I can’t always do the things I normally do. But would this be worth it - and why is with that “side to side” movement?

1. It arrives almost completely assembled, with only the handles needing to be hooked on and the readout box mounted.
2. The mounting of the box is easy - hook onto the attached cord, then place it onto the mount.
3. The handles are easily attached with carbeaner hooks.
4. You’re ready to go!
5. The platforms for your feet are large, wide, and should fit most foot/shoe sizes. There are “ridges or ripples” to the surface; they are not ‘hard,’ but rather produce a good traction surface. I am standing on them and did 100 steps in bare feet to see how comfortable and I was fine. Could have kept going. In shoes they are equally comfortable and keep my feet (with/without shoes) from slipping.
6. The handles and bungee are great for added effort. I’ll usually keep them in my hands throughout the workout, altering using/not using them, changing the direction I’m pulling in in order to give my arms various things to do. They provide a solid workout, giving my arms a nice burn to compliment the work my legs are going.
7. THE STEPPING... I was worried about the side to side movement of the stepping - I’ve never seen or experienced this before. I LOVE it! In the past I’ve had issues with my hips and knees from stepping - or treadmills - but I find this movement is very natural and for some reason does not cause me pain. I recently tore my hamstring, but I’ve hit a point in recovery where I’ve been on the stepper every day for a week and I’ve felt great - it’s actually worked some minor knee pain I’ve been having WHILE stepping. This is a great movement and I’m thrilled it’s part of the design.
8. So far the stepping is very smooth - I feel like the system used to create the movement is superior to the steppers I had in the 90s. This leads me to think it’ll last far longer than that stepper system. If it does, this will be a perfect unit for me.
9. It’s a great height, sturdy, and strong. Okay, it’s heavy - but it should be. It has to hold you up and in place - and it does. It’s height is nice - I can stand at my conversion standup/sit down desk and work. And it’s strong enough to make me feel safe and secure.

Overall this is a great unit and I’m thrilled with it. I’ve been at it a week and feel like it’s becoming a regular part of my workouts. I’m happy to recommend this stepper.

title: Great ball, will work well for us
text:
My wife and I workout for health, but we can get bored with regular exercises. We added a weight ball last year and really enjoyed the experience - both individually and together. We wanted to upgrade to a heavier ball, so when I saw this Sanabul Lab Series Exercise and Fitness Medicine Balls 14 inch Diameter, I decided to give it a try. I come away happy with the choice and know we'll get a lot of use out of it.

Sadly, my wife severely broke her foot a few weeks ago and is off it for another couple of months. But I've been able to use it alone and so far, I like it. It is heavier that our first, so I alternate - heavy, then light... it gives me a nice range of options by doing that. I like doing sit ups with a ball: this one I can only go for so long, but I love the challenge.

The materials are "soft" and comfortable on the outside, seem solid for longevity, and whatever is inside feels like it'll hold up. I will NOTE: it's a little lopsided - I hope that goes away with use.

The ball is decidedly larger than our original, so that is something you should pay attention to - and I had not thought about when given the dimensions on the product page. I do have to use it differently because of the size difference. Larger folks and those with larger hands should be fine, but do make sure you take size into account if you are smaller (my wife and I have smaller hands so there is a noticeable difference for us). We won't be able to pass it back and forth in the same way around our backs, because at least right now it feels like it might be too big - we can't try it until she's better. She's only held it at this point. So I can't say how it'll work, other than it'll be different. It's the same for my tossing it in the air. I can do it, but yes, being larger in size, I do notice the difference in catching it and have to be more careful. As I adjust to the weight that should change, but again, someone smaller or with smaller hands should be aware.

Overall I like this ball so far and it's given me another level of challenge. I do believe my wife and I will get good use out of it, but I can only speculate at this point. But I'm happy - and she is to the point of holding it - and with the above notes mentioned, we are happy to recommend it.

title: Very nice, will be going with every time we go on vacation, to the beach
text:
When I saw this I thought of all those times we’ve taken off a swimsuit standing on a parking lot pavement or cold floor, dripping everywhere and not wanting to harm the suit, keep our feet cool, and not have a mess to clean up. I was right: this is going to limit or eliminate all of that.

The standing bag is made of what feel and appear to be solid materials: thick, well constructed, with longevity likely a result. Standing in it (both shoes & barefoot) felt solid and safe. I never felt like I would fall. I did not try when wet, however, but my thought is it’ll be fine. I suggest trying it to check for safety.

There is a drawstring tie to pull the “walls” up, thereby allowing you to hold the water in. And higher to bring it even more together for carrying. I suspect we’ll dump it and put suits into another bag, but I also think it’ll be easy to dump (water) and leave the suits in for transport home or to a hotel room. There are handles and an attachable strap for ease of carry. Again, have not tried it wet yet, but with the draw string it does not appear it’ll leak - and we would dump an excess water before carrying.

Along with the beach (parking lot, sand), pool (hotel, home), or other such things, we have a pop up privacy tent we recently got - it has no floor. We will also be using that to change and this step in wet bag will work perfectly inside. We can lay it down on the grass or parking lot, have the pop up tent on it, then change in comfort. I thought it would make a perfect pairing and by all appearances, I was right.

We have not had a chance to get to the beach since it arrive, and the weather is cool enough, it’ll be awhile. But we’re planning our spring outings and this step in wet bag is now on the Take List. Can’t wait to get back out there... We are very happy with this choice and think it’ll be used often and get a long range of use.

title: Works great, happy to have it
text:
My wife and I had seen a neighbor carrying a similar bag during his workout - walking an area near our home we walk. So we started to look at them, so we are new to these types of bags. We ended up getting 2 - two different manufacturers - so we would each have one. This is the second and we come away happy (with both) and pleased we got it.

The materials and construction are excellent. Again, having nothing other than the other new one, we are not experienced enough to know what to look for - but the materials are strong, tough, and feel like they will last. This includes the velcro - which takes effort to get get apart and should hold the sand in well - and the zippers are great. Overall it seems like it’ll last a good long time.

We ended up injuring ourselves (not with these bags nor associated with working out) so we ended up only being able to use this bag a couple times. But during those times we were able to find it a solid, hard workout, one that will add to our overall exercise programs. We like the idea that it isn’t an ‘easy” or ‘typical’ use of weights, but a way to add weight to our walks thereby using muscles and muscle groups to their fullest. In the wake of our injuries my wife will be out for another 2 months, I’m coming back now - we agree it’ll be nice having these - we can adjust the weight in the bags, not loose (too) much sand as we can remove/adjust as we need to - and we can bring ourselves back - these bags will be part of that.

So overall we are impressed with this bag and glad we have it. It’ll get great use and give us a nice, longterm addition to our workouts and healthy lifestyle.

title: Works great for us
text:
My wife and I have gotten this to support our workout efforts. Sadly, she severely broke her foot and is down for 3+ months, I tore my hamstring - I’m almost back. But prior to that we were able to get this out and loaded with sand and use a few times.

1. It’s great material and construction. It’s our first such bag and we are very impressed. We had seen a neighbor using something like this and started to look. Saw this, grabbed it, and with no knowledge on how to pick one, come away really impressed. The velcro alone is so strong it makes you work to get it apart. This is great for holding the sand in place. Overall, impressed with material and construction.

2. We did not get enough time prior to our injuries (from other workouts, not this), but what we did get to use it’s impressive. It allows us to add weight to our walks and try different things that more mimic life movements rather than repetitive weight lifting. That makes it more interesting and unique. Works various muscles/muscle groups in different ways.

3. Wearing it into place. Coming new it’s “rough and tough” meaning the material is harder than what we saw with our neighbor’s bag. This is to be expected. We did not get to use it enough, but we feel as though it’ll quickly work into a softer bag that’s a bit more comfortable to carry. But that’ll also be a great way to measure our workouts.

Overall this is a great workout bag and we are happy to have it. We know we are going to get a good use and great workouts from it. As we both build ourselves back from injury, we have talked about ways to modify - that one can change out the amount of sand is great. It’ll let us build back safely, while keeping the sand for re-adding. This is a good bag and for amateurs are happy to have it - have to think higher end athletes and those looking for a good workout would find it a good tool as well.

title: Really nice battle rope - will get lots of use
text:
We already had a battle rope, but with the 2 of us, we thought a second would allow us to workout together - for the challenge and competition to push ourselves. Unfortunately, my wife severely broke her foot (doing something else) and has been grounded - so I’m on my own. We use trees at our local park, so I tried it out and find it’s as good as our first. I like the material, the weight, the length, and the handles. I can get a good, solid grip, and it more than certainly is a great workout. It arrives in a couple box (deep), with the anchor and support items inside. It’s tied, so that was nice pulling out and first carrying around. I like the look - I’ve tended towards black, but this pattern looks cool. It also includes a little instruction book with workouts, so that was a nice addition. We have not used the anchor - but that appears like it’ll come in handy should we ever live in that kind of situation where we can use it.

Overall this is a nice battle rope and I’m glad we added it. We’ll be able to have our competitions once she’s healed, but until then, I’ll take it out from time to time. Happy to have it!

title: Great pop up room, but the breakdown...
text:
We love going to the beach (pre/post-covid), but it can be a pain trying to change post swimming - or we just don’t go in. So when I saw this pop up space (changing, port-a-potty, privacy) I thought it would be great to take on hikes or to the beach. We popped it out and we loved it. Based on another review, we knew to do it in a space that has room - you should! This is big and the pop can take things out that are too close. But it’s very easy to pop up. The bag is great, easy to carry, and (someday) we will store it in there. Popped up it’s great. Plenty of room.Easily change and whatever you need/choose to do in there. There is no base to it - no floor. We are getting another item (when it delivers in a few weeks) we’ll put down that you can use for changing swimsuits. But you can do this on the grass, sand, or out in your own base. For us this is fine. The materials feel great. The frame feels like it’ll last (**** have more on this). The zippers work very well. It included a couple fold up hangers which are small, but they’ll. be great for hanging suits. There are one or two straps hanging in there to hang the hangers from. ** NOTE, we did not try to hang anything from them, but I get the feeling it won’t stay up if you plan to hang many - I’d say it’s fine to hold something light, or a wet suit for a few minutes as you change so it doesn’t drag. But I don’t think the tent itself would be able to handle much more. The room should be tall enough - we are both under 6’ - with room for us, but I’d guess someone 6’ should be okay. Not much over. There is a little window - but it only keeps you from suffocating. For a change or bathroom use, this is a great pop up and we will likely use it...

However, we cannot get it closed!!!!! My wife has found a few videos online (YouTube) but first... we tried and tried... We happened to get it once closed - trying to fold it like we do our car window cover. That (accidentally) worked. Turns out that was not the way to do it. So after MANY MANY tries we gave up - it’s been standing on the porch since. But my wife felt she wanted to conquer this and looked it up. There is supposedly a way to do it, laying it on the ground and pulling it... we have not tried it. In our methods (*** the frame) we slightly twisted it. It still stands fine, but because we tried this other way... anyways, I’ve not wanted to get back into this so we haven’t tried yet. Worse case, it gets laid out in the back of our Prius. We hope this new method helps. But I’m too weary to try - yet. We will, eventually.

While this is very frustrating and I have considered giving it a 4 star rating because of it, I still like the rest of the set up and I think it’ll help, that I decided to still give it the 5 stars. BUT... do yourself a favor and find those videos and preplan.

title: Wow, these are going to be a serious workout!
text:
I’ve been seeing these disk things popping up among workout gear and did a little research: seems they can add to a workout and be helpful in developing the core. I thought I’d give them a shot. This seemed like a good set: I’d read in the research that you want the reversible kind that are fabric on one side and smooth plastic the other for both carpet and hard floors. This set offered that.

They arrived in a nice box - I appreciate good presentation as it speaks to the care put into the product. The materials look and feel solid, as though they are well made and will last. I prefer getting items that have longevity to them. Now, will they do anything?

Unfortunately for me, shortly after ordering them I tore my hamstring and was sidelined for 4+ weeks by my doctor to heal. But, I was just allowed to return to full workouts and I’ve tried these... wow! This is going to be a workout! I did loose some muscle mass and strength while down and healing - it was a pretty bad tear. But I’ve tried these and they are working my legs and core really hard - in a good way. I was feeling the burn quickly. And while I’ll have to build up on them, I can see where the positive results are going to come from. Overall I am thrilled with these disks and their consecution, but the workout sold me. I’m happy with this choice.

title: Really love these: give me great support for weights, kickboxing
text:
My wife and I have been working out and among our activities are kickboxing and weightlifting. While I have 2 sets of wrist guards, neither of them work in my boxing gloves - something I desperately want for the added support. So I figured I had nothing to loose with these wraps... I come away thrilled with the results! Not only are they great for weightlifting, but they fit in the gloves and give me excellent support!

They come in a simple, yet fine bag. I’ve been keeping them in it - unless I’ve worked out and they are sweaty. I’ve great with the blue, couldn’t care less about the camo, but it looks great here. I’m not sure what the material is, but it’s this weird, yet cool mix of gripping and giving, like a neoprene, but not. It wraps a few times and yet doesn’t bulk up, which is what allows me to get them comfortable into the boxing gloves. And that fit is literally perfect! For the first time with these gloves I’ve had all the support I’ve needed. Best hits I’ve had since getting the gloves months ago. Now with these gloves and wrist wraps I’m getting a solid and safe workout.

Additionally they’ve been great for lifting weights; again a solid and safe workout. I’m so happy with the results.

Overall these are great wraps. I’ve been completely pleased with the results. I will say, I have not washed them yet, but I can’t imagine anything changing once I do. They are good enough I would consider getting this kind again when these need to be replaced.

title: Seems like it will work if ever needed
text: We got this for my wife to carry on those occasions we are not together. She will at times go places she's not as comfortable these days, and to have something like this makes us both feel a little better. It arrives in a nice box - I feel presentation is a standard by which a product sets a tone. The instructions seem pretty straightforward. We were able to test it - as other reviews mention, it is loud. We did not try it on ourselves, and hope to never need it, but based on what little we have done, it appears as though it will be useful - hoping that situation never arises. For us as with many being prepared is a standard, but we are not ones to carry a concealed gun. This seems like a good alternative - nonlethal, but painful and easy to use. We are happy with the choice.

title: Works very well
text: As my wife and I find new ways to enjoy working out and being active and healthy, we both decided a mutual enjoyment of badminton meant we had to play. Using our community tennis courts (with a portable net we found on Amazon) we grabbed these AIKESIWAY Badminton Shuttlecocks in order to support the racket set we got. We come away happy with the choice. We are by no means advanced or pro players, but more the active, backyard variety, but we still didn’t want to waste time and money on something that comes apart quickly. These shuttlecocks have so far delivered. We can be hard on them - we hit hard, but also ‘wrong’ often enough - but they managed to keep sailing. By the end of a game (evening) we have had fun, but have done some damage. Yet we can play another night with the same one - we use them to their bitter end. And we get several nights out of a single one. We are happy with this choice.

title: Work well, appreciate the quality
text: My wife and I enjoy badminton and thought a better quality shuttlecock would help us enjoy the game more. The Young Performance P20 (Speed 76) Badminton Shuttlecock gives us the quality we are looking for. We have only used them for a couple games, but are happy. We are by no means “pros” nor “advanced” players, but we can do some damage - so we wanted something that would last and not fall apart too quickly. This was what we got. With the feathers there is damage, but we were able to continue playing - we will use the first one until it becomes obvious it is no longer giving us good play. For backyard use, newer players - even intermediate - this seems like a good shuttlecock with solid performance. We are happy with the choice.

title: Really enjoyable, can’t wait to use more!
text: We’ve weaned hammocks for a long time and finally grabbed 2 (this and another kind). Of course, then Covid threw a wrench in our plans... It took a while to get to use them and so far we’ve only done it as a test - but we come away happy with the choice. We like the colors and materials. It was easy to figure out and get up and take down. And we enjoyed our test reclining. It was comfortable and we know we’ll eventually get to use it longer and as we hope (reading, napping, enjoying time in nature). Covid may be limiting us for now, but one day we’ll be back out there hanging around and this hammock will let us enjoy!

title: These will come in handy...
text:
As we live in a hurricane prone area we decided to add these to our preparedness collection. Along with our gallons of water we thought it would be a good idea to grab these. Unlike the gallon we’ll full these bags up last minute and use for cooking and cleaning water. They are very large and store a good amount of water, and with the their base that speaks out and sits well, it’ll be good to have around. But they don’t seem like they’ll be able to sit and hold water as we do for the entire 6 month season with our normal gallon jugs. No problem, again, we’ll fill them as a storm is approaching and use for short term storage.

The materials (plastic) seem like they’ll hold up. We have found with the gallon jugs there are quality differences: some are thin and will start to leak after a few months. We also do not keep them from season to season. As a season hits it’s end we’ll use that water for water and cooking and then restock for the next season. With these jugs we’ll fill as the storm approaches, then empty after it’s through and water is no longer needed.

I THINK I’ll be able to fill in the sink, but have not tried. It is large and we’d prefer doing a good cleaning on the sink before laying it inside. I did not take that time and instead filled it from the tub. That worked okay. I lost a good amount of water as the flow from that spigot is not great. But it filled in a few minutes and will sit fine.

Overall it’ll be a good back up and we’re happy to have them for our set up. Should we ever go camping (not something we do) or need water in a pinch, we’ll find other uses. But just the prep element is well worth having these around.

title: This is really a fun addition to exercise
text: Ok, so we all get bored with exercise - I prefer "workout" - so when I saw this I thought it might be a fun way for my wife and I to keep at that boring stuff. But doing those push ups and lunges helps and so... welcome this dice! We just got it today and I've already had fun out there doing these! My wife is sidelined (severely broken foot) and I tore a hamstring, so I'm coming back... but this let me have a nice workout and not feel bored. It's larger than I'd expected - fits in the full palm of the hand - and mushy - a coated cushion type material - with the writing around. Roll it, comes up, do the exercise. We got the mid-level intermediate option. We're coming back from injuries, so we're not going to be doing the full out suggestions at first - but adapting is fine. And I got a few back to back and a few changes, so it kept me interested. Yes, this could get too easy (up the numbers) or boring (the same options), but it can also give a fun something to something that already is way too boring at times. So get it, have some fun, and enjoy working out with a twist. (you can always tape your own ideas on top at some point ;-) ) I'm happy to have something fun to keep my workouts going.

title: Really fun way to enjoy golf!
text:
We are actually not big golfers - we like going to the driving range and putting, but we don't "play" golf often. So when I got these balls it was for at home, on the putting green, and our occasional foray onto the course. Honestly, these are fun - there is NO way I'm taking them to a driving range - wouldn't want to loose them!

We set up the putting green and got to it. We'll use them one at a time (for longevity) and so far love them. It's been fun playing in the house. My wife recently severely broke her foot, so she's limited - I figured she could get some exercise safely, and we have had a few really fun hours playing. You'll thrown them against the ground to activate, then play like normal. I mentioned our lack of time on the course because I cannot legitimately compare them to what a normal ball would feel like, but for us they feel on point - like anything we've hit. The glow is great. Lights on or off we've had fun. As you can see, it's easy to see either way. And they are very attractive to cats... who only add to the obstacles for a little indoor miniature golf challenge. Note on this fur - you can see how much they throw that light.

Overall these are just really fun. I'm sure it would be cool hitting one for distance (again, don't want to loose it - as if you could). We were playing and suddenly it went off - had only been putting, so no hard hit, which may keep it on longer. I'd say it was within 5 minutes it went off. But this is a fun way to enjoy the game and we're glad to have them. I would most surely get another set.

title: Really great step
text:
So the good news is we love this step, the bad news is, my wife and I are both off it for a while longer. We got this because she's been wanting a step to add into our workouts. But, I found it a few days after she severely broke her foot and then I tore a hamstring. She hasn't been able to use it at all, but I did get on it twice before my injury break.

First, it comes in a box, put together, and you have to figure out how to undo/redo the step raise. No big deal. It's incredibly sturdy and can easily hold my 220 weight. I felt great on it. The leg rises are on there tight - in a way too tight, but I would not want it any other way. Yes, it takes effort to get them off/on, but that's good - it means they'll stay put. The height difference is good and you'll feel it, but not so much it'll hinder you. And the construction overall is great. I felt sturdy and like I was getting a solid workout safely.

I've kept it outside so my wife isn't upset over being sidelined for 12+ weeks. But she did get to check it out when it arrived and she was very pleased. It's everything she had wanted and she's excited - especially since it'll help her get back into things in a way that's safe for her. I'm just able to get back to things and I think having this will aide my recovery - as per my doctor's instructions. So overall we are both thrilled with this choice and feel like it'll help us each recover, do so safely, then press on in our healthy lifestyle.

title: Fun for inside practice
text:
I thought this might be fun for indoor practice when it's rainy or way too hot to be outside. Also, for my wife who, with a broken foot, has been strictly limited on activity. This she was able to stand with her scooter and get a little exercise without risk of injury.

Ours (came with/attracted) an obstacle. Yes, it's even more challenging when guarded by a cat. But it's fun for inside - we had it set up in a small hallway and had a nice time. We have another, wider area we'll try next. But indoors it's fun and lets us practice, but also get some activity going.

The green grass is good quality and a nice stand in for the real stuff. I was not using the cup when we played, but it was no big deal. There is also a little flag - didn't want that to also become a toy - but without it we didn't miss a thing.

We'll keep it folded up - which is a good size and fits on our porch - but it does mean there is a lumpiness to it. As we rent we can't keep it in a yard, so we make do. I'm joking above, but it is like having a private miniature golf course (cat obstacle included). But even for putting it's a challenge to have the ups and downs to practice on.

Overall it's a fun thing to have around. We'll be able to practice, have some exercise, and when we can, keep it outdoors for better "real world" play. But until then, it's all fun and games... We like having this

title: Works great, easy to install, but piece broke off on first use
text:
This bike light should be getting a 5 star, but because on the first charge the small cover piece to the input for the charge broke off, we have to drop it to a 4. My wife has been using such tiny charing ports for years (like us all) and she’s very careful. This thing easily popped off and in spite of her dainty skills at repairing such tiny things, cannot get it back on. That’s a minus for us.

But as a tool, it’s great. So if they can fix that flaw in how the port cover is attached, we’d be happy to give it a 5.

It arrived in a nice box (for yourself or a gift) in 3 parts: light, clamp, and charger. She charged right away - after as she pushed the piece in it popped off - and we put it on. She severely broke her foot a couple weeks ago and gets around for the next 3 months on a scooter. But she wants to be able to see at night if she’s moving through the house, or if we are outside, so we thought a bike light might work. It’s perfect for that. It fits on the handles of her scooter as easily as a bike - and we plan on switching it to a bike when she’s recovered. In the mean time, the 3 levels of light mean she can see safely in the house without being disruptive, and she can see safely outside moving to the car or around our home. It’s really easy to clamp and remove - she takes it off when we are in the car so it won’t get broken off. And she can easily pop it back on.

Overall this is a great light and minus the flaw with the port cover, we are really happy with it. That we cannot overlook, however, because there is little doubt that in 12+ weeks on the scooter and future use on the bike, covering the port hole would be a safety issue (rain). So the 4 star has to stay. Happy to have it though.

title: A really great set!
text:
Ok, this one hurts... we ordered these because my wife and I have come to love the game of pickle ball. We have a set that we love, but we were taking about something a little more advanced (lighter) and when I saw these, grabbed them. But... before they even arrived my wife broke her foot severely... so there they sit...

This review will strictly be based on how they look and feel, but I can’t speak to how they work for another 9 weeks...

This set rocks! It is great looking, great material, and really seems like there will be some solid longevity to them!
The set includes 2 pickle ball paddles, 2 covers, and 4 balls. The look is really nice - we both love the blue. But what blew us away was the weight - they are solid and strong, but really light! They feel great in the hand, and as my wife said, you can get an amazing and strong grip - they won’t slip! The covers take this set to the next level. Our other set, again is great, but the covers (neoprene) will protect the paddles and that they are included is what really impressed us. The balls also feel solid, as good as any we’ve tried or seen. We are by no means pros and have only (come back to - since high school) the sport this year. But we love it and plan to enjoy it for a long time to come, and this set is going to be a big part of that - including our now - future - plan to join a club.

We are very happy with this set and very happy to recommend.

title: They work, but not sure they are needed
text:
UPDATE: We've had rain today so wore these out - have to say, they were great. Please read on for my earlier thoughts regarding them overall and night, but I am adding this - I like them. We are in a state that rainy weather can cause glares and that gray palate that makes elements blend together. We also have a rainy season over 4 months, so it is something that causes me to sometimes wear sunglasses in order to see better. But that makes it even darker. I put these on and it brightened everything. Had my wife try and she too felt there was a brightness. She didn't like them in that she didn't loose the glare per se, however, I did. But for rain, I will most certainly use them - night time, I'm still 50/50.

I had lasik eye surgery a number of years ago and ever since when I drive at nights, lights have “star bursts” and while I can see easily, it’s a bit of a stressor on my eyes - the bright lights can make me squint. So I saw these - and many like them over the months - and I thought I’d give them a try. No idea why, but why not.

1. They fit well and look somewhat cool - though my wife has now refereed to me as George Michael several times. I like them.

2. I don’t know that they work. Or what they are supposed to work for. But, they do something.
I feel it like this: there are those bright white-blue LED lights in many homes now. You can see them stand out brightly - apart from the softer, warmer, yellow or orange lights we grew up with. When I drive/walk/am out at night I can see fine with the white-blue cold lights, but I’ll find myself squinting against them at times, even feeling stress on my eyes from the harshness of them. But with these glasses, they warm and soften these bright white-blue, cold lights and make them more like the softer, warmed, yellow-orange ones. This cuts my squinting and feeling of stress. So Yes, they DO something and DO work, but I’m not even sure if that’s what’s supposed to be happening. It’s what I experience.

3. I still see star bursts on lights, these have not changed that at all. I have not worn in rain yet, but if there is any similarity, they only change the coloring, they do not make anything. sharper, easier to see, or enhanced. But they DO something that makes it a little more comfortable.

I can’t give them a 5 because while they do something I honestly thought they’d do more. I fell like that is the implication. But, I also did feel a bit of stress relief and comfort in these over the sharpness of the LED bright white-blue increasingly on the roads and signage. So I have to give them 4 because I did feel something positive.

title: Great bag!
text:
We recently got a second pickle ball set and needed a bag - so I grabbed this one. I will be honest here: we are not going to get to “use” this for awhile. Just before the pickle ball set arrived my wife severely broke her foot and will be off it for up to 12 weeks. But we love the game and we love how it lets us workout and be in shape, so she/we are determined to get out there and play again!

This bag is great!

First, it’s made of food materials - they feel solid, sturdy, and like they’ll last. The bag looks attractive with its black with white accents. Our other one is blue and we love the look, but the black is sleek and fresh. As I said, the materials are solid and it feels like we’ll get some good, long use out of it. the zippers - always a consideration - are solid, well built, and feel like they’ll last as well. DO NOTE: the middle zipper/section has a looser lining and we noticed the lining tends to come up and risk getting caught - luckily I felt it and stopped before it was an issue. Make sure it lays inside right.

Second, the size of this bag is excellent! We are blown away by how large this bag is, how much it already fits, and how much room remains. Blown away. We have two, covered paddles and 4 balls and there is plenty of room for more. My wife - and I really - think our other 2 paddles would easily fit, as well as another ball or two WITH the 4 paddles - or at the least, a number of extra calls. Keep those out and we could put back up shirts, a light jacket, those types of things in there. Plus there is plenty of room for wallets, keys, and phones.

A bonus is the hook included attached inside. We usually have a carabiner to attach it to something like a fence, or for whatever. This one has the hook, so no need.

Third, ease of carry. This one comes with a strap for over the chest carrying, but no handle - not at a all a big deal. Use the strap or carry it over yourself - as I’ve already done - and make things easy.

Overall this is a great bag and we cannot wait to get back out there and use it! I’m so glad I picked this one and the only bad side... it will taunt us as we wait for my wife to recover... very happy to recommend.

title: Works great on our porch for workout equipment
text:
We have been trying to up our game with exercise as Covid has gotten us out of the workout room and fully at home. When we added a heavy bag to make up for not being able to go back to our kickboxing guy we knew we needed something on the porch floor to protect our legs and feet. Based on existing reviews we knew we would be able to cut this if we needed to and that the thickness should be right. And with that hard cement we knew we wanted something to cushion us. So we chose this option.

It comes well wrapped in the included bag, strapped, and plastic. For our set up, the porch has a weird cut to it and we thought we’d have to cut the mat. Turns out we didn’t have to. The mat is thick enough to hold the heavy bag, but not so thick as to make it unsteady. We feel secure and we feel cushioned. Rolling it out we didn’t want the full amount, so we kept I partially rolled - so as to keep it away from the open end and any potential rain damage - and use the bag’s stand to hold the rest rolled in place. The width and length our perfect for this space and when we move we’ll have more or less depending - but not cutting it gives us options.

Working out on it has been fine. It gives security for footing - we do have one spot due to configuration, that makes it so we have to watch how far back we step, but it’s also not so high if we step funny we’ve had any issues. It gives good footing and we can punch full on - no worries. We are about to add a bench at the bottom end, that can be moved, so we’ll see how well that works, but based on the weight stand we’re confident it’ll be fine. We don’t know about marks it’ll leave - footprints from the weight of the stand or bench - but if we keep it in the same spot it’ll be fine.

Cleaning so far is easy - we have only had to wipe it down. We use our shoes on it and so far it’s been fine.

Overall we are really happy with this choice and think it’ll be a good mat for a long time, protecting us as we continue to workout.

title: The kind of thing you want to have around but hope to never need
text:
I’ve seen ads for this type of blanket of late and thought it would be a good addition to our home safety gear. So grabbed this set. It appears nice, good, solid. But then again, I haven’t even pulled them out. It’s the kind of thing you are not going to test and hope never to use, so we are going to have to trust. But the materials look and feel good and we will have them around to use if...

Looks like a good product and from what I’ve seen on articles and ads, it’s smart to have the blanket. We have one on our fridge and one in the laundry room just off the kitchen, near the extinguisher. Happy to have added this.

title: This worked out very well!
text:
We had grabbed this to throw into our car, but with Covid we were not finding ourselves using it during our rainy season... until last weekend when I was out, had not known it was going to rain... when I reached back there it was. And it saved me! Our rainy season may be over, but someone forgot to mention it to Mother Nature - this was a downpour.

The umbrella is very lightweight - I was blown away. Almost thought it was not going to work or be substantial at all until I opened it and it stayed light weight, but opened huge and easy to handle. I can’t tell you the size, but while often your arm gets wet, this was keeping me drier than I usually ever am.

We got blue - it has a rich color, looks great.

Again, we live in a place where rain is a promise for part of the year and we are certain to find this umbrella helping us through so much of that. We are happy with this choice.

title: So far we’re liking this addition to our workouts
text:
Last year may wife and I took up kickboxing in a class setting (heavy bags) to help us take off some weight and build up our muscle mass. With Covid we were off the bags and loosing our progress. We finally broke down and got some items to help us through, including this pad. We use it in addition to our other workout methods.

So far we are finding it works great for us. We are still getting used to the size and our comfort with kicking. It’s a good size, but for 2 adults at 5’7’ and 5’5” it’s okay, but we need to be very cautious.

For kids this would be great. For taller folks I’m not sure you’d be comfortable with the size.

It’s a good thickness, but we do feel it more than we feel like we do with our hit mitts. Overall we do use this and like it and it is well made, but we are also moderate level in skill. I do not think it would work for more advanced hits or again, for taller. We are happy with it and what we need.

title: Average, there are better options out there
text:
I have a very similar kit that is far better. I grabbed this one 1. for my wife to have some of the items I have, but not as used, 2. share the adjustable grip and set a bit higher. The main issue: quality.

1. My set is pretty much the same with a slight shape difference on the egg ball (mine is round).

* My grip ball is far better. It actually has a solid grip and resistance. This one is small, very easy to grasp and squeeze. For my wife - or anyone - really new and starting out, this would work. But this ball is pretty soft and would easily be out grown. For anyone with strength it’ll be almost worthless. I’ve had sawdust filled balloons with more resistance.

* Finger spreading: this one is very weak. My wife, again being new, was able to do it with resistance, but with any strength it’ll be weak. What really brought down my opinion is the inconsistent width of the rubber it’s made with. You can clearly see as you pull on it that one side is thinner and weaker and likely won’t last long.

* The ring: wow, again, the quality. I crushed it once in my hand and I could feel a cracking. Like the material was hardened. My wife also found this to be weaker than mine.

* Finger grips: Once again, low quality. My wife was working it and it did give her resistance, but mine is far stronger. Even I have to work mine harder. So for a beginner, my wife was “working” her fingers. But the materials and construction are what stand out - it feels weak and not solid and without longevity.

2. Adjustable hand grip: I was really hoping this would allow us to set it harder or softer than mine - I like mine where it is and don’t want to adjust. Yes, we can with this, but again, quality is off. It includes a counter that seems accurate so far, but the clicks are so loud it’s actually distracting. I like to just sit and do my hadn’t exercises when watching TV or something, but this thing is so loud it’s actually distracting.

Overall the quality here is not great - not even really that good. I never had the chance to try mine before I bought it - bought it on Amazon a few years ago. But it turned out to be excellent and worth the money. My wife will continue to use this - until it wears out or she gets past it and I’m not at all sure which will come first.

But overall I am not impressed - she seconds the sentiment.

title: Really like this, but for beach only - must use sand
text:
We had gotten this hoping to use it at the beach and park. First, it will only work at the beach - unless you’re willing to carry sand. The anchor element is bags of sand: it has the bags, you add the sand. So no park. Not a bad thing, but limiting.

The overall shade is nice. The materials feel nice and we do think they are good enough to have some decent longevity. Everything is easy to figure out and put together - read the instructions - aligning the right direction is the only thing that tripped us up a little. But once we got clear, it was good... until we realized we were not actually getting it set up - we didn’t have the sand. The anchors are a major element in it working.

We ended up not using it on our vacation to The Keys - too windy - and we have not been able to get to the beach at this point due to Covid and rain. But that does not negate that we have high hopes for when we can get back to the beach. This has a great look - the blue is really nice - a nice feel - and yes, easy to set up.

We haven’t had the chance to actually use it, but we are impressed enough we believe it will be well worth it.

title: Great set for families, backyard, beach
text:
We have enjoyed playing badminton in a club setting, but due to Covid, have been unable to get back. So we decided to get a set for ourselves at home - as well as a net - and still be able to play. This set includes: a bag, 2 rackets, and container of 6 shuttlecocks. I would call this a set ideal for families, the backyard, beach, or picnics, but not for someone at the intermediate or advanced play/club play.

This is a great set. We got two nets here on Amazon for different settings, and took this set to our community tennis court.

The Bag: This is a great bag for this set. It allows one to carry both rackets and the tube of included shuttlecocks. That said, it would be a little better if the bag were even an inch longer. These are a tight fit at the current size. Even without the tube, these rackets have to be in essence pushed in in order to fit. But overall it's a great bag, looks great, and makes carrying easy.

The Rackets: These are nice. Again, this price point, these rackets are for family or couples looking for an hour of fun in the backyard, picnic, or on the beach - not a club setting. They have that nice sound when they connect, and they have a great distance on them. Lightweight, there was no fatigue after an hours play.

The Shuttlecocks: This is a great tube - 6 included. They are feathers, so nicer than the plastic kind. They get a nice sail to them. As feather, these will be damaged quickly, but one can continue to play for a good amount of time. We used one for a few games before needing to trade out. Plastic ones, once damaged, tend to need to be changed more quickly - in my experience.

This is a great set and for the right setting and players, perfect. We are happy and happy to recommend.

title: Very good for backyard or at the beach
text:
This is a simple, easy to put together, fun on a nice day set.

We decided to try this for perhaps taking to the beach or park and it works great for that type of situation. Adults are going to laugh at the size, but it's also great for kids.

It comes in a small carrying bag. The set is easily pulled out and put together: maybe 3 minutes after your first time. The pieces (arms) will push into one another to form two long lines, with one end attached/hooked together (leave it that way). Then you attach the "bottom" fabric via 4 snaps (2 extras included). Then attach the second end like the first, then the net. It took us maybe 6-8 minutes to figure this out - the instructions are okay to good.

Once up it is small. But it works. We played on our community court. It leaned - enough we used the tube of shuttlecocks we had to "anchor" the one side of the fabric base. This was greatly humorous. But it worked. Using it more of a suggestion as to where the net was/is - it works - and had a wonderful time.

It easily came apart and went back into it's bag. Overall it's a fun little set, great for the beach or backyard, and great for kids. Light and easy. Happy to recommend.

title: Got for safety, think it’ll work perfectly well
text:
I’m very happy with this shovel. I got it for safety and emergency situations. We’ll keep it/use it in the car, backpack, and go-bag. It arrives in a nice box in of which is the carry bag for the shovel set. Every once in awhile I get something that is so nicely packed I don’t want to take it apart - things don’t go back the same way and/or it just looks so well done. This is one such package. They have found a way to disassemble this shovel and its parts so well, putting them into this bag. Done very well. So it fits nicely in our backpack. There is also a belt loop - haven’t tried, but I will when I have an appropriate belt.

The idea with this is for safety or an emergency. I think it’ll work for both: it is solid in feel, the materials feel good, substantial, as if they will have longevity. The shovel head is strong and with it’s edged can be used in a variety of situations. The compass seems like it’ll be of help.

I think it’ll be a great addition to our kit and think it’s been a great addition.

title: Good for camping, hiking, go bag
text:
We are not campers, but we go hike, take day/half day trips, and keep a go-bag. I got this knife for that. Between our two bags (go bag, backpack) I’ll keep this knife handy for safety and emergencies.

It’s a great size. Coming in a nice, small box, it sets in a sheath that can attach to one’s belt. The sheath is hard plastic and from the look of it, it’ll rest well on the belt - I don’t currently have one I’ll use so have not tried it yet. It’s in the backpack where I keep it in a side pocket.

The knife has a nice balance. The handle makes up for the short blade, while the blade’s width and heft balance against the longer handle. Not sure what all it can and will do, but I look forward to getting out more to try it. But it’s main purpose is to have it handy for just-in-case.

This is a nice knife and I’m happy to have it.

title: Great jump rope, helpful
text:
My wife and I are slightly different heights, but being even an inch shorter than her, it throws off our jump ropes. So yes, we have two different ones. That said, I was jumping one day and got the rope caught on something on the sidewalk, it hung up enough it caught my foot and almost took me out. Additionally, living in Florida, we can go through times of rain and limits out ability to do outside workouts. Jump ropes are not conducive to indoor homes.

I started to see these no-rope jump ropes and finally paid attention. This one caught my eye and I’m glad it did.

It eliminates that fear or actual act of getting hung up and catching you. I am already feeling much better about jumping with the no-rope. Secondly, we have only done it inside. That means we have another place to jump, and in Florida (hot, humid) or up north (cold, snow) one can jump rope all year round.

The system is great: it counts accurately how much you do. Plus can keep track of weight, time jumping, and repositions. It’s great. I do have 50-something eyes, so I have my wife turn it on/off - buttons are a little hard and I’m not wearing my readers - but otherwise it’s 100% on point for a product. Would say the handles feel at once a little cheap, as far as the read out - but also like they’ll last and take the punishment. It’s strange, but we have confidence in them.

Overall we are very happy with this idea and this product and happy to recommend.

title: Tough, but good for adding strength
text:
Got this to add to our weight training. Looked to see if this type of equipment was worth it - did a google search to see the benefits and it would seem it is a valuable addition. So we grabbed this. It has been working good for us. Admittedly, we’ve only had it a short time and this is something you use in an overall, ongoing program. But so far we are very happy with it.

It is tough - but that’s the point. There is a good grip. so we don’t Geel nervous using it. And we can get a solid grip. but it took some practice and trial and error to get it to bend. But now that we know what we’re doing, both my wife and I are able to get it to bend and are already feeling results. At least we feel like it’s working.

Overall it’s a great bar and we are happy we added it to our workouts. Happy to recommend.

title: Actually disappointed
text:
We’ve seen things like this on social media and thought we’d give it a try. Seemed like an easy, lighter way of having a nice lounge chair for the beach or picnic. Didn’t turn out that way.

MAYBE it was the lack of a breeze the day we tried it, but in reality, you’re doing all the work. My wife (who is in great shape, can run easily, and fit) ran to try to get enough air inside. It didn’t really work. It actually looks fuller than it feels or is (in the pictures). She tried 3 different times to run and get enough air inside.

But each time it came away not full enough. She’d sit on it (I’m heavier so didn’t even try) and her backside is ON the ground. Yes, her weight pushes the air and makes it look fuller, but she is literally sitting ON the ground - it’s hard and not comfortable. I’m not including the picture of her looking at me and pouting.

In the end we were really disappointed. We are going to try it again - we are looking for a windy day - maybe that’ll do it. But when you’re already running to get it filled, we’re thinking wind will make it harder and you’ll be fighting wind with this giant sail. Anyways, we are disappointed. Can’t recommend.

title: Great mat, happy to use
text:
Our apartment flooring is a thin carpet with cement directly under (no padding) so working out with and without shoes grows painful and tiring. We have a single individual mat we’ve used and that helped, so this large mat seemed like it might help with our larger needs. It has been very helpful. We are happy we got it.

It’s not as thick as we thought/hoped it might be. But it’s still good. Ours is specifically marked FOR SHOES, so we know we can’t do damage using shoes for our workouts. This is important for us.

It’s a good size. We use it in our living room, which has decent, but not overly large space. We were actually pleasantly surprised by how much room it offers, but how little it floor it takes up. We roll it and keep it standing in a corner when not in use.

It stays in place very well and so far have not had it slide.

Overall we are very happy with this choice.

title: Very comfortable, worked well for us
text:
Florida heat is wet, humid, hot, and often. This towel set has worked well for us. Simply wet it, then wrap it or carry it. It feels comfortable around the next and kept us cool.

It is long and narrow, so far more for wrapping around the neck or even head. We also used it to wipe our faces. We haven’t used it on an overly humid day time at say the theme parks - direct sun and humidity for hours - due to Covid. But for the time we have had it, it’s been hot and humid. And it worked fine. We took it with to the pool last night and it cooled on the way over, then let it sit out to see and it actually stayed very cool - maybe even got cooler - over the course of the hour it sat out.

Overall the towels look good, fit our necks with comfort, look good, and work nicely. We haven’t used for more than an hour at a time, but at most we feel like you’d only have to rewet. But our experience is a good one.

title: Great backpack. Happy with this pick
text:
I’ll admit, this is our first hiking backpack, but we are very pleased with the choice. It’s lightweight, but the materials feel solid enough for longevity. it’s comfortable on either of our backs. And it’s got plenty of room. We do a couple hours to half a day hikes/walks and wanted to be able to carry things we want (eating, comfort) as well as for safety (I’m putting together a safety kit). This backpack fits it all.

We’ve been using it just around some smaller area trails - not longer hiking yet - for some days out during Covid and it’s carried a lot of things. We have it filled right now from yesterday’s outing - it worked perfectly. There are plenty of spots/pockets/hooks for carrying in or attaching to. Adjusting the straps to fit each of our bodies was easy and quick.

For beginners or midlevel hikers and day trips just getting around, I think it’s perfect. I can’t speak to hiking pros, but I can’t (currently) see what more you’d need. This has quickly become a go-to for us. We have a day bag, but I see us filling this with extras, keeping it by the door, and grabbing it for a range of days out.

Love the colors (blue with orange) and the material. Love the way it sits. Even fully loaded we were both comfortable, so that was an added plus. We hope to one day get out for longer trips and think this will be a perfect backpack to take us safely into the wilds.

Overall we are very happy with this backpack and happy we chose it.

title: This is an awesome blanket!
text:
Honestly, I grabbed this blanket on a whim. I had recently picked a new one for our car - we keep one in there for just-in-case - and wasn’t sure if that one would workout (it did). But I saw this one and thought why not. The description said good for two people and really warm. So why not....

This is a great blanket!

I don’t want to keep it in the car - I want to use it more than that - but I also want it for the car, stops, fireworks and the beach, hiking and camping.... I want it for the bed, the couch...

It is warm and feels great - together. It is a comfortable material just to sit under. It’s warm for a nice time by the TV or cuddling. It’s big enough for two or great to wrap yourself up in. So it ended up on the bed and we have actually ended up watching movies and sleeping with it. When the cat hasn’t taken it over. I have no idea where it’s going to end up, but this just-to-have-it blanket is a new favorite. Very happy to recommend.

title: Horrible, not safe, cannot recommend
text:
We have a two piece core trainer one stands on on top of a cushion - I love this, it makes my wife uncomfortable. So when I saw this yoga core balance board I decided to give it a try.

I cannot and will not recommend it.

First, it arrived undone. There are little holes around the bottom with clips that snap into place to hold the top to the bottom. One was not in at all the another was not even halfway in. We attempted to snap them in, but could not budge them. The surface was therefore off, as you see in one picture, we could pull it easily away.

Second, for something that calls itself non-slip this is completely slippery. We both stood on it with no socks, socks, and shoes and not one felt non-slippery and in fact we had to hold onto one another and a hard, sturdy surface not to fall. With or without the top secure, the actual surface of the piece is very slippery. There are ridges, but they do nothing to provide any sort of non-slippery surface. It’s very smooth and slick.

Last, the materials themselves seem okay, but by no means strong enough to last a long time. The pieces that snap in - by virtue they are already not in - seemed like they could snap if we fought to get them in. We did try - they did not snap - but there was no way to do it. They would not snap. Does that mean the material is strong? No, we don’t think so. We think it’s just how it was made - we are still not sure one of the snap pieces even exists - we can’t see it at all.

Overall this is a nice idea, but horrible execution and a bad product. I will not and cannot recommend.

title: Really like this set for simple fun
text:
This is a really nice set. My wife and I both have time in the water Scuba diving and snorkeling and we have owned higher dollar equipment. This is not on that level. But for a day at the beach, a vacation to the coast, this set is a nice alternative to the more expensive options.

I gave this a try in our community pool and really felt comfortable. I had a slight leak due to my beard/mustache, so each time I put my face down I had to clear (something I learned diving) which worked fine and cleared me out. Mask reset I was fine for the rest of my swim - I did this maybe a dozen times.

The mask fit securely and felt solid on. The materials felt fine - not sure about longevity compared to a diving/higher priced option, but these materials feel fine for fun at the beach or pool. Taken are of, they should last. The view is nice and one can see clearly for a good distance - our pool is pretty long and I was very comfortable. I’m fine taking this set to the beach the next time we head over.

title: Really wanted this to work, but...
text:
