We’ve seen this type of mask - similar - so thought we’d give it a try. Yea, it looks cool and with our backgrounds in snorkeling and Scuba we thought this might be fun for a larger view. I had noted another review saying the view was distorted, but not everyone is comfortable looking through masks, so perhaps that was the case.

First, it fit me fine, but my wife not as well. I have a larger, rounder head, hers is smaller, more narrow. This version she was unable to reduce it down enough. She was never comfortable enough and it did leak for her. I was able to use it without a leak. It fit my head fine and out of the water I was very comfortable.

There was a moment when I first went under I had to think about a different kind of breathing from normal Scuba or snorkeling. Once I was past that, breathing was fine. I felt completely comfortable breathing within the mask and not worried about how the system is set up.

The other reviewer was correct - it wasn’t just a different person’s experience - but the view is distorted. In a very large range of view right to left, up and down, if you look straight ahead things directly out front are clear, but as you move outwards, even just a bit, the distortion begins and continues. One must actually turn the head in order to keep the view clear and undistorted. In other words, a fish right in front of you will look fine, but anything even a few inches to either side will begin to look distorted - for some it might even cause discomfort.

We tested this in a swimming pool - controlled environment - so I was able to swim around and not feel nauseous with the distortion (no tide, waves, reefs, or other things to disorient and bounce one’s view off), but could easily see if I were in the ocean/Gulf that might be different. It is possible someone else might be fine. However, I would add that my wife, before she became too uncomfortable with the leaking, also felt and saw the distortion.

The other thing that made this uncomfortable for me was the buoyancy - this literally held me at the surface. I had to push my head down in order to go even an inch or two deeper, and that was an effort after awhile. My wife noticed the effort I was having to out in and felt it herself. This also lent itself to a pressure within the mask - any time I’d get my face to a certain depth I could feel the pressure build and push the mask even tighter/harder against my face and head. This became uncomfortable in and of itself.

I’d like to be able to recommend this mask - it is a great idea, especially for someone not sure about snorkeling/breathing with a mask. But this version just does not deliver. I cannot in all good consciousness recommend this mask.

title: Well made, feel good, helpful
text:
My wife has been needing these - we tried another set, but those did not work well and were too tight, causing her discomfort and outright pain. So I grabbed this set. She immediately felt the difference and was far happier.

They look nice. The colors are nice, the pattern detail is nice, and the materials are very good - comfortable. They feel like they will have longevity and not wear out.

Her issue with the first pair was that they were too tight. They were very high, very tight - it wasn’t size, but how they bound. So she rolled them down trying to get around the part that cut into her. That only made it hurt more. Again, not size, but how they were designed or fabricated that had them cut in at the top.

But this pair, fine on size, do not cut in. They fit perfectly. The size is great, but there is no cut in, no part that is more tight than others.

In other words, these are great compression socks. She is very happy and finds them comfortable. Not stylish for her to wear out - personal opinion - but perfect for wearing around the house for her benefit. Happy to recommend.

title: Good, solid set with many options
text:
We have a large array of options for working out - to loose/keep off weight and build and maintain muscle. But among the options we wanted something that we could travel with as well as give us a variety of options at home. Boredom can kill a workout routine.

I specifically chose this set for 1. the variety and choices of weights, 2. The options for use with/without a door, 3. The look of the hand and ankle straps and handles, 4. The look of the ends of the bands - their connector including the carabiner connectors.

1. The variety of weights/resistance allows one to go up to 120 lbs. We are not there, but we have the option. Changing the bands out can give a range of weight options and this was a good one compared to others. It also lets one adjust what they are doing - legs, arms.

2. The options for use with or without a door means one can anchor the bands under one’s foot or in a door. We have a TRX set we use with a door, but this gives us another option - we would be more likely to travel with this set now so if unable to use in a door on a trip we would still have the ability to use our feet. That said, there is something “better” to a TRX version. It feels stronger - but it is slightly heavier, while this set is more complicated with all the items included.

3. The hand and ankle straps appeared average overall, but better than some other sets we were looking at. The handles are a bit “rough,” but not uncomfortable. I have worked them with and without gloves and both are fine. The ankle straps are average in feel, but better than some I’ve experienced. Overall both are just fine.

4. I was mostly concerned that they would have longevity. I looked at how the bands connected to the handles, how they were topped off to keep their own ends secure. Compared to others - via pictures - these appeared to have good, solid endings, and that the make up of how they connect to the handles was a good method. I know the carabiners are the weakest link and I took that into consideration. I think they are pretty solid - based on pictures and how they feel - but I am prepared should they fail - we would be able to change them out for others if needed.

Overall we are happy with this choice. The set is what it appears to be, but compared to many others - and I looked at more than 20 sets - this one had everything we wanted, feels as though it has the longevity and strength we wanted and expect, and will give us another successful workout option.

Happy to recommend.

title: For two beginners these are great
text:
Both my wife and I workout, but wanted to add yoga for its benefits. My wife has been doing it longer - for both its general effects as well as specific to her needs - and I’ve only begun as an addition to my workouts, hoping to increase flexility. The videos (app) we follow uses the blocks (we have not seen a need for the straps yet, but she said she’ll look for that as well), and so she wanted to try it. I was watching and it does look like it’s a great addition.

So I grabbed these blocks because there are 2 (honestly, I don’t know enough yet, but I figured we could each use one or if 2 are needed, we don’t always workout together), and that the strap would let us add that when we are ready.

At this point the blocks are working great. I’ve used them a couple times, my wife more, but we are both happy with them. They have been a great addition to our workout program. The materials for both clocks and the strap feels and appears quality and like there is longevity. We are beginners and do not have a comparative frame of reference, but so far they have worked for us and feel fine when in use.

At this time we feel we can recommend them.

title: Outstanding towel, expected no less, got what we expected
text:
We would have expected nothing less than excellent from a Gaiam product and once again, they delivered. My wife has been using their stuff for years, introducing me as well. So when I spotted this Yoga Towel I was sure it would be everything we were looking for. It lives up to the Gaiam name.

My wife has taken up yoga and is teaching me for strength, flexibility, and endurance. To that end I grabbed this towel to help with our matts and the inevitable sweating from our sessions.

We washed ahead of time which made a soft towel even more so, dried quickly, and was ready to go. It looks and feels great! Both sides are soft and wick away water easily and quickly. My wife has used it more - I have grabbed it a few times before her - but we both love it. We have a few widths in our matts - the regular yoga matts it’s perfect with, helping keep them dry. But I have a thicker workout mat I also use for exercise: we both have noted that it helps keep that one in particular from getting so wet it moves, gets slippery, and you can slide.

Plus when we are sweating it’s nice to grab and dry off a bit.

Overall this is a great towel, looks and feels great, and has helped with keeping things clean and dry for yoga and other exercise. We are both thrilled with it and happily recommend.

title: This is a great blanket
text:
My wife can feel cold in the evenings and who doesn’t like cuddling on a beach or at fireworks. I got this to help her feel more comfortable and for us to share some nice times together when out. I was not at all sure what to expect with this blanket, but now that we have it, I’m beyond happy - it exceeded my expectations.

First, I liked the blue color and in person it’s even nicer. The feel of the blue side is where you’ll find the “waterproof” element. It has a nice feel, but it also has this cracking thing to it. It’s nothing bad, just feels interesting and sounds a little funky, but nothing to deter from using and enjoying the blanket. The soft, gray side is the warmth and cuddle side. It’s very warm, extremely comfortable, and feels great. My wife, who does get cold easily, loves it.

We have used it only once so far - this is Florida - but winters here are rather cold at times, and evenings on the beach can be bad. So we plan on having this with for trips to the beach, park, even theme parks if we’re staying late. We are also talking about keeping it in the car for those times you don’t expect.

It has a great carrying case. it’s lightweight, but substantial for use. And the size is amazing! We laid it out on the king sized bed and it nearly covers it (see pictures).

Overall this is a great blanket and in the end I am more than pleasantly surprised. Happy to recommend.

title: Looks nice, good size, should work great
text:
What sold me on choosing to get this dry bag was the picture on the product page of the guy SUPing, the bag dropped over his shoulder and back. We enjoy water sports and activities including kayaking and SUPing. We have a large Dry Bag for carrying a lot of gear, but seeing this size and his use, it seemed perfect for what we want to do. It would allow us to carry things out on the water with less worry.

The bag is really cool looking, with a great feel. We love the size and yes, it’s that perfect smaller size for wearing on the back when SUPing or on or anchored in a kayak. We have not been out - Covid has kept us from getting out, yet - but with plans coming into play, we know we will be using this before too long. Based on what we are seeing and experiencing trying it out here at home, we are confident it will be perfect for what is intended. If this turns out to be good, we would also consider adding another so we each have one - if even needed. The size is good enough we feel like one will hold a solid amount of stuff and may not even need a second. But it’s an option we would most certainly consider.

Happy to recommend.

title: Excellent poles, easy to put together
text:
We are not experienced hikers in that we do go for walks and lite hikes in the wilderness. We are not advanced, so our review is based on limited knowledge of this product type. But, we are increasing our walks and hiking into wild locales and to that end, wanted something to help us. Having done some reading and based on what we have experienced without poles, we thought this set might be good to try. We’ve been out in Illinois, Wisconsin, Arizona, and Florida, and we feel these poles would be helpful in any one of those locations. Overall we are very pleased and would consider getting a second set - one for each of us.

This set is collapsable. It is step by step, spelling out in easy to understand instructions. We took our set to our local park to give it a try. It took maybe 4 minutes the first time as we had to locate the parts, but the second was toggery in less than a minute. Once together they feel strong and sturdy. We only used the included point, but there are 3 other types for various settings. On this trip we again only used the one.

The set feels strong and sturdy once together. We walked the park a bit, nothing major here. We will take out once we can hit some of the trails around here post-Covid.

In the mean time, taking it apart was again easy. Each was apart in less than a minute and into the included bag. Again, we were happy enough that we will be looking at getting a second set so we each have one. Happy to recommend.

title: Very good for added workout equipment
text:
After a few uses my wife and I are both happy to have added this set to our workout options and happy to recommend.

This was a frustrating, but easy set to put together.
First, the pieces are few: the two U bars, 4 bases, screws with washers, little wrench, and 2 hand grips. The hand grips are on, but are velcro so they can be removed and returned.

The set is easy to put together, one person can really do it in about 10 minutes.

That said, it was a but frustrating: having to hold the screw in place while turning the wrench - the little wrench kept sliding off the screw head and there is nothing to hold the other side - other than your hand - to help tighten. It worked, but it took awhile, and it was frustrating. Perhaps using another wrench of your own, but 1. they emphasis not over tightening and use of another tool might encourage that, and 2. I didn’t feel like I needed it in the end. Yes, a little rough, but it worked as is. I would strongly encourage checking tightness from time to time.

I’ve used it a few times and find my weight doesn’t let me do it too much yet, but I’m able to maintain what I do on the ground. I plan to use this intermittently with the ground and another piece of equipment I have. My wife too has used it and with less weight to lift is already able to do both push ups and reverse push ups. It’s a great height, the weight keep it secure - we have used it on living room carpet - and is not at all too heavy to move around. It is a large set, meaning you’ll have to find somewhere to keep it. But it’s not so large as to not be usable.

Overall this is a great set and we are happy to have added it to our workout equipment. This will get great usage and is already contributing to our love of competition. Happy to recommend.

title: Mixed feeling
text:
My wife and I are of mixed feeling, individually and overall.

We are both kickboxing in a class/gym, but due to Covid, haven’t been in months. We still box at home with mitts, so when I saw this, I thought it might add some resistance to that practice.

Overall, she would give it a 2 stars and I give it 4.

She is slightly taller than I am and very good kickboxing. However, she found this to be too far a reach - she is actually taller than I by 2” - and that it did not give her resistance as she thought it would. She felt the straps rubbed against her too much and caused her to be uncomfortable.

I was not as uncomfortable and felt that even though, yes, the length on the resistance bands is a bit too long, I was able to feel and experience resistance enough to feel the effects. I also was bothered by how much they rubbed, however, with the right clothing, I don’t see it as an overwhelming issue.

I have a bit of weight around my belly still - and though I was able to get it on and use it, I am looking forward to trying it when I am thinner. I will use between now and then, but the weight does make it slightly uncomfortable.

1. You will likely need help getting it on and off.
2. It took some learning to figure out what goes where and how
3. You will likely have a better experience if you are taller/longer
4. It does rub on legs, ankles, arms, so you’ll have ti find the right kind of clothes
5. There is resistance and you will feel it, provided you observe the above. I think length is the biggest factor.
6. It looks and feels like some sort of Tudor era device for punishment - and could create a feeling of being trapped -we were okay, but you won’t be moving around normally, will likely need help in and out, and you might feel extremely limited in general movement. For some this could be or become uncomfortable to frightening.

Overall I split the difference and went with 4 stars. I struggle to recommend. I think larger men and women could find this a very useful and fun workout addition. However smaller folks are not going to get the resistance they are looking for.

title: Great for what they are designed for
text:
These are great for attaching things: bags to backpacks, loose items to picnic backpacks, pickle ball bags to fences, etc. No, you are not rock climbing with these. But what you do need to attach will be held firmly in place. We are happy with them.

They come in the little resealing container, two of each color with a silver key ring. We have already attached them to our picnic bag, pickle ball bag, and a few other items. If you’re like us, from time to time you need to hook/attach something and having these in the draw is now going to make that easier.

We are happy with this choice and happy to recommend for the appropriate situation and use.

title: This is a great ground cover!
text:
We love going to the beach or parks for picnics and wanted something that would keep our towels dirt free and dry, plus give us a good amount of space to move around. We grabbed this for the size. It’s huge!

The bag arrives in its own little bag that remains connected to the main cloth so as not to loose it. It has 4 stakes - we were a little confused why 3 were smaller than the 4th. But all 4 worked great and held it firmly in place. We took it out to our park to test and make sure it worked well and it turned into a windy day. With wind climbing we had to hold onto it (looked beautiful waving in the wind) and when we got it down, it took seconds to place the stakes, which held it firmly in place as the winds continued.

We loved the size, it looked great, it was very easy to clean off, and was nice to sit on. We didn’t stay long as weather was moving in, but it was great and we are looking forward to more trips. The materials feel like they will last as well. It did take both of us to fold and roll - only due to wind - which also kept it from getting back in properly this time. But we are confident in being able to do it on non-windy days with ease, even one person.

We loved it and are happy to recommend.

title: Great, simple cover
text:
This is a great, simple cover. Nothing fancy, but it looks nice, the material is nice, and it does what it needs to do. There is one in this “set” so with two pickle ball rackets only one is covered. However, this is not an issue. We covered one and with the two in the bag together, it protects them both.

It feels like it’ll last. It fits perfectly. It does what we wanted. There is room for both our rackets in our bag. We are happy with this choice and happy to recommend.

title: This backpack is great!
text:
I have wanted a picnic backpack for a long time, keeping an eye out, hoping to find the right one for us. I found this one and I am so happy I did! My wife was not as enthusiastic about my wanting one, but was instantly won over by this backpack. We are thrilled with it.

It has great materials and zippers, all making it feel like it’ll last a good long time. It’s a great size, both for filling and carrying. Carried it on my back our day in the park and it was great. Counter balanced with a beach bag full of stuff and I was never uncomfortable.

The pictures show we had a good amount of stuff in there. It handled it all with ease and was never a problem to carry, load, or unload. There is this cool little hidden spot in the strap - still no idea what it’s for, but it would fit keys or a pocket knife.

The main body is a good size and we got plenty in there. Covid is limiting our trips, but we are making plans for more picnics, the beach, and our next trip. We don’t carry food often when we do road trips, but as I told my wife, we will be from now on.

There is a bottle/wine bottle holder on the side - it’s perfect. The front zipper fold is for plates.
*** NOTE: This is a very set size. Plates and utensils are not included. DO MEASURE before you buy. We had to try a few different options before we found two paper plates we had that fit.
*** NOTE: The utensils not being included, we used two sets of them we’d gotten here on Amazon and they worked, but we did not use the provided utensil spot. Like the plates, I suggest you measure for best sizing.

This is a really cool bag and I won my wife over - we cannot wait for more trips out. it feels and acts as though we will be able to use it for a long time to come. We are very happy to recommend.

title: Feels great, can’t wait to get it out to the beach
text:
We got this one for two reasons: being at the water and in the car. So far we are very happy.

We like keeping towels in the back of the car for those days you get caught out in Florida rain or if you happen to end up near the beach (Covid has kept that from happening). We keep our beach towels at the ready, so this one will soon be in the trunk.

At this point we have not been able to try this at the beach. However, we have ironically used it when my wife was cold and used it as a blanket. She loved it. We did wash it - making it wet - and it was easy to wash, hang, and dry. It feels even nicer since that first wash, and again, we can’t wait to get to the beach and really use it.

The martial is nice and dried quickly. It feels great, looks nice. Overall I think it’ll have some nice longevity to it and we are happy with the choice. We are happy to recommend.

title: Decent set for having fun
text:
I misplaced my diving goggles and snorkel on our last move and with an upcoming trip decided to give this set a try. No, it’s not pro level, but for fun in the pool or I’m thinking on the reef, this will do.

It is attractive and so far the materials feel and look decent: solid. There is a nice bag for carrying.

I have a larger head than my wife and while she will use hers, she tried these as well. The straps were easy to adjust.

The snorkel is solid, and with land and a quick pool test, gave me what I was looking for. The mask stays on when holding with your nose, and in the pool for a few minutes did its job - no noticeable leak.

We plan to try them on a beach practice before we head further out on our trip to make certain, but at this time, we are happy with what these offer.

Overall, yes, we know they are “cheap,” but so far we cannot complain. I think they’ll do fine on the trip and at this time I will give them a 5. Like any mask - pro or cheap - in the end you have to try them and find what works on your face and your comfort level. These are fine of an easy trip to the pool or beach or on a reef.

title: Seems like a solid bag
text:
We got this for working out and other trips we need our weight or workout equipment. My wife and I take kickboxing classes and have been sharing a name brand bag, but talking about each having our own. I grabbed this for mine. It seems solid enough, but no, not as solid or perfect as our name brand. That said, I’m happy with it so far - not that it has been used. We are not currently going to kickboxing, but when we return, this will be my bag.

Again, overall it is a good bag, but not as perfect as our name brand, which is reflected in the price of this bag.

That said, it has good materials, the zipper appears and feels good, and there are enough places and size in which to store/carry my gear. I am happy with this bag for what I intend to use it for.

Therefore I am happy to recommend it.

title: Not sure at first, come away really like this ground cover
text:
When I first opened the package my wife wasn’t sure: she said she thought it seemed “cheap” and “like a tarp you can get at Lowes.” But we took it out, opened it a little, and she felt slightly better. But when we took it to the park to give it a try, and laid it out, we were both very happy. This is not as large as another we got (which I think actually that one calls itself extra large), but it is a great size and works well.

The bag it comes in is small, but it works fine and feels like it’s solid for a good number of uses. There are 4 stakes to secure it. When we were out there the wind was picking up and blowing things hard as storms moved through the area. These stakes kept the cover solid on the grass.

It was large enough for two people and supplies. We would use it alone or with the second one for more space - we couldn’t really tell using a measuring tape, so went for both. But this is a good size.

The material is not as cheap as at first appeared. It seems pretty decently solid and like it’ll last for a good while.

The bag is attached to the cover so as not to loose it. A carabiner is included for easily attaching to something for carrying. We had it in a bag for our test day.

We mostly go to the beach rather than parks (Covid has changed that for now) so we didn’t get to test in sand, but we think the stakes, cleaning, and use will be as good. We have been wanting something rather than just our towels to help control bugs and such, and this seems like it can help. (Bugs do whatever they want, but dirt and sand seem like they’ll be easily kept at bay.

We did not do as well repacking - part trying to get out of there before the rain came - but we have to figure out a better method for folding and getting it back in the bag. We got it in, but not all the way - not a big deal overall - but nothing we feel defeats the purpose or lessens the value of the ground cloth.

Overall we are happy with it and plan to use it often, and are happy to recommend.

title: Great for outdoor adventure, excellent view, light and fun
text:
We both enjoy looking for birds and other wildlife and while we have binoculars, they are a little heavy for my wife and neither of us feel we can consistently use them and see well. We’d been talking about monoculars, but never grabbed them. Saw these and thought I’d give them a try - they are excellent.

Lighter weight than the binoculars, right away they improve the experience. Holding the one lens rather than two also makes it a tad easier - not that binoculars are hard, but this can be one handed or two, and takes your mind off the weight. There is a guard for the lens so we both prefer popping it out to see and so far it has helped control glare and focus on the lens properly.

Easy to focus, the image is amazing. Very impressed with the distance, movement to focus between distances, and overall image.

The carrying case is great with a divider that protects the tripod and other pieces on the bottom from the monocular on the top. Again, light so by hand or over the shoulder it’s easy too carry.

Overall thrilled with this monocular and will be carrying it with often.

title: Great ropes, light, easy to use right out of bag
text:
Got these to support our workouts. We’ve both been working on dropping weight and building muscle and endurance. We wanted something that would be light weight and be good for both our heights (about a 2” difference). This set of two gave us what we needed and we can adjust so we each have the height/length we need.

Took them out and instantly they fell so we could use them - others we have had it can take days to weeks to loosen and stay untangled - we were impressed with how easily thee fell.

They are light and great for focus on the jump - not weighted for fatigue. They seem like they will sustain for a good while for durability.

Overall we are very happy with this choice and neither my wife nor I have any current cons.

title: Love these rings
text:
I have had my eye on another brand of silicone ring for awhile, but at about $25 or $29 per ring I did not want to risk it if I didn’t like the style or if they didn’t end up fitting. So when I saw these two sets I decided to take a look. Because my size is right on the bubble I decided to get both sets. I come away really happy with this choice.

The smaller size fits my ring finger while the other set is good for other fingers on both hands.

I also have fingers that taper down, so metal rings easily fall off. Additionally, over the course of the day my fingers can swell from humidity, so a loose ring can end up becoming stuck and hurting my finger.

With these rings I have not have that issue. There is a slight give to these, so any swelling has been fine. And while loosing weight the taper is not as severe, when my fingers are way down I don’t feel like these are slipping off at all.

The colors are interesting. Some I really like, such as the navy, black, and a bright blue. However, some look... like a cartoon. I’m not fond of a green, white, or camouflage. However, the gold and silver - made to look like weddings rings - are pretty decent, and the tie dye looking ones are fun - but I do not wear often.

I have now done everything from working out (Weights, battle rope, etc) to showering. I have learned to take it off (when I remember) when washing my hands or showering - they can get very loose and I don’t want to loose them. But working out was fine. I did the battle rope and noticed it was there, but I’d do it again. Without my workout gloves (weights, boxing) I’m fine, but in the gloves I notice it more. I think in future I will likely do without, mainly to lengthen the life of the ring rather than due to any interference.

Overall I love these rings and happy with the set which gives me choices. Hope they have longevity because I can see wearing them long term. Have not had anything formal to wear them to, but I would, though I’d stick with the black or navy in that situation. Happy to recommend.

title: Pleasant Surprise: really like these
text:
I’ve had my eye on another brand for awhile, but wasn’t sure - a single ring is around $25 - being concerned the silicone wouldn’t work, feel good, or have any give. My ring finger tapers and can go up and down during the day, so metal rings can go from loose to tight. Would this kind work? While not metal pricing, I still didn’t want to pay for another ring to sit in the drawer.

I am thrilled with these rings.

First, I got two sets: I literally fell on the line between the two sizes so figured it would be smarter than risking it. My ring finger is the smaller of the two, but I still get use of the larger set on other fingers. Usually not at the same time - looks a little goofy.

Second, I wasn’t sure on the grip - would they work on my tapered finger and would they have any give. Yes to both. In fact the only time I have an “issue” with being loose is washing my hands. I have to watch a bit, holding fingers tight, but otherwise the rings both stay snug and on, as well as give a little when humidity expands them. I love the fit, the size and look on my finger, and that little give.

Third, Yes, I keep them on when washing my hands, but I do take the ring off to dry it as well. Otherwise it will retain moisture - it does get annoying and loosens the fit. I have worn them to shower, but now keep it off, just in case.

Forth, working out and doing things with them on is a breeze. I lift weights (with/without gloves) play pickle ball, do chores, you name it, and the rings hold up. There is no issue and I don’t have to worry about damaging, bending, or otherwise having any problems.

Fifth, The Colors... Interesting. Some I love and look really nice on their own and on my hand. Some I just don’t like. It’s a personal taste thing, but some look cartoonish or goofy. Overall, it’s a personal thing, so have some fun. I was surprised I liked the look of the bright blue, red (thought I’d hate it), and tie dye.

Sixth, there is a slight difference between the cuts of these two sets I got. I include image to show: one is rounded, the other sharp cut. Not sure you can tell from product page the difference - I didn’t until they arrived.

These are some great rings for the price and I do like that I got different sizes. I do wear the larger ones on other fingers from time to time, but I love that I can now wear a wedding ring and not worry. (* Same review given for the other set in order to stay consistent with my experience)

title: Simple and basic, but works great
text:
I have been wanting to play pickle ball again for a long time. As a GenXer I grew up playing in high school gym and actually enjoyed it. It took some talking my wife into. But I started by grabbing a pickle ball set from this same company. The bag and set arrived yesterday and today at lunch we went out... our apartment community has a tennis court, but according to our online research, you can at least get started, but know the tennis court net and lines are not exact. No worries, it was a blast! By halfway through lunch my wife was talking about getting back out there tomorrow.

The set is excellent (look for that review) and we found that both paddles and a ball fit perfectly. We actually had 3 balls in there as well as using the little pocket to store my keys in. I’m going to get a carabiner to hook it to the fence while today I had it hooked over the net pole.

The bag is simple and basic. I would say the quality is average. Yes, there are much nicer bags out there and we would/will consider one if we get to the point of playing often and getting into a higher level. But for now this bag and set work perfectly and we are absolutely happy with the purchase.

The bag is net so it can breath and won’t retain smells. There is enough room for 2 paddles and 3 balls, though the instructions say there are a combination of options: 3 paddle and 1-2 balls or 1 paddle and more balls. But for our needs (2/3) it is perfect. The smaller pocket is in fact small, but my keys fit fine. You could not likely fit a wallet or more than a set or two of keys.

It is light weight, which was fine for walking to and from the courts - 1/4 mile - and carrying it over my shoulder going and in my hand by the handle coming back. The strap for the shoulder is adjustable.

We are most certainly happy and are pleased with this purchase. We look forward to many more days playing and getting back into great shape.

title: Great resistance, feel a real workout
text:
We have been working to improve and sustain our fitness, especially as we move through middle age. With a number of items we currently use (hand weights, bench w/weight bar, kettle bells, etc) we were looking at resistance bands to augment our options. We live in an apartment, so while there is the community workout room, in the age of Covid, we are avoiding that space. Two people working out at the same time can also take up too. much room and I sometimes workout late at night and do not want to make noise. So we took a chance on the FILA Accessories Resistance Band with Handles and we come away positive and happy with it.

This band is a great compliment to what we are already doing. I’ve been working on two areas: upper body/arms and lower body/legs/core. This supports that overall goal.

In my experience this heavy resistance has been great for my arms and challenges me. I do feel a solid burn and full on resistance.

My core does feel it unless I focus and make certain I’m getting it involved.
This so far there is little affect on my bottom half/legs. It does include an exercise chart with several options, which does include a lunge. I have not yet done the lunge.

Which brings me to: you must wear shoes!

My first time, as I took it out of the box and wanted to see, I was barefoot. Not smart. NOT that it caused pain.

But it didn’t feel great on the bottom of my feet as I pulled. The rubber band is a rubbery, hard tubing and it pulled on the bottom and was uncomfortable to stand and apply pressure on. I added the shoes and all was well.

Overall I think this is a great product and we are happy with it.

I will say there is a limit: it is Heavy Resistance and no way to interchange with others resistance levels. Other packages come with multiple resistance options. But if you are looking for a single weight, this does the trick.

We were also discussing how this would be great for travel. Again, with Covid, rather than worry about taking heavy hand weights or kettle bells or use a hotel’s workout space, this would be far easier and lighter. So that will be the plan for the future.

One Con: the handles are not the most comfortable. This is not enough to keep me from using the band. They are rough I’m sure in order to assure grip, but in future I’ll use weight gloves to get a better grip and counter the uncomfortable feeling of these.

Overall we are pleased with this Resistance Band and foresee continued successful use.

title: Great set for building, working hand, wrist, forearm
text:
Without question would recommend.

As we increase our range of weights and include the TRX system, we wanted and needed to increase hand strength. It’s been building, but especially with the TRX, we needed something more. I’d been considering a finger trainer to individually train my fingers with my hand, so was looking on Amazon and came across this kit. For the price I figured give it a try.

We love it. I pick up everything at least once a day - with one day off a week. I had a hand squeezer already, so the new one I keep at the resistance it arrived at for a second level. But that was my only dedicated hand trainer. It is great, but it does one thing. This kit offers five different items working the hand, wrist, and forearm in various ways and I wanted that.

In fact I was right: my hand muscles are great with the grip, but once I started the finger pull out, used their ball vs a far softer one I have from my doctor (a marketing thing) I instantly found my hand, fingers, and wrist were good in that one direction, but needed these new ones!

In other words, use one kind and you get something. Use five kinds and you get a better overall workout.

This kit is great with it’s bag, which feels like it’s good quality. Each item feel tough and like it will last a good amount of time. And they work well, are easy to figure out (there is a picture instruction booklet), and are great to just pick up whenever. We keep it on a side table in the loving room and just grab it once or twice a day to get in a few minutes. We both already feel a difference.

Without question I recommend this kit. And IF something were to break or wear out, as of right now I would replace with the same product.

title: Awesome
text: Finally took some time today to assemble this black metal 3 bike rack, and I really like it! So I used a smaller molly and shorter screw of my own and the screw doesn't stick out the back to hurt you. I sincerely believe this last step isn't even necessary really. Otherwise, thing's went well and I'm pleased to have a permanent place for my bike that looks really nice in my garage. And I love that there's a basket on top for my motorcycle helmet, soccer ball, pickleball rackets and a few other items to sit in the basket or hang from the included hooks. title: Wonderful Hydration System
text: This "Mobihome" hydration backpack is wonderful! In the past, we had bought one for our youngest son, and he raved about his. So...I ordered this hydration backpack for myself. I go hiking in the Wyoming hills with my BFF occasionally and it seems I always run out of water before we get return. This backpack holds 2 liters of water so I have plenty for a day hike. Also there's these little rubber ice cubes you can put in the freezer the night before and have cold water all day. Just make sure the rubber ice cubes have no sharp edges. The bite value you pull up to open and push down to close. The water bag inside the backpack has a harder plastic handle that you slide off to expose the water bladder to fill it up or drain/clean. Make sure this water bladder is completely drained and dry before you close it again or you could have mold next time. There are additional zipper pockets for cell phones, bandages, anti-bacterial cream, bug repellent, an extra pair of clean socks and shorts/pants, and your breakfast and/or lunch. Perfect for a day hike. The main storage area at first was difficult for me to find as it sits inside an oval shaped fabric trim. Plenty of room in their for clothing and/or lunch, beef jerky, and any snacks you bring along with you. There's also braided elastic bungee cords on the back that you could use to hold a small blanket or an extra pair of shoes and even a small tent. It does unhook so you can tie your item down. Each side has mesh pockets. I usually put canned/bottled pop in mine but others like to take along a can/bottle of beer. There's a yellow rainproof cover to keep everything dry. The shoulder straps are nice and large with an orange snap closure. And there's a black snap closure strap for around your waist. This lightweight backpack fits snug to your body and if it wasn't for the weight of the water, you'd probably not even notice you had it on. I hope to get more hikes in this summer. However, it's already getting pretty hot even in the mornings. So next time we'll need to find a place to hike that has lots of tree's for shade. This hydration backpack is holding up very well.

title: Good

title: Oh My Gosh!
text: Oh my gosh, the first time I got on this Synergee Balance Board I almost fell off. Scared me! title: Comfy with Extra Cushion Women's Socks
text: These socks made by MAUYA MX are awesome women's sports socks! I have to say though, I'm not sure about 42% cotton, 55% polyester, 2% spandex, and 1% nylon blended fibers. I tend to purchase socks that have a higher cotton percentage than any other fiber. Cotton is breathable and will wick moisture away from your skin as well as dry fairly quickly. So...55% polyester makes me kind of leery but at the same time realize that it will provide more strength to the sock. BUT....the comfort is out of this world. And the thickness of the sock should be durable for all the sports activities. These socks are reinforced at the heel and toes and have elastic at the top band. And they have divided them according to shoe size range which is fantastic as these socks fit me perfectly! Be sure to wash them first before wearing. All clothing manufacturers put "sizing" on their fabric which gives it a crisp smooth finish. You want to remove this coating especially if you have sensitive skin. I believe the mfg also wrote this on the band around the socks. Enjoy these comfy and extra cushion socks!

title: Very Bright

title: Helps to Relieve Fibromyalgia Symptoms!
text: I use this FIT foam roller pretty much for muscle and mid-back. I have fibromyalgia & rheumatoid arthritis and this foam roller helps to get the fiber muscles to relax. Fibro causes your muscles to stay contracted all the time and sore. Sometimes super sore. And there are knots under my skin where the fibro has caused scar tissue. My entire immediate family has fibro which is a connective tissue disease. I also have 2 first-cousins with MS which is also a connective tissue disease. Genetics can be a royal pain literally.Ha! I have to take muscle relaxers but even they don't help as much sometimes as needed. So out comes this white (yes I got the white one too) foam roller. I can use it down my buttocks and inside my legs (by artery) where the highest concentration of pain is. I also use it down the back of my arms and mid-back/shoulder blades. You don't want to use it on neck or lower spine. I'm keeping the wrapper on mine as the white will look pretty bad with black Bernese Mtn. dog hair all over it. Use this foam roller slowly and gently so you don't hurt yourself. I feel better after using it because it helps release some of the contracting muscles. It's only a temporary fix, and I'll have to use it again daily.

title: Really Helps Us with Our Aches & Pains
text: This is a wonderful sports travel medicine kit. It's fabulous!!! There's the "ChafeZone" that prevents chafing from saddle sores, cycling chamois lubricant, sports bra, groin area, and swimsuit irritation. Both me and my husband are constantly fighting groin chafing from packing and hauling, then unpacking are belongings in a current move out of state. This has definitely helped us immensely.  Second, there's the "BlisterZone" that helps athletic and new shoes, high-heels and new shoes; along with skates, ski and hiking boots, ballet & dance shoes, and scuba and swimsuit abrasion. I don't know about you, but I get blisters with hiking boots & new shoes. This will help alot. Thirdly, there's the "BurnZone" that's designed to be used for minor burns, scrapes, insect bites, sun & windburn, skin irritations & itching, and minor first-aid pain relief. My husband is very light skinned, and I had him use this for a recent windburn in frigid temperatures. He said it helped him greatly! And finally, there's the "PainZone" to be used for redness, irritation, swelling, pain, particularly over raw & blistered area's. It rolls on and helps reduce pain with associated pain area's. It has a strong smell similar to other pain relief treatments. We're taking this kit with us when we travel for our residential move as we're moving about half of our belonging ourselves and this kit has really helped us with our daily aches and pains.

title: A Perfect Fit for Me
text: Well, I finally got around to checking out this awesome dual-bike lights!  We're moving soon so my day's are spent packing. And presently we're having all of our wood floors refinished so this place is a mess and difficult to find things. But this bike head and tail lights are great! I love that it includes batteries which saves a lot of time. Both the headlight and tail-light can be on with just the steady light, or you can turn on a fast blinking light, and finally there's a slow blink but more like a strobe-light. The light is really bright! It was easy for me to figure out how to open them and insert the batteries. And they clip-on the handlebars and on the back post. NO tools needed! Yay! Previously, I had a different bike light....just on the handlebars light. But when I got this one, I gave my old light to my husband because this one is better suited for me. I ride more than he does, and I don't see well in the dark. I just want enough light should I be late trying to return home when the sun is setting. So this is a perfect fit! You'll love these lights too.

title: I LOVE these boots and the Ocean-Print Lining
text: Well, these Xtratuf Legacy 15" Ocean-Print -Lined fishing boots fit much better than I thought. they would. The boots are a size 9, and I wear a size 8. But when I tried them on, there's only a small empty space. I can easily put a little loose cotton in the toes, and I'm good to go. I also have a large calf, but I folded the top down and didn't have any problem after that.  I love the ocean print  lining! Gives the boots a more chic look. It would be fun to have a fish pattern option too! We're buying a new home in Wyoming on 40 acres with a detached garage (down a hill) and a barn also down the hill. We just have gravel roads. Now I'm looking forward to fishing in the cold Colorado streams this spring with my son. But these boots will get a lot of use working around the barn and getting through the deep snow or rain. And if my Bernese Mountain dog gets too adventurous on the 40 acres of mud, I can easily walk with these boots to find her and not mess up my dress shoes. I'm very pleased!

title: Yes!
text: I am so happy with these women's SPRI premium fitness gloves!! I cannot even describe it. I've been suffering with carpal tunnel in both wrists so I haven't been able to do any weight training. But when I put these on, with all the velcro strips, it supports my wrists so I'm unable to bend my wrist. Which is exactly what I need so I can lift weight again sometime soon. I have to wear these hand splints to keep the wrist from bending.I have to  especially wear the splints at bedtime. So I'm hoping I'll be healed sometime soon so I can start working out again. These gloves will immensely help in my healing and recovery process. Yay!

title: LOVE IT!
text: I already did a review for this yoga mat bag made by Gaiam. I don't know what happened to it but here goes again. The bag is made of black cotton and there's a gray mesh in one section to allow your yoga mat to dry. There's a full-length zipper down one side and straps that are full-length so you can easily slip over your shoulder. This bag is a little larger than some so it can accommodate a larger mat. My mat is smaller so there's extra space should I want to add another item within the bag. But I'll have to remove the extra item to prevent mildew if damp. There's a water-proof zip pocket inside the bag and a velcro pocket on the outside. Plenty of room for keys and other small items. Very well constructed for durability!

title: Very Pleased with LED, Double-duty, and Performance
text: Well, I finally got four AAA batteries to give the Sylvania FX10 Osram Bicycle Headlight a try. Actually, I was impressed. Being LED, the light definitely provides a very bright light. What I also liked was the fact that you can slide the light off the base and use it as a flashlight too. This LED light performs double-duty which makes me happy! I usually ride my bike during the daylight. But if I were to get caught at sunset, then I know this bike headlight will help guide my way home. It's getting dark much earlier now (December) and not enough warm days left. SO....this Sylvania bike headlight will be ready for me in the upcoming spring. I have placed it in my bike's basket so it's ready to go whenever I am. Very pleased!

title: Franklin Sports Indestructible Practice Balls are wonderfu!
text: These Franklin Sports practice plastic baseball are wonderful for my grandkids to learn how to swing a bat and hit a ball all at once. My grandkids love every sport imaginable, and I know they will really like these 9-inch indestructible A balls. It's a great idea to have these practice balls for youngsters to practice and develop skills before they join a team and/or to improve their skills when on a baseball team. I even took one from the package and stood on it and it bounced right back. Now that's wonderful! I was told at a very young age that if you want to be good at something to practice, practice, and practice some more! So there you go....

title: Great "Junior" Football by Franklin Sports
text: This Franklin "Junior" professional football is perfect for teaching your youngster beginning around age 9 years old. Franklin Sports make great footballs!!! The football has a rough exterior and is tight with plenty of air. And you can grip it quite well with the stitching. My husband and grown son sleep & eat football season. They won't even take a phone call if a game is on. So now it's time to pass the football to our expectant grandson once he's in grade school. What a perfect holiday gift for the youngster in your life that loves football too.

title: AWESOME!
text: I was so thrilled with ordering these Franklin Sports Horseshoe set! They recently arrived, and I showed them to my husband. He said it will be fun for us, and he was anxious to play right away. So we did. I won the first round, but he beat me all of the rest of the time. Darn it! Yesterday, we had a cold front come in so we put them in the basement just in case we didn't get to play again. I think we will though. The advanced horseshoes come with two sets of shoes. One pair is gold and the other pair is silver. So it's nice to tell the difference with the different colors when you're playing.The horseshoes are substantial and heavy but not too heavy. They just seem to glide through the air and you can really hear them clink when it hits the stake. We love playing this horseshoe game, and I know our family and friends will too when they come to visit.

title: A really FUN and Adorable Ninja!
text: Ordered this Ninja golf club head-cover for my step-son. He loves golf.....and he's a jokester. He has always been the class clown and still is. He will love this Ninja head-cover by Daphne. It certainly will be a conversation starter. Ha! The Ninja is so soft inside and out. There's fleece and a synthetic fabric. You can even clown around pretending it's a puppet. A really fun and adorable Ninja!

title: Daphne's Horse Headcover is ADORABLE!
text: This Daphne Horse headcover is adorable! I ordered it for my grown son since he loves to play golf with his buddies and family. Our son is always upbeat and the class clown. I just know he's going to love this horse for his driver golf club. The horse fur is plush with white and cognac color fur and loose dark hair down the mane. Inside is a tan fleece. The mouth and nostrils are stitched with round eye buttons. Simply beautiful. A great quality product and adorable too!

title: Beautiful Longboard!
text: I ordered this Ten Toes Emporium Zed longboard skateboard for my 14 year old granddaughter. I'm not sure if she knows it or not but her father was a skate-board guru in his day. I love the roughness on the top that will give your shoes traction and the light bamboo wood tone on the bottom. In my younger years, I also skateboarded and loved it until I jammed my hand. Oh, the price we pay to have fun. Ha! Well, I believe my granddaughter will love the longboard. She has plenty of siblings that will want to ride it too....so it will get a lot of use.

title: Awesome Franklin Sports NHL Mini Hockey Passer 4 Street Hockey!
text: We have one granddaughter that's is super athletic, and she wants to play street hockey among other sports. So....she will love this passer of hockey balls to get the game started. We live on a cul-de-sac so it's safer for her to play here. Once she gets a game started I'm positive all the neighborhood kids will come out to play also. Franklin Sports has done a nice job with their NHL Mini Hockey Passer. There's a ball feeder with a 10 ball limit, some extendable ball shoot pieces, includes 6 foam mini-balls, and can be attached to a hockey goal. She's going to love it......

title: I really like it!
text: I found this ProSource kettlebell in a box on my front porch after returning from work. The box was all beat up and crunched. When I went to pick it up it was a struggle because it kept rolling around. There wasn't an area to grab the box since the sides were all caved in. I could hardly get it through the front door. I just left it there until my husband moved it. There seems to be a huge need to make some kind of packaging around the kettlebell to stabilize it such as a snug fit inside a custom shaped styrofoam container so the box isn't destroyed like mine was. I don't have any previous kettlebells, but I ordered this vinyl-coated cast iron kettlebell to add to our home gym. I will definitely go through some of the internet explainations on how to use it properly. And  then come up with a plan to streamline it in my exercise weekly sessions. I really like the iron kettlebelle!

title: Yay! To a COOL Bruins Hockey Stick
text: I ordered this Boston Bruins hockey stick for my granddaughter. Yes, a girl. Out of my 9 granddaughter's, she's the one that plays outdoors sports what seems like non-stop. I asked her recently if she would like to play street hockey and got a BIG yes. So hopefully she will like it so much that the Franklin Sports vinyl hockey stick will get plenty of use in the next several weeks before the snow starts covering the streets. The hockey stick looks very well made and the bright yellow & black Bruins graphics are cool. It looks like the hockey stick is the right height (48" inches) for an eleven year old to handle. I know she will be very pleased.

title: Have a ZINGER good time!
text: Oh, wow! My six year old granddaughter will have a Zinger fun time with this Zycom 3-Wheel Scooter by Madd Gear USA! It's adorable. I can't really try it out since I'm no longer a kid. (Darn!) But from what I see and touch this is a spectacular scooter toy. They ought to make them for adults too, wouldn't you agree? My husband had a Segway and it kept throwing him off which could cause some painful injuries (so we sold it). So, really, Madd Gear USA ought to come out with something for us big kids to ride. This 3-wheel scooter is lime green (one of my favorite colors) with black wheels and handle. The description says the handle bars are self-adjusting. You can use the handle bar to turn left by leaning the handlebar to the left  and right, lean handlebar right. Then once you straightened, it will straighten as well...and even if you let go, the handlebar returns to the center straight once again. Just a super scooter toy that will get a lot of use when the grandkids come over to visit.

title: Bodyglide Skin Anti-Friction Balm
text: My husband is thrilled with this Bodyglide Skin Glide Anti-Friction Cream! I ordered it for him as he is an amputee who has experienced chafing and blisters occasionally due to wearing a prosthetic (especially for summer heat). We are hopeful that this anti-friction bodyglide will help prevent skin problems going forward. He tells me that the Bodyglide Skin balm went on smoothly, and he believes it's going to help. Which is all that matters.

title: A Great Franklin Sports Goal
text: Oh, our grandkids are going to love this goal! We've also ordered two hockey sticks and a helmet. I think they would love playing this in Nana's cul-de-sac so hopefully no windows get broken. Ha! I and think it would be even more fun to play with skates on. The bulls-eye are targets for pucks to hit (or a safer ball so little one's aren't missing teeth). Schools about ready to start again which means more studying indoors. Being cooped up indoors would make Hockey be a great activity to play outdoors before the snow flies again. The goal looks like another Franklin Sports product with great quality. I especially like the bulls-eye targets. One could use it as a soccer goal which is a great option also.

title: AWESOME SAUCE!
text: AWESOME SAUCE!! I ordered this Transport Case (by Pivotal Gear) to help transport my needed items when doing an art show. I am SO elated!! The three compartments will be wonderful to divide fragile items that won't be bumping into each other. I am a jewelry bead embroidery artist. There's a large quantity of stuff you have to transport to an art show. This case will eliminate a lot of anxiety as my work is with gemstone cabochons and glass beads which can be fragile and breakable if not packed and transported properly. This case is a hard-case with a pivotal handle so you can turn any corner easily with better mobility than other cases I've seen. The ABS plastic is hardsided with durability and yet lightweight. There's a built-in handle on the bottom for when you need to lift it. I can hardly wait to use it!

title: Bat Man Goalie Mask by Franklin Sports is Way Cool
text: Waayyyyy Cool! The Bat Man goalie face mask by Franklin Sports is super-quality. It will take many hard-hits all day long and hold up each time. Even when your kid calls "give" the helmet will march on. The durability in a goalie mask is extremely important these days when too many head concussions is happening. Hopefully this helmet will help prevent that going forward. It has a very hard shell, hard  & thick wire that will protect the face, chin strap with velcro and back-plate with elastic straps! Now to the awesome graphics.....on top you will find the oval Bat Man logo with the black bat with yellow background, the chin area has a line drawing of a bat, on each side is Bat Man in black & white with gripping expressions, in the forehead area has mystic yellow eyes, and at the very top is Bat Man lettering. Franklin Sports did a great job, and kids will enjoy playing outdoors with this Bat Man face mask. Outdoor playing is excellent exercise for everyone. So get out there and play and invite mom and dad sometimes.

title: Front Child Carrier for a Day of Fun
text: We're so happy with the Mini Shell Front Child Carrier that arrived today. We ordered it for our grown son so he and his wife can take their baby with them while biking in Colorado. They love having our granddaughter with them so we know they will be thrilled receiving this gift. It's easy to install and it's awesome our granddaughter will see the bike trails with a full-frontal view. So many beautiful trails with wildlife and wildflowers to see.

title: Yoga Wedge in Purple (my favorite color)
text: This is a wonderful product! If you have low back pain, then the wedge will be a big benefit for when you're doing yoga or toning exercises on your back. I placed it below my knees and it takes the pressure off my back. Very much appreciated too! I've had low back pain ever since a car hit me from behind in 1973. I'm a grandmother now and the pain is still severe. This mat wedge will be of great benefit for me and you as well should you suffer too. It's flexible to use other ways as well. So give it a try!

title: Eco-Friendly Yoga Mat
text: Well I never thought I'd be excited over a yoga mat but this one is extremely eco special. It's so soft and reversible. It's a raspberry color on one side and black on the other. And the best part, for me, is the fact that it's machine washable or one can wipe with a soapy cloth and rinse. Now for the eco part, it's biodegradable, recyclable, free of latex and synthetic rubbers. Which can be real important especially if one is allergic to latex. The foam is super soft but has a great grip to the flooring and made of closed-cell construction (fusible) without harmful glues. It has a hygienic barrier to bacteria and resists water. Personally, I have a bunch of allergies so this mat is perfect for my workout!

title: No big Bouncy, Bouncy for me
text: I only gave this nice basketball 3 stars as I played with it upon opening the box and it wouldn't bounce back up very well. I'll check again to see if low on air but from my first initial trial it didn't rate well with me. Sorry.

title: I purchased this blue Bike Basket as a Christmas gift ...
text: I purchased this blue Bike Basket as a Christmas gift for my 9 year old granddaughter's Schwinn bicycle. She was elated!

title: Plano Pink and Periwinkle Two Tray Tackle Box
text: Last summer while visiting Friday Harbor in the San Juan Island (north of Seattle), I spotted this pink and periwinkle tackle box. I had to have it. This pink tackle box DOESN'T contain lures. No way...it contains my seed beads, cube beads, and bugle beads for beadweaving. But you could also store your beading tools, wire, etc. here too. There are two smaller trays inside that fold out and will hold a lot. It fits well on a shelf so it's out of the way. This tackle box also makes it easier for transporting on and/or off our boat especially if I'm carrying other items too which is usually the case. Our other tackle boxes do contain lures for fishing (which I enjoy too) but there's no confusing the two since this special one is pink. My original one is full now, and I found the exact pink one again on Amazon so I ordered another one.  ... Bead On Girlfriends! ... Pink Power! :-)

title: NO
text: Not worth the buy.

title: A little tight over my upper torso
text: This shirt should be the right size, and technically it fits (more or less like on the model), but I thought the style would be a little looser than it was. It was loose around my belly but almost tight fitting on my arms and at my upper torso. It's not quite what I was expecting in terms of material, but it does hold in heat well when you exercise, helping to create a sweat. I thought it was made from heat-reflecting material, like mylar, but I didn't feel that way to me. More like wearing a rain coat and taking a run. Also, it had a smell for a day or two after opening.

title: Can get sparks, but none cause a fire. No instructions included.
text: I had such hopes for this based on the 5 star "even kids can do it!" reviews present when I got this, but there must be a trick I don't know about. I tried to light a pile of brush (dry leaves, small twigs, small branches, and some newspaper stuck in several spots). Holding the rod about an inch above the crumpled newspaper, I scraped the rod with the raised edge of the ruler/striker gadget. After scraping off the black coating, I could get a shower of sparks with each scrape, but nothing caught fire. After about 50 scrapes, only one spark even smoldered a second. I tried over dry kindling, the twigs and leaves, but nothing caught fire. Even if I got a fire to start in a little bowl (like one reviewer did in demonstration; thank you!), you'd still need a spill (long bit of twisted paper or something like match wood) to get the flame started on several spots on the brush pile. So it's a no-go as a fire-starter in practical situations. I was able to start the fire later with only one match, BTW.

title: Sturdy and keeps things cool or warm
text: It's been nine years since I got my cooler, and it's still in good shape and working well. Good product.

title: Well-made
text: This balance board is solidly made and should last very well. It can stand balanced on it's own. There's a rough material on top to provide grip for your feet and different material on the bottom rocker and corners to prevent slipping and damage.

title: Well-made
text: To be honest, I didn't get this for the intended purpose. I can pick up and lift a frisbee with it, so I expect it'll work for the intended purpose. It looks well-made and has no obvious flaws in how it works. I have some range of motion issues that make it awkward to remove coats, and this makes it a breeze. Love it.

title: Looks like a good design
text: You get two small, nylon bags with a whistle on the drawstring. The poncho is inside the bag and looks like in the photos. It looks like it'll work better than those mylar blankets, which are kind of awkward to hold in place. However, these still look thin enough that I'm only expecting to get one or two uses out of each poncho. As I'm putting them in my car for emergencies, I'm actually hoping I'll never need them but that they'll be in good shape if I do.

title: Very sturdy. For tall people.
text: The piping is made out of heavy steel, so you really do need the carry handle to easily tote this chair around. The fabric is taunt and the back nearly fully upright. The pipe under the knees is uncomfortable if you're not tall enough. At 5' 4" tall, I'm not tall enough. It lifts my heels off the floor by an inch or two (unless the shoe I'm wearing has a built up heel) and so puts that weight against the back of my knee. My 6' dad who likes taunt, upright chairs like this folding chair. The chair looks well-made and very sturdy. Even the canvas looks like it'll last well, though I'm not sure how it'd handle being left in the rain as there are no holes for the water to drain off the seat.

title: Big for 2.5 years old and way short for 5 years old
text:
So I have a 2.5 year old niece who wants to ride the bike of her just-turned 5 years old sister. I thought this balance bike would be great for them, especially as the older child is still so nervous about balancing her bike on her own. The younger niece was so excited, but even at the lowest setting, it seemed to be difficult for her to "walk" to bike with both feet while sitting on the seat. She's almost walking on tip-toe. She's big for her age. She also didn't seem to like the hard seat and found it uncomfortable. It'll probably fit her better at age 3. The older niece wanted a try, so we put the seat at the max height line. She's about average height for her age, but she was too large to use it to learn to balance on 2 wheels. It was awkward for her to walk it and will be difficult to coast it even if she lifts her legs outward (as she can't use the built in foot rest). So we're a little disappointed. (UPDATE: Actually, the older girl can coast on it and has gotten quite good at balancing, but it's still awkward for her and she complains that the seat is uncomfortable. The pictures show the 5 year-old.)

The assembly instructions were a couple of crowded diagrams with the brief text instructions on a different page. The text added nothing to the diagrams. I was getting ready to put the bike together before the nieces arrived to visit when my dad (grandpa) saw what I was doing and took over. He promptly proved that you can't just guess about how it should go together and then, yes, you really do need to align the pieces the way shown in the diagram. However, once he started following the diagram, we did hit snag with the handlebar section. The front wheel comes up through the shaft and the handlebars go down in the shaft, then you tighten a band over both to hold things in place. It wasn't until the plastic spacer on the wheel section was removed that enough of the bottom pipe was exposed for this band to effectively tighten over and hold everything in place and aligned. It looks sturdy now that it's together.

title: Way to small
text: The workmanship on the vest looks fine, but the sizing is way off. I looked at the measurements for each size, measured the person's body to confirm, and chose a size that should have been about 2" looser than skin-tight (not to mention it's the person's regular shirt size). Even when pulling the neoprene tight, the zipper was about 4" too far apart to close, with some spots further apart than others.

title: Comfortable, thick, absorbent, snug, and stay in place well.
text: This is a 12 pack of headbands made from organic cotton. They're soft, comfortable, and absorb well (and hold a lot when I tested with water). They stretch a lot and seem to have a heavy-duty elastic, but they're a little bit tight the way that I like to wear them. Not uncomfortable, just very snug. And maybe I don't need to have the back quite so far down the back of my head as the band stays in place well. Still, I'm very pleased and I'm guessing they'll be perfectly comfortable after little more wear.

title: More for shock absorption than cushioning
text: These 3/8" thick, interlocking rubber floor tiles appear well-made and durable. We got these to put under some kid's play equipment, but these heavy tiles are so dense that they don't seem like they're that much more cushioning for a fall than the wood slats current under the equipment. They are safer, though. They probably would work fine for tumbling (summersaults, hand stands, etc.). They repeal water and are working fine outside. The set included edging pieces that give the mat a smooth-edge look. The pieces are pretty easy to interlock and hold together well.

title: Well-made, sturdy chair. Forced into a leaning back position, though.
text: This camp chair has a sturdy metal frame with a thick cotton canvas seat and back. It's easy to open and close. Simply grab a diagonal back and front leg and pulled them together or apart. It comes with a storage bag. While I like this chair, isn't really comfortable for a long period of time. The low height at the knee is comfortable for me at 5'4" and for those who are shorter. However, your seat ends up slightly below the knee level and the back is tilted back, so your back is unsupported when you make the effort to sit up straight if you're eating something, for example. Add your lap is tilted a little, too. When leaning back, there's nothing to support your head, so you're holding your head up and forward instead of in a restful position. I had realized the that the back was tilted, but I'm disappointed that the chair is not easier to sit upright in when desired.

title: Lightweight and compact
text: This is a very lightweight, compact inflatable sleeping pad. It took up very little room in the car, and I think it wouldn't be too heavy to carry for a while. I took it along to a hotel room to provide extra padding if the bed was too uncomfortable. It turns out I didn't need it for that, but I did inflate this when I got home just to try it out. It feels comfortable, but I also didn't try sleeping on it all night. I've been using it to take naps on, occasionally, and it works fine for that.

title: Good length and soft, comfortable fabric
text: You get two headbands made of a soft, somewhat stretchy fabric made of 95% cotton and 5% spandex. The black fabric with floral pattern is pretty and won't show sweat, dirt, etc. easily. They are 38.5" long; long enough to reach from under a ponytail at the back of the head to the top of the head and still have enough tie length left to secure it. The ties are a narrower width (2.75" wide) than the main section (4.75" wide), which make the ties easier to work with.

title: Vastly under counts steps, especially start and stop movement. Too easy to bump reset button.
text:
This step counter doesn't count steps very accurately, and the buttons are easy to bump when unclipping the pedometer so that the step information is reset to zero and lost. There have been many times when testing the best way to use this when the steps showed zero when I checked it. In order to not over count steps due to random movement, the steps are not counted until you've done 10 similar steps in a row. Since I do a lot of work in the kitchen and gardening that is under 10 steps, then a pause, then more steps, this means a lot of steps are not being counted. Also, it seems like it is not counting those first 10 steps, either. If I step 50 steps in a row, it only counts like 32 steps. Frankly, an app on my phone works better than this. I had thought a dedicated device would work better, but I guess not. I will note that it seems to count steps better when this is clipped to my shoe rather than to my waistband. I'll update after little bit if I figure out how to make it work better.

The step counter comes with a battery, and you remove the plastic strip preventing connection in order to turn on the pedometer. It is then constantly on, though it does go into a sleep mode when there is no movement. The instructions that come with it are not very clear, but you're supposed to be able to set things like stride length. You hit the mode button to switch between steps, distance, calories burned, time spent walking, speed, the clock, and total steps. There is also a reset button along one edge and a set button along with other edge. You can remove the counter from the clip (mainly to access the battery chamber). My accidental reset problem has been when the buttons are near the top of the clip, where you have to squeeze to release the clip. I still seem to bump the buttons when the ends are switched, but it's not as often.

title: Set of five massage with instructions
text: This set comes with five types of massage tools along with a set of instructions on possible ways to use them. Unfortunately, the instructions show a small foam roller when what you get is a huge firm foam roller that measures 6" thick and 17.5" inches wide. Perhaps people with experience with this type of roller can better know how to use it. You also get a 19" long plastic stick with rolling cylinders on it. You grasp the handles on each end and roll it over the sore spot. There is a textured rubber foot roller that is 6.5" long with 2.5" tall wheels. There is a spiky, hard plastic ball about 3" across that looks like a dryer ball. Finally, my favorite, a smooth, rotating ball in a handle that is comfortable to hold on to. You roll this over sore muscles to create a massage. I don't really use the dryer ball and huge foam roller, but I have used all of the rest of them and they work well.

title: Nice looking, sturdy, heavier than expected.
text: This block is heavier than I expected. The outside is covered with cork, providing a good grip for lifting it. The actual packaging makes no claim that the whole thing is cork, but there are also no obvious joins to the cork surface. The block measures 9" x 6" x 4". The block is sturdy enough to hold a fair amount of weight. It also looks very nice.

title: Not all four are equally loud
text:
In the past, I've bought a lifeguard whistle that looks like these, and the slightest puff of breath created a piercing whistle that could be heard far away. Imagine my disappointment when the first whistle that I tried wasn't that loud. It just gave a muffled sort of whistle. It would probably be loud enough if I blew as hard as I could, though. Since I only need three of these for my intended uses, happily, the other three are nearly as loud as I expected. I was hoping this would be something that would scare off potential attackers or draw attention and help from nearby, and I think it will do that. I'm giving one to each family member and, as we live on a farm, I need the sound to carry for quite some distance. The intent is to get attention if someone is hurt. We and our neighbors have had problems in the past were yelling for help couldn't be heard, but hopefully these will be. I like the lanyards, which have a satiny feel (which should be comfortable on the skin) and an easy-to-work toggle.

The whistle is 2 3/16" long and 5/8" wide and 3/8" deep, so they don't take up that much room. They are lightweight. The lanyard is about 16 inches long when major doubled, lying flat (from the back of the neck to the whistle rather than the length from the whistle all the way around that point again).

title: 10 packages of mylar emergency blankets
text: I received 10 packages containing mylar emergency blankets. If you know what those look like, then you know what you're getting. They're a thin, crinkly metallic blanket that does hold in heat but aren't exactly cozy. Then again, these are for emergencies. I'm actually using these as backing on two curtains that receive a lot of sun as well as as an emergency blanket for several cars, etc.

title: Cushion measures 13 inches across, so not wide enough for adults to sit on comfortably
text:
This balance board/wobble cushion kit includes the cushion and a hand pump with the correct connector to add air to the cushion. There is no "balance workout disk." The cushion measures 13 inches across and is made of a material similar to exercise balls. I intended to use this as a seat cushion, but even though I have a slim rear end, 13 inches is not wide enough. If you wish to use it for a seat cushion, I'd recommend measuring to see how it would fit you. This would probably fit kids just fine, though.

The cushion comes with a "stop" warning sticker that says not to use the cushion until you go to the provided website URL and read the instructions. Well, you will never get those instructions. The URL provides a page with a Clickfunnels ad that you cannot close and forces you to divert to another page. I saw no way to get back to the desired page, but behind that ad, it was clear that you would have to provide your email address before they would give you any instructions. So you're not going to get the instructions which are so critical according to the sticker.
