It's fairly long and that's works out for me because of my leg length.  It isn't too thin or too thick, but just right for your exercise needs.

title: Great for anyone interested in balance training...
text: This is a great way to get a balance training stability cushion for less.  The disc is fairly easy to inflate and once inflated it does a great job at holding the air with little to no leakage.  The cushion is just that-cushioned.  It's easy against the skin and works really well when combined with certain stretches and light weight training.  The disc is large enough to be of good use and will hold up to a good bit of movement.

title: Nice band, effective, but not for beginners...
text: I enjoy using this band.  It's definitely a work out as it doesn't give much without a fair amount of force.  I have a wide stance and found the band to be a bit too small for me, but that doesn't diminish how effective it could be for others.  It's fairly easy to use and looks great while in use.  I wouldn't say this is something for a beginner to use and the price is pretty high for what you get, but it is a nice band all together.

title: It's All About That Base (...no treble...)
text:
As far as desk lamps go -and I've tried quite a few - this one is right about where the price should be.
However, for the minimalist design the base doesn't have quite enough weigh to prevent tip overs even at modest angles. The instability increases as you rotate the head right or left. If the base were heavier this would be my go-to desk lamp.
This one is rather tall and long and, for it's length, the throw of light and corresponding color temperatures are very effective and provide a very nice spread. The color temp and brightness selection features are a very nice addition.
The aluminum upper (only) lamp body is durable and the hinges stay put once you account for the spring-back.
The bottom line... if you don't need to make many adjustments other than a standard 45 degree angle this desk lamp really is a great choice.

title: Random, odd, and broken...
text: To be honest, when I saw this available for review, I knew I had to try out this random and odd sweatshirt.  The good news first- it's warm and comfortable to wear around the house.  Now for the bad news...the shirt fits much larger than expected, and I'm a size 14/16.  It came in with the bell accessory broken in two.  Yes, it comes with a large bell.  I still can't figure out what they want the wearer to do with it.  The pet carrier pocket zipper was broken and the construction of the shirt is such that anything over five pounds is going to weigh you down considerably.  The pocket is very deep, which when combined with the previous piece of advice, means a small animal is going to have a hard time keeping their head up enough to breathe fresh air.  Also, the pocket is lined with sherpa and grabs pet hair like crazy, not letting go of it even in the wash.  I won't be wearing this shirt in or out of the house.

title: Chomp! Chomp!!
text: This is a great backsack for hitting up the games, whether they are in the stadium or at your buddy's house.  Gators fans will love sporting this nice piece of officially licensed gear.  The sack holds a fair amount of stuff and is comfortable to wear.  It's about as secure as any backsack can be.  The decals are nice and detailed, crisp lines and rich colors.  Great price for a gift for anyone who's all about the Chomp! Chomp!

title: Good support and easy to use...
text: This is a really nice brace to have in a runner's arsenal.  Putting it on and adjusting it is easy, and wearing it is rather comfortable.  It provides great support while allowing for a good range of motion.  The neutral colors ensures that it blends into the background and doesn't call attention to itself, if that sort of thing is a must for you.  Overall, the price and quality of this product is fantastic!  A must have!

title: Excellent Quality Waterproof Headlamp
text:
I can't say enough about the pleasant surprise I got when I tried the Knog Bandicaot LED Headlamp.
Too cliche', you might ask? Well, how about these points:
*it's my new, absolutely go-to headlamp for reading in the bed at night so as not to bother my spouse.
*It's also my new go-to headlamp for working in the attic because it stays put while remaining comfortable. No buckle or stretchy elastic. Pure, old fashioned, quality, non-slip rubber.
*It is AMAZINGLY bright for it's size. It literally lights up the whole room and not just a spot if necessary.
*The different setting are all very practical (1.High Brightness, Forward Facing; 2. Medium Brightness Forward Facing;3. Reading brightness, downward facing; 4. Pure Red Lamp Forward facing)
*The 'secret' USB plug compartment fits nicely into any standard USB charging outlet or power bank.
*The headlamp holds a charge VERY well and uses the LED's quite efficiently.
*A quick press of the smaller button tells you the battery level using the reading LED's
*Totally practical, efficient design.
If you are in the market for a headlamp then this is what I would HIGHLY recommend it. It is worth the little extra money and should last a long time.

title: They look great on!!
text: This is a nice pair of yoga/lounge pants.  If you're like me, you wear pants like this for day-to-day errands and not just for exercising.  These are perfect for both.  The black is nice and rich.  The seams are sewn very well.  The pants washed and dried well when washed with color safe detergent and on a gentle cycle, and dried hanging up.  They did not shrink after washing.  They fit snuggly, but that's what you want in this style pant.  They don't cut in around my middle (I'm on the chubby side) and they help to disguise my "pooch".  HOWEVER, the price of these is way too high.  I can find many other brands who sell the same type of pants for a good bit less.

title: A cute addition to a young child's toy box...
text: This golf bag and clubs set is pretty cute.  It's not the highest quality toy out there but that doesn't diminish the fun that could be had during playtime in the back yard.  The entire set is made of a hard, albeit thin, lightweight plastic and features two large working wheels and a handle that can be raised to whatever position is comfortable for your child's height.  The clubs are light enough for a child to swing to whatever degree they are able to.  The three hollow golf balls are stored in the front bottom portion of the cart.  The set comes with a two flags to use as hole markers.  There are three different clubs included in the set and they store inside the golf bag.

title: Every yoga fan needs a pair of these!
text: There's nothing worse than do floor exercises and your knees coming away bruised.  Well, these babies are a life saver.  I even use them when I'm leaning over the bathtub giving my toddler a bath.  They work really well!  I bruise easily so having the option to exercise without coming away with purple knots on my knees is awesome.  They are well worth the price.

title: This makes my day a bit brighter...
text: I love this mat!  Not only is it easy to use, it's funny and encouraging at the same time.  It's a nice navy blue with teal designs on it.  It's light weight and easy to roll up and stash away until it's needed again.  It has good grip and works well with accessories.  It's affordable too!

title: Fun game but a tad pricey for what you get...
text: I love a nice game of Ladder Ball with friends and family.  It's challenging but fun.  This set is great for the casual player who wants to play on the occasional sunny day outside.  The setup is a bit tricky but once it's done, it's done.  The quality isn't top notch but it really doesn't have to be unless you plan on playing constantly.  The price tag is a bit high for a casual game set, in my opinion, but it's still a nice set.  It even arrived in it's own zippered canvas bag so you can keep up with all of the pieces.

title: Fun game but maybe a tad pricey...
text: If you like a good game or horseshoe with friends and family, this set is a good bet for you.  The set is sturdy and durable, though the price is a bit high for me.  Setup is easy and happened quickly enough.  The set comes in a zippered canvas bag so you don't have to worry about searching around the garage for all of the pieces.

title: Fun but not the sturdiest product Franklin's put out...
text: This is a nice set.  It's fun to play a great yard game with friends and family, and this Badminton set helps to make that possible.  While it isn't the sturdiest or most durable set, it does contain everything you'll need for a nice game together.  The setup is easy to assemble with an extra pair of hands.  The rackets aren't the best I've seen but it gets the job done.  I do think the price is about $15 too high, though.  For the quality of the product you receive.  The set comes in its own zippered canvas bag so you don't have to worry about searching the garage for all the pieces next time you want to play.

title: Fun for everyone!!!
text: I love a good game of volleyball.  There's something about skillfully smacking a ball around that helps me focus and let of some steam.  It's even better when that game is played with friends and family.  That's why this set is so great.  It's so much fun to head outside for a great time in the grass.  The set includes everything you'll need for a good game.  All you need is a few minutes to set things up (with an extra pair of hands), an open area, and a group of people who are ready to have a blast.  The setup is sturdy and durable.

title: Fun for the whole family!
text: There's nothing quite like friends and family gathering under the sun for a game together.  It's enough to put a smile on even the gloomiest face.  This is one such game.  Bocce is a fun game for the family but normally the balls are quite hard.  That's why this set is fantastic.  The balls are heavy enough for a real game of Bocce but soft enough to be easy to grip.  Great price for a great product!!

title: Cut a tad bit small but a great shirt!
text: My husband really likes this tee.  It's moisture wicking and lightweight.  The cut is a bit small so I might size up.  It's a silky, stretchy material and skim the body rather than hugging it.  The color is a nice rich black and it washes and dries well.  Great buy!

title: Great addition to any yoga session!
text: There's a real need for stability in any yoga session.  This block really helps me achieve that stability during certain poses.  It's very firm but still comfortable to press against.  It's super lightweight and a beautiful, rich shade of purple.  The price is just right for this block.  Note: Use this on a yoga mat because it will slide across the floor if you don't.

title: Nice constructions  and easily worn with other colors!
text: I like this hat.  I purchased it for my husband and he seems to enjoy it.  It's made of a nice thick, almost denim style material and the bill is nice and firm.  There's a Velcro closure in the back that is easily adjusted, but I think it could look a little nicer and higher quality.  The color is a nice, rich black and being a neutral color, it can be paired with a variation of colors and athletic styles.  I like the sun protection factor, which I think is achieved because the hat is thick up top and has a bill, basically like most baseball caps.  The only downfall is that the thick material holds on to heat.  For the price point, it's a safe buy.

title: Adorable and priced right!
text: What can I say?  This hat is precious!  The colors are perfect for Autumn and the plaid will work with your sweaters well.  The hat is lightweight and a touch loose when worn, which is great.  The colors are a nice creamed coffee, copper penny, and dark brown, with a copper colored satin trim around the band.  The materials aren't the highest quality but it's a hat.  It doesn't really matter if the price is right and the construction is done well, and it is.  The seams are sewn very well and I see this hat, with proper care, having a place in my fall wardrobes for years to come.

title: I love this band!
text: I'll start here:  I'm a klutz.  A big one.  Unfortunately, that's led to the delicate ring my husband custom designed now being two diamonds short.  I needed a great everyday band that wouldn't cost a fortune and was low profile.  I found out about silicone rings and kept the idea in the back of my mind until my pregnant sister purchased one for her swollen hands.  She loves it and encouraged me to grab one up.  I started trying out different brands, colors, designs, and band widths.  I'd get them in, try them on, and set up their returns immediately.  Until this ring!  I love the width; not too thin but not too thick.  It's a nice, rich black with a slightly satin finish.  The edges are nicely rounded and the material is silky smooth.  The 'infinity' design is well done; evenly spaced and grooved.  The sizing is true and the ring easily rolls down the finger into place.  I'm very satisfied!!

title: Not a great set if you're looking for decent coloring...
text: My issues with this set isn't with the quality of the product.  They wear very comfortably, the colors held up after testing in water.  They're a bit thinner then I'd prefer, but only by a tiny bit.  They sit perfectly when stacked one on top of the other.  The silicone could be sturdier, but if you aren't super rough on your hands, it doesn't seem like it will make a difference.  The two problems I ran into are textured pattern and color.  The grooves are unevenly cut and the colors are different than advertised.  The "black" isn't black, just a gray.  The "rose gold" is a light pink.  The "gold" is more of a dandelion yellow.  The only ring that looks like the pictures is the silver.

title: An unexpected delight!
text: This product works really well for projects outside of its intended purpose.  I used this to age several pipe fittings I've used to build an industrial coat hook piece.  The fittings were fresh off of the factory floor, which means they were shiny and bright silver.  This stuff worked like a champ!  I lightly applied it with a soft cloth, barely buffing it in.  The black coloring ended up coming out a very dark brown, but I'd washed the fittings and allowed them to rust a bit.  The polish dried down to a matte/slightly eggshell finish, buffed to a nice pewter satin finish, and layered well over another coat of rust.  It held up beautifully under a coat of matte finish polyurethane.  I love the end product!!!  I would definitely buy this again but I don't think I'll need to, as a little goes a very long way.  The bottle is still full, even after two layers of it.

title: Protect Your Face!
text:
A family members mows a lot of lawns, and is outside a fair amount.

He got skin cancer on the tip tops of his ears from the sun. He had to get it treated.

Since then, we encourage him to wear a hat when he's mowing lawns.

This hat is perfect for that he says. It provides wide coverage of his ears and face.

The sizing is adjustable, and it fits his large head well. Head circumference about 22~24 inches (56cm~ 61cm) for Adult Men & Women. So, men and women can wear it!

It is light weight and foldable. It weighs 10 ounces.

It provides ample shade. It gives you 360 degreee protection from UV rays.

It has a lifetime guarantee, with 90-day money back guarantee.

There is a snap on the side, so you can snap one side up if you want a breeze. Or want it to resemble a cowboy hat.

It has a camouflage interior which is popular.

It is made of polyester and mesh so cools quickly if it gets wet. Good to wear at the beach, too.

Dimensions: 13.6 x 13.4 x 1.7 inches

It says it's made of polyester, and then says it's made of 100% cotton so am confused about that. Company says it blocks 90% of UV rays. Yet promo says "complete UV protection". So that's an inconsistency.

Given its fabric content - cotton or polyester - it should be washable. Label inside hat says: 100% cotton. Made in China. I assume that's accurate. There are no washing instruction. I'd probably hand wash it in Woolite or dish washing soap and let it dry naturally so it doesn't shrink in dryer.

This hat will get a lot of wear at our house.

4.5 stars as the company is inconsistent about fabric content - it feels like cotton.

title: Super Rain Jacket
text:
My husband tried this rain jacket on tonight and loves it. Features he loves about it:

* Long - the length is longer than most of his other jackets so protects him more against the rain.

* Zips bottom to top - not over the head which is annoying. You zip from the bottom up to your chin.

* Very large exterior and interior pockets - the 2 exterior pockets near your waist and hips are deep and you can zip them shut so good to put keys, phone, wallet etc. inside and they won't get wet or fall out. There are two upper pockets near your chest which have a flap to keep water out. Inside there are two deep pockets near your waist and hips - 6 pockets total! Lots of room to carry items.

* Navy color - won't show soil easily, and goes with all colors of pants.

* Light weight - not a heavy jacket so you can wear it in the summer, too, on rainy days. Easy to pack and carry.

* Elastic at hem and bottom of sleeves - elastic is loose but gives a little stretch so should fit many sizes. It's also gathered so should keep water out at end of sleeves.

My husband is about 6 feet and weighs about 180. The large fits him well with a little room to spare. The lining is a shiny fabric. There is no tie at the chin. It just zips up to under your chin.

We will test this on a rainy day, and report back if it's not water-proof, but it looks like it should do a great job keeping you dry.

There is a slight scent from the fabric which should dissipate as it airs out. It smells like nylon.

My husband was thrilled with this jacket when he put it on. We've had a LOT of rain in the northeast this spring and summer - 4-5 days a week! - so this jacket will come in handy.

title: Light Flannel PJ's for Young Patriot Fans
text:
This is made of a light, soft, flame retardant flannel.

It has a long white zipper which goes almost to the toes, with an easy snap at the top.

The fabric is cute with Patriots logo.

It has white stitching for accent.

It is 100% polyester. I prefer cotton which breathes better.

It has two pesky labels at the top back.

You are supposed to turn this inside out when you wash on cold, gentle cycle with like colors. Do not use fabric softener or it will impact flame retardant ability. Non-chlorine bleach. Tumble dry low.

It was made in Bangladesh.

Suggestions for improvement: use more cotton in fabric, substitute print for labels at upper back, and perhaps skip the flame retardant chemicals. 3.5 stars

Here's some info which discourages flame retardant fabrics close to children's skin:
A study published in August 2014 found that PBDEs (polybrominated diphenyl ethers), the most commonly used fire-retardant chemicals, were linked to numerous health problems.

Researchers found the chemicals were to blame for:

thyroid disruption
early onset of puberty
cognitive problems
delayed mental and physical development
“The chemicals used to make pajamas and other consumer products flame-retardant show up in water, wildlife, and human breast milk,” says pediatrician Michael Macknin, MD.

According to Dr. Macknin, the chemicals in fire retardants do diminish the flammability of products treated with them and have been associated with decreased burn injuries in children. However, the chemicals aren’t well-bound to the fabric fibers at times and can leech out. This allows the fire-retardant chemicals to float free in the environment.

“The long-term impact these chemicals may have on health and cognition is not closely scrutinized,” says Dr. Macknin. “They are often put on the market without long-term studies of their safety.”

Other dangers besides pajamas
These chemicals are found in furniture and mattresses as well as cell phones, television remotes and numerous other consumer plastics, says Dr. Macknin.

“If the tag on a sofa or mattress you’re planning to buy says, ‘this article complies with flammability requirements of California Bureau of Home Furnishings Technical Bulletin 117’, or language to that effect, it likely contains pounds of PBDEs,” he says.

You’ll find this sort of notice on numerous children’s products like car seats, strollers, toys and changing mats. According to Dr. Macknin and other health experts, these added chemicals may put your child at a greater risk than the flames they claim to inhibit. An alternative to chemically treated flame-retardant pajamas are close-fitting pajamas made of natural fibers. Some fabrics meet smolder standards without added chemicals.

title: Quality Kettlebell
text:
As a beginner with a kettlebell, this seems like a good basic one. The handle has some texture to it which keeps it from slipping I imagine. I thought the handle might be plastic, but it's a metal.

It will stay cooler, and not contribute to sweating like plastic might perhaps. It's a little bumpy - just slightly bumpy compared to the smooth green plastic below. I notice this is standard for the quality kettlebells. Some kettlebells come with a DVD at the same price point - this one doesn't. There are less expensive kettlebells available, but FILA has a good name in the athletic world. Some of them don't have the wide handle, which seems especially helpful for bigger hands.

I like the neon green color. It's a positive color.

It might have been fun to have a diagram of the 5-10 most popular kettlebell exercises on paper to look at with the kettlebell.

However, if you google kettlebell exercises, there are some on YouTube.

Here's some facts which FILA wants you to know about this kettlebell which they manufacture:

Solid iron construction with durable vinyl coating to protect floor
Easy-grip classic style wide handle
Build strength and increase endurance during weight-training workouts
Great for beginners and ideal for all kettlebell movements and exercises

It appears there may be a manufacturers warranty on this product, but it is not spelled out. You need to contact the company. It's hard to imagine you would wear this out.

For a beginner, I might investigate some of the less expensive kettlebells. However, if you know you like kettlebell exercises, and will do a lot of them, this looks like it will hold up well.

title: Fantastically Designed Cooler
text:
This is a great collapsible SnapBasket cooler to take shopping for cold items, to the beach or to the park. My son lives near Prospect Park in Brooklyn and likes to take his dog there for walks. The dog likes to just lay down and watch the action there, so this would allow them to bring lunch and hang out. Here are some features to like about this SnapBasket cooler:

* attached bottle opener on strap - always handy and you have one with you when you bring this basket

* good capacity - holds 50 cans plus ice!

title: Good weight vest, but way over priced!
text:
This is a great weight vest. This is only the 2nd vest I've ever used. I have a Gold's Gym weight vest that is similar to this one but it uses small sand bags instead of the bars that this vest has.

Comparing this vest to my old one it has a much better fit then my old one. This one is more adjustable then the golds gym one. I tightened the straps as tight as they would go on my golds gym vest and the thing still way to loose and sags when doing push ups with it. But on this Portzon vest it can be made to fit very snug and makes doing push ups alot better because I don't have the thing sagging down to the floor.

The Portzon vest has good range of motion as well. I do P90X which has a ton of push ups and pullups in it. Have not had any trouble doing either with this vest. It has a soft feel and even with all the weight bars in, it doesn't start feel uncomfortable like my old vest does when it is fully weighted. The only thing about this vest that I found to be a but if a bother is that the material makes you feel hot and if you start sweating it just kinda feels sorta like you have a sweater vest on. It's like a velvety feel on the inside, which feels soft and comfy but when your burning up doing a intense work out that material is t so nice.

Overall I am happy with this vest, much better feel and usability then my old one. Aside from the material inside making you feel hot, I can't say anything bad about this. BUT........

The PRICE! I can not believe this normally cost $80 on Amazon. I got it as part of the Vine program. But if someone gave this to me and asked what I thought the cost was I would maybe say $40 which is actually what I paid for my Golds Gym one years ago. Not $80!! Now don't get me wrong the vest feels well made and all, and I do like it alot. But at the same time it does also have that feel of a cheaper brand of the same product, if that makes any sense. I have a feeling that this company or brand is copying this from a big name brand and it has that feel to it. For that reason $80 is way to much for this. There are much cheaper vests out there and they may be even better then this for all I know. But I am happy with it, just wouldn't pay $80, heck I am not paying $80 for any weight vest that's just ridiculous.

It comes with a sun shade that snaps onto the outside frame and a rain cover the covers from the very top to the bottom by hooking it on with small stretchy straps. There are 2 vents on the front, along with reflectors on the front and back. The seat itself reclines to 2 different positions which is nice. The basket is huge! Much bigger than I thought and if you don't need to use it, it clips flush up the back. The handle bar is adjustable up/down. There are 2 mesh pockets on the inside for the child to use which is nice. Pushing the stroller itself is a breeze. I haven't been able to use the bike attachment yet, but can't wait to give it a go! This is overall a great stroller for an active family on the go!

title: Very Roomy!
text: I really like this bag. It is big enough to fit my thick workout mat, plus clothes, shoes and a few small other things inside. It feels like a canvas material on the outside with some leather on the handles. There are pockets inside as well. The color is deeply pretty too.

title: Light weight.
text: This little pump is compact and light weight. It worked well, but I only had a issues with the small nozzle not being long enough to work well on our floats without me having to pinch the float nozzle open.  It worked well though for what it is.  It gets a little warm if you have it on too long. Great pump for the value.

title: well made
text: This exercise band is pretty simple, but it is well made and feels like it will hold up with lots of use.

title: Two Stars
text: Size too small for bike.

title: I love it!
text: I love this little treadmill. It's much smaller than the typical treadmill, so it doesn't take up so much room. It's very basic, without inclines or extras. It's simply for walking. I've been using it a good bit lately, and it's worked wonderfully for me. I hope it holds up, because it's helped me get my walking in even if the weather isn't to my liking. It's been easier to get myself in the habit of walking when I don't have to worry about waiting until rain is gone or bundling up because it's too cold for my tastes. The only complaints I have about it is that the little locking device for the handle wasn't included in my box. I doubled checked all the Styrofoam (because sometimes things get hid in there), but it just wasn't there. I have to be super careful not to push or pull too hard on the handle, though I try to swing my arms while walking anyway. There was also part of a rubber pad on the bottom broken off. Despite those complaints, I'm still super happy with it. So far it seems pretty durable.

title: Works great for my son
text: My children have bunk beds in their rooms, and my youngest likes to hang out underneath one of them, like a cave. We got him an air mattress, but it got to where it wouldn't hold air. We thought this might be a better option for him, and it is. It's not so wide that the stability posts underneath the bed interfere with it sliding in and out. It's soft and comfortable for him to lay on. It's much warmer, too. The covers that come with it are a super soft material. There are two of them, which makes it easy to swap them out for washings. It's not a super thick mattress, but it works great for him, and he's been happy with it. It's sure better than laying on the cold, hard floor.

title: Great bag, but super basic plates and all
text: I love this bag. It's perfect for picnics or simply packing snacks on the go to keep from eating out. There's plenty of room for food basics and drinks. The plates, cups, and utensils are super cheap looking, though. They don't seem durable at all. While I appreciate having them, along with storage space on the bag for them, I don't see any of it lasting long. The pieces can easily be replaced as needed with something better, though. Aside from that, we've been pleased with it.

title: I like it.
text: This water bottle has worked well for me so far. It's kept ice for most of a day and overnight. There was still ice the next morning. It seems pretty durable. While there's not a true handle, the part that keeps the lid attached to the bottle doubles as one, so it can be carried around that way. A little removable filter comes with it, so you can add fruit or herbs if you wanted. I haven't had any issues with leaking. I've turned it this way and that testing it out, but haven't had any leak out. It doesn't fit in my vehicle's cup holder, which is a negative, but one I can deal with. I've been happy with it, overall.

title: Not bad, but not my favorite
text: This bike isn't bad, but it's not my favorite either. The assembly isn't awful, but I did have a bit of confusion with the instructions. Certain parts, especially the seat, was difficult for me to get adjusted just right. My husband didn't have as much trouble, though. It's not as comfortable as I thought it would be, but it could be worse. Other than those things, it's a nice bike, and seems quite durable.

title: Nice kit.
text: With three sons, we have a few of these types of kits. The quality has been similar in all of them. Some pieces are better than others, but it's still a handy kit to have around. There are some pieces we aren't positive what purpose they serve, but most would be quite useful. I'm sure the others would be, too, if we knew what they did. It's a nice enough kit, though, that it'd be a great gift, especially for those outdoorsy men that you just don't know what to give.

title: Works great, and handy, too
text: My son has always been a dinosaur fan, so he likes this bottle. It's a great way for him to keep some water nearby at night. It's great for outings, too. Plus, the nightlight part is handy. It's worked well for him, and he's been happy with it.

title: Pleasantly Surprised
text: I was pleasantly surprised at how nice this stepper is. It was pretty easy to put together, and it's super easy to use. It's on the smaller side, so it doesn't take up a ton of room. It's easy to move around, too. It gives a great, but simple workout. There's nothing complicated about it, but it really works out the muscles. I've been super pleased with it.

title: Sturdy
text: This batting tee is much nicer than others we've tried. It's much sturdier, and the base is heavy. The height is adjustable, and it has a rubber ball holder that holds up well. It's an excellent batting tee.

title: Bulky and not as warm as I thought they'd be
text:
3.5 stars

These are super bulky. I got them for my husband, but I've used them some too. I should have gone down a size, but I still don't think that would help with how bulky they are. I got them for when we're taking care of our animals when it's super cold out. They're so bulky it's hard to do the work. I have to take them off at times for certain jobs, but they do help keep my hands warmer. They're not as warm as I would have thought, though. While they are a great help, especially on windy cold days, it's simply a mild warmth, not like a heating blanket. To charge them up, you also have to take the battery completely out of the glove. The process is a bit of a pain, and I wish there were a simpler way to charge them back up. Overall, if you're wanting these for while doing a job of sorts, like watering animals, I'm guessing there are better options. If you're simply wearing them while out in the cold not doing too much, they'll probably work better.

title: Comfortable
text: My husband has liked this hoodie. It's been comfortable for him and gives him some warmth on cold days. He feels it's true to size, and it's washed well so far. It seems like a nice quality hoodie, and he's been happy with it.

title: Plastic cover cracks super easily
text: My children like this hoverboard, and it's worked well for them. (They've only used it rolling through our house so far, because they don't want dirt getting in the wheels.) They like the bright colors, and it's been comfortable for them to ride. (Just be careful starting out. A couple of my children are naturals on it, but one doesn't have great balance, and he needs more help. He fell once and falling off of this thing is a pretty hard fall.) The only complaint they've had is that the plastic cover is super easy to break. It looks nice when it first comes out of the package, but after the cover starts cracking and breaking, it doesn't look so nice.

title: My son loves it
text: My 8-year-old likes to lay under his bunk bed. He'd been simply dragging a blanket under there and laying on the floor (which is hardwood). It didn't seem comfortable, so we got this for him to put under there. It fits perfectly between the extra poles, and he's been quite happy with it. He agrees it's much more comfortable than before. It was easy to air up, and we've been pleased with the quality.

title: Nice.....
text: This is a super nice folding chair. Sometimes, I simply use it for an outdoor reading chair. It's easy to fold up and move around, though it is a bit heavier than the typical camping chair. It looks much nicer than any camping chairs we've had in the past, too. The armrests don't have a place for drinks, but with the design of it, they probably wouldn't have been the best for the ease of folding it has. It seems like it's incredibly durable. It's worked great for me so far and for a chair like this, it's comfortable, too.

title: Easy....
text: This is a nice tent. It really does pop up into place with barely any effort. Getting it folded back isn't hard once I got the hang of it, but it took a bit of effort before that. There are directions attached to the storage bag. We haven't used it for a true camping trip, but my children and I have used it in our yard a good bit. It's an easy way to create a little quiet room for reading. As a bonus, it keeps the bugs away, mostly. We've enjoyed it and been pleased with the quality.

title: Works well and seems durable....
text: This is a nice bar. It's helpful for mixing up a workout a bit. It's easy to use and has worked well for me. It's comfortable to hold and seems pretty durable, too.

title: Ready to go...
text: My husband likes this pole for him and my children. It's all set and ready to go. It has the fishing line spooled on and everything. It cast and reels smoothly, and it's easy to adjust drag. He's been pleased with it.

title: The XL is still small....
text: I've been wanting a folding stool that I could easily carry with me for nature outings. If I want to draw/write/read, I'd have a place to sit. As much as I love nature, I don't want to sit on the ground with the little creatures that will bite me. We have some smaller stools that my children use for marshmallow roasting, but they're too small for me. Since this one is considered XL, I thought it might be a better fit for me. It's not. It's still small. While it's slightly bigger than my children's other ones, it's not by much. My children have even complained about how uncomfortable this one is. I had decided to have it around for a reading chair(so my children could bring it wherever I'm doing chores or sitting and read to me), but two of them have already fallen out of it(it slipped beneath them). The first time was when one of my children was laughing at a book and I joked with him that he was laughing so hard, he fell out of his chair. One of my other children fell, too, though, after that. I think it won't be a big deal if it's on the ground or carpet, but on a flatter surface, like hardwood floor, it slips out from under a smaller person(at least), easily. Overall, with this one being considered an XL stool, we've been disappointed with it, but it does still provide a lightweight sitting option for when needed.

title: Works well.....
text: My husband has liked this reel. He just had to attach it to a rod and it was ready to go. It already has fishing line spooled on. It casts and reels smoothly  and it's easy to adjust the drag. It's worked well for him and he's been pleased with it.

title: My husband is pleased with it....
text: My husband used to fish a great deal, but I guess his vegetarian wife has put damper on that adventure for awhile(since I won't go with him). Our children are getting old enough to want to fish now, so he's had more motivation to fish again. This reel did well right out of the box and worked smoothly. It only backlashed on him the first cast, but since it'd been years since he'd used one, it was more of a practice round and not the reel's fault. He's been happy with it.

title: Fun....
text: My children have had fun with this scooter. When asked to tell me about it, my 9 year old said that it turns well, the handles are comfortable(though not when the covers come off), but he has to go really fast to get the lights to work. Then he added, "...and well it scoots". It looks like a nice scooter and seems pretty durable. The height is adjustable, so it'll work for a variety of heights, too.

title: Work well...
text: These are nice bands. They go up in resistance, so there's a variety for different needs/wants. They're different colors, but the bands also have the strength(with both words and dots) on them. While I already have resistance bands, these loop ones help add more exercise possibilities for me. They seem well made and I haven't had any issues with them so far.

title: Works great....
text: This cooler works well and my husband has been pleased with it. It seems well made. It has carrying strap handles on the sides, as opposed to a big one that goes across the top. It has a drain plug, too. It's kept items within cold for us and it's great for trips.

title: Handle comes out easily, but works well...
text: My husband likes this little cooler. It won't hold a ton, but it's nice for small trips. It's small enough that it's handy to keep in a vehicle, just in case a need arises, too. It seems well made and has a drain hole. Rubber straps keep the lid closed. It has a metal handle, but it comes out easily. This is my husband's only complaint about it. It has a seal on the inside, though, and keeps items cold within. It's worked well, other than the handle coming out.

title: Great sunglasses...
text: My husband likes these glasses. They're comfortable on him and they seem well made. They're also lightweight. The lenses are wide and instead of darkening things like sunglasses tend to do, the bronze in these brightens things. They protect his eyes well. They come with a cleaning cloth and a case. They're extremely well packaged to keep them safe during delivery, too. He's been pleased with them.

title: Looks odd, but my husband likes it...
text: My husband has been wearing this mask and he likes it. It's been comfortable for him and it has a velcro strap on the back to adjust it. He thinks it looks decent, but I think it looks a little like he's in a science fiction movie. I've had to get used to it. It comes with extra filters, which are replaceable. It has vents on the sides. He was hoping this feature would help with fogging on his glasses, but it doesn't. He still has to position his glasses just right to avoid so much fogging. The vents also have to be "locked" in place or they'll fall out. He's been mostly pleased with it, though.

title: Works great...
text: I like this strap. It's a huge help with stretching. A few months ago, I checked out a yoga kit from the library. It had a yoga strap in it and sadly, I didn't realize how much better a non-stretchy strap could be with stretching. Before using it, I'd only used my stretchy ones. While the one from the library was just a basic type of strap, this one has loops for your hand to grip better through the whole strap. There's also padding on the main grips. It comes within a mesh drawstring bag and also has a little booklet with some stretching ideas. I've been pleased with it so far. It seems like a durable, well made strap.

title: Lanyard comes apart easily, but the whistles work well....
text: I got these for my children, so that when they're out exploring, they can have something to make enough noise for us to hear if they come across a dangerous creature, get hurt, or get lost. To test them out, I had them go as far as they go on an average day to blow it. I could still hear the whistle noise. So far we've been pleased with the whistle part of it. As far as the lanyard goes, I'd recommend replacing it right from the start(or at least tightening the metal part on it). They come apart super easily. We tried out a few different sets, but they all look the same, except for the colors. One of the sets we got has different colors in it, which I like. It lets my children each get their own color, so it's not as easy to get them mixed up. Plus, the brighter colors make them easier to see.

title: It's worked well for us......
text: My children use exercise balls to use up a bit of energy at times. They'll sit on them sometimes when I read to them. Before this one arrived, we only had one. With 3 children all wanting it, I figured having another would be a better solution. This one is much bigger than the other one we have(so it does take up more room). It also just seems a better quality. It's worked well and has held up to my 3 guys so far. I've appreciated having it around.

title: It's holding our bikes up.....
text: This isn't the highest quality bike stand, but it's decent enough for some organization help. I found it to be a pain to put together, at least when putting the curved bars that hold the tires on. The bottom part has several pieces, but these just pop together. Other than pincing my fingers a bit, this is easy enough. After that the tire bars have to be fitted properly into the holes and then screwed on with an allen wrench. A bit of moving back and forth/up and down is required, both for the bottom part and the tire holder bars, to get the screw into the proper place. The final pieces are easy to put on as long as you start them at the top of the bars and let them fall into place. Trying to put them on mid-way down the bar wasn't easy. I think it all would have been a bit easier with a helper, but I did it by myself. I don't expect it to last forever, but it's holding our bikes up for now, so I appreciate it for that.

title: Great knife...
text: My husband likes this knife. It's the one he's been carrying around lately. The only negative he's found for it is that the belt clip isn't reversible. He likes the size and style of the blade, though. It's sharp and has worked well for him. The handle has a good feel to it and it has grooves to make it more comfortable to hold and gives a better grip. It's been a great knife for him to carry and he's been pleased with it.

title: Lovely hat...
text: This is a lovely hat. The material is rough to touch, but it's comfortable enough to wear. There's a band on the inside to keep the rest of the hat from rubbing on you. There's also a string that can be pulled to make the hat tighter if you have a small head. The brim is wide, which I love. There's a metal band along the outside of the brim, so you can bend it into the shape you need/want. This feature is extra handy for pictures and the hat is beautiful enough for photos. It has a charming quality to it.

title: Soft, Comfortable, and I Love It....
text: I got to try two different shirts from this brand and I truly love them both. They have become my favorite shirts to wear. I like a loose fit, but not so loose that I look sloppy. I normally go for a size large, but since I'd read these have a slim fit design, I went with a size XL. I tend to do this with slim fit shirts. It usually makes the shoulders a tad big, and that's no exception with this one. It's not bad, though, and each washing does help it fall better into place. I do love the fit of it, though. The material is super soft. It's neither thick, nor thin, but for me that perfect in between. It's held up well with washings so far and I haven't noticed any shrinking. The design on the front is fun. They've been super comfortable to wear and I'm thrilled with the V-neck of it. It's not too low that I have to wear something under it for modesty. I've been super pleased with them both.

title: My husband likes it...
text: My husband always keeps a knife with him and he's been using this one since it arrived. He likes it. He feels the blade of it looks big and aggressive compared to most other pocket knives he has. He's also found it to be sharp. It comes within a cardboard case, which is actually pretty neat. It has some shapes that can be cut out to makes designs. This allows you to test it right out of the case. He also likes that it has a reversible clip(moves side to side). His only semi-complaint is the look of the handle. He thinks it looks on the cheap side. It's made out of a material that makes it more durable, though, so as far as function goes, it's great. He's found it comfortable to hold and it's easy to open and close. It's a nice knife and it's handy to keep close by.

title: Too long for me...
text: This isn't my favorite jump rope for various reasons, but mainly because it's too long for me to use well. Each of the handles have a little piece which will tighten/loosen. This allows the cord to come through to adjust it to the length you need. I have to pull so much through the handle part that the leftover cord slaps at me if I don't hold it(which isn't the most comfortable).  The cord itself is thin and lightweight. I prefer something a tad heavier. The handles are comfortable to hold, though, so if you're on the taller side and want a jump rope that's incredibly lightweight, this might be a perfect fit.

title: Long, but narrower than other sleeping bags we've used....
text: This is a nice sleeping bag. It's incredibly lightweight, so it's not something most people would want to use outdoors on a super cold night. For lighter warmth needs, it works, though. It's long, but a bit on the narrow side compared to other sleeping bags we've used. I do have a little wiggle room within it, but if you sleep with your arms in it and tend to need extra room, that might be a negative for this bag. As far as length goes, when I stand up in it and raise my arms straight over my head, there's still a little of the bag left over. (I'm 5'5".) It has a plastic guard, so that when zipping open/closed it keeps the fabric from getting caught up in it, which is appreciated. An air pillow is included with the bag and it's pretty cool. There's a pump built straight into the pillow. You can press it to air the pillow up. This way does take a little longer than using your breath(which is also an option), but it can allow you to get it tighter. You can add as much or as little air for your preferences, though. For lighter needs, we like this bag. We just wish it was a tiny bit wider.

title: High quality glove...
text: This is a nice looking glove. With the gold trim and embroidery and simply the detail work, it looks much fancier than the average glove. It has padding on the inside for comfort and it is comfortable to wear. It needs to be broken in, but it's not too stiff. It's recommended for ages 8 to 14, but it was way too big for my 8 year old to wear(and he's on the taller side for his age). He was unable to use it properly when trying it. Even as an adult, it fits me perfectly. My husband can wear it, though it is tighter on him. It is quite an investment, so if getting for a child, the size might be something to consider. It might not be the best pick for smaller and/or younger hands. If it fits, it's a great glove, though.

title: Works well for my 8 year old...
text: My 8 year old likes throwing a ball around and playing catch with his daddy. He doesn't play any type of organized sports, so it's all purely casual play. We thought this would be a nice glove for him and it is. He likes it and has found it comfortable. It fits his hand well and it has padding added for more comfort. It's lightweight, too. It does need to be broken in, so it's a little stiff when it first arrives. It seems well made and looks nice. We've been pleased with it so far.

title: My son likes it...
text: This is a nice looking bat. It's stamped with USA Baseball for those that need that. My guys, mainly my 8 year old, only play casually, so we don't do any type of organized sports. I don't know how well it works for team type play, but it's great for us. My son has liked using it. It's comfortable for him to hold and it works like a bat should.

title: My 8 year old likes it...
text: This is a nice looking bat. It's stamped with USA Baseball for those that need that. My guys, mainly my 8 year old, only play casually, so we don't do any type of organized sports. I don't know how well it works for team type play, but it's great for us. My son has liked using it. It's comfortable for him to hold and it works like a bat should.

title: Great for kids...
text: My 8 year old likes hitting a ball around(nothing organized, just play), so we thought these would be good for him. They're softer than regular balls, so he's less likely to hurt himself. These are nice and they seem well-made. They're not real leather, so if genuine leather is important to you, these aren't the way to go. The seams aren't too raised on them, so they're comfortable to hold when practicing throwing. Each ball is individually wrapped in plastic, but it's easy to get off. We've been happy with them.

title: Nice...
text: These are nice balls and they seem well-made. They're not real leather, so if genuine leather is important to you, these aren't the way to go. The seams aren't too raised on these, so they're comfortable to hold. Each ball is individually wrapped in plastic. We've been happy with them.

title: No assembly, works well...
text: This is a nice scooter and my 6 year old has enjoyed it. It seems well made and durable. He especially likes that the wheels light up when he rides it. I like that there was no assembly and no batteries are needed. All we had to do was press a button and twist the handle to get it in position. It clicks into place and then it's ready to ride, with no waiting. The handle can easily be folded back down, if needed. The handle is also adjustable on the height, going from 25" to 32" inches(from the ground). When riding, the child isn't supposed to steer, which can damage it. They simply lean to the left or right. It's comfortable to hold onto, with a soft rubber feel to it. It's rolled well so far and we've been pleased with it.

title: Soothing color options....
text: I've tried two yoga mats recently for me and my children. One is this Gaiam and one is a FILA. They are incredibly similar to each other, as far as looks and performance goes. I like that this one is non-toxic, so it definitely gets credit for that. They both say they're 5mm. The FILA looks obviously thicker, but they do feel about the same. As far as looks go, I like them both, though I do like the color options of this one, as does my youngest child. They're more soothing. They both have a simple design that's more appealing than an older one I had. My older one had velcro straps to close it, too, and I'm not fond of the feel of velcro. I find this one more relaxing, since it simply rolls up, with no straps. I don't slip on it and it does give me some cushion. That said, I need a bit more cushion(from both of them). I'm getting older and it just hurts to do some exercises on it. It does work well otherwise, and seems like a great quality.

title: Lovely Set....
text: This is a lovely set. The colors are beautiful and it all seems well made. I know the beauty of an item doesn't overly make a difference with performance, but it does bring more joy, at least for me. While this isn't a complaint, because I know it helped protect the handle grips on the way to me, but the plastic that was wrapped around them was a pain to get off. If I was able to pull at just the right spot, it'd come off easier,  but it was hard getting that right spot. I didn't want to cut it off for fear of damaging them. If you're like me, you'll probably want to make sure that's done before wanting to play, because it'll take awhile. Plus, there is a bit of assembly required(though it's just screwing the handle into the mallet head, which was easy to do) and some setting up for playing. They've worked wonderfully and my children have had fun with them. It comes with everything you need to play and even a zippered bag to keep it all in when not playing. It's a great set to keep around for some outdoor family fun.

title: Nice Socks....
text: My husband likes these socks. They don't have the "L" and "R" on the socks to make them left and right specific, but they do have the logo on opposite sides of the leg part. This feature makes it to where they can be assigned to a specific foot. (My husband had an accident as a younger person, which broke his leg badly. It left one foot slightly bigger than the other. For that reason, he highly prefers left and right specific socks.) The arch support is super mild. It's a bit tighter in that area, but not as much as my husband prefers. (I'm the opposite. I prefer my arch support on the milder side, like these.) He's found them to be soft and comfortable, though, and overall, he's been pleased with them.

title: Not my favorite....
text: These aren't my favorite bands. The elasticity of them seems off and I fear that they're going to break and end up hurting me(or anyone else using them). That said, so far they haven't and while I've used bands that I feel give me a better workout, these do work. The set comes with one pair of handles and 5 bands of varying weight. The bands are removable to swap them up. Ankle straps and a door anchor are also included, which I do greatly appreciate. (Those aren't always included in sets.) Based on my use of them so far, they're an okay set. They don't seem as durable as I'd prefer, though.

title: Nice quality...
text: This is a nice hoodie and my husband likes it. It looks like a higher quality than the average hoodie. Despite being 50% polyester, it doesn't have the shiny look that polyester can have. It's on the thick side, with the inside being super soft. The design on the front is appliqued on, which tends to last longer than the screen printed types of logos. The inside of the hood is the same camo fabric that is on the logo design and gives it a bit of character. It's a warm, cozy hoodie.

title: Hard for my hands to get it completely closed, but nice quality umbrella....
text: This is a nice umbrella. It's a much nicer quality than the cheap ones I usually grab. Those never last long and they tend to get blown around with the wind. I've even cut my fingers on sharp edges within the metal frame of some(and learned to be careful with others). This one is great, though, and we've been super pleased with it. It opens easily and quickly with the press of a button. That same button will also fold the top closed, but it still has to be manually pulled down to click it closed. This is my only semi-complaint about it. It hard for me to click it completely closed. I do have weak hands, but I have to push it against something for it to click. This won't be an issue for most, but if you have weak hands, like mine, and don't want to push it against something to close it, this might not be the best option. The handle is soft, with a leather-like feel to it, and it's comfortable to hold and use, otherwise. My husband and children have also used it and like it, too.

title: My husband likes it....
text: My husband likes this hoodie. It is polyester, so it has a shiny look to it. This isn't my favorite material, by far, but it does tend to fade much less than other materials. I just seem to always get snags in this type of clothing and I don't care for the look of it. He hasn't had any issues with it, though. The inside is super soft and cozy. There are thumb holes in the sleeves. This is a nice feature for when hands need a little extra warmth, while still keeping fingers free. It can be worn in the regular way, too. (It just leaves a little half circle hole showing on the cuff.) It's not super thick, but it's also not thin. It's perfect for cool days.

title: Comfortable...
text: My husband likes this shirt. He's found it true to size and likes the fit, but based on my experience with the women's shirts in this same line, they shrink a great deal after washing. He lost a great deal of weight(quickly) before trying it on again, so he didn't notice this like I did with mine. They're basic shirts, but soft and comfortable. The logo is screen printed. In the past, we don't have the best luck with this type of print. It cracks and peels quickly with washings. So far, ours have been fine, though, and we've had no issues. They're a nice and comfortable way to show some team pride.

They're a nice and comfortable way to show some team pride.

title: Pretty Basic, but Soft and Cozy....
text: This hoodie looks so soft and cozy I want to steal it from my husband, though I don't think he'd let that happen. While it is on the basic side, the inside is incredibly soft and comfortable. It's on the thick side, so it's perfect for cool days, especially for those that the mood calls for super comfortable clothing. My husband has found it to be true to size and he likes it. It'll work perfectly fine for women, too.

title: Polyester...shiny type of material
text: This shirt is 100% polyester. It has a shiny look to it and it is the type of material that snags easily. Between my cats and chickens, they'd have it looking quite rough within minutes. It's not my favorite type of material. That said, my husband has been wearing this shirt and he really likes it. He's found it comfortable to wear and it does feel incredibly soft. It also looks good on him. The logo on the front is screen printed. In the past, these types of prints don't last too long in the wash, with cracking and peeling. This one has done well so far, though. Overall, it's a nice shirt, as long as you don't mind the polyester.

title: Has a kickstand...
text:
My children have greatly enjoyed riding this bike. It seems to be their favorite. My 8 year old has complimented it especially for having a kickstand. He loves this feature. We've went through quite a few bikes as they outgrow them, but this is the first one that's had a kickstand so far. That said, my 8 year old is a little too big for it, I think. (It's targeted to 5-7 year old children.) Though he can ride it well, in general, his feet hits a part on the top of the back wheel when riding. One particular time caused him to have an accident, and in the process knocked one of the pedals off. I'd recommend sticking with the target age in the description when deciding on what size to get. My other two have did great with it, though.

Assembly is required, so that's important to keep in mind when buying a bike online. It's easier for many not having to haul it home from a store, but when bought in stores, you don't have to worry about assembly. I wouldn't be comfortable assembling the bike, but my husband has put together several and he had no problem with it. It comes with training wheels, but my children don't need them, so they don't have to be used.

title: Not my favorite material, but it's nice...
text: This shirt is made with 100% polyester. It has a shiny look to it. While this isn't my favorite material, it's pretty soft and comfortable. My husband has some men's shirts from this same line/material and he's more fond of his than I am of mine. The fit is a little big(or maybe right on target, since I went up in size). I normally go for a large to get a loose fit, but with sports shirts, sometimes they run super small. I went with an XL in this shirt, but it's too big for my tastes, especially in the neck and shoulders. It seems nice and well made if you're looking for a polyester shirt, though.

text: This shirt is made with 100% polyester. It has a shiny look to it. While this isn't my favorite material, it's pretty soft and comfortable.
