title: Please don't waste your money (or time!)
text:
I purchased this in a store (before there were any reviews)on January 20th. I wore it for 10 days. It has now been returned to said store. I had considered three similar products to purchase, but I ended up getting this one because of The Biggest Loser's endorsement. Never again. Here are my complaints/issues:

1. The website is SLOW (as Christmas). And your complaints are met with "we're working on it", or "give it time".
2. To get true accuracy in the unit, you have to purchase a chest strap (for another $60+), then to GET the info from the chest strap, you have to purchase the Advanced membership (for another $80, I believe). So that's around $280... I think I'd rather have something like a body bugg for that price!
3. Once I activated everything, I got on the message boards. MOST were complaining about how they felt they had "purchased an overpriced pedometer". I agree. Unfortunately you can't see any of that until after you've laid down your $140 for the unit(including taxes for me).
4. They told me "It takes a week for it to track your activity level to give you accurate goals." BULL! It gave me a goal of "30 heart activity minutes" the first week. Fine. But my actual totals were 40+ per day (meaning I worked out for 40 minutes per day). But guess what? On day 8 (the beginning of week 2), AFTER it had supposedly figured out my activity level so it would give me more of a challenge, it STILL had my goal set at 30 minutes/day. Wow! What a motivator!!! (*she says dripping with sarcasm*)
5. I was also told that it doesn't even use the calorie log for the calculation - so how much do I need to burn?!?
6. I met my goals (ie: "I went green") by 9am EVERY day I wore the Slimcoach. So, theoretically, I could have laid on the couch for the rest of the day - I had met my goals!
7. The ONLY thing I'll miss is a couple of people I met on the message boards.

I had such high hopes for the Slimcoach. I wanted a motivator to make the think about doing more doing the day. Funny enough, the only motivation I received from it is to write this review....

UPDATE / FYI (2-12-12): When I returned the Slimcoach, I purchased the Fitbit. I have been wearing it for a couple of days now, and it already blows the Slimcoach away! Look at its reviews. I haven't written a review on it yet (need more time/experience with it), but it already has over 400 reviews that are very favorable (4 1/2 stars overall). I use it with LoseIt! for my calorie logging on my iTouch, and it all integrates seamlessly and gives me tons of feedback.... for free (no "annual membership" fee!!!!).

FINAL UPDATE (2-25-12): I've been using the Fitbit for a few weeks now, and I LOVE it! My recommendation: Sign up on the Fitbit website - you can do this before you ever purchase it. That will allow you to look at what it tracks, and you'll be blown away - it's FREE! (You can get an advanced membership, but I find that what it already tracks for free is the info I want anyway.... Yay!) The Slimcoach was such a disappointment that I came close to not getting anything else, but I'm so glad I did.

BTW: I also contacted NBC & Biggest Loser to voice my complaints & disappointment for endorsing this product that doesn't deliver what it promises to. I've never heard back from them.... thankfully, I'm not holding my breath, because I have a sneaky feeling they've gotten a ton of the same type letters recently.....

title: Reliable and quick inflating sup pump!
text:
After trying a dozen other pumps of various brands I kept coming back to this one. I have tried it on 5 different brands of SUP boards and each time it has been consistent. Filling up each board to 15 psi within 9 to 9.5 minutes. I have pumped up 3 SUPs in a row without any issues. It doesn't heat up the pump or hose nearly as much as others I have tried. Took this pump out on labor day to the beach. But instead of using my vehicle to pump this up I bought the Jackery Portable Power Station Explorer 300 (Which is smaller than a toaster). Walked everything down to the beach and pumped up all SUPs right next to the water. It was great not having to worry about moving boards from your vehicle down to the beach. Just be careful not to get sand or dirt in the connections so they get a tight seal.

One note I would like to mention. When I tried this pump with the 12v in my suv and the engine wasn't running the pump did preform at a slower rate about 11 minutes for 15 psi. I would recommend you have the engine running if you want the pump to perform at the better time around 9 minutes.

For comparison my boards are 10.5 feet and 33 inches wide. I also have an 11.5 foot also.

I also want to caution you, that there are other pumps that look exactly like this pump being sold on Amazon. Externally they may look the same but the motor/pump inside is not the same thing and does not pump them up nearly so quickly, they also heat up a lot more.

I paired this with the Teton Foam Pad and Teton 0 temp sleeping bag. Not once was I cold or uncomfortable on this cot. Without a bar in the middle you are free from anything poking you or causing discomfort. I have had 500 pounds on this without any trouble. Teton does recommend you don't put a ton of weight on the sides. I kept this is mind and was careful getting out or in just incase. But honestly they are made so well I don't ever see this becoming a problem. I bought two of these Cots one was ok but the other came and had rust inside of the legs. I contacted Teton and sent them some pictures they were prompt and so nice in helping with the issue. They got me a new Cot and I couldn't be more happy with the purchase. title: Durable Water Storage

title: Great Tent
text: I took this on a camping trip and can honestly stay I will never have a tent that you can't stand up in ever again. This tent is awesome, it was so nice to be able to stand up straight and handle two kids in this tent. I was able to fit two oversized twin cots in this tent with a few feet at the bottom and a walkway down the middle. This tent is like the Tardis, its not so huge you can't find a place for it, but once you walk inside you are amazed at how much room you get. Its fantastic that you can use every inch of this tent with the 6 foot plus height in the entire tent. It was up in a matter of minutes with two people. I never again have to mess with tent poles SOOO HAPPY! The stakes are really heavy duty with this tent. I really need to buy a few more to use for the canopy that goes over the tent. I didn't get the same brand for the canopy that you need over the top of the tent. I ended up buying ABC brand Canopy, straight legged 10x10. And it works great for it. The tent has two straps in the top middle one for canopies with no low cross bars in the middle and one for low cross bars. Word of warning, do not attach the small black clips to the top of the canopy before using the Velcro straps around the canopy legs. If its windy it could break one of the black plastic clips. I wish the zipper was a little easier for opening and closing, but its heavy duty and serves its purpose. I will say the little welcome mat was a nice surprise. For cold nights its really kept the damp cold air out. Tent was at least 10-15 degrees warmer inside then outside at night. Yes its a little heavier than other tents, but for adults with Kids this is a must! You can also buy accessories with this tent, I bought a collapsible corner shelf. And there is a hook in the middle of the tent for a light etc. Works really well, very well thought out with the oversized doors and windows.

title: This was going to be my wife's rod until I put it together and tried it out!
text:
Much better than I had expected!
I opened the box, then the long square tube, then the tube ! This rod was definitely packed well!
The rod sock is a bit lacking and the ties just don't do it justice. Upon pulling the rod pieces out and putting them together I can see this is a beautifully crafted rod with no flaws and the feeling of new cork (of course I take the plastic off, who are you saving it for?) against the skin of my hand is luxurious!
I take it outside because I am in a low ceiling room. The action is spot on fast just as I had ordered and just like I like it!
I put the reel on it (of course I had one ready) and take it out back to the trout stream that runs through my backyard, one of the advantages of living in the Smoky Mountains! After I get the line out and make a few false cast I lay my fly right where I want it. This rod cast pretty damned good, I got a hit and miss but it was enough for me to evaluate this rod and write this review.
All in all I"d put this up against my Orvis and Redington rods. It's got most of the bells and whistles but is lacking in a few areas like dots to line the rods pieces up, A better rod sock and no rode tube.
The good part is the price! For less than $70.00 you've got a nice rod!

title: Stainless steel water bottle
text:
[[VIDEOID:a1cec7262796fc48d51746da7275d292]] I really like this water bottle. It has a spout and flexible straw, which helps to get every last drop. It stays cool overnight, for at least 12 hours. The handle is a unique shape that is comfortable to carry.

It also does have build up of condensation on the outside. It does fit in my car cup holders, sort of. It doesn't go all the way down in the cup holders, but it goes in far enough to stay stable.

There are several parts that were tricky to figure out. The lock mechanism is sort of difficult, I included a video so you can see how to use it. The handle is also difficult at first, you basically just have to pry it up with a finger nail.

Once you figure out the tricky aspects, this is a really great water bottle.

title: Large stainless steel water bottle
text:
This water bottle is great. It comes with three different tops to choose from, two straw, and a carrying case.

It keeps water cold for a really long time, I have yet to have the water get to room before I empty it. I like that the mouth of it is big enough to put ice cubes in.

My only complaint is that the straws are a little short. One of my pictures shows how much water was still in it, that the straw couldn't reach.

title: Decent shaker bottle
text:
This shaker bottle works really well. I like that it has a silicone ring in the lid to prevent leaks. I also like that it has measurements inside. Also, it made mixing super easy and there wasn't any powder left stuck to the bottom or the lid.

However, there are a few problems I have with this bottle. Firstly, the lid is pretty difficult to get on and off. If you have arthritis or carpal tunnel you probably won't be able to use this bottle.

Also, it is not double walled so it has a lot of condensation build up on the outside. Another thing is that their listing says that it had a sliding lock, but it doesn't.

This gloves do not have rechargeable batteries, you have to provide three AA batteries for each glove. Also, when the batteries are in the battery pack is a but heavy, and the compartment is in the top of wrist section, it is not a super comfortable spot to have a battery pack.

title: Very sturdy and definitely re-useable.  A worthwhile purchase.
text: I bought this to use as an emergency blanket for my car. It comes folded up in a thick, Ziplock style clear plastic bag which is also re-useable.  I took it out and unfolded it as soon as it arrived. I wouldn't call it a blanket. Essentially, it's an insulated medium weight tarp.  Would it work as a blanket to keep you warm, dry and protected from the wind, cold, rain, snow, etc.? Absolutely! It folds up very easily and is most definitely re-useable. In its folded form, it takes up about the same amount of space as a small collapsible umbrella and weighs about the same. This will fit very conveniently in the glove compartment or under the seat. I was trying to choose between this and a 100% wool blanket. The wool blanket would be much more comfortable and flexible, but it would also weigh more and take up a lot more space. Additionally, it would cost twice the price, and of course, they're not waterproof. Bearing all that in mind, this will suit my needs just fine. I can always pick up a thin fleece throw blanket for about $5.00 for supplemental warmth and creature comfort.

title: Perfect Beach/Outdoor Towel

It’s nice and large for sitting on and drying yourself off. It is super lightweight for carrying in any size bag or luggage when traveling. I love the colors, and it is two sided- one side is a multi colorful print, the other a plain white and gray geometrical design.

The towel has a nice finished pink edge and is made of a microfiber which absorbs water, yet dries quickly. title: Inexpensive Solution for Storing Balls, Pool & Sandbox Toys, Lightweight Hoses
text:
If you are looking for an inexpensive solution for storing any size balls, pool toys, sandbox toys and even those light weight self winding hoses, this bag will work. It is made of a hard plastic open weave mesh. We've seen these mesh bags used in smaller sizes for things like plastic soldiers and other plastic toys. It's sturdy enough as long as you use it for light weight and not sharp items.

We have three of these and they are great on a hook in the garage for keeping things off the floor and organized. We use one for our variety of basketballs, soccer balls and baseballs. What is great, is when these balls get dirty, we do a quick hose off and just throw them in the mesh bag. They air dry perfect when hanging.

We also keep our self winding hoses in the bag- again the light weight hoses dry perfect hanging in the bag. And last we found this bag perfect for pool and sandbox toys. A quick hose off and they air dry in the bag. With three bags, we have eliminated ball, hose and toy clutter and it's so convenient to just hose and bag these items to air dry. As long as the items are light weight and not sharp, I can see the bag lasting even with it's inexpensive construction.

title: Great Grip, Good Control, Smooth Bounce, Nice Weight
text:
This Spalding Zi/O Excel Tournament Basketball- Official Size 7 (29.5) is everything you want for home or neighborhood court basketball games. I come from a home of sports loving guys- 3 brothers, my Dad, my husband, my son and myself all being tall, have a natural love of basketball. Over the years, we have owned all different brands of basketballs, but we always come back to the better quality of Spalding.

This particular Spalding ball has some great features. The ball is made of a composite leather (another word for a pretty good quality rubber type plastic), but with it's pebbled texture, it feels great and gives your hand a great grip. The channels are a bit deeper than other balls, giving you great control when bouncing it. There is a light foam lining that you will notice when it bounces, as it gives the ball a tiny bit of weight so the bounces are not out of control high, but smooth and in control.

Last, the weight and size of this ball are official NBA sized. The ball performs great and the price is very reasonable. We have spent almost one and a half to two times more for MacGregor and Wilson basketballs over the years that didn't perform anything near this Spalding. Our ball came almost ready to play with. It was inflated, but we had to get out our pump and needle and add more air. For the price and the way the ball performs in your hands, it's a great 5 STAR basketball.

title: Greatly Improved Arm Band & Improved Pepper Gel Has Less Blow Back
text:
I have always kept pepper spray in both my car and home for safety reasons, and even in my purse. There are times when the only thing you have to protect yourself may be just pepper spray. Whether it's an animal or person meaning to do you harm, having pepper spray may be the only thing that gives you that precious moment to get away and stay safe. Living in a Cleveland suburb, I have had close calls and pepper spray is a must for even our postmen, as you never know if those unleashed dogs are red zone or not.

The first time I found I needed any type of protection was when I was taking flowers to our family's cemetery in Cleveland. There were actually people in hoodies stalking us- I was not alone- to the point where my husband took his golf club out of the car and held it like a baseball bat. Just having the pepper spray attached to my arm is a huge relief. I don't have to get it out of the glove compartment or my purse- which I never carry when I'm walking or doing things anyway. For walkers or bike riders, this convenient arm band is a must for protection. If only the 3 teenagers abducted by Ariel Castro in Cleveland had pepper spray, what a different outcome that could have been.

Sabre Red made a Pepper Gel Spray in an earlier model of this armband type, which had a wider and unbelievably uncomfortable armband, and it never stayed on your arm. They redesigned the armband on this new model- it stays on your arm, it's very narrow (1 1/2 inches wide) and it doesn't hurt like the wide one. Just know that it is made of velcro- so it won't feel like a soft piece of cotton (the underside is comfortable enough though), but being narrow, I like that there is less velcro on your arm. I like the buckle on the band, to keep the end from sticking out also. You can make it as tight as you like and I have no slipping or discomfort at all. At 20 inches long, this band will fit all arm sizes- even those larger biceps.

The canister of the red pepper gel spray has an ON/OFF position for your safety. The tight elastic sleeve has the velcro strip all the way down the side of the canister, so you can attach it to the arm band anywhere. There is also a strip of reflective tape on the side for additional safety from vehicles if you are walking or bike riding at night. My sister is a bike rider and she had to use this pepper gel on an attacking dog. She sprayed the dog in the eyes and it kept running along side her bike trying to grab her leg. She said she sprayed it again hitting it in the nose and mouth- that slowed it down and the dog finally turned around. So, I guess with a dog, that sense of smell just keeps on going until it gets sprayed in the nose.

As for the gel spray itself, it goes the full 12 feet when sprayed. You will get some fine mist coming back at you when the wind is against you, so protect your face. Make sure you test the spray first, so you know how far the spray will reach and to make certain you have a good canister. Sabre Gel has made great improvements on both the armband and gel spray on this Pepper Gel Duathlete Arm Band. The arm band is nice and narrow, comfortable and stays put. The Pepper Gel has just a little mist spray back, so you still need to protect your own face. It's a great 5 Star Improved Pepper Gel Spray and Armband, that hopefully you will not have to use, but if you need to use it, it can truly be a life saver.

title: Fun & Fitness For First Graders To Teens
text:
Even though we have a regulation basketball hoop in our driveway, here in Ohio with our mostly crummy rainy or snowy weather, we only seem to use it a few months out of the year. Just shooting hoops in the drive is a great way to burn off some calories, and our family always enjoys not just the skill of shooting, but also the competition. We've owned other small basketball hoops that are on a stand for inside or hang over a closet door to have fun with during our long winters and rainy falls and springs, but nothing as nice as this Atomic Deluxe Basketball Shootout.

This Atomic Deluxe Basketball Shootout arrived in just it's store box- no extra shipping box- but it arrived perfect. The box is heavy, so you will need a little help lifting it. Once opened, I immediately noticed how solid the tubular frame is and how sturdy the fabric with netting are. This Shootout is built to last, which is a good thing, as the kids and their friends really love playing with it. The four little basketballs are also very sturdy and this even comes with a pump to keep them inflated. Putting this together with the enclosed instructions and tools took a little over an hour. We took our time with the little infrared sensors, as they are the hardest part to figure out when assembling.

This is electronic, so you'll have to set it up near an outlet for the plug. It keeps score electronically and does make some beeping and click noises as it counts. Whoever makes the most baskets in the allotted time wins and it does count accurately. You can also just play without the electronics any way you like. What I love best about this Basketball Shootout is that the 6 year olds love it just as much as the teenagers. They really enjoy the furious shooting against each other with the 4 balls that keep rolling back to them. It's great to have it in the basement, game room or garage for those that have crummy weather like we have here in Ohio. I love the fact that all ages can enjoy this fun and furious basketball shooting no matter what the weather is like outside. Just for the fun and exercise alone, this sturdy Atomic Deluxe Basketball Shootout deserves 5 Stars.

title: Exercise, Fun & Laughter On Any Table
text:
This Stiga Retractable Table Tennis Net Set is a great way to enjoy a game of table tennis or what our family calls ping pong anywhere. It comes with a sturdy retractable table tennis net that expands to 6 feet, two paddles, a mesh storage bag and three ping pong balls. Everything is amazingly sturdy- wood paddles with nice rubber coverings, balls that don't dent and a well made net that expands and pulls out of 2 strong plastic cylinder posts. For easy set up, you clamp down one post on the table, pull the net across and clamp down the other end. The sturdy clamps don't move making the net completely stable.

Playing on any table makes this so much fun. We played on a low long rectangular table in front of the couch, our oval dinner table, a card table and a long folding table. The long folding table was the closest thing to a regular game of table tennis and everyone loved the exercise they got running a bit as this was played outdoors. The oval table was shorter and there was no running but laughing, as keeping it on the table took some skill. The most laughing we had, was playing table tennis on the low coffee table in front of the couch. We were on our knees and could only tap the ball lightly to keep it on the table. When we are on our knees, you can't run after a loose ball, so we sort of end up rolling around the floor to get the ball and end up looking like we are balls on the floor. We ended up laughing more than playing on this low coffee table.

This game is well made, you can set it up on any table 6 feet wide or less, you'll get some physical exercise, lots of fun and if you play it on an odd table- lots of laughs. We could never fit a table tennis table in our small house, so this is really great that we can enjoy the game without the large table. You can't beat the price for the enjoyment this set brings to family members and friends of all ages and for that it deserves 5 Stars.

title: DURABLE CART BAG HAS POCKETS FOR EVERYTHING
text:
This Pinemeadow Golf Realtree Cart Bag has pockets for everything you'll need on the golf course. The bag itself is very sturdy, made from authentic Real Tree camouflage fabric. There are 14 very well padded golf club compartments. The well padded shoulder strap is removable with large hooks, and which beneath this large strap are smaller elastic lift handles. There is also a very sturdy cupped lift handle on the opposite side, making for easy lifting.

The bag has a total of 13 pockets- two of which are mesh and the other 11 are zippered. Besides the 2 small net pockets, there are 2 very large zipper pockets for clothing or large items. There are also large, medium and small zippered pockets for various items like your balls or tees. There is a small lined pocket for your valuables as well as a Cooler pocket which is very well padded and vented for condensation.

Besides all these great pockets, there is a loop and tie to hold an umbrella, as well as a hook to hold a towel and even a rubber edged hole to hold a pen or pencil. To keep everything in your bag under cover, they've included a great cover you can snap onto the golf bag. Amazingly, even with so many compartments, pockets and being well-padded, this cart bag is surprisingly light weight. This 4 1/2 Star cart bag may be just a standard bag, but the pockets give it lot of great bells and whistles for keeping you organized on the course.

title: Young Wrestling Fans Love This Ring!
text:

This ring is a lot of fun for the kids- and you really only need to spend another ten bucks for a Super Striker figure that they'll love launching into the ring!

title: Perfect For A New Golfer
text:
For anyone just learning the game of golf, like me, this SKLZ Pure Path Swing Trainer With Instant Feedback is wonderful. We have clay soil here in Ohio and it went into the ground really solid with a bit of pushing, then stepping down on it. I used my Taylor Made Burner Driver and all my irons every day for a week hitting the plastic ball and this trainer's spikes only had to be stepped down just a little bit once. It really doesn't move at all when it's pushed down in solid clay soil.

Being a new golfer, I have been learning to just hit the ball, focusing on my grip and how to swing. My husband takes me to putting greens and driving ranges- but when you just want to learn to make contact with the ball- it is quite expensive paying for those buckets at the driving ranges. I love this Swing Trainer, as it costs me nothing. You can set it up as you like, with three different ball heights, and being able to connect with the ball with your club coming up right under it, is just like the driving range.

The best part is, I don't have to chase after any plastic balls in the yard, I don't have to pay for buckets of balls, and that leaves me just time for concentrating on making contact with the ball. Not only that, but when you hit the ball, you can watch the yellow rope spin straight, to the right or to the left. I can actually see in which direction I'm hitting it. I know once I get my swing better, make good contact with the ball, feel my grip getting comfortable, and see most of my shots going straight, I'll be back on the driving range. But until then, I can practice making ball contact and see if I'm shooting the ball straight- right in my own back yard and the cost is nothing, which is just perfect for me.

title: Great On Many Surfaces
text:
Coming from a golfing family of 3 brothers, I've seen just about every putting cup, hole and mat invented. This particular Putt Pocket by SKLZ, is not as forgiving as the typical putting cups, holes or mats. The opening you must putt into is only as wide as about 1 1/2 golf balls, making it harder on you to become that accurate.

The Putt Pocket is shaped like a horse shoe and is heavy, so your ball, no matter how hard it hits, will not move or knock over the pocket. It comes in 2 pieces that you can keep together on any surface, or separate and place the inner piece inside a standard size cup on a green.

We've used this on a golf practice putting green inside the cup and also on a variety of surfaces- carpet, tile, wood and even on the cement on our driveway. It is great to be able to practice anywhere with this pocket. The small opening has made this one of the most difficult putting pockets I've ever used, which, with a lot of practice will definitely make me a much more accurate putter in time.

title: BEST Golf Home Program Lessons For Golfers & Beginners
text:
TOURAcademy's Home Edition 8 Week Total Golf Improvement Program is absolutely the best home program available today for both golfers and beginners at golf. I should start by saying I came from a home where my father paid for lessons for my 3 younger brothers (who all won tournaments as children), but would never pay for me (a daughter). I always wanted to play the game, but never had the time or money over the years raising my own family to get into the game of golf. Now with my children grown, in recent years, my husband, who is a self taught golfer took me to driving ranges and putting greens, where I love to be outdoors learning the game, but without any lessons, failed to have the ability to hit a good shot. A pro who gives lessons came up to me at the driving range and told me, to hit a good shot, I need the basics. He gave me a couple tips and that made me want to learn more. Out of every 50 golf balls I hit, 45 felt like I was hitting a block of cement. My good shots that clicked went about 100 yards, so for a never played the game person, it encouraged me to learn the basics. I bought books and dvd's- but they don't go slow enough or detailed enough for me to learn anything.

This TOURAcademy Home Edition Program is so totally different from any of the programs and books on the market, that I am certain it will help anyone- from young to old, new to a long time golfer. The pro at the driving range told me I don't have the flexibility of a young golfer and that I would have to do what was within my ability, and that is what this TOURAcademy program says as well- get as flexible as you can for your best shots. The program comes with 9 Lesson dvd's covering: 1.) The Set Up-Grip,Posture,Alignment 2.) Rolling It-The Essentials Of Putting 3.) The Impact Zone-Educate The Hands 4.) Learning Small Swings-Chipping 5.) Developing Body Motion-The Pivot 6.) Mastering Intermediate Distances-Pitching 7.) Synchronizing Body & Club-The Full Swing 8.) Power & Distance-Driving With Authority 9.) Specialty Shots-Lob & Bunker.

The TOURAcademy is where the pros practice, and these PGA pros really know their stuff. The dvd's are narrated by 1991 British Open Champ Ian Baker-Finch, a superb golfer. The lessons are given by TOURAcademy's Instructors Travis Fulton, John Stahlschmidt and Christina Lecuyer. What makes this 9 Lesson dvd set so superb are the slow, meticulous detailed lessons. On Disc 1, the grip is shown in details how to begin your set up, by marking your glove and hand with a marker so the club will fit you perfectly. It's this very clear and concise instruction that allows me to learn at my own slow pace. They give you all the exercises to give you the flexibility and right movements to swing properly and remain aligned. It's all so detailed and wonderfully concise, making it easy to copy. I could always putt, but never drive a ball. No one ever told me that you have to hit down to make it hit up. I never wanted to hit near the ground before I got these lessons.

Also included are alignment sticks, which are invaluable in learning your proper stance, swing and where to stand to the ball. For Disc 3, there is a Contact Bag they included for your lesson, which you stuff with towels or an old blanket, so you can practice connecting your club to the right spot on the bag. At the end of each lesson on the dvd's, there are practice white tracks for beginners or blue tracks for golfers wanting to improve their game. And even more included items are a Practice Guide, a Bonus dvd called Troubleshooting- Diagnose Your Swing, Analyze Ball Flight & Extras, an 8 Week Program Calendar and an Instruction Manual.

Practicing with these dvd's brought back a lot of memories of my 3 younger brothers learning golf in the 60's. Instead of hitting this included Contact Bag, my brothers hit a car tire. At my age, I'd break my wrist hitting a tire, so the contact bag is perfect for me. My husband, who is a self taught golfer is actually thrilled with many of the tips for his game- correcting his slice is a huge thing at our age. As for me, I'm learning to hit the ball with a click instead of like a block of cement and that is one step closer for me to get on a golf course. This is the BEST Pro Golf Program I've yet to find with it's 9 detailed dvd's, Bonus dvd, alignment sticks, Contact Bag, Calendar and books. I know from my brothers playing golf all the time, that 8 weeks is just the beginning of learning the basics- the rest is practice all the time to be good. Like the pro's say: If you are not constantly improving your game, you become stagnant, and with this great program giving me all the basics of golf in 8 weeks, I can get ready to practice, practice, practice and finally play the game.

title: The Umbrella Flies Away If You Have Any Wind
text:
I couldn't wait to try this Sport-Brella Umbrella Chair just for the sun protection alone. I thought, what a great idea, sun coverage any where you go outdoors in an instant! The chair is just like any shoulder carry-type folding chair- easy to open, set up and close. It's comfortable on the seating and arms. It has an arm cup holder and front zip pocket for storage with a bottle opener on the zipper tab. The umbrella opens and closes with ease and you can place it on either side of the chair. You can also adjust the umbrella with a full 360 degree rotation.

It's all great except for one major flaw. The umbrella has this teensy tiny plastic tab that you push into either side of the chair that will hold this umbrella in place. The smallest gust of wind lifts the umbrella up and out of the umbrella holder breaking off this teensy tiny tab leaving you with an umbrella that no longer locks in place, and of course chasing an umbrella wherever the wind decides to take it. This was a perfect idea made so cheaply that it makes the best part- the umbrella- pretty much useless in any wind. The gust of wind that lifted this umbrella out of the holder was actually a light breeze, so I can't imagine what a real gust of strong wind would do to this umbrella. It's such a shame that the company SKLZ didn't put in a few cents more for a stronger metal tab which could have made this chair a real winner instead of a waste of a design which is what it really is. It is still a nice chair that does shade you, but only on a very still day when you have no movement of air, which makes the main part I like- the umbrella pretty useless to me.

title: Outdoor Fun For Everyone!
text:
Ladderball was originally invented by cowboys to perfect their throwing ability. The idea was taken from South American cowboys who use the bolo for roping. Outdoor challenges like throwing balls and pitching horseshoes are always fun activities, so ladderball fits right in with these.

Any activity that gets everyone up and moving rates 5 stars with me! There's nothing worse than being a couch potato when you could be outside and burning off body fat. This outdoor game is literally for all ages. The set up is simply putting together plastic poles and corners, which is finished in 10 minutes. When you take it down, you remove the ladders from the bases and store it flat- a 1 minute task.

The base is secured to the ground with 4 curved pins. I found that adding more pins works better. They sell these curved pins for about $2.00 in a longer size in garden centers for securing ground covers, and they really work well, added to the pins provided. You could even make your own pins with old hangers, which are easy to curve and cut with wire cutters. The top side poles are numbered and have 4 black rubber bands included for keeping score by moving the bands on the poles. The 6 bolos come in 2 colors- red and blue. They are golf ball size and just as hard, so just make sure little ones and pets know not to get in the way of the thrower. The game is easy to play, each of the three rungs on the ladder are worth different points and the first player to reach 21 points wins.

I've played ladderball with other friends and this is actually one of the better sets made. Wood ones seem sturdy, but crack after a few hard throws, and most of the bases are not wide enough to take the throwing power and fall over, even with weight on the bases. For $24.00, this is a great set- just add some $2.00 curved garden center pins for solid stability and you're ready to get off the couch and have some great family fun and outdoor exercise!

title: Beautiful Full Tang Knives
text:
This is truly a stunning set of knives, and the Kukri knife will be the largest in my collection thus far. Both knives arrived oiled with the blades sharp. Each knife also has a drilled hole near the handle end for a lanyard if desired. Both of these are full tang knives and share a heavy duty sheath each having its own fitted sleeve/sheath. I had a hard time at first getting them in and out of the sheaths because of how tight they were, but the sheaths do start to loosen up as you remove the knifes and insert them back into the sheaths. The larger knife weighs 1 lb, 11 oz. The smaller knife weighs 7.3 oz. Both knives with the sheath have a combined weight of 2 lb, 10 oz. The sheath fits over a belt, and the belt strap is quite wide and looks to me like it should fit over most belt widths. At first I thought the sheath for the smaller knife could be detached by perhaps a snap or velcro, but the smaller knife sheath is strongly attached to the large sheath.

The only issue I found was along the outer edge of the smaller knife handle where the blade runs through the handle. The metal wasn't fully smooth and had what felt like microscopic burrs along the edge. I was able to smooth this with a super fine nail file, but had to be very careful in doing so such that I would not sand any of the wood on the handle. This only took me about a minute to do, but had to be done.

Aside from the little issue mentioned above which I was able to easily fix, I really love this set. Both knifes and sheaths are super strong, heavy duty and well-constructed. Great addition to any knife collection!

title: Plenty of height adjustment
text: Each scope ring weighs 2.8 ounces. The good quality design keeps the rings and scope from moving once mounted. The design and manufacturing of this item is good quality and worthy of a 5 stars.

title: Sharp looking and functional
text:
What I like about this knife:
It's a sharp looking knife with a cool multi-functional design. The blade opens well and I can easily release the lock to close it. The blade is strong, sharp and durable. It clips to my jeans and stays there because the clip is tight so I can either use the sheath to carry it or just clip to jeans without the sheath. The little LED light is pretty bright.

What I don't like about this knife:
Although the LED light is bright, I'm not too crazy about how it functions. It's easy enough to understand turning the light tighter to turn it on and loosening to turn it off. But on the knife I received you really have to remove the light from it's magnetic hold area on the knife in order to turn the knife on and use it. It would have been nice to be able to screw the LED tighter while in the knife since that would make it much easier in an emergency, and there would be less risk of dropping or losing the little flashlight. Maybe the intention with this design was to be able to keep the light affixed while using it, but mine just doesn't work that way. So there is that.

Overall it's a great knife and I like it a lot! It's priced reasonably, functions well, looks sharp, and it would also make a nice gift.

title: Perfect for the range
text:
I love this bag for bringing my guns to the range. As far as the material the bag is made from, it feels a little strange, yet is typical of fireproof material as I have multiple fireproof document and storage bags and they all have this same weird feeling.

As far as the functionality of this bag, first I want to mention that I only have conceal carry size that use .380 (the largest being a Bersa Thunder) and pistols that use .22 ammo. This bag works perfect for me for these sizes. Each of them is already in a small case of its own or in a little conceal carry pack that fits on a belt, and I don't even have to take them out of their little cases to put into this range bag. I can just leave the guns in the small cases or holders they are already in and just put them all into this gun bag. There are 4 of them and they all fit fine. There is also plenty of room for a universal loader, lots of magazines and lots of ammo. There are additional mesh pocket for cleaning rags, etc. I even have room for a small cleaning kit. Can't beat it for gun bag for smaller pistols. The dividers do not come pre-attached. They all attach via velcro, and you can use them all or just a couple. I used them all when I set up my bag. The bag has a strong fabric carrying handle, and also comes with a longer strap if you want to carry over your shoulder. This bag fits my needs perfect for taking to the range. It's so convenient! I may even throw a couple sling-shots in there while I'm at it!

title: A simple eagle engraving would have been better.
text:
At first glance this was a nice looking slingshot that I was eager to get assembled and try out. Everything you need to assemble this item is included in one handy little case. Extra screws, Allen wrench, 2 extra rubber bands, and steel ammo. Because of how this is constructed, it took me a little longer to get the bands connected and secured, but once it was done it looked good and was ready. Or so I thought. As I started holding it more and aiming it, I felt something protruding from the handle and looking closely saw it was the eagle design and the bottom tail of the eagle was sticking out a little when it should have been level with the slingshot surface. I tried to fix this by hammering the slingshot protected with a towel, only to find the entire eagle design moves every time I tried to use the slingshot. That metal protrusion is really a safety issue.

I then went ahead and wore gloves to try out the slingshot. The bands are really nice and stretchy and the stainless ammo balls were perfect for practice. The slingshot shoots pretty well and is comfortable to hold. Even though the handle is kind of short, the large metal loop makes it easier to hold because it conforms better to my hand. I do like this slingshot, but feel something needs to be done about the eagle design and how it moves such that the sharp edges stick out.

title: IR / Infrared is what it’s all about
text:
Unboxing the night vision goggle/camera had everything in its place and ready to set up. Setting up is pretty simple. Four batteries go on each side of the goggles and the covers lock tight afterwards. A few things include the goggle outer case design as it is easy to hold and the case is easy to grip. They also included a decent quality padded and adjustable strap for more safety. The goggles have metal clips that hold the strap on each side making it a strong design. The goggles weigh 1.94 pounds with batteries. The carrying case is above average in quality with a carrying handle. The goggles fit secure in one direction and have a separate section for the cables, cleaning cloth, strap, user manual and room for more of your own items.

There are the 6 user buttons 3 on each side and are placed in a good position for feel to the fingers and they are easy to remember what each button does. There are an average amount of settings under the menu button. Mainly photo and video quality that you can choose plus some other sensitivity settings such as brightness and IR settings along with date and time and storage settings. One added feature in the menu is a Burst setting (on/off) and it is for fast acting shots. Note: The higher the camera resolution is set, the longer it takes the media to process, just something to keep in mind.

On shutdown the goggles remember all your custom settings. The goggles can handle up to a 32GB micro SD card. Don't worry that is 9999 pictures in HQ and 2.37 min in HD video. I didn't notice any difference in quality with FHD setting and storage time. If you connect the included USB cable to your computer and goggles and set the goggles in play mode, viewing media is a lot better quality than in the goggles view finder. In the photos I uploaded, I show a picture in the woods set at 1M pixels 1280X960. Notice a bit grainy on an overcast day. On testing the highest setting at 3M pixels 2048X1200 was about the same on overcast day. There is another picture of white flowers in full sun at the highest resolution setting. Last, there is an indoor picture of piano keys close up at the highest resolution setting.

Here is something that is not in the goggles manual: You can use your camera and photo computer software (Windows 10) for capturing video and photos from your goggles live using the goggles USB port. Make sure the goggles are in Mode/PC Cam and your computer camera software window is open. Another feature is you can copy the media to your computer using this mode. The goggles in Mode/ MSDC mode is for loading your goggles micro SD card media to your computer. Simultaneously you can use the goggles mode button to switch between both while plugged into the USB port.

Final Thoughts: This item in my opinion is for IR use at night time. The video and photo quality are crisp and clear for that purpose and the goggles give 7 IR settings for brightness, a good feature when viewing in dark and distant places. I wouldn't use the goggles for making family media because the goggles have
a bit of grain under certain lighting and color conditions but not in IR modes. The goggles do very well in IR modes. I did my test using rechargeable lithium 1.5 volt batteries because they do hold a steady voltage longer than alkalines. To sum it all up, I personally feel this item is a good choice for the cost.

title: Built like a tank!
text:
What a beautiful working scope package and my first experience using this brand. This scope arrived with complete instruction on setting up and it included 2 bubble levels and all the tools for mounting the scope. I temporary set it up on an AR rifle in about 30 minutes but this scope is so nice in quality, I plan to use it on a better source. The turrets are super and click smooth and lock tight. I can move the turrets all around over and over and the tracking returns back to zero. The eyepiece moves around smooth and easy. The turret covers are good protection and a welcome addition. The scope mount fits solid on my picatinny rail.

Overall this is a great scope for the value and Blackhound knows what they are doing with design. It even has a lifetime warranty that is transferable. Wow!! Perfect!

title: Features like an ACOG scope
text:
This is a good value scope and features are satisfactory. The red or green dot has several brightness settings by clicking the button each time for higher or to lower the brightness. A simple press of both buttons will turn off the red or green light leaving it in the same brightness position for the next time you use it. You can also just press and hold the red or green button for 2 seconds and the light will go off. Both the red and green dots are precision with clear circle views. The front honeycomb lens cover can be removed with a special tool but I like it for focusing the dot faster and it acts as a sun shade.

Overall construction looks good. It weighs 11.4 ounces. The flip up covers lock tight in a closed position, but you will need to reposition them to the side of the scope so not to interfere with the sights while open or you can simply remove them when using the scope. The fiber optic site works good with little outside light and during the evening hours but not where it is pitch black. The accessories in the description were supposed to be 3 Allen wrenches but this sight came with one for removing the scope from the mount. If you have a good set of Allen wrenches handy, this is not a problem. My testing was on an AR short barrel. This scope should work good on most air soft too.

This is certainly a good value for an ACOG style scope in my opinion. The buttons and sight settings are all in fingers reach. I have other Pinty products that are dependable and have lasted a long time.

title: Flashlight and Laser
text:
This item takes just one CR123A battery for operating both the flashlight and laser. The flashlight switches work good for left and right hand users. Touch once for on and again for off. Touch 2 times fast and the strobe is activated. The 400 lumens is average brightness.

My main dislike is the where the laser slide switch is located because it’s too easy to stay on and wear out the battery. You may find it awkward and slow to deactivate and that could put someone in a dangerous situation. I think a button design would have been much better than sliding the switch. The switch has a weak center click holding it in the off position. My opinion is I cannot see the value in this model and mainly because of the laser switch design.

title: Great Product
text: Everything works perfect. The 5 brightness settings are perfect from low to high. The lens covers work okay as long as you remember to put them back on in one direction. The manual says both CR2032 and CR1632 batteries. The correct one is CR1632 in the technical section and is installed. CR 2032 is in the installing battery section and will not fit so do not attempt. The manual writers should be more explicit so some customers don't get confused.  Overall this Feyachi sight is a good value in my opinion. It would be nice if the battery was the more accessible standard CR2032, but don't let this affect your deciding factor in purchasing because other features excel in value.

title: Very good product
text: All adapters are made with high quality. The spring tension on the bipod is perfect and this design is easy to unfold and extend the legs. The feet are sturdy.  This item comes with all mounting hardware for rifles. In my opinion, this is a 5 star item and good value.

title: Super Clear Lens
text:
The lens quality is excellent viewing and probably because of having the Japan optical glass. Focus is also very clear at short and long distance. Turrets have a quiet click sound and stay in position okay just not as good as other scopes we have. Our other scopes have a solid click and are harder to move out of position. Even though this scope does not have the illuminated reticle, the magnification adjustments are easy to enlarge the crosshairs. My only gripe is I feel the Arory scope is pricy without having an illuminated reticle. I have other scopes with similar specs for a lot less. That being said for example if you price out the Athlon Optics 6-24x50 Talos and Athlon Optics Argos sold here on Amazon both have an illumined reticles.

The Arory long range is good for over 100 yards so it is better than just a beginners scope. Unless you feel the need for an illuminated reticle, you should be happy with Arory quality as I am. My final thoughts, I personally like having an illuminated reticle for the versatility of using it or not. I will still give this scope 4 stars for overall good quality.

title: Great Combo Scope
text: Testing this scope really impressed me. It came with all the batteries for the combo devices. It does use that odd 14250 battery but Amazon sells them. The mounts are good quality. I totally could not find anything I didn't like. I have owned Pinty items in the past and all were good design. I am giving the scope 5 stars for quality and value. Grab one before they are gone.

title: Good clear vision scope

My opinion for the quality and cost, this scope is worth having.

title: All the functions work well
text: In addition to liking this tactical pen, I also like that 2 extra sets of batteries was included and the 5 ink refills.  Nice!
