The end point that can break glass is very sharp, and that end unscrews to get to the bottle opener and little hex wrench.  It does not seem that the pocket clip on it can be adjusted or moved.  The flashlight works by the press of a button, and a second press activates the strobe.  You do need to ensure you remove the plastic from around the batteries that are already in the pen or the flashlight will not work.  Considering the inexpensive cost of this pen, the flashlight is bright enough for an emergency, but of course cannot compare to a tactical flashlight.  Still a nice tactical multi-use pen that deserves 5 stars.  It also comes in a nice easy-to-wrap box and would make an excellent small gift.

title: Quality Scope
text: All works perfect. The red dot brightness dials in the red intensity you desire. The red dot is super sharp along with the contrast lens.  This item is no slouch in quality. I can see the red dot clearly in full sunny days using the 10-11 intensity settings. This Cyelee micro reflex scope is a winner in my opinion for quality and value.  It came with a new CR2032 battery and the tool to mount it all in a strong neatly designed box with a clearly printed manual and cleaning cloth.  I totally recommend it.

title: Fiber optics are okay
text: The sights do not automatically flip up. They do lock good once you pull them up and it’s an easy task. Putting them back into lock mode by pressing the side button is somewhat tight but I think in time this will be okay.  Once mounted they do a good job lining up and the sights are strong. The company asking price is reasonable. Sure you can find better at double the cost.

title: Good Flip up Sights
text: Both iron sights are tight when pressing the open release button. I believe that practice will loosen them up. These are solid strong iron built sights with no play between the mount and sight. The machining is good on these sights and the top is smooth and a low profile. For the asking price the company is asking are of good value.

title: Excellent boresight
text:
I love the way the batteries were upgraded. They somehow taped together so that you can put all three in the boresight at once and remove them the same way. You must remove them when not in use as there is no switch. This perfect little boresight fits directly into the chamber and easy to remove.

This is a good quality item that is valuable to have on hand for targeting. The case opens and snaps shut tightly and is exactly like the company picture in this listing. 5-star item!

title: Packed in a neat little case
text: This is a great tool to have and it works good. It comes with 3 sets of batteries and each set is taped so that it makes it easy to install and remove. There is no switch, so after using the batteries must be removed and can be stored back in the case. This bore sight is a very easy way to set targets.  This is a good buy in my opinion and a must-have for setting up accuracy. Good value and well made.

title: Good scope mount Only for 30 mm tube
text:
If you wanted to use the scope ring reducers you’re pretty much out of luck. They are plastic and did not have any notch or groove for mounting and holding the scope tight in place. It does not reduce the size for a 1 inch scope barrel properly. You would be out of luck if trying to use this mount for a 1-inch tube scope. Just don't do it.

If you use this mount for a 30mm tube scope and are not using the reducer rings, the mount itself is strong and gives a tight fit on the Picatanny rail and the scope tube. Because this is a lower priced mount, it deserves some credit but the company should take that 1-inch business out of the description and not include those horrible reducer rings.

title: Better than average mount
text:
This is a good quality scope mount. The base and rings are strong and fit the scope ring tight using a 30mm barrel tube size. The hardware holds the rings tight as well and the mounting Picatinny base is heavy duty. Having the cantilever option is good for some that want the distance adjustment or need
it for the length for eye relief. The value in my opinion is especially the reasonable asking price. It’s not the best mount but for lower priced scopes this mount should give a scope a better than average secure mount. I recommend it for quality and value.

title: One Beautiful Mount
text: This mount is lightweight and appears to be very strong and a solid build. It offers a very stable tight fit on a Picatinny rail for 30mm scope sizes. With this design the mount can be positioned of your choice. All machining looks good and it is a true value scope mount.  I can't imagine a buyer would regret purchasing this.  I am giving this WolfMtn product 5 stars as it deserves.

title: Quality construction mount with 20MOA
text: Nothing short of saying this mount is machined in perfection. It also weighs 6.7 ounces and is not a light duty item. The 20 MOA option is something for long range users. If you are adjusting the elevation dial on your scope for ranges longer than what the rifle is zeroed for, they will run out of elevation in the scope. The 20 MOA allows you to use the extra travel not being used. This Lockoos model is a seriously good quality product in my opinion and not breaking the bank to purchase one. With all said and the built in slope makes this item a pretty good choice, but it is also important to know the MOA of elevation travel the scope has when deciding whether or not to purchase a 20 MOA mount. I personally feel this is a value item and deserves 5 stars.

title: Excellent accessory
text: Strong material and easily fastened to a picatinny rail.  We had some that were flimsy and had way to much play in the swivel.  This Gogoku brand is a solid build, not too tight and no unnecessary play in the swivel. They should hold up for years. Each adapter includes a strong wrench for mounting. This company made an excellent quality design product and they deserve high ratings. Totally recommend them for quality and value!

title: Strong high rise rings
text: Good product design and great for when needing riser rings. The machine quality is real good in my opinion and these rings fit tight on the tube barrel. They are not lightweight - 6.2 ounces mounted together. Personally, I have good luck with Godturtle products and this item is no exception. Good value and worth recommending.

title: The quality is in the first look
text: We own a variety of scope rings, and upon first look at this item I was amazed at how well this item is machined. The hardware is perfect. If you have a 1-inch scope then spacers would be needed as this one is specific for 30mm scope diameter. If you decide to purchase this set, the quality in design and the hardware is top notch.  I cannot find anything that I do not like about these mounts, and totally recommend them.

title: Excellent quality
text: These fit perfect to a 1 inch scope rail, and they are high quality rings.  They will fit some flashlights with the 1 inch diameter tubes.  All the hardware is good and I feel this high quality item deserves 5 stars.

title: Good working sight
text: It’s easy to adjust the settings on both the red dot and reticle. The red dot can be removed if you wanted to mount somewhere else or not use it. Overall this is a nice item and the only thing that I didn't like is the odd 14250 red dot battery.  Luckily, red dot batteries last a long time and the 14250 is easy to find here on Amazon.  I recommend this sight for value.

title: Good scope for the money
text:
This scope uses one AAA battery that is included. On top the RBG button is for the color you select. The +/- buttons are there to select the brightness for the color you choose, and if you press both brightness +/- buttons at the same time it shuts the power off.

The elevation and windage adjustments work good, and the reticle is perfectly straight once mounted. Eye relief is okay for being a short 3x30 scope. The scope is heavy at 15.8 ounces but I believe it’s because of the heavy duty frame construction. I do wish the scope included lens covers. But overall I still like this scope for the rifles the company says it works best on. The 11 brightness settings on each color works good. I would recommend this scope because of the quality and price.

title: Nice and Bright
text: This is a compact little light that is a bright 600 lumens. It has the solid beam and a strobe by pressing either button on the sides twice. A battery indicator is sketched into the light body to remind users of the battery + /- positions when replacing. The extra keys are included for different rails. The switch is well sealed and water protected. Overall it checks out to be a solid item.  My thoughts are that this flashlight is constructed well, and if I had a Sig Sauer, that's what I would put it on.

title: Good value for the money
text:
I couldn't find anything that didn't work on this item. The legs pull out and lock on the setting you choose. You have to pull the legs all the way out at first to release the settings pins. I did have to use some silicone spray on the legs only at first use as they were a bit tight moving to the different settings. Afterwards you can raise them to the height you want at one of the 5 settings

When not in use, the legs fold forward and backward to the position you want them. The included tools can adjust leg tension if needed but mine did not. There is a wing nut if you want to change how the center mounts on the Picatinny rail. It swivels left and right, but once locked it stays in position.

The build quality is good for the asking price. Sure, you can buy better ones but the cost is three times more. This bipod is a good value.

title: Red dot green dot, good brightness
text:
It’s small in size but good quality and both red dots can be adjusted for W/E and has locking screws. All the tools are included to make adjustments. The 3 MOA in my opinion is perfect in size. The glass looks great. The battery compartment is good along with soldering connectors. (shown in photo). Wind and
Elevation locking system looks good. This is a 5-star item.

title: Good scope
text: Good clear lens without any glare. The 3 MOA is bright without any glare.  The sight has a solid construction and the cover attaches tight. W/E adjustments work good and the covers seal tight. You will need to keep CR1620 batteries on hand for replacement but they are easy to find all over here at Amazon in variety combinations. I recommend this item for good quality design.

title: Good strong mounts
text: All hardware is strong and easy to mount for exact fit. They include sleeve inserts for the smaller flashlights. All tools are included and work good.  Overall, no complaints here and I recommend them for good quality.

title: Good quality built sight
text: There is not much glare if any. The lenses are clear and the anti-reflection works great. The construction is solid and all the hardware works good. The covers fit good and tight. The red dot has 11 brightness settings and all are clear. The settings dial is a bit over tight then most others I tested but it does have a good lock on the each setting.  Having the riser offset mount is a nice added piece. I have nothing to complain about. CVlife red dot sight is recommended.

title: Good value scope and precise
text:
The lens is very clear and quality is good for this price range. The reticle brightness wheel is hard to turn, but the good thing is it locks tight on the setting you choose and one click next to it is off. I like this feature instead of having to move the wheel all over the place where there is only one off setting. Maybe it will loosen up over time. The zoom works great but is pretty tight to turn. I like the elevation and windage turret covers that fit tight when not using.

It didn't come with a battery but it takes a standard 2032. It does have a thin battery cover. The cover is in front of the parallax. I have never found a parallax adjustment perfect for the yardage marked on the wheel. This one is better than some I had tested. Overall this Lebo is a nice value scope.

title: Good value scope
text:
Set up FOR THIS SCOPE is easy. If you needed the manual it shows in detail. The scope takes (3) LR41w, AG3, CX41, or 392A. Any of these batteries will work. It has a windage adjustment but make sure to keep the screw loose while you make other adjustments first. If it’s tight then use the small Allen wrench to loosen. After making the elevation and center adjustments then tighten the windage screw. I didn't notice much if any glare through the lens and is good in my opinion. You have 4 different reticle patterns depending on your field of view.

Brightness is adjustable for both red and green reticles by pressing the button for brightness settings. The company listing says there are 5 brightness ettings. The included manual says nothing about any brightness settings. Here is what I experienced...Each time you turn the scope on to the color of choice, the default brightness starts at the lowest brightness and pressing up to 9 times then it goes back to default. Note: after turning off, it does not remember your last brightness setting, but hey… this is still a nice feature!

After you’re done using the scope you have to press both the red and green buttons to turn off. You can see in the company’s listed picture how it shows the off button with arrows pointing downward on both red/green buttons.

My final thoughts are this scope is of good value. It is also waterproof and shockproof according to the manual.

title: Strong thick handle
text:
The frame and handle of this slingshot are strong and heavy for its small size, and I like the sites and the level. This is about the 5th slingshot I've ordered, so even though no instructions were included it was quite easy to assemble. I prefer not to use the green and red in the sites and to leave them as is, but everything is included to add them as well as a small bag of practice ammo. Two extra bands were included when replacement is needed.

I do wish the handle was about an inch longer. And the projectile pocket is a bit too narrow for my preference. About 1/4" wider would have made it perfect. Otherwise, this is a great little slingshot to practice with and reasonably priced.

title: Another fine Wurkkos product!
text:
This model is totally a true 13,000 lumens flashlight. The first thing I did was charge the batteries. Don't forget to remove the cardboard cover in the battery compartment on top of the second battery that disconnects the power while in shipping. Speaking of the power and switch, this is an easy push switch with a light touch. The four brightness settings are by touching the switch each time for a bright or less bright illumination. Wurkkos has a wonderful design for these 4 settings. You can turn the flashlight off by lightly short pressing the button and that brightness setting will stay for the next time you turn it on. The attachment cord included is also good quality and is comfortable and adjustable for holding or carrying the flashlight and underwater.

The power in this flashlight is amazing, and you do not want to look directly into the lens set on the high setting as it is so bright. On testing distance, I could see 100 yards far into our wooded area and way on top of the 80-foot tall oak trees. Imagine the brightness for deep scuba diving or having to change a prop on your boat at night. On land the flashlight does get warm on high beam for 5 minutes but cools off quickly. I really praise this company for making such an excellent product. This model is nothing short of perfection. The handle grip is comfortable to hold. We have owned a Wurkkos 5950 lumens for 6 months and use it all the time without any problems. If I have any problems with this model, I will update. Right now it is of value and a precision build!!

title: Bright Red and Green Reticle
text: No complaints on this item. It stays in focus and I like having both a red and green reticle. The green and red buttons each have 5 brightness settings, and they all work great.  The picatinny rail mount has a safety lock once mounted.  It’s a good value overall considering the price and accessories such as the battery, tools, lens cover, and a strong case.

title: Lightweight Mugs
text: The rim is smooth and the handle is comfortable to hold. This is not a microwave mug because of the iron  in them. They are better for cold beverages.  The white enamel is a smooth finish.  Overall, they are nothing fancy and I like that they serve the purpose for camping.

title: Bright and Heavy Duty
text:
First, this LED is a P70 Quad core meaning it is 4 LED's in one. I have others like this and they are pretty bright. Second, it is not 90000 lumens. It checks in on our lumens meter around 5000 but is still pretty good for brightness. It is not a flashlight to look into because of the blinding. The P70 led illuminates in a narrow straight path so it looks better in distance.

Before I ordered it, I never thought it was 90000 because the P70 in my experience does not flash that bright. The company needs to update the description. It does come with one 26650 - 5000 mAh rechargeable battery. This flashlight is a solid construction and heavy duty.

My final thoughts: I think it is an above average item and the company's asking price is reasonable. With that said, it is certainly a good value and I will rate it 5 stars.

title: Excellent Clear Lens
text: I am waiting on getting a mount for it but played with it on a block.  I can tell the reticle is very clear and sharp along with all the rheostat illumination settings. Having the parallax adjustment is also a great feature on this inexpensive scope. The turrets both have good working lock systems. I can move them one click at a time and they lock up nicely.  I like 50 mil smaller objective as it keeps the weight down.  This scope is certainly a quality item and it all seems to have a good design. The dust covers open and shut tight with ease. For me, practice will tell more and if I find anything to report I will update. Right now it’s a value scope and I recommend it.

title: Perfect Mount
text: This item came in a box with the Allen wrench. All looks good and precisely made. I can highly recommend getting one. It looks as good as the listing picture. It has smooth edges and a thick black coating. The wrench will also tighten the Picatinny rail screw.

title: Perfect
text: These scope rings are strong and all the hardware works perfect.  I cannot find anything that I do not like about this item. The screws are long enough so that if your scope is a little larger in diameter, they should work. They are strong and have a good tightening for mounting on a Picatinny rail.  Nice product at a reasonable price and I recommend them.

title: Perfect to add to emergency food
text: I like to have emergency food stored away and these #10 cans in my opinion is the way to go.  This one has a shelf life of 25 years, and I generally don't see onions, so this was a nice find.

title: Stunning vintage replica sextant!
text: I have always wanted one of these sextants because I love antique instruments and anything that measures angles.  This is a beautiful piece that came in a strong vintage look wooden box.  The quality appears to be excellent, and all the moving parts move easily. It is easy to hold and is not heavy.  It comes with 2 extra sighting telescopes and overall this would make an incredible gift for any boat owner or collector.  It could also serve as an inspirational tool for anyone writing about the sea, boats, old geometry or poetry.  If I could give this item 10 stars I would!

title: Does not work
text: I opened the tail cap cover and removed the insulation. I put the batteries in the correct direction. The LED flashed a second then went out and I never could get it to work again.  I would not recommend this item. No product support.

title: Don’t waste your money
text: This product is super low quality.  When trying to turn it on the LED switch only flashes for a second then quits.  I made sure connections are tight but the LED will not stay on when pressing the switch. It only flashes once then goes out.  It is as simple as this.  Worst design ever and horrible mounting hardware.

title: Works and mounts perfect
text: This item is easy to set up and includes the Allen wrenches to do so. I have no complaints about the design as it is pretty good quality.  The selector knobs for both red and green work good as well as the reticle settings. They hold strong in the position once selected.  The G and R setting is for turning off and should be kept in either position when not in use. I am giving this item 5 stars for value and I recommend getting one.

title: Great for emergency food
text: These freeze dried meals are good for camping as the listing states, but I prefer to keep them on hand for emergency food.  These meals taste wonderful, each packet serves 2 people, and they have a super long unopened shelf life of 30 years.  You can't go wrong with Mountain House meals.

title: Perfect for practice with my many slingshots!
text: I love slingshots!  They're fun and smaller than a bow and arrow and ammo like this is PERFECT for them and easy to use.  Functionally this slingshot ammo works great!  And you get a lot of it.  The steel ammo is heavier of course, but I was surprised at how compact the clay ammo is since I'd only used the steel before this.  The two types of ammo are not all mixed together, but rather each comes in its own bag.  Personally, I like to put the ammo in tupperware (steel separated from clay of course) to store and even when practicing, just makes it easier than having to reach into a plastic bag.  I'm happy with this slingshot ammo and recommend it.

title: Good item for the price
text:
This scope came in an excellent package with tools and batteries (1 installed and 1 extra) and instructions on how to set it up. There are 3 brightness settings for both red and green lasers and choice of red or green lasers on top of the scope and in back of the lens. The G and R letters are the Off positions. Keeping the Off position set when not using it will save battery life. On the top back of the scope are 4 reticle settings by sliding the switch back and forth to choose the one you want to use. All the settings are a little firm to move but stay in place afterwards.

First thing I did was mount the scope and secure to a picatinny rail. After mounting, I used the adjustment screw on top of the scope for elevating the up or down setting. I also used the adjustment screw setting on the left side of scope to zero in the laser. You can do this for up to 100 yards away but make sure you’re on a flat secure surface. I only needed to do small adjustments. This Rub1zro is in my opinion a quality item and a good value for the price.

title: Perfect and easy Setup
text: Very nice package with everything needed to set up. The red dot zeros in quickly and the adjustments are precise. I cannot find anything that is wrong with this item. The 11 brightness settings all work good from a dim narrow red light up to a strong bright red light. Another good feature is the lens inside is nitrogen purged for keeping the fog out at different temperatures. Yes, I can look through this lens with both eyes. Last, the price of this item is a great value in my opinion and quality all seems good right down to the mounting hardware. Well deserving of 5 stars!  Thank you Godturtle company!!

title: Holster snap broke
text: On first open, the holster snap broke off as shown in the photo I uploaded.  It does have Velcro almost everywhere to try and keep things in place and plenty of pouches for storage. Nothing came with the holster for customer support.  I can’t do a full test without being able to fasten the holster because of the snap breaking. I can probably pop off the rest of the rivet and use the Velcro that is also in the rivet area to fold over the gun handle and keep it somewhat secure. Overall, too much Velcro everywhere and the rest of the fabric is strong; however, the Velcro weakens keeping it all together. Design quality is average at best.

title: Comfortable and compact fold away bike
text:
Set up for this exercise bike was easy. The instruction booklet has pictures to help. There are some sections that need to be read so the double parts are installed properly. The bike comes delivered with the major frame put together. The only change I added after fully assembled was a small black zip strip for gathering the wires and keeping them all in one place.

The monitor display works good and keeps track of time and heart rates. It is a simple easy to read monitor and has auto shut off after 4 minutes of inactivity. The manual has one page on settings adjustments and what to monitor.

The bike has a lower extension knob for adding distance in length by using this setting all the way out, but my hands couldn't reach the handle bars to monitor my heart rate. The seat handle bars next to the seat worked good in this situation and using the pull ropes also worked good in this situation by holding while peddling.

The bike functions great and I like that the pedaling tension can be adjusted. My one small complaint is the bike didn't have a high enough seat adjustment for tall people. It worked great for me, but my husband is taller with longer legs, so a longer seat bar giving it another notch upward would have helped.

The bike folds up nicely by grabbing the handle bars and lifting up. Make sure to put the lower legs with the rollers on the front of bike with the rollers not facing downward so that only when you lift the bike the rollers are flat on the ground.

My overall thoughts are that this is a good sturdy bike and should last a long time with home use. Most of the hardware was already fastened to the bike parts. And now, it’s time to go biking!

title: Surprisingly good taste
text: These meals are quite good and are the perfect size meal for 2 people.  Mountain House foods have a shelf life of 30 years unopened, so an excellent choice for prep storing.

title: Powerful slingshot, but had a few issues
text:
This is a strong and durable slingshot, and definitely not for children. It comes with 4 sets of rubber bands, a container of 56 steel balls (supposed to be 100), 2 Allen wrenches, flashlight bracket, and magnetic keyring. What it did NOT include that was supposed to be included was the other 44 steel balls and the 100 mud balls were not included at all. There were also no instructions whatsoever.

Even without instructions this slingshot for the most part was easy to put together since I have other slingshots I have had to assemble. The rubber bands and wrist support (which is a great feature!) assembled fine, and each side of the handle has a lovely dragon image. The flashlight connector was another matter. I was able to get it affixed to the slingshot, but 2 of the components on the connector itself do not fit together well, so it cannot be fully tightened. So I decided not to use the flashlight connector at all.

Another thing I did not like was that one of the sights of the slingshot had a lot of excess metal that I had to file down. I used a metal file to do this, but had to file quite a bit out of the inside of that one site, and the outside of both left and right sights also needed some filing as well.

My final thoughts: This is a powerful slingshot and not a toy. It’s a really nice looking slingshot and can be accurate if you know how to shoot a slingshot. But due to the lack of instructions, missing pieces, the need to file the sights, and the flashlight connecter not being able to tighten properly, I cannot in good conscience give this item more than 3 stars.

title: Average holster
text:
I find this product not to be the best choice for several reasons. The zipper in the center pouch for the Concealed Carry area is hard to zip shut. It does unzip open easier but the gun is not real secure when opening. I tried quite a few times opening and closing the pouch, and the gun was loose and smaller ones like a 380 would fall out of the slot from normal walking and bending.

If you have a flashlight or red dot attached to your concealed the elastic will not allow for the extra diameter, and more important the on/off switch will turn on from body movement if the switch is located on either side of the flashlight or red dot. Also if you put 4 clips into the inside pouch slots, these slots are not fully covered elastic and the clips will bang against your concealed while walking, sitting, and just standard moving your body around. It is a sloppy fit and scary at some degree if your concealed chamber is loaded even with safety on. I think of safety first and this holster would not be my first choice.

The side pocket zippers open and close good. If you carry the case in front center of your stomach, the latch sits behind you and it could easily be unlatched and possibly steal your pouch altogether.

Overall, this fanny pack holster does have a lot of zipped storage including the belt pouch for money or other flat items. The construction material strength is strong and all the extra storage you get is good.

title: Sharp looking slingshot, but that’s about it
text: Appearance wise, this is really a stunning slingshot that uses a double pair of tube style rubber bands.  It has a very custom look and different feel to it.  One of the first issues I came across was that one of the rubber bands was noticeably longer than the other 3, and I have to wonder if this this is affecting the shot.  Granted, when you pull on the bands, they are all stretched to an equal length before the projectile is released.  But that one rubber band is not as taut as the others, and this slingshot did not come with replacement bands.  I can still shoot it okay though.  Then the 2nd issue I have is that sometimes when I shoot it, when the bands snap back they turn inside out, and I have to flip them back.  This happens about 2/3 of the time which is kind of annoying.  So for this slingshot, I will say it’s a very cool item, but other than that I’m not very impressed with it.

title: Needs a Picatinny rail mount hardware
text:
This Ulako flashlight has good brightness for being a 250 lumens LED light. The flashlight buttons work good including the remote switch. The red laser is average quality and these work okay after you zero them in. The package included the wrenches to do it. You can mount the laser to a Picatinny rail by itself but if you decide to mount the laser, flashlight, and a scope, you will need the hardware for mounting the whole bracket on a Picatinny rail. It’s kind of cheesy that Ulako didn't include one.

This product is not a pricey item so you get a good flashlight, an average laser, and an incomplete mount. You decide. I am only giving this item 3 stars because it is at best average, but I have tested other Ulako flashlight kits and they were wonderful.

title: Bright light, low profile
text:
Testing this light everything worked as the company says. The box included 4 CR123a batteries. You only need 2 for powering the light. Putting the batteries in place takes some talent by aligning the cover back to the base while the batteries are pressing against it. It is just a bit tricky but the cover will snap in place while holding with one hand and you can snap the lock with the other hand. The on/off switch in my opinion is in a good location. I also like that it stays out of the way from your finger until you need it.

Also the flashlight comes with additional clips for mounting it on a Picatinnny rail. The use of the clips will depend on what kind of hunting item you will be using it on. The stock one that came installed worked for me. They are easy to change out by removing a screw on the flashlight side. The included clips may also allow for how close you want the on /off switch to your finger.

Final thoughts: I like this brand and model. I also feel it is in a fair price range. The light is bright and should last a long time before having to replace the batteries. One more note is that to replace batteries, the flashlight will need to be taken off the Picatinny rail. I am giving this Feyachi flashlight 5 stars for good quality construction, value and brightness.

title: Looks brighter than 220 lumens
text: I tested the same version of this product but with the green laser and my assessment is the same but with this one being the red laser. The buttons are in  too close of proximity that makes it hard to press the correct one. Also the buttons are easy to press down so this makes it easy to make a mistake which I would never want to happen in a defense situation.  If you have smaller fingers the buttons may work better for you. All the other functions work good as the company says but I can only give this item 4 stars.

title: Looks brighter than 220 Lumens
text: The green laser is bright and easy to set up. Personally i like the magnetic charging cable. I am not a fan of the location of the buttons being so close as it is easy to touch the wrong one and they are not hard to press. Mounting was easy and the light stays in firm position. I do like that the flashlight button has a strobe setting. If it wasn't for how the buttons can be easily mistaken, I would give this high marks for a quality item. If you have small fingers the buttons could work okay for you. The green laser is bright even in daylight and so much more distance at night.

title: Povast makes good flashlights
text: Everything works on this great flashlight. This Povast model flashlight button mounted where it can be easily accessed. This would make a good hunting and camping torch. It has 5 button settings - 3 for brightness, 1 strobe, and 1 SOS setting. It has a nice thick lens and you can store it upright with the lens facing the surface without the flashlight wobbling. The 2-button remote switch works as stated in the description.  And this flashlight is bright!  You can see in my pictures how bright it is. This model also has the turning ring (left and right) for zooming in and out and stays in position until you decide to move it. I really like this feature. The overall construction seems very good as well.  Well deserving of 5 stars for quality and value!

title: Perfect Fit
text: Fits perfect for a 1911-A1. The holster design seems very good and the belt clip holds tight in place. title: Bright laser light
text:
This item has a nice low profile design. For set up, the top cover slides back a fraction of an inch, then I was able to lift up the cover with my fingernail. The inside markings are easy to read for positive and negative battery positions and it only takes 2 batteries. The company gave 4 batteries which I think is very nice. The laser light has push buttons on both sides and either one on each side can be pressed on and off at any time by the user. This feature is nice for right and left hand users and the buttons are easy to press. A super small Allen wrench was included (and I mean SMALL!) But it worked good for aligning the laser’s four adjustment screws.

This is really a great quality product and good value. Definitely worth 5 stars and recommending!

title: Bright, easy to mount light
text: Setting up this item for mounting was quick and easy.  It came with 4 adjustment additional universal plates for different kinds of rail mounting. The one picture shows the plate mount area. You get an Allen wrench and extra universal plate screws plus a screwdriver for fastening the light to your rail. Also included is an extra thin rubber washer for the light seal in case you ever need to replace it. The battery replacement is under the front light bulb and is easy to access.  Flagpower is a bright light and the side on and off switches are easy to press for fast action. It is designed for left and right handed use and is such an overall compact flashlight.

title: A Flashlight bright as a Star!
text:
This flashlight is a bit heavier than others in this size range. I think that is leaning more toward the battery size. The 21700 battery weighs 2.5 ounces whereas the 18650 is 1.5 ounces. The flashlight without the 21700 battery weighs 4.9 ounces. Another thing is it gets very warm from holding it in your hand on high mode for 5 minutes. A few minutes longer and it gets HOT and almost hard to hold unless you are wearing gloves. With this said the flashlight is designed for diving and stays a lot cooler under water. I submerged it in cool water and the flashlight does not get more than warm on high mode. It is the 3 LEDs that cause all the heat.

I love the brightness and the ease of turning the switch on and off. The 3 brightness settings are a good feature in my opinion and work flawlessly. To show how bright the high setting is, I included a picture of our stove with kitchen light off and standing about 7 feet back and no camera flash. If you store the flashlight for long periods of time, or if traveling and want to make sure the flashlight doesn't accidently turn on, you can just turn the tail cap backwards less than 1 turn and the flashlight is totally off. It works, I tested it! Wonderful!! The lens is very solid and thick. It appears to be nearly indestructible. Another feature is this item comes with a cover adapter for using the smaller 18650 battery that is standard in most flashlights. The 18650 wouldn't have as long a running time but runs a little cooler using this flashlight above water. We tested a fully charged 18650 on high for 5 minutes and it drained the battery to 64 percent. It is also just a bit less bright but noticeable. Testing the 21700 battery fully charged for 5 minutes above water drained the battery to 87 percent and when putting it back to charge it finished to 100 percent in about 17 minutes. We used a MiBoxer 8 battery charger that shows percentages while charging. Amazon sells them and we love it.

This flashlight in my opinion really is best underwater use. I also think if it was used as a normal flashlight and running it for 15 minutes or more on high on a hot evening could burn out the LEDs from the heat. The manual does not mention this and it says the flashlight has a built in ATR (advanced temperature regulation) and will reduce the power under certain situations of excessive heat to prevent overheating.

If you just wanted to use it above water for shorter times to find something lost like your wife's wedding ring because she got mad at you, this little gem is excellent and fits into most any size pocket. But it is SO bright you really do NOT want to look into it, and also have to be careful not to shine it in anyone’s face, and that includes pets.

Overall this is a great flashlight and I recommend it for quality and value!

title: Well-designed warm hat!
text: This hat is one of the most comfortable hats we have. Between my husband and I, one of us has a large head and one a small head, and this one size hat will fit either one of us. The snap on coverings give even more options on how to wear this hat depending on how warm you need to be. It is also a lightweight hat that is comfortable to wear. Another thing is we both wear glasses and both agree it is best to put on the hat first then the glasses. For cold windy days the snap on plastic eye cover fits good  nd it has adjustable side straps if needed.  This is a phenomenal hat and totally deserves a 5 star rating!

title: Laser works but on/off switch needs work
text:
This laser comes with six batteries and you only need three so you have one set for backup. The laser itself in my opinion works good and is bright with a thin beam. You can adjust the beam with the included tool. The attached button cord also works good. I could turn it on and off easily and it always worked properly. Mounting the laser was also a non-issue and tightened good.

The problem with this laser is the button switch located on the back cover of the laser. I had a horrible time getting it to work properly. After studying this thing for awhile, I discovered after removing the battery cover that the spring was crooked and would move the batteries out of position. The result was that the spring tension and spring not making center contact was causing the laser to not work properly. The spring was loose and wobbly too. I tried bending it to center but it only made it worse. My husband had spare various size springs in his shop so was able to remake one that fit better. After about an hour of work we finally got it fixed. I had to make sure the spring was dead center when closing the cap so the batteries wouldn't move out of place and had enough tension so when pressing the on/off button it would work. Another little issue is the batteries do not fit perfect inside the case and are a bit wobbly. So there is that.

I hope you have better luck and maybe this was a glitch in the one I received. I really believe the switch could have been designed better. After all, you want the laser to work when you need it. I cannot in all honesty give this item more than 3 stars and I would not recommend it.

title: Good carry on cleaning kit
text:
On first impressions I like this kit for what it is. It’s not a cleaning kit for taking down a large selection of calibers, but for taking to the range or overnight hunting trip it is fine. The little bottle came empty as I expected but I have a lot of oil and cleaner so this is perfect. The brushes and steel flex cable all seem good. The swabs are okay and they give you enough. The 2 blades on the super X tool are very sharp so need to be careful if you’re going to carry it in your wallet. This is a thick piece of steel and should hold up for a while plus it has the American flag on the back which I like.

I look at this kit as something you could throw in an overnight bag and be done with it. It is enough tools for a quick fix situation. And for the price, it is certainly a good deal.

title: Beautiful Bright Light
text: I must say I do like everything about this Povast flashlight.  All the features work as they should. It is simple to charge with the built-in USB connector. The switch lights up red while charging and green once finished. The switch also lights up green when in use. This flashlight is very bright for just one 18650 battery and is pretty amazing.  The rubber USB cover on the flashlight stays in place when not in use and seems to be a good design.  This USB cover will not come off just by opening it and it keeps the connector dry and clean at all times. The glass lens is thick and strong.  Very nice!  The on/off button works well with all modes and defaults to the highest setting when turned on. If this is the setting you would normally use, just hold the switch when you want to turn it off so you don't have to go through all the other modes. My final thoughts are this tactical flashlight is certainly good quality and worth recommending.

title: Bright Light
text: Everything on this light works as stated.  The glass lens is strong and thick unlike some others that are thin and look like they could break easy.  The brightness is excellent for this using just one 18650 battery. The switch has 3 settings of brightness plus a flash setting and SOS setting. It defaults on the high brightness setting. If this is the only setting you want to use just press the switch and hold the button, the light will go off and you don't have to go through all the other settings to turn off the flashlight.  Nice!! The included accessories all work good too. It has a good quality USB cover built into the flashlight keeping the connector from getting wet and dirty.  I cannot find anything wrong with this flashlight and am happy with it.

title: Strong construction and easy to assemble
text: This is one heck of a little slingshot.  It is made well, very strong construction, easy to assemble, and it’s a nice looking product.  There is a little instruction insert, but it’s really just a matter of inserting the 2 bands into their slots and tightening the screws, then inserting the sites into their corresponding sites and using the included Allen wrench to tighten the slots.  I have another similar slingshot from Amazon that has sites, but that one does not have a level on the site whereas this one does.  I’m not sure I’ll need the level as I generally shoot straight, but it is a nice extra feature that I am going to see if I can try shooting with it horizontal.  As with my other slingshot, I have the same issue with slingshot and that is that the handle really needs to be longer. It is only 3 inches from the end of the handle to where the handle meets or intersects with the body.  I guess I don’t understand why these otherwise great slingshots have such  short handles.  The end of the handle digs into the palm of my hand when I hold it so can cause blisters.  I will also be getting some better straps but the two that were included should be okay for a bit.  Overall this is really a very cool slingshot that I feel is reasonably priced and it even came with some ammo.

title: Quality Mount

title: Love this case, holds a lot!
text:
As a woman who wants to enjoy the concealed carry option but doesn’t want to carry an extra purse for cell phone, cash, etc., I have to say this little case takes care of it all. It has so much functionality that I almost don’t know where to start.

Laying flat and without anything in it, this very durable and well-made nylon case measures about 7-1/2” wide x 9-1/2” tall. That also includes a gusset which, when extended, accommodates a pretty good sized gun. Almost all the seams are double-stitched, and an outer strong and durable bungee style closure keeps the pockets on the outer side of the purse secure. In addition to the larger inner pocket where you can stash your weapon (or if not a weapon will hold quite a bit of other things), there is also a front outer pocket that is perfect for a cell phone. My Galaxy J7 fits great. Another great feature is you have the option of carrying this case like a purse with the removable strap, or you can remove the strap and wear on your belt.

There is a wide band of Velcro in the front of the case which, when opened reveals 10 card slots (including 1 clear for I.D.), a zippered pocket which is perfect size for cash bills, and a pocket behind each set of card slots where you can store coupons, receipts, etc. **I do want to note that while the zipper pouch is great for bills, it may not be great for loose change because if you unzipper the bill slot with the case in upright/vertical position which it would be if you are wearing it, and loose change may fall out. There is also a zipper pocket right at the very top of the purse actually at the top of the front flap. Unzip that and you’ll find a great little pocket for an extra magazine (or 2-3 depending on the size). It could also be a good pocket to hold your keys. On the back side of this pouch there is another zipper compartment that can easily hold a larger size cell phone or extra ammo mags or even your gun depending on the size.

Overall, this is a great case that can be used by men or women, and I can’t find anything that I don’t like about it. It’s a keeper!

title: Rugged little slingshot
text:
I was pretty excited when this slingshot arrived, and very happy to see that all the pieces were there, including an extra band, the steel and clay balls. I was a little perturbed that the assembly instructions were not included and I had to go back online to get the instructions… anything requiring assembly should always come with instructions. I did get it assembled okay and really like this slingshot a lot.

I have never been very good with slingshots and hoping to have better luck with this one. It is very sturdy, well made, and the handle and metal parts should last forever. It would be nice if the handle were a little longer, maybe an inch. As a female, I have smaller hands than most men, and this handle is even a bit too short for me. I am also concerned about thinness of the band and how long before it will need to be replaced, but replacement bands are readily available so we’ll see how that goes. Other than that it’s a great little slingshot and very reasonably priced.

title: Exercise while working or watching TV!
text:
I ordered this item because I wanted something I could take to work for under my desk so I could get some exercise while working. I have a sit-down job and need to move my legs sometimes throughout the day. The listing for this ellipse made it sound very appealing so I decided to give a try, and I am happy to report I am thrilled with this item! It has so many great things about it.

First, it was easy to assemble. It was just a matter of putting a couple screws into the bottom of each pedal to attach them, inserting the batteries into the digital readout, then hooking the wire from the base unit into the readout. The screws and batteries were provided with the unit. Very simple and it was ready to go after that. The digital readout turns on automatically when you start pedaling, and shuts itself off a few minutes after you have finished pedaling. To reset the digital reading back to zero before it shuts down is just a matter of pressing the white button for a few seconds and the readings will zero out. While you are using this desk cycle, it will keep track of how many rotations/steps were taken. You can also view RPM, time, and calories. This unit has a tension adjustment knob that is also very simple, just turn to a higher number and the pedaling gets much harder. Or you can keep it at the lowest setting to make the pedaling easy. The pedals are huge, so should work for any size foot whether or not you are wearing shoes. Also, this unit is ultra quiet. You could certainly use this in a room where someone is sleeping and not wake them up.

As you can see in my photos, there is a sticker on the top of the unit. This sticker does not really go there, there was one of these on each of the pedals as a warning that you should never stand on the pedals. The reason I kept one of the stickers and affixed it to the top of the unit is in case someone else decides to try it out in my office when I am not around. I can see where the temptation to want to try to “walk” on the pedals would be very tempting.

If I had to say anything negative about this unit would only be that it is very heavy. But it has to be in order to be able to stay in place while you are using it. It’s just that the weight doesn’t leave it very portable such that you could just move it from room to room all the time. Having said that, I appreciate the heavy weight in that it is part of what makes it the superb quality that it is, and the weight will prevent it from sliding on the floor while using it.
5 stars for this fantastic piece of equipment!

title: Nice socks but too tight

Unfortunately, these XL socks were just too tight for my husband’s feet.  The length was fine, but the width was very tight and they were also too tight going up the leg. He has worn other compression socks just fine, but this fabric was just too rigid for his foot to even move and not stretchy enough for him to wear for any length of time.

title: Made for smaller waists, not one size for all
text: I have a couple women’s belly bands and wanted to get one for my husband.  Am very disappointed that this band was too small for him, and I am in full agreement with the reviewer who said it would not fit above a size 36 in men’s, and that may be pushing it.  While the flexibility of the band would make it comfortable for the people it would fit, it is not a stretchy belt so there is no way this belly band is one size for all.  The only thing that’s elastic is the sewn pockets and strap that holds the gun.  Another thing I don’t like about it is the rounded ends because there is like a loose round flap at the end.  Furthermore, to really secure this belt more, this could have been designed for there to be additional Velcro hook & loop sewn at the opposite end so both ends would “catch”.  Last, I don’t like the little metal hook and latch where the elastic pocket holds the gun.  It is just too hard to unlatch to get the gun out fast if you ever needed to.  Fidgeting with that closure could be a real detriment in a situation where every second matters.

title: Well worth the money
text: My husband and I bought this piece of equipment to add to our existing exercise equipment, and with the hope that it might boost my low bone density a bit.  I've been using it about 3 times a week for several months now, and while I don't think there is any weight loss (did not want it for that anyway), I definitely feel better after I've been on it for 10 minutes.  When I first started using it, I would stand with my feet about 14-15 inches apart, and an hour or so later would feel my back hurting a bit and I couldn't have the speed any higher than about 5 or 6.  So figured out that since this oscillates up and down from left to right (like a superfast see-saw), I would try standing with my feet much closer together.  The up and down movement would be greatly lessened so it wouldn't put so much pressure on the back after the 10 minute stand.  This worked beautifully and now as long as I keep my feet only about 4" apart I can turn the speed up much higher, it seems to eliminate residual stress in my system, and my back does not hurt at all after using it.  So how you place your feet and your posture also is very important in how you will feel after using this vibration plate.  I have yet to get my bone density rechecked so not sure if it has helped that or not, but I really like this machine a lot, am very glad we bought it and plan to keep using it for as long as it lasts.

title: Handy protective set
text:
At just 3.75” long x 1.5” wide this Sabre stun gun is a convenient size that is easy to hold. The flashlight is bright, and to activate the stun jolt just requires the unit be in the ON position, then press the jolt button. This unit is easy to recharge by sliding the button on the bottom to bring out the electrical plug, and then plugging into a standard outlet. I tested a quick jolt into the air and the unit seems to work fine. I like the patriotic design and also the smooth glossy finish on this item, it feels good to hold. It comes with a little belt case with a Velcro close. The sewing fabrication of the case was rather sloppy, but the stun gun does fit into it well without being too tight, and the case also has a loop so can easily be worn on a belt. The case with stun gun inside is fairly small and inconspicuous which I really like.

The pepper gel spray is a handy size canister and stands just slightly under 4” tall. It has a clip for pocket or belt, and the cap has a safety that you need to flip to the right before you can engage the “Press” button. I’m glad this is a gel as opposed to the spray making it safer for the user. I also like the fact that it has a long expiration date of 4 years.

title: Durable and lightweight rollers
text:
I have to say this is quite a cool little set of rollers! But you really need to be careful using them if you have never used anything like these before. You need a mat or rug, and knee pads would also be very helpful.
These rollers are very lightweight – only 1.5 pounds each weighed on a postal scale, and they don’t even feel that heavy. Each is 7.5” wide from wheel end to wheel end, and the length of the handle grip is 5.5” so wide enough to accommodate most hands. The diameter of the wheels is 5.5”. The rollers are very durable, the grips comfortable to hold, and there are quite a few ways you can use these. Really like these a lot!

title: Worth the money!
text: My son loves to fish and recently moved to an apartment that has a large lake within walking distance. He has bought a fishing kayak and when I saw these Fishing Pliers/Scissors, I thought they would be perfect. They are not big - only 4.8 inches, which is a good size to keep in a small tackle box on a kayak. He was happy to get these and thought they would be a great multifunctional tool to have. We were both right! They work perfect to get a fish hook out of the fish's mouth - I think the small size worked in favor of that. They are very easy to manipulate in the fish's mouth. They also worked great for cutting the line. The handle has a lock so they won't come open unless you need the to. These pliers would be a great asset to anyone's tackle box! I hope this review was useful. This is a disclosure as required that I received this item at a discount. I am in no way required or influenced by the seller to leave positive remarks. In exchange, I put the item received to use as intended and then provide an honest review in exchange. I offer honest feedback to the best of my ability. I am not overly critical of items when reviewing them so when I do deduct a star, the item has really not met my expectations. I do hope this was found to be helpful. Always take note of why a person liked or disliked a product, rather than going off the star system alone. Many products can be used with different intentions, and the way you intend to use something or what you need it to accomplish may not be what the person reviewing the item used and rated it for.

text: I’ve never actually played this before now. Out of the box it’s pretty easy to assemble; the hardest part for me was getting the length of the strings right. It was hard for me to get the hang of at first but like other games in this line there’s always a little trick to learn on how to properly toss the ring. I bought these for my family to be able to go camping and have some additional padding under our sleeping bags, as well as to insulate from the ground temperature. While we haven't had opportunity to camp with them yet, I have tested the product out in the house.

At first, I wasn't sure about the inflation, but being inexperienced with this type of product, I really didn't know what to expect (would it inflate like an air mattress, or would inflation be minimal?). When I first unrolled it, it didn't seem to inflate, even after the 3-5 minutes described in the instructions. Then I realized I unrolled it with the valve closed, and the instructions state to unroll with the valve open. So, I rolled it back, squeezing out what air had entered it, then proceeded to unroll again with the valve open. After several minutes, I came back, put it on the floor and tested it. It had inflated significantly more (don't expect an air mattress), though still remained thin. For me it was fairly comfortable on its own, and with my sleeping bag on top of it, it was more than comfortable enough for camping.

After testing it for comfort on the hard floor in my house, I rolled it back up, and a lot of air came out. It was easy to roll and easily went back into its carry bag, which is a big plus (too many products never fit back in their original packaging).

So, short of knowing how it would do on the ground outside in cold weather, I'd say this product was worth the purchase. It seems to be made of high-quality material, and it provides added comfort for sleeping in a sleeping bag.

I don't know if my callus issues were a result of improper sizing, as the gloves did seem a little large. That said, I followed the sizing instructions provided, and the gloves were fairly comfortable.

title: I love my Polar M400
text:
I love my Polar M400. It does a great job of tracking my heart rate, it's easy to read, and I love all the features (I'm sure there are many I'm not even aware of yet). This device is incredibly customizable, and alerts, while not silent, are not obnoxious or loud either. It is a little large, but for a man, not so much that it looks bad. It's actually fairly attractive even just as a watch (though if you aren't going to use it as a fitness device, don't spend the money on it just for use as a watch).

As far as exercise tracking, I do find that I occasionally forget to start it recording, but that is my own fault and really not much different from any other trackers out there. I would like to see some other types of activities available, such as jumping rope (this is even an activity it recommends to reach your goal, so why not be able to record it?). I sometimes use my speed rope for warm-up and for cardio, and the only selection I can really make for recording this activity while using the heart rate monitor is "Other Indoor". I'd also love to see a way to move more easily from one exercise to another, rather than having to completely stop recording then go back in and select the next exercise. I know the V800 has such a feature, so I can't imagine it would take much more than a software update. Since the V800 has other features not available on the M400, I wouldn't think adding this to the M400 would detract from V800 sales. Those who want the additionally functionality offered by the V800 are likely looking beyond just quick changes between exercises. Either way, it's still not a deal breaker for me, nor is it difficult to transition.

I have not experienced the sync issues others have complained about. I did have trouble once, but it was of my own doing as to when I enabled bluetooth on my phone to start the sync.

I love the fitness test, because I like having an idea of my VO2 Max. If you do any kind of heart rate training, you're probably familiar with this concept, and it also gives a good "summary" view of your overall cardiovascular health. I believe this is also what allows the M400 to be able to fairly accurately determine your calorie burn whether during exercise or just regular daily activity.

As far as the heart rate monitoring, I have no reason to believe it is inaccurate in any way. I used to use a Sportline META 1075 which I loved! I loved having it act both as my MP3 player while I exercised, and I loved having it read out my heart rate to me audibly. That said, the Sportline only gave me time exercising, max heart rate, min heart rate, and average heart rate. The Polar provides SO much more information that, while I miss having my heart rate "announced" to me, I find the additional information from the Polar much more useful. I also love the graphs of my heart rate. This is something the Sportline could not provide, as it didn't record the information or allow for transfer to another device. Aside from resistance training (for which I also like knowing my heart rate), I do both heart rate-based and interval training. It's great to be able to see a graph of your heart rate as it peaks and recovers during intervals to see how your cardio vascular system is improving. It's also nice to see things like your running pace, average and max, and a graph of it, over the duration of your run. These are things I haven't had before, and it is interesting again to see not only how I am doing, but how I am progressing, as I can go back and compare current workouts to previous ones.

I've also had no problem with the water resistance. I haven't worn the device swimming, but I have forgotten to take it off while showering, and it hasn't had any issues.

I would definitely recommend this device for any fitness enthusiast!

title: Good basic kit for one
text:
Received it today in preparation for an upcoming trip, so this is coming from one use - lunch time.

Upon opening, the pots and pans are tiny! If you're a large hungry man, you'll need a bigger set unless you just plan on boiling water for dehydrated meals. Handles seem strong enough to lift as much that fits without bending. Pot has 8, 12, 16 ounce markings readable from the inside. Then pan/lid combo is nice, however I'd like to see the pot go up to 24 ounces, with a shallower pan lid. It seems just slightly too deep for a pan.

The stove is a jet burner. It oxidized after the first use, but I didn't buy it for looks so whatever. It puts out a ton of heat. I really like the wide burner instead of a narrow one to prevent hot spots. On a simmer, the flame will heat the entire bottom of this pot set, awesome!

Trial run: couscous with a few fresh veggies mixed in. Put 4 oz of water in to boil for the couscous on my deck. Started the stove, ran inside to grab a spoon to stir with and it was boiling by the time I got back. Great! Moved the pot aside to let it simmer a bit with the couscous in (3 oz). Mixed in a few (5) cherry tomatoes, some carrot slices, a little bit of white onion, a little garlic and a teaspoon of olive oil into the little pan lid. Put that on and stirred that around for a few minutes. Rotated back to the couscous and then the veggies again one more time. Mixed it all together for a decent sized lunch. Not super filling, but plenty. Could have added plenty more couscous if I was hungrier.

What I didn't like:

The pot and pan cooled almost immediately. Great for cleanup, not so great when you're cooking in both.

The valve control is touchy. Everyone said this about this stove but the problem is not the valve, but the foldout control. As you turn it, if it bends in or out, the gas can turn up or down. With a little practice and focus, it can easily simmer on a low setting.

All in all, I feel like this is a decent set. Should last for plenty of trips where you don't need to cook for anyone else.

title: Good for car camping
text:
It's a camping stove with two burners. It isn't going to replace your in home stove, but it works well and doesn't take up a lot of space. Heating up coffee in the percolator while making eggs. Making pasta and a stir fry... The list goes on.

The wind screens help a lot, but you have to use the stove cover as the third screen to fully block the wind. The grate is fully removable for easy cleaning. The two burners put out plenty of heat, the pots and pans make a bigger difference for heat control. The control knobs work well, but be careful - you have to watch the flame when adjusting.

One fuel canister lasted me about 3 days cooking breakfast and dinner, then hot drinks later at night. Over three 3-day trips, I've used 4 canisters total.

title: Good value
text:

Take down was a breeze as well.

Haven't actually used it yet so I won't give it 5 stars, but it looks well made and should handle plenty of car camping. Good size for two adults, all the gear, and maybe a dog as well.

Has two doors, both with a screen. The bottom half of the doors have a fly to cover the zipper, since the rainfly doesn't come all the way down. The zipper does get snagged on this occasionally if you're not careful. If the rainfly is off, the two walls are screened to get plenty of airflow through the tent.

Overall, seems like a good buy for the price, but definitely not top notch quality.

title: Perfect day bag.
text:
For a daypack, this is a great bag. Purchased from a Columbia outlet for under $30, but I'd be willing to spend up to $75 on this bag.

On the outside, there are a ton of straps on it, it might take you a little while to get it comfortable, but once you do, you won't notice it is there. The sternum strap has slides to sit comfortably on your chest. The shoulder straps are made of a foam/mesh combo. They can be a little rigid at first, but after a number of wearings mine have become comfortable. They also have two straps at the top, to adjust how the shoulder straps sit on you. The waist strap is the least comfortable, as it is just the nylon strap and a buckle, but it does a good job at taking some of the weight off of your shoulders. There are pullcords to strap things to, like hiking poles if you need to. The back is rigid, yet comfortable. I usually put water bottles in it, and in my older bag they would press against my back causing aches. This bag has a rigid back to stop whatever is in the bag from pressing against you, but then has comfortable padding to keep you going.

To the inside, there are three pockets, the main one, one for your phone, keys, etc, and the one on the front, which has two zippers. I use this for the sunblock, bugspray, all the frequently used things. The main compartment has a sleeve for a bladder though it does not come with one.

Storage wise, it is plenty for a day long adventure for one where the weather might change, or plenty of room for a few people when no clothing is needed. I've hiked 4+ hours with this bag, carrying food/drink for four people total. The straps took all the weight off of my shoulders. I've also had enough room to bike to work, with a full change of clothes and toiletries, and a water bottle.

I haven't had to use the rain-fly yet, but it will cover the entire pack when it is full.

The 'backdraft' is useless. You'll sweat just as much. The only benefit, is that once you do start sweating, it's mesh against padding, so it'll dry quickly.

All in all, I'd buy this bag again if it broke on me.

I did find that the pole adjustment locks took some getting used to.  You have to turn a knob and then flip the clip to lock it into position. If you tighten the screw too much then there is too much tension and you can't flip the clip, so you have to go back and loosen the screw a bit more and then try again. Once I got the hang of it, it was fairly simple. I would suggest doing it before you leave the house. I'd also suggest leaning hard on each pole to be sure it's locked firmly.  Also, when putting the mud guards on, it helps to screw them on to the threads at the pole bases and then push on firmly. I lost one mudguard (in some really deep mud.) It's great for the backyard or take along for camping trips, the beach, park, etc. Roundnet involves a mini trampoline, a ball and your hands. It's tricky to learn and to play, but this is the best of both roundnet and pickleball. The sides around the trampoline mean that you have to work a little more challenging to make the ball bounce out. It's a surprisingly great workout, when I thought it would be less exercise because the game area is smaller. Not as much running across the court, but more arm movement and faster reflexes and short movements to get to the ball, so I hurt in places that pickleball didn't find!
I love how conveniently this all folds up for transportation! SO much easier than trying to set up a net and mark off a court. Also, we've had tons of interest and people asking where we got this!
