Also, the discs need to be replaced with foam pieces to keep them from clanging loosely inside, but there is no storage bag - a ziplock worked for me, but it's just not pretty. If you just leave them as-is without  messing with the insides, these are pretty good. They grip easily, and since these are covered in neoprene, they're so much safer than some of the nasty chemical filled plastic coatings found on dumbbells.

title: Weak, unreliable.
text: I got these to attach the side panels of my canopy to the canopy itself. A simple job for them, not much weight to carry, this should have been easy. Two of the set had springs that broke, or were not properly installed, rendering the carabiner useless. Another one fractured on its main body, making it totally useless. At this point I removed them and replaced them with a metal set that has not let me down.

title: Easily test and inflate anywhere
text: : A couple of days ago, my “TPMS” light came on. I was able to connect this to each tire to find the culprit, then quickly and easily increase the pressure until it was where it should be. It is noisy, but it is also small and very convenient, charges from a USB connector.

title: So roomy!
text: I'm not a huge fan of camping, but I go along once in a while for spending time with friends who love it. This is a big roomy tent - not sure what a six person tent should be like, but this sleeps 4 adults with room for gear. I love the big opening for easy loading. I like the attached poles because I hate trying to find all the parts when stuff isn't all together. This keeps it all in place until setup. I knew I would never be able to get this back in the case, so I took photos of each step as I unfolded and then reversed that and it fit!

title: trampoline - but 2in1?
text: This is a very sturdy and well made trampoline. It was easy to assemble and the handle folds easily. It's great indoor exercise for littles on rainy days, or anytime! The handle makes it easy for toddlers to bounce without falling off. It took me a long time to work out what they meant by 2in1, but there's a little border with a road printed around the edge, so it's meant to double as a play mat? That's just the dumbest thing I've seen! It's cute, but really a useless 'selling point'. It's a cool trampoline, and that's it.

title: So thick & cushy
text: I love the softness and thickness of this mat. I'm never comfortable on a hard floor, so this gives that extra padding to make floor work more comfy. The strap is great for carrying this, and though it is a little thicker, it's still lightweight. Also easy to wipe clean.

title: Cute & fun
text: This is a cute little scooter that's fun for the littles, and good for their balance and dexterity. I love that it lights up in use, but the littles really never get to play with that since it really only shows at night. Regardless of the lights, this is a sturdy well made scooter that's adjustable as they grow.

title: Strong, secure, and shiny!
text: These are great. They are strong, the springs are firm, but not too stiff, and they have a threaded “cover” that you can tighten to lock them in place. All of which makes them excellent (at least, for my needs). I tried twisting and pulling them to break or bend them. Nothing happened, they are solid. And they are bright colors, which can be useful for identification.

title: Easy to build, very sturdy
text: I like this bike. It was very easy to assemble. It is well built, a great introduction to cycling for little ones. Will last a few years before they outgrow it. Plenty of learning and playing opportunities for parent and child.

title: Good activity, but balls fall out
text: I love this for indoor agility exercises for little ones and adults alike! It adds an extra incentive to work on balance and coordination at the same time. Toys don't have to be electronic to grab kids attention and this is a perfect example. The only issue I have with it is the balls falling out, so keep a close eye on that!

title: 28 miles on one charge!
text: This is a great little scooter. It's silent, will take you safely for almost 30 miles, is easy to stop, corner, mount and dismount. It is well made, with strong connections and strong components. The lights and brake lights work well. It will carry you at just over 16 miles per hour, and the suspension will make the ride quite smooth.

title: Easy to set up
text: This camping table is pretty easy to set up and fold away. It's sturdy and so much nicer than the last camping table I had. It even has a hole for an umbrella but does not come with an umbrella.

title: Love the cooler inset!
text: This is a great camping table, especially the cup holders and the inset cooler for more drinks! It's well made with quality materials and can hold up to lost of weekend getaways. I love how easy it is to set up and break down, and it folds up tiny into a small trave bag.

title: Love it but...
text: The padded cover doesn't fit into the case. If it would, I would definitely give this a solid 5 star. It's very comfortable and easy to set up. It's also a little heavy, but the extra strength adds to the solid frame that makes sleeping on this comfortable. That cover makes it very plush, but is awkward and bulky.

title: Great for smaller exercise equipment
text: I have a lot of exercise equipment like balance discs, small weights, thigh and arm exercisers, pulleys & resistance bands and this is a great organizer for all that! I had them all in a deep basket which was hard to maneuver with all the stuff down in it, so with this, it's all organized and easy to find everything. It rolls easily and takes up a small floor space.

title: Great for my stationary bike
text: I love that with this desk, I can ride my exercise bike that's taller - standing desk height, and work or watch videos. I can also use it as a standing desk. It's sturdy at nay height and makes a flexible work space perfect!

title: Easy assembly, comes with everything
text: This is a great bike for the first few bike years, it includes training wheels and a kickstand for when the training wheels come off. The seat and handle bars both move up as your child grows, too. Also has a bell and adorable basket. It took one person about 15 minutes to assemble, and then adjust to the kiddo's size. We and kiddo are super happy with this bike!

title: Excellent Quality
text: This is a great, sturdy scooter for ages 8-adult (weight limit 176 lbs.) and grows very easily with your child into teen years and beyond! It's very well made and easy to fold to carry. Non skid surface and excellent brakes!

title: Great little scooter
text: This is a cute little scooter that's great for beginners! It's built for littler kids in size and skill, so they've limited the turning range. Kids can turn by leaning, and they catch on quick! The light up wheels could be fun but aren't very visible during the day. Sturdy and well made.

title: Superior quality
text: This is super sturdy and excellent quality. It's well made and takes very little time to assemble. This is professional regulation sized, and great for any level experience.

title: Comfortable
text: This is a great chair with the extra pad on it. I just wish the pad would fit into the carry bag as well, but otherwise it's fine. Easy to set up and fold, and nice for lounging at the park or beach.

title: Very impressive quality
text: I was reluctant to try an inflatable stand up paddle board over a hard shell, but this is super impressive! It's much sturdier than I expected and easy to inflate and deflate. The best thing about an inflatable is that if you don't have a car with roof rack or storage in your home, this just what you need! The carry case will fit in smaller cars and you can store it in a closet. This is well made with quality materials that have stood up to several uses so far with no visible or functional damage or wear. Looks as good as new after about 8 uses.

title: Love that it folds up
text: This is a great quality treadmill. It's surprisingly sturdy for a folding treadmill. It was easy to assemble and is great for small spaces. Works great and is incline adjustable.

title: Great plank assist
text: This is a great balance tool to help you perform several exercises better. I love that it has a place you can put your phone for watching exercise videos while you work out and your phone won't slide off. Well made and sturdy. Works great.

title: Great indoor/outdoor activity
text: This is a nice setup for staying active both indoors or out. It's easy to set up and to deflate when not in use. Soft footballs are great for indoor play, and in the right conditions, perfectly safe! (Hint: avoid areas with small kids, pets, and lamps!)

title: Keeps water cold!
text: I love that this is so well insulated that water stays cold for over 3 hours. It has a 1.5 L insulated reservoir and can hold several other bottles of water or sports drinks and your other needs like keys & wallet. It's well made with quality materials and built to last.

title: So adjustable
text: This is a really versatile weight set for small spaces and for beginners. It's easy to adjust, and takes up a small amount of space, but is easy to change up as needed. It's comfortable and well padded, and great quality.

title: Unique concept, fun game
text: This is a great concept and a lot of fun once you're over the learning curve! I love that it's an active play game that keeps you moving, but it's also simple and can be played on any surface. Portable and well made.

title: Great for any outdoor use
text: Say you're an outdoor enthusiast that likes more sedentary outdoor activities that involve lots of sitting - fishing, hunting, etc. This is THE chair for you! It's lightweight and easy to set up and comfortable for longer periods of sitting than most outdoor folding chairs. Say you're a weekend sports parent that sits on the sidelines - this is also the perfect chair for you for all the same reasons! Camping, or even just backyard bbqs, this is a great outdoor chair!

title: Good beginner bench
text: This is a good starting place for someone who wants to begin an exercise routine that includes a workout bench. It's sturdy enough for lightweight use, but once you get to the point where you want to use heavier weights, it's time to move up to a sturdier bench. It's foldable, so easy to put out of the way if you're short on space. The foldability alone is what makes this a beginner bench, as it's less sturdy than a solid frame.

title: Very Easy Setup and Fold Down
text: This camp cot is so easy to use! It's super lightweight and portable with included carry bag, but also very sturdy. Comfortable for up to 300 lbs. I love the side pocket for holding a phone, book and flashlight. Perfect for people who love camping but hate sleeping on the hard ground. Super quality and workmanship up to Coleman standards.

title: Great for backpacking or biking
text: I love the filtration quality of anything by LifeStraw, so this is an excellent collaboration. It works great after a simple priming process, and filters anything out of stream or any water you refill from along your outdoor journeys. Excellent quality materials and workmanship, lightweight and sturdy.

title: Nice slim design
text: I really love these for individual lunch boxes for keeping food chilled. They're also thin enough to slip around food in a picnic style basket. Super sturdy and easy to clean between uses. I love having a set of 4, enough for a big road trip bag on a weekend, refreeze and use in four different lunch bags during the week!

title: Nice road trip/picnic bag
text: I really love this bag for a lunch at the park, or a road trip cooler. It's really pretty and holds a lot of food inside. I love that it can hold two bottles of wine on the side! Nice space in the outside extra pockets for food that doesn't need to stay chilled or utensils.

title: Awesome cooler bag
text: This not only looks really cool, it keeps up to 24 cans cool! It's super easy to keep clean with a removable hard liner that also prevents leaks from melted ice. It's super sturdy and well made, and also great for an entire picnic meal.

title: More fun than Cornhole
text: This is a great game indoors or out, in your yard, at the park, or camping! It's easy for all ages, and everyone loves playing. It folds flat into the included backpack, and can go just about anywhere. The game tower is sturdy and well made. The beanbags are just like hackey sacks. Play from all angles instead of just aiming the same direction at a board. It's easy to play right out of the backpack!

title: Great quality bike
text: This bike is an excellent value. It's more adjustable than any at-home bike I've used. the height range is great for all sizes from 4'3"to 6'6" up to 350 lbs. The display is easy to use and to see, and there's plenty of room for a larger tablet. Good resistance and super comfortable!

title: Great bike, tools weren't included
text: This is a great little balance bike, but it was a pain to put together since the tools that were supposed to be included were not in the box. I finally found an Allen key and wrench that would work, but that was frustrating. The bike is well made with quality materials and will last. The basket is a cute addition.

title: Nice fit, comfortable
text: I like that these are more like the shape of an athletic shoe, so they keep your ankle more free to move. They're a much better no-show shape since they can easily be pulled off and on and do not ride down.

title: A really good home gym investment.
text: This is so easy to use, there is no excuse!. You twist the handle to get the weight you want. If you need to move down to a lower weight, it is easy, and makes me feel less guilty! If you want a bit more weight, and other twist and there you are. Enough to easily push yourself, or wind down.

title: This is great for camping or for emergency.
text: I like to have a fan going 24/7, and when the power goes out, I'm stuck feeling stuffy. This is a great little fan for that, and for camping. It can hang in a tent and the light is nice & bright. Even charges your devices. Handy gadget to have around!

title: Easy to assemble, great stability
text: This is one of those devices that you don't realize you need until you try it! I'm not great with my form when doing squats, so this is an excellent tool for me. It allows me to stay in position as I exercise. It was very easy to assemble, and it's sturdy but lightweight enough to move as needed. Also has bars at the back for push ups or planks.

title: Awesome quality for the sports minded parent
text:
When comparing this to the few high-end multi-sport trailers/strollers on the market, this has a huge advantage. It's a great value for what it does. This set is basically the jogging stroller frame and cover. You can add sporting kits to this for cross-country skiing, cycling, or hands-free running to cover the multi-sport uses.

The frame is super sturdy and adjusts high or low, depending on your preference. The handle also adjusts up or down for a comfortable personalized height. The suspension on this is amazing, and it rides very smoothly. This also folds down pretty small with easily removable wheels to fit into the trunk of a car or back of SUV.

Less important, but a feature I love is that you can mix and match the covers and frames for the exact look you want. Some of the color options are so gorgeous! I love the quality of the materials and workmanship. It was easy to assemble, only zipping the cover over was a little tricky but easy enough to figure out with just a little muscle to zip the last bit on the top cover.

title: Lightweight but sturdy
text: I love how much more lightweight this step is than my last one! It's easier to get out of the closet and put back when I'm done. It's also easy to adjust up or down as needed. It's sturdy and well made, and adjusts to three different levels.

title: Super adjustable!
text: I love how easy this is to adjust as you get stronger! This is such a great concept for fitness. Instead of having a bunch of different kettlebells, you can simply remove or add sections as needed. Easy to change, but also won't just come apart. The pieces stay in place until you want to change.

title: Pretty, nice coverage
text: These masks fit right over your nose and chin without slipping, and I love that my glasses don't fog up when wearing them. The only thing I don't like is that I can't just put it on quickly - it takes a lot of adjustment to get it on just right. I rarely have time to fiddle with masks and just want to pull it on and off as needed.

title: Awesome beach/park chairs
text: These are very well made beach chairs! I love the wood handles, and that they're each lightweight enough to easily carry. The drink holder and snack pouches are a great addition! These are made from quality materials and built to last. I love the multi-position adjustments for comfort, including fully reclined.

title: Super easy setup
text: These are perfect for beach or tailgating. They hold drinks and plates for four, and they set up and break down really easily, too. Also great for a picnic at the park! This fits right into the half-circle bag for easy toting, too.

title: ok, but not very smooth
text: I got this for my elderly parents to get exercise from a comfortable chair. My mom had a hard time using it because the pedals didn't move smoothly, but kept 'sticking' at one place as she pedaled. Changing the resistance didn't help her at all, either. She's learning to use it anyway, but it's a struggle for her.

title: So easy to assemble and use
text: Often. I've had exercise equipment that I'll end up not using because it's bulky and in the way. I love that this folds up out of the way, then easily unfolds for use. Best part - I like to watch TV while I use it, and it's perfectly comfortable for that with back rest. I can also get some arm exercise while riding with the resistance bands. Sturdy, well made, perfect for smaller spaces!

title: So fun, great safety featured
text: This is a super sturdy, great electric scooter for kids 6-12+. It's easy to use and works great! Good speed and battery life, too. up to 7 miles at 7.5MPH. It looks gorgeous all lit up, too! It's super stable and comfortable to grip without slipping. Recharges in 4.5 hrs.

title: Move over cornhole, there's a new bean bag toss game!
text: This is a great concept, and the board is just gorgeous! Nice smooth wood that folds makes this easy to use and store. I love that it's got carrying handles to make this really portable. It's a lot of fun for the whole family!

title: Great quality, sturdy
text: This is really sturdy and well made. It's fairly easy to both assemble and break down, so you can take it to the park with you, or set it up in your yard. It's solid with dual-layer chains and the right size for both beginners or pros.

title: Too hard to open and close the latch
text: This is really difficult to open and close the latch over the button. That makes this useless to me since I drink all day long. Once unlatched, the button pops the lid open, and that works easily, but it's not as secure. Not something I'd recommend.

title: A little too firm, complicated setup
text: So I've only ever used ice packs that come ready to use, and usually soft enough to bend a little around things. This was confusing to start with - fill with water, only a certain amount, plug, twist on top... and they they froze hard - not really bendable around food in lunch boxes. They're ok but I won't get these again.

title: Super sturdy, great for 8+
text: This is an awesome looking scooter for kids and teens. It is sturdy and the dual hand brake works great. The deck is large and non-slip, so it's nice & safe. Well made with quality materials and built to last!

title: Great for lunches on the beach!
text: Grab a couple of Sport-Brella chairs and one of these for an easy lunch on the beach! This table is super lightweight and easy to take along to the beach, even for a quick lunch break. Sets up in seconds, and has 2 mesh cup holders, even a little cargo package, and a bottle opener! It's super sturdy and you can easily level it in the sand.

title: Comfortable chair, roomy backpack
text: The straps on this took a little adjusting to make it comfortable, but once we did that, it's great! The backpack is roomy enough to carry lunch in it. The three position backrest is great for watching the waves, or kicking back, or even napping! This is great quality, and comfortable for both a smaller person, and a larger 200 lb person. Sturdy and very well made.

title: Easy assembly, easy to fold and switch
text: This is a great little bike that transforms from a toddler balance bike into a bike with training wheels, and then without the training wheels. It also folds for easy storage and transportation. This will save you from having to buy two different bikes since it easily switches from one mode to another.

title: Makes hydration easy
text: This is great for helping you stay hydrated without having to remember how much water you've had! You can keep this in the fridge and fill your glass or tumbler as the day progresses, and see how much you have had and still need to drink by the fun, encouraging markings on the side. This makes an excellent gift, too.

title: These work great, super sturdy
text: These buckets are really surprisingly sturdy. They also collapse easily and carry over 2 1/2 gallons of water. Great for so many things - holding drinks on ice, cleaning, gardening, etc. Durable and very well made.

title: Compact, good for game room
text: This is not exactly arcade quality, but for the value, it's fun at-home family time! This was fairly easy to assemble and works ok, not what you'd find in professional units, but good for the price. It has everything you need included, and works right out of the box.

title: Super fast and easy assembly
text: This was really quick to put together, and it's sturdy and stable for the tiniest of tots to ride. It's got a small range for turning so littles won't topple over, too. Lightweight enough for them to carry on their own.

title: Super sturdy and adjustable
text: I love that this was really easy to assembleand it's secure and sturdy. It is also really ajustable for your customization for various workouts and positions. I also love that it folds up for storage easily!

title: SUper easy setup and sturdy
text: These were easy to assemble and the instructions were simple and clear. They're sturdy, functional and well made with quality materials. They have a solid grip, so no slipping. Great addition to a home gym!

title: Stable, sturdy
text: This bench is just what I needed - stable and sturdy, but also foldable. When your workout space is a guestroom, you have to adapt, and this was perfect for the job!  Well made with quality materials.

title: Great for kids or adults
text: I love this balance board as an adult because I can exercise with it and not slip! It's got a nice felt bottom, and the handles make it much easier to grip when I'm stretching or bending. I love the solid quality of this wobble board. I'm improving in balance and coordination as I work with it! ALso would make a great wobble board for the kiddos!!

title: Easy install, super sturdy
text: This, like everything Thule makes, is super sturdy and well made with quality materials. It's easy to install and to use and adjusts easily.

title: Perfect for big campers, or as a guest bed
text: This is a super heavy-duty cot for large people, up to 330 lbs. It's VERY sturdy and secure, and large enough to comfortably sleep on for any sized person. It's easy to fold and unfold, and about 20 lbs to carry. FOlds up fast, slips right into the carry bag, and you're good to go!

title: Super sturdy, well made
text: This is a great, flexible balance board set with multiple uses. I love how much this is helping me with my physical therapy. It's very well made with quality, sturdy materials and built to last through hard use!

title: Every kid needs one of these
text: These wobble boards are so great for indoor exercise in bad weather, for imaginative play, sliding, rocking, even as a resting space for reading! Make bridges and tunnels, so much to do with one solid, well-made, sturdy board! I also love the felt bottom of this to prevent slipping. This is also great for balance physical therapy and can be used by kids to adults up to 300 lbs.

title: Super cute trampoline!
text: This is so cute, and great for indoor or outdoor fun for kids up to 10, but mostly for toddlers, probably just one at a time. It was a little challenging to build but worth the effort. The zipper is at the back of the panda face, so consider that when it comes to placement.

title: Nice quality, great indoors or out
text: This was quite an ordeal to put together, but so worth it! It's not going to be easy to take down, so decide before building if you want it indoors or out! It's super sturdy and well designed. Safe for one kid, maybe 2 small ones, under 110 lbs total. Great exercise and loads of fun!!

title: Excellent quality
text: This is not your average home croquet set! It's super sturdy and strong, the wooden pieces are heavyweight, high-quality mallets and posts. Every piece is of professional quality. This is a must-have for your socially distanced outdoor spring and summer parties!

title: Great indoor hallway entertainment
text: This is great for game rooms, but we have a hallway that rarely gets used except for passing from one room to another. Now that we've placed this on one wall, the hallway is now a hangout! The space is perfect for this game with plenty of room for the game. The electronic part works great, and the darts are good once assembled, which was not much work at all.

title: Ok quality, fun indoor activity
text: This isn't the strongest, best quality indoor golf practice green, but it's a good value and lots of fun in bad weather or just for some indoor fun and practice. Good for kids or adults and makes a great gift!

title: Excellent quality
text: I've had a few home-use croquet sets in the past, but none compare in quality to these! They're super sturdy and well made. Solid, quality workmanship in every detail. These are for serious players! I love that everything fits right into the carry bag. The only thing missing is a stand, but not something that's necessary. I'm thoroughly impressed with the quality.

title: Awesome little scooter
text: This is such a cool little scooter that is a breeze to assemble - just insert handle! The little ones love the flashing wheels that are powered by their movement. It's sturdy and well built, and will hold up to tough little ones!

title: Good for stunts, not for commuting
text: This is a good scooter for what it is - a stunt scooter for the beginner or more experienced users. It's not foldable, so not great for commuting, and it's not height adjustable, so won't last that long when it comes to the growth of your child. Maybe best for tweens and up.

title: Super cute, fun little Blue attached
text: This is a really cute little scooter! It's well made and has fun Blues print on the board, and the little attached blue wiggles as your little one rides along. It was super easy to assemble with a Philips head screwdriver.

title: Great quality, super adjustable
text: I love the quality of this scooter. It's perfect for little ones as young as 8, and it will adjust up to adult-sized, transitioning as they grow. It's good for adults up to 220 lbs, so also good for teens and students to go from public transportation to their final destination by scooter. Well made and super sturdy, and folds super easily.

title: Super easy to set up & comfortable
text: I hate sleeping on the ground! It's always so uncomfortable! This is perfect for camping. It's in an easy-to-carry tote, and is easy to set up in seconds! No loose parts, just all one unit. It's also great to have around for when the grandkids come for overnight stays if you don't have spare beds. Super sturdy and holds up to 225 lbs.

title: Amazing electric scooter
text: This is a great way to get around town, especially on campus. It's easy to use and to fold for carrying. It works great, with long battery life. Charges fast & easily. Simple to assemble, with just a few screws. Great quality and workmanship.

title: Easy to assemble, great kids scooter
text: This is a great scooter to last as your kids grow. It's sturdy and well made, and grows in height, but I think it might not support over 200 lbs. It doesn't state weight limits, so I have no idea if it's suitable for larger people. The design is pretty focused on kids and maybe early teens.

title: Great for small spaces
text: Sure, I'd love a high-end home gym, but I'd need a high-end home to have room for it. This is a basic stepper without a huge range of ability levels, but it's great for starting a fitness routine at home when you don't have much room. It's compact and fits into a corner, under a (high) bed, or in the closet, but I leave it out so I'll use it! It's great for working all sorts of muscles and is a great addition to my walking routine. No instructions for how to set it up, but it's pretty easy to work out.

title: No English instructions
text: The instructions were very frustrating for this because they were all in Chinese. It took a lot of muscle to push the front wheel in place. The Assembly of the handle was much easier. It's super cute and sturdy, and of good quality. Just harder to assemble than expected.

title: Great for camping or dog washing
text: This is a great outdoor shower for camping, or for washing dogs outside. It holds enough water for a quick shower and is a light, but just enough pressure. Super easy to set up and use.

title: Sturdy & well made
text: This is such a great thing for kids to learn balance and coordination, but best of all, they find so many other ways to play with it! Bridges, tunnels, so much more! It's super sturdy and well made & built to last. Fun indoor exercise equipment, and also great for physical therapy.

title: Easy assemble table
text: This camping table is really easy to set up and tear down. It's well made with quality materials and built to last. I love how easily it folds back up into the carrying case. It took two of us the first time to work out the top, but once we did, it's easy enough for one person every time. This washes up easily, too. Great for tailgating, park picnics, and makes a great snack table for kids' sports practices.

title: Great indoors or out!
text: These are awesome for building your kids an indoor climbing wall, or for use on a play gym or outside wall. Super strong and well-made pieces. Your kids will love learning to climb with these holds!

title: Great lightweight camp chair
text: This is such a nice lightweight chair for camping or hiking. It's super lightweight and really easy to set up. It's surprisingly sturdy enough to hold 225 lbs for such a light chair! Folds up into a little carry bag that can hang off your backpack.

title: Pretty good lightweight punching bag
text: This is great for lightweight boxing training. It's semi-sturdy, but has a good bounce back, so be careful! WOuld be good for kids, too.

title: Great for camping & hiking
text: This is a great hydration pack for camping or hiking. It's well made and very sturdy and collapses super small. You can even add one of several brand filters if you're using it for lake or stream water.

title: Sturdy & lots of fun
text: This is a great little balance board for imaginative play and for motor skills. The handle is great so even little ones can move it around with a nice grip. Well made and super sturdy from quality wood.

title: Perfect camping blanket
text: I'm not a fan of sleeping bags because I have trouble with feeling 'trapped' in a sleeping bag. I'm so happy to find this! I use an open sleeping bag and just use this over me and it's perfect! Also great for campfire time!

title: Great scooter that grows with your child
text: I love how adjustable this is for kids at the age where they grow so fast! They will love the flashing lights this has when it's in motion! It's good quality and lightweight so they can carry this with them when not riding it.

title: Great light weights
text: I like to use these while I'm on the recumbent bike. They're light enough for a few reps of several arm and shoulder exercises I can do while riding to get a more effective workout. I have considered taking these along for my walks, but I like to enjoy walking and not turn it into a workout. Do it if you're after more of a fitness routine, though!

title: Great little balance bike
text: This is a sturdy, well-made toddler balance bike. It's a great way for little ones to learn the first part of using a bike - balance. I love the purple color, too! It's lightweight enough for even a 2-year-old to maneuver at only 5.5 lbs but strong and sturdy enough to hold up to 66 lbs. The tires are foam so don't need inflating.

title: Sturdy, made in USA
text: This is a sturdy, well-made little scooter that toddlers can use indoors or out. It's got a toy storage compartment and is sized perfectly for 1-3 year olds. The base is stable, so no tipping over! Makes a great gift.

title: Great training bike
text: Balance bikes are a great way for little ones to learn the most important part of biking - balance. Once they get that, pedaling comes pretty naturally. This balance bike is well made & super sturdy. It adjusts up as your child grows, too.

title: Great for indoor exercise during cold months
text: This little trampoline is a great way to keep kids active at home when the weather is cold, rainy, or snowing outside. It's sturdy and can hold up to 220 lbs, so even parents can do a little rebounding on it!

title: Sturdy, well made
text: This is a good value for the quality of materials and workmanship. It's super sturdy and works great, from folding and unfolding, braking, and using the kickstand, it's all well designed. Great for 10 to adults, up to 220 lbs. Lightweight enough to fold up and take on the bus with you.

title: Great indoor or outdoor fun!
text: This has been a great family time fun set for both outdoor use on nicer days, and indoors when it's cold and rainy. It's easy to set up and even the littlest ones can get in on the action! The pieces are well made and sturdy, built to last.

title: Fun little workout aide
text: This isn't exactly the sturdiest exercise equipment, but it's an excellent value for a little at-home movement! Great compact indoor waist-trimming exerciser that even the most uncoordinated person can use. Just set it on the ground, step on and twist side to side. That's it! Nothing complicated or awkward, just side-twisting muscle toning!

title: Lightweight & Comfortable
text: These are great for beginners and weaklings like me who are just starting out with punching bag practice. They're comfortable and easy to put on and take off. I'm just starting with kickboxing training, and these are perfect for me.

title: Love clean drinking water from LifeStraw
text:
We have quite a few LifeStraw products for filtering water and love all of them. This tumbler is perfect to take along when you don't know where you'll be getting your drinking water. If I'm out and about and need to fill my water bottle from a water fountain, this will assure I'm getting clear, clean water. The filters last for a long time before needing replacement, and the replacements are reasonably priced.

I also love the company's giving policy. Bringing clean water to communities that don't have access. I strongly support that!

title: Easily goes together, take down for storage
text:
This is very strong! Once assembled it is also very sturdy. It easily lifted my 250lb body, no rocking, wobbling, or creaking (the station bars and me!)
Undo a couple of thumb-screws to disassemble it and of course, to reassemble it. Moving it is easy enough. The finish is excellent and again, very resilient, this will take a lot of abuse!

title: Great for 8+
text: This is a great bigger kid scooter and also for teen to adult. It's well made and easy to fold to carry, so great for bus rides, etc. It's sturdy and well made and adjustable to three positions as your child grows. Even great for bigger kids, since it can hold up to 220 lbs.

title: Fun sturdy kids scooter
text: This is a great kids' scooter, tough enough to hold up to a lot of use. It's great with the lights on the wheels as they spin, but it takes a good speed to get the lights to work well. It's good for ages 3+. Super easy to put together, too.

title: Easy to build and fun to ride
text:
Putting this together took less than five minutes. Everso easy.
Playing with it takes hours and hours! Simple to use this is easy to steer and to stop. A great step-up from walking, get some wheels, and move around easier!

This will help to develop balance and coordination. Plus, don't forget - loys and lots of fun!

title: Fun, paced at the speed you want, filled with laughs and healthy competitiveness!
text:
From unboxing to playing takes about 10 minutes. Or in my case 2 days while I tried to find the right batteries! The game is very sturdy when assembled, but when it is folded up the backing for the "target" is fairly weak.

The game can be enjoyed by players of any age. It really cannot be played very quietly, but it can be played with moderate noise (the sound of the balls hitting the target cannot be done silently! The target works as a fairly good drum!

But when everyone is involved and excited, you cannot hear the game over the fun!

title: A perfect dart board
text:
I really like this. You can tell by the weight that it is a serious dartboard, and once hung you can start throwing darts at it. It is accepting of any dart that hits it squarely, the numbering is solid and this, so as to not to make the board less accepting.
The board is strong and quickly 'heals' from hits.

title: Easy setup, very roomy
text: This is a really interesting tent! It has a sleek, modern look, and it's very roomy, with plenty of room for 4 people! It's fairly easy to set up and to break down, and stores nicely in the included tote. It's super lightweight, too, at just 7 1/2 lbs. Great big doors on each end make it super easy to load and unload.

title: Super lightweight, great for backpacking
text: I love so much about this tent! It's super easy to set up and tear down, and it's so lightweight at just 3-4 pounds, depending on how you want to set it up, which is also cool that you have that flexibility! The carry bag is convenient for storage, too. Super durable and very well designed!

title: Loads of indoor family fun
text: This is a great way to bring the arcade home during stay-at-home orders! It's lightweight and easy to fold up when not in use, and just as easy to open up for play. It's well made and sturdy for the price point and can be used by small kids to the elderly! We had a few glitches at first - like the balls not returning, and we just learned to adjust the parts underneath to keep them returning smoothly. It keeps score for two players at a time & the only thing that's hard about this is waiting for your turn to play!!

title: Best camping mat ever!
text: For such a compact sleeping mat, this is the most comfortable, easy to use camping mat ever! It's got the height required to keep you from feeling the ground below, and none of the annoying noise when you roll over. It self-inflates and deflates fast and easily. Love the superior quality and workmanship that went into this, not to mention the clever inflation/deflation valve. You can also clip two together! It comes with a nice store & carry tote, too.

title: Great for older kids to adults
text: THis is a super sturdy over door basketball hoop that kicks the ball right back to you! It's super sturdy and shatter-resistant, so even the tough guys can use it without too much damage! It's great for office stress relief, or for tweens & teens. Excellent quality product!

title: Excellent for indoor PE
text: This is a great way to keep your kids moving for PE inside during cold months! It's pretty much a yoga mat - thick and comfortable, with games printed on it on both sides. The Hopscotch side is great for exercise and the target and tick tack toe side is great for tossing the well-made sturdy little bean bags. Excellent indoor homeschool fun!

title: Incredibly lightweight and super easy to inflate
text: I was really impressed with the thought process that went into designing these! It's crazy lightweight and tiny, easy to carry in your backpack. The tote bag acts as an inflator to make it easy to fill even at high altitudes. There is no air escaping the valve once inflated. Once it's inflated, it's thin but super comfortable. Deflating is fast and easy, and then it just rolls right back up into the case! Bright and comfortable, this is made from super lightweight poly. I highly recommend this to backpackers or campers. Makes a great gift, too!

title: Love the style and features
text: I'm a long-time Fitbit user, and I've also tried several smartwatches. I like the IDEA of smartwatches, but hate the bulk on my wrist. I find this slim face so much more comfortable than the larger sizes. Besides fitness tracking, it does have some smartwatch features, like letting you know if you have a text or call. It's the fitness tracking that Fitbit has down better than any other trackers. From heart rate to steps, reminders to move, and sleep tracking, this is the best system I've used. The interface and the app are super user friendly. I'm not a swimmer, but I love that this can be worn while swimming, or even in the shower. Sleek, stylish, and does all you need and more. I do like some of the features found in the larger models, but this one is the most comfortable for 24/7 wear to me.

title: You wont know they are "soft" darts
text:
This feels and behaves like a regular dartboard with regular darts.
The sensors are very accurate, and it always gets the score right.
Great for family game night!

title: Its too easy
text:
When I was in my late teens a game of darts involved quite a few beers and quick scribbling to do the math for the scores. Plus, for the novice of the group (usually me!), there was trying to see what score a dart had.
All that is gone (well, you can still involve beer!) the board knows what you scored, And what is left to be scored.
It feels like a real boar. The soft darts react and feel like "real" darts.
A lot of fun. Great for family, great for one, exceptional for friends. Dangerous as a drinking game!

title: Ver nice, complete system.
text:
This is a great family treat. With the case closed, it looks great on a wall, whereas just a dartboard can look, well, untidy.
The doors allow you to track scores, which is very old-school!
The case is well made, looks great opened or closed. Hanging the piece is very easy to do.
The board is well made and easy to play on.
The family loves it, game night often includes the dartboard.

title: Well built for little tough ones
text: This is a perfect little scooter for your tough little tots from 3-6. It doesn't take long for them to learn how to turn and to use the foot brake. Excellent for learning coordination and just plain fun! It's well made and was easy to assemble.

title: When the simplest part is wrong, how can you trust the rest?
text: The one I received is listed as a left-handed but is right-handed. Testing did not go beyond that, I simply did not trust it.

title: A great pen - fun pen. But for defense?
text:
Ways that this pen can be used for self-defense:
1. Poke your assailant in their eye.
2. Stab them in the throat
3. Hit them over the head with it (this will only annoy and/or amuse them)

As a fun multifunction pen, this is great.
If you are genuinely buying this for survival or defence, and you are over 10 years old, you may want to seek help.

title: Easy to assemble, great for tots
text: This is a great little balance bike for babies & toddlers for both indoors and out. It's got built-in safety so it won't turn so far it tips over. Little ones can scoot all over with this adorable little bike! The seat adjusts up to 2" so it grows with your child from 10 - 24 months. It's lightweight enough for littles to carry around on their own.

title: Not very smart, Not a good watch
text: Aside from the strap, which was clearly designed to be uncomfortable, the watch has an unfinished feel to it. The screen, the watch face, the buttons - it feels and works like a Beta model, not finished, still buggy, but hopes to be better one day.

title: I didnt thinnk that the lights would help
text: I did not think that the lights would help, but they really do. I saw a measurable increase in catches using this lure!

title: A nice little motor
text:
Easy to install, a nice simple clamp. Easy to set up, just two wires, and easy to use.
Get away from the noisy smelly gas motor, and try this clean green electric machine, you will not be disappointed.

title: Could not deflate enough to be ergonomic for me
text: I would have had to make this ball so deflated to even come close to touching the ground with my feet. No matter how much air I let out, my thighs were not parallel to the ground. Those are the basics of ergonomics. I'm 5"5", so not really too short, so I'm not sure why this was so hard to adjust to the right height.

title: Easy to use, easy to clean
text: This is really comfortable and holds an amazing amount of water (100 oz) for long rides. It's really adjustable and has enough storage for phone and a few essentials. The hydration pack is easy to fill, clean, and use. I'm really happy with this!

title: Great hydration pack
text: This provides a very comfortable fit and has a great hydration system preinstalled. It's easy to use and to clean. There's plenty of tool and other storage in this for longer rides, too. Really happy with this.

title: Almost perfect! It doesn't like puddles/rain but other than that, it cannot be beat!
text:
This is awesome - its strong, smooth, quite fast. Controlling it is easy, but it will not let you use it until you take the class! You install the app, it walks (scooters?) you through what you need to know to be safe. And then you are free to travel as you want.
There is a headlight a brake light and even a bell! (You do not have to fit the bell). It does not come with knee/elbow pads or a helmet. You should be wearing those with this. The battery has a good life, and will keep you zipping around easily. The kick-stand makes parking easy.

For ages 14 and up this is a great way to get to work, college, a friends house, or even a quick grocery run.
It comes with a charger and an impressively loud bell!
Very affordable and great fun

title: Excellent for drills and especially for social isolation
text: Keep fit and practice even if you're avoiding others for safety! This is a great way to keep teens and kids active during social isolation, and well beyond. Super sturdy, well made, and easy to assemble.

title: Works great at the quiet day at the range
text:
I have used these a couple of days at the range firing a thousand rounds of .22 LR and through the whole time, it silences the shots to a micro fraction of what it would sound like. I used the electric amplification once and didn’t like because of how much it distorts the sounds, I just leave that off and use them as regular noise-canceling range headset.
The fit is tight but you can adjust to your liking and it will still be quiet even with a bit of the headset being left from the eye protection. I would recommend these to anyone needing a powerful headset for a day at the range and the low price.

title: Excellent quality and super safe
text: This child's bike seat is very well made and sturdy. It's secure and keeps little ones safe on your tandem journeys. I love the roomy storage compartment on the back, too! The armrests are kid-approved for comfort too!

title: Great sun protection
text: This is the perfect protection for keeping the sun off your neck and face. Good for yard work and gardening, hiking, etc. Well made with sturdy durable materials. Adjustable enough to fit men or women and stays on securely.

title: One serving, tops
text:
It frustrates me when companies skirt the nutrition labeling requirements to make things fit the way they want. Before even opening, I really was irritated that this little package is supposed to be 2 servings. If you used it while backpacking, you really do require a lot more food than this for a meal, but most backpackers wouldn't eat stuff with all this junk in it. So, let's move on to survivalists. If you're stocking up for survival, this would probably be fine for 2 meals if you're conserving. Still not exactly a healthy meal, though.

On to taste. This is ok taste-wise. Following the directions exactly, it doesn't fully hydrate the 'dumplings', which are still pretty hard after 'cooking'. The shelf life is amazing, but the value is pretty lame for the small amount of food.

title: Weird bag, but great Bocce set!
text: So sometimes, Rally & ROar get it perfect. Other times, they seem to stop planning when it comes to storage. This is one of those cases. Though the rest of the set is perfect unless you leave the cardboard in the bag, it's pretty useless.  No support at all.

title: Great light blocking
text: This tent is great for blocking out light if you like to sleep in while camping. It's also super easy to set up and has way more headroom than most tents this size. It's well waterproofed and doesn't leak. breaking down is a challenge the first couple times, but it gets easier once you get the hang of it.

title: Pretty good, but small for 4 people
text: This tent is easy to set up and use and has good sun/weather protection. It's a great lightweight, way to stuff into a backpack, but more for 2 people if you need to keep your pack and stuff inside. If you're camping near your car, you can store your stuff in the car and sleep 4 with no room for anything else. Otherwise, it's good quality, not the best, but a good value.

title: Great fitness equipment for gym or home
text: This is an excellent way to build muscle and stamina with medicine balls. It's super sturdy and well made and holds up to pretty tough use. It holds up to 5 medicine balls, too, which are not included. It's really adjustable for just the right angle.

title: Not my favorite design
text: I really love most of the Built tumblers we own. This style lid, though, is not one I like. It is awkward to drink from, only pouring through a small slit, and it's very hard to clean. I do love anything they make with a flip-up lid, though! SO check out their other styles!

title: Easy to make. Easy to use, in theory!
text:
This is easy to use. If you are fitter than I am. For me, it's easy to use for one lift. On a good day.
It weighs a lot, so it is quite a work out to get it to the correct location and to build it.

I am 240 pounds at 6 ft 6 inches. there is little wobble as I use this - it is ever so strong and well balanced.
Easy to clean, a small footprint given its stability. Over all a nice piece of equipment

title: Perfect for keeping active during Stay at Home orders
text: This is a lifesaver for a little golf practice now that many of us are under stay at home orders. It's easy to set up and fun to use. Even the kids can practice. It's well made & sturdy and holds up to pretty heavy use!

title: Durable and great for shopping in hot weather
text: I love this as a great tote for frozen groceries in hot weather. It's also meant for use as a drink cooler for beach or lake, but I prefer hard-sided coolers for that. This will hold my frozen foods, even from a big costco run!

title: pretty good exercise bike
text:
Putting this together was uneventful - a simple process. Once built there is certainly room for improvement:
Adjusting seat or handlebars. You have to remove the bolt, move what you are adjusting, line the bolt up, and refasten it. If it is only one person using the bike, that is no big deal. If you share it and have to change it regularly it soon gets old.
Then, no matter how much you tighten the handlebars, they still wobble. Not a lot, just enough to be annoying.
Finally, as you apply tension, the noise gets louder. It is a rough grinding sound that does not fill one with confidence.

Aside from the unwelcomed audio, using this is very comfortable. The handlebars will support a tablet, so you can watch a video or easily listen to music as you race through your living room! Other than the wobbly handlebars the unit is very sturdy, And pedaling is very comfortable.

title: A little awkward, but it's great overall
text:
I really love this for what it can do, but I want to address my issues with it first. It's heavier than the photos show - picking up to move it is not easy. It's also bigger than I thought. It fits under my desk ok, but your desk needs to be pretty deep to be able to use it ergonomically. My chair wheels easily hit this if I am close enough to type comfortably. So I try to use it only for breaks when I don't need to type. However, since it's there, I tend to just use it and end up moving my butt about halfway up my chair so I can reach the keyboard easier without causing RSI. I found that actually works my thigh muscles a little more anyway. It's actually hard for me to just stop pedaling and let my legs & feet rest! I also do not know how o register the activity on my Fitbit, so I will research that. I use it sporadically throughout the day, so stopping to set the time is not an option.
SO for the benefits - my blood sugar is staying down thanks to the movement, even when I have to work! My restless legs are improving - I think movement actually helps those muscles relax more. I can actually focus more on my work when I'm not thinking I should go for a walk or get up and move.
This is super quiet! I expected some noise, but it's not bad at all. It's easy to adjust the tension. I wasn't sure why the feet pedals were so long, but I like being able to place them in different areas for different muscles. It really does make a difference where you place your feet.
Overall, I really like it!

title: Nice thick mat
text: I love that this mat is nice & thick and very well padded. It's well made with quality materials and comes with a really easy to use shoulder strap. It doesn't slide around on slick floors, and it's super easy to clean.

title: Easy to grip
text: These are great easy-grip dumbbells in a nice, lightweight for beginners. I can grip them easily and do a lot of reps since I can't use very heavy weights right now. The vinyl coating makes them easy to hold, and they're really durable.

title: Strong and sturdy, not quite stable
text: I would love this if the risers actually clicked into place so it stayed stable. SO far, No one's fallen or had problems with it, but it's not as stable as I'd like it to be. This is HUGE and does a good job, though.

title: Great for exercise but smells intense
text: I like this yoga ball. It’s a nice size and the stabilizing ring is really helpful to keep the ball from rolling around when you’re trying to exercise with it. It really helps with my back and rib issues, I needed something to stretch regularly with and this yoga ball works great for that. I haven’t used the resistance bands a whole lot yet, but the times that I have used them they are okay. I don’t think I’ve really figured out how to position my arms when I use the bands, but maybe I’ll watch a few videos to figure it out. My only issue is with the smell when you first unbox it and inflate it. I had to keep it outside because the plastic odor was really intense. It only took about a day or two to completely air it out and now it smells fine. It’s like any new plastic inflatable appliance, you have to air it out when you open it up. I plan to use it regularly for stretching and exercises.

title: Great outdoor fun, unique game
text: This is a really fun yard game - a different idea that everyone can learn together. It's very well made with quality materials, and the instructions are clear and simple. Easy to set up once you get the hang of it. Fun for adults and kids about 10 were playing easily - maybe a bit younger would be ok, too. And it all goes right back into a sturdy zippered tote.

title: Simple, easy to use
text: you can set the code to anything you want. Setting this is easy. Opening this is easy. Closing is... wait for it.. you guessed! It is easy!

title: Ok if you have a very specific desk, or without a desk
text: First, I'll talk about what I like. This is pretty sturdy and the seat is in a comfortable position. It's workable as an exercise bike for 3 in our family, ranging from 5'3" to 6'6". The pedals are reachable and easy to use. The tension is in a good place to easily adjust. The drawback? This requires a standing desk with the right base - it has to be wide enough to fit underneath. We have a standing desk with a pedestal, so this doesn't work with it. IN shopping for desks that would work, they have to be pretty wide, which our space can't accommodate. The display is awkward, too. You could sit it on the desk (if you could find the right desk), but then if you try to move the bike (WHich is NOT easy!), you have to find a place to put it, or just set it on the floor, where you can't reach it to reset. So even Fitdesk does not sell a desk that works with this bike, either. This is the second fail we've had from them. Just poor planning in their design department make these horrible.

title: NOT for under 5'6" & seat feels like a rock
text: I'm actually 5' 5 1/2" and can't quite reach the pedals comfortably. I'm frustrated because this was just what I was looking for, but the description is so misleading stating it's for 5' and up. The other major issue is that the seat is so incredibly uncomfortable. It feels like a rock, and after sitting on it just a few minutes, I was sore for over an hour - without riding because I couldn't pedal anyway. It seems sturdy, and comparatively, the FitDesk Standing Adjustable Desk Bike For Exercising for Home Use or Office is very comfortable plus I can reach the pedals. Sadly, it doesn't have the attached desk like this one, and that one only fits under desks with wide enough clearance, which Fitdesk does NOT even sell. Customer service is unresponsive after a week. Don't waste your money on this, even if you're tall!

title: Good, light bats
text:
These are good bats, not great, not perfect, but not bad either.
For a beginner they are more than adequate. An expert is not going to enjoy these!
That said, they are well built, the handle could use a little more padding. They are strong.

title: Easy to install, easy to adjust
text:
This is a simple set, but it does all it needs to. It attaches easily to the table.
Adjusting the tension is easy. It is very well designed, and very well made.

title: Nice spin on the old game
text: I love this big outdoor version of tic-tac-toe! It's a little more fun in large pieces, but also, a fun spin when you play the 'toss' version! Great indoor or outdoor fun. This makes a great party game for outdoor events.

title: Cheaply made
text: These are pretty flimsy and cheap glasses. They're brittle and feel like they will break easily. They're an off-brand with no way to contact the manufacturer for support. Not a good value at all.

title: solid, but wobbly
text: This is a heavy, strong piece. It is simple to put together, but when properly constructed, itis not firm in its position, the sides wobble a little. Tightening the screws any more would have threaded them. I took it a poart and added a couple of washers. This resolved it, but it should not have been nevessary,

title: not strong, not comfortable
text:
Based on the description, I ordered the correct size for me.
However, these are too loose and very awkward/uncomfortable as they work their way off your finger.
On the first day of wearing, I caught the ring on something, and it split a little.
I love the concept of these, but the execution is very poor.

title: Very solid. will outlive you!
text:
This is built to last. It is solid. You could effectively use this to cause "Blunt trauma" but if you do, please don't tell them I suggested it.

The imprinted grip is excellent, even damp hands will not slide on that. nad there is no give, no wobble, no movement at all. This is a solid piece. Expect to see this in a gym 100 years from now. It is not going anywhere!

title: Excellent Quality
text: This is a really well-made high-quality pickleball paddle. It's really lightweight and has a nice comfortable grip. It has a really strong, durable build from solid materials. I love the design too!

title: Flexible use and weight
text: I like that this is so adjustable. For a small space, you can have a weight range up to 40 lbs, so it's not for pros, but for people who are trying to get into shape gradually. I like the benefits of the unstable resistance these offer. It's super flexible to use so many ways.

title: Keeps water cold
text: These are great insulated bottles that are perfect for water or sports drinks. They say you can use them for hot beverages, but I don't like using narrow opening bottles for anything that's hard to clean out so I use these strictly for water. They keep water cold for a long time (I'm not sure how long because I refill about 5 times a day!) and haven't leaked yet!

title: Great vertical medicine ball storage
text: This is the perfect storage rack for medicine or slam balls. I love vertical storage, especially for small spaces, and when your exercise room is a corner of your bedroom, you NEED stuff like this! It's super sturdy and was very easy to put together. I've only got 4 balls (too weak for more than 12 lbs!), so the top holds my balance discs!

title: Quick setup and tear down
text: This is a great portable passing practice net that can be easily set up in your yard or at the park. It fits perfectly into a sturdy carry bag for easy transportation. Setup is super quick & easy. Great for off-season practice or use during training.

title: Very durable & well made
text: Great safety set for street hockey goalie use only. The leg pads are well padded and sturdy. The whole set is very well made & durable. Note that the set says it's made to reduce, not prevent injury.

title: Vibrant colors, well made
text: The thing I actually love most about this croquet set is the beautiful vibrant colors! I love the tropical shades of the mallets & balls so much! It's also very well made & easily fits into the carry bag. The pieces are strong and made to last.

title: Love the handles
text: I love medicine balls for core training, and the addition of handles is great for ease of use! These are really well made and one-piece, so nothing to break. The handle makes it much easier to keep hold of. really great quality and workmanship.

title: Better than the hard ground
text: This is a pretty good camping mat and pillow. You really can't get 4-star hotel bed comfort when sleeping on the ground with a small pad, but for what this is, it does a great job! It's not as flimsy as some I've used, and it is super compact when deflated. Does a great job for what it is!

title: Strong and easy to install/remove
text:
I like these. The hole in the tip lets you use another tip as leverage to ensure a really tight connection.
After a lot of games where they were thrown harder than one would normally throw, the tips still looked like new.
A set of 100 means it will be a long time until you need to replenish your supplies.

title: Durable and works great
text: I love the sturdiness of this stability disc. I've needed to work on balance for so long, and this helps a lot. It's well made & durable with super thick vinyl. IU also love the cute little pump included.

title: Super well made & easy to store
text: If you want an excellent quality, durable table tennis table, this is it! It's super easy to wheel around for storage and it's very well built. Easy to assemble and to use. We're really impressed with this table! And, it's pro size!

title: Great grip, nice weight
text: I love the ability this provides to use a glass water bottle with a safe hold grip. The silicone sleeve makes it super easy to grip and won't slip out of your hands. It's a solid glass that is a nice weight for safety but strong enough to last without easily breaking. Love the quality of this.

title: Works great for the less flexible!
text: So I've had a ton of health issues lately, and I just don't have the reach I used to. This helps so much! It's also lightweight and easy to use. I don't know what I'd do without it!

title: Thick & well padded
text: Nice thick, cushiony workout mat! I love the pretty mint color, and the easy-clean surface. It's easy to roll and thick and padded enough to make hard floors comfortable for workouts.

title: Firmer than most foam rollers
text: This is a pretty good foam roller if you prefer a little on the stiff side. It looks very much like a styrofoam icebox with a rubberized coating, but it's much stronger than that - it's pretty lightweight, but not very cushiony. title: Now filters lead and organic chemicals, too
text:
I live in the Pacific Northwest and love to get out into nature. Often, we'll take along water but end up needing more along the trail. When I was a kid, scooping water out of a stream never made me sick, but now I know better! LifeStraw has been an amazing tool to have on board, even for short day hikes.

It’s a 2-stage filter that provides safe drinking water in any environment. We have built up a small collection of LifeStraw products, some for our hiking trips, and some in our emergency kit.

This new version is a huge step above the standard LifeStraw. While the original LifeStraw filtered out bacteria and parasites, this new LifeStraw Flex multi-use water filter with gravity bag removes bacteria and parasites and also removes microplastics and reduces lead - exceeds the NSF 53 standard - from the National Sanitation Foundation website: Filters are certified to reduce a contaminant with a health effect. Health effects are set in this standard as regulated by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and Health Canada. Both standards 42 and 53 cover adsorption/filtration which is a process that occurs when liquid, gas or dissolved/suspended matter adheres to the surface of, or in the pores of, an adsorbent media. Carbon filters are an example of this type of product.

For backpackers, hikers and campers, this is a perfect way to drink right from natural water sources. It’s super compact and easy to pack and carry along. Travelers can take this to filter drinking water in places that have a questionable water supply.

There are four ways to use this. As a one-gallon gravity filter bag, as a personal straw (drink straight from a water source), attached to plastic water bottles and adapts to hydration bladders in a backpack.

From the packaging and a little research I did, here are some of the statistics:
Filter Weight: 2.0 oz / Gravity Bag & Hose Weight: 5.3 ounces (dry)
Filter size 6.4”x1.5”
Gravity Bag Volume: 1 gallon
Microbiological filter pore size: 0.2 micron
Removes 99.999% of bacteria, parasites & microplastics
Carbon fiber capsule Improves taste, reduces heavy metals including lead, chlorine and organic chemicals like pesticides, herbicides, and VOCs
