It's not going to give you the power of a full sized megaphone, but that's not what it's trying to be.

title: Great Quality Resistance Bands
text: Anyone who has had physical therapy probably has piles of stretchy resistance bands laying around. They have fairly short lives, though, and it's a good thing to keep up with your routine afterward. These resistance bands are amazingly strong, durable, and well-made. They will last a good long time for many types of stretching & resistance exercises. I highly recommend these as a step up from the standary roll-cut elestic bands!

title: Good padding, easy to fasten
text:
I do like these - at least for training. They are very lightweight, well made, good stitching, okay material, and amazingly comfortable. They fit well, and the foam barriers work impressively well.
The velcro fasteners are easy to put on, adjust, and undo.

title: OK hiking stool
text: I like this as a camp stool that's super easy to carry, especially for a quick backpack trip, but for camping, I like something more substantial with a back support. It's well made with quality material and will hold up to a lot of wear, but it's not very comfortable to sit on for very long.

title: the target will take a beating, and you will not feel a thing
text:
These are so comfortable - the velcro is easy to do up if you are working alone, and you can punch as hard as you like, you just won't feel it - the padding is amazing.
These are light, breathable, very comfortable, even after a long hot session.
They are well made, the stitching is showing no signs of wear after a lot of use. The leather is looking great too.
Quality components, quality build, quality product.

title: Soft cover, no rashes
text: Super strong but soft - so no more rashes! Love the kwik-connect easy hookups too. Well made with quality materials & sure to hold up for years at the lake! It's also easy to deflate.

title: Works & feels great
text: Love this nice, lightweight badminton racket. It's lighter than the others we own and has a nice grip. We're no experts, so can't really contribute to a more detailed description, but we're happy with it! Nice quality workmandship and materials.

title: Pretty good set
text: This is a nice set of table tennis paddles & balls. We are definitely amateurs, so can't give expert advice, but they fit well in big and small hands and work as intended. They seem pretty well made of good materials. We have a couple professional paddles that feel great and work well, but these are fine, too.

title: Yes, they are indestructible
text:
I received these with more than a touch of skepticism. Indestructible? we will see about that.
So I called in my two extra special review assistants. Edison and Enzo - dogs. With teeth. Lots of them.

I threw the first ball, and found a bit of an issue - neither were interested! But, with some attention, I got them to chase, claw at and chew.

Are these indestructible? No. Enough chewing, or me treading on or driving over them, they don't do so well. However, a bit of a dog chew, accidentally gently treading on them (or intentionally, if you are so inclined) and they will do fine. Hitting them with golf clubs again and again - no problem. losing them in the water? no, they float. And are a bright yellow.

title: Outstanding for any Gym/Hospital.  Maybe overkill for home use
text:
This is an impressively serious piece of exercise equipment. It is strong. It is fairly easy to build. It is amazingly well designed.
When assembled (takes a couple of hours, the documentation is very good, it comes with all the tools that you will need) it is amazing.
Where to start?
You can connect your blue tooth device to this and blast your music whilst you pedal
No more adjusting the tension - the faster you cycle, the greater the air resistance, the harder it is to pedal.
No more boredom - the device will allow you to place any tablet and almost any laptop on the "dashboard" and you can watch videos, read reports, or do whatever you want whilst you pedal.
You can exercise your arms, legs or all of the above! Just choose what pushes and what pulls!
You can have it monitor your pulse - assuming you have a wireless heart monitor.
You can see distance, speed, calories burned and so much more. The screen tells you everything!

It weighs a lot. You do not want to be putting this away and bringing it out each time you want to use it... you will simply not want to use it, and that would be a shame.

This is a truly wonderful piece of exercise equipment - but don't forget its size and weight - you cannot leave this in the corner of a bedroom ore dining room, to bring out as needed.

title: comfortable, well padded, nice to wear
text:
I love how comfy these are, and how they breathe, so my hands don't get all clammy.
I love how easy they are to put on and take off.
I love how the padding protects me so well from impacts.
I usually love how the padding equally protects my sparring partner, but there are times when I wish it didn't!
I love the feeling of the gloves, they are very comfortable.

I fully recommend these gloves!

title: Don't ask me how, but it works
text: I just don't get the science behind this, but it truly is cooling with nothing more than water, wrung out. Keep it damp to keep cool, but it doesn't 'feel' wet. It's magic. Truly.

title: Adorable & easy to put on
text: My little guy, Enzo, is a Chihuahua/Mini Pin mix at about 9 lbs, and the small fits him perfectly - loose enough to be comfortable, but not so loose that it falls or his feet get tangled in the legs. It's super easy to slip over his head and legs, and he's comfortable enough to walk & run in it. Will be perfect in the fall!

title: Works great
text: I enjoy playing table tennis, but I'm no pro! So I can't address any of the technical features without sounding like an idiot! So with that out of the way, this paddle feels comfortable in my grip, and works great! It looks and feels like it's high quality and made with good materials. It's a lot better than the standard paddles that came with our table!

title: Easy to see, msakes playing easier!
text:
wonderful, easy to see, table tennis balls.
If your vision isn't 100% (Or, possibly even if it is!) these high contrast balls make playing a lot easier. I can now clearly track the ball, even when the wall in the background is white.

Hard to review beyond that - they are spherical, light, they spin and bounce - all as expected.

title: all you need in one small pack. Easy to get the tool you need, easy to keep in a pocket (or even tucked into a sock!!)
text:
fantastic tool! It's very strong, light-weight has most all you would need for a bike ride, including a chain pin extractor.
It looks really cool!
It is held together with a very strong magnet - easy enough to pull the tool parts out, too strong for them to just drop out!

title: An amazing light, but until the software is improved, it cannot deliver on its promises.
text:
This is, by far, the brightest LED battery powered light I have used.
It's waterproof, which is great.
It charges from a USB port, which is convenient.
The idea of having it programmable, so you can set how it will behave when you use certain settings is beyond incredible!
At this point, it is a five-star review,

And then, it drops to a three-star review.

The software to program it, whilst being in beta, simply does not work. None of my computers would detect the light in a way that pleased the software, and because the software was unhappy, I could not customize the light.

This is a real shame. Maybe version 2 of the software will make this worth buying

title: All you need to get going
text:
These are good for starter play. You are not going to get great, controllable spin with these, but you will get a little spin, and you will get good enough control as your improve your play with them.

The balls are nothing special - firm, not too firm, bouncy, not too bouncy. Good, but not too good!

The bats are light-weight and strong. The pads are basic but functional.

All you need to get started, and to have a great many fun games!

title: Wonderful table for tennis against others or yourself.
text:
A great, space-saving table. It splits into two pieces, making storage a breeze, moving it simple and light, and playing against your worse adversary, yourself easily possible.

Its the practicing against yourself that really sold me on the table - no need to find someone on your level, there is *always* someone on your level, right there with you! That alone is why you should consider this table.
Beyond this, it is very well constructed, quality parts put together nicely, from the latch locking the table in the upright position to the foot-breaks on the wheels. Quality and strength from top to bottom.

And folded up, it can easily fit away out of sight, until the next game!

title: Super comfortable
text: The description for this is confusing, so be careful when ordering to make sure you're getting what you want. No pillowcase included. Anyway, I got the Buckwheat Organic Bed Pillow and it's amazing! I love a fairly soft pillow but need the firmness as a side sleeper. My neck feels better, and I sleep better because the pillow keeps my head in a position that improves my breathing (bad sinuses!).

title: Great bag - can take more than you can give!
text:
This is an impressive bag. Solid, great to punch or kick, it has a real feel to it, and the movement you would expect from hitting or kicking a human combatant.

the stitching is solid. you will not hurt this bag! The leather will wane before the stitching does. The loops for the chains are equally well made.

Once you have it hung, you will be impressed with it - every detail, the finish, the materials, the chains, the whole lot.
Excellent punch/kick bag.

Give it hell, it can take it!

title: round, bouncy and spin.
text:
Lovely tennis balls!
They retain their shape even through a violent game. Lightweight, accurate, easy to spin. Very good balls for your game

title: Outdoor fun, especially in the dark!
text:
Fun toy, as it spins, the LED's light up, and look amazing as its spinning above your head. Good in the dau - totally amazing at night!
The only issue is that its green. And you use it outside. Now and then, when it doesn't get launched straight up you have to play "hunt the spinny thing". But outside, it is on the grass. And it's green :/

Other than that, very good, the spinny part often gets bent out of shape, but it is easy to reshape. The base is fairly strong - I thought that the ripcord would not last, but it's going great, you pull it really hard, and it simply winds back in automatically!

title: A great way to climate cotrol what you are carrying in your car/boat
text:
This is very good, almost 5 stars.
The Good:
Easy to clean
Top locks on
Holds its temperature well
With the heating or cooling switched on, noise is minimal.
Easy to set hot or cold, and how hot or cold

The Bad
The power cables are hard to stow away. The cable storage needs to be better designed. Maybe have a single outlet on the back that a 110 or 12 v could plug in to (via a transformer for the 110)

It is an excellent food carrier, keeping take-out food nice and hot (or cold) for the journey home.

title: Table Tennis (almost!) anywhere! Great family fun where you dont have foom for a table tennis table.
text:
Cheaply and easily add a table tennis table to your home, even if you don't have room for one!
I like that when you play on it, it feels the same as a "real" table tennis table.
I like that it is easy to set up and stow away
I like that it comes with the net!
I like the weight, little ones cannot do it without help!
I really like that the underside is well cushioned to protect what's beneath.

This is a great family game - easily hides away in the back of a closet, easy to set up, great fun to use! I could say more good things about it, but I have just been called back to compete in the family tournament!

title: Heavy, but worth the load
text:
This is a fantastic grill. The only issue is what makes it so good! It is very strong - it will survive high heats, brutal cold, and still just work. It is easy to clean, but all of this makes it heavy.
So, you will always want to carry this on trips, only, you won't want to carry it.
It is beautifully manufactured, solidly put together, it is not going to get beaten up easily, and it is not going to crumble after a hot roasting.
But carrying it may slow you down a little, at least on longer hikes!

title: An amazing stick! Light (VERY), accrate, strong. Perfect
text:
This thing is insanely lightweight. I thought I had been sent an empty box! You truly will not believe how light it is.
Or, for that matter how strong it is!
It curves slightly and works well, throwing the puck as it should. Very accurate, and very gentle on your hands/wrists at you strike the puck,

It looks amazing. I have to reinforce: it is amazingly light, and for the price, just amazing.

This will help you improve your game, and do it with style!

title: Great starter to introduce you to the game.
text:
If you want to start pickleballing (you do!) then this will get you going. Two paddles, 2 balls. All you need is a small area (a flat driveway will do, but a flat bit of lawn will be much more forgiving to your knees!) and an accomplice.

Then let the games begin!

The paddles are okay, but there are much better out there. For simple fun games, or to see if the sport is for you, then this is perfect!
Have fun, it's an enjoyable sport, and this set contains all you need to get going

title: Works great, well made
text: This is just the right size recommended by our chiropractor for both of us. It's a little firmer than the one he has in his PT room, but it does the trick fine. I love that it has several exercises right on the roller. I hate the constant search for my exercise sheets! It's well made and super sturdy.

title: Get better control at a lower price!
text:
For the price, this is excellent. Compared to the entry-level paddles I had been using, this gave me awesome control (and also helped me learn how much I need to learn!)
The paddle feels well made, a good weight to it, a Solid merger of handle and paddle. Heavier than the basic paddles that I already owned, but not uncomfortable!

I have used better paddles, but not in this price range - this is, for its price, phenomenal!

title: Excellent grips, simple installation, couldn't be better!
text:
Not sure why this is marked as being for pickleball paddles - you could use this on many things. And you would not regret it - the cushion is excellent, soft to grip, but not so soft it rapidly becomes useless.

It's very comfortable, easy to apply and it stays on well. If your paddle needs some TLC, this could be just what you are looking for!

title: Adorable, keeps water chilled
text: Such an adorable little water bottle for the littles! It's great that it's stainless steel inside, so keeps water cool, even on warm days. A good size, too. The artwork is just beautiful! Well made with quality materials.

title: Fun & sturdy
text: We had no trouble blowing this up with an adapter and our air mattress electric pump. It is made from strong PVC and works great even in the yard for lounging in the sun. It's got that flocked feel on the outside but dries quickly.

title: Simple, easy to tighten belt
text: A great, simple belt. Not much of a fashion statement (I suppose that would depend upon the statement you wanted to make) but a simple, strong and minutely adjustable, very comfortable belt.

title: Excellent hitch mount bike rack
text:
This is one solid piece of hardware! It feels like it could carry 2 tonnes worth of bicycle!
Beautifully made and finished. Very easy to adjust, and ever-so strong.
Your bikes will be very safe on this. A great way to transport them and keep the dirt out of your truck/SUV.
Its well finished, well made, practical and does its job perfectly.
You won't find a better two hitch mount bike rack than this!

title: Cute toddler set
text: This is a really cute toddler set of gloves & bag. If your littles like to work out with you, they can use this set - or even just for play. It's small and lightweight, so they won't get hurt. Would be great for anxiety relief, too.

title: Well made and great quality
text: This is perfect for protecting your outdoor ping pong table. We keep ours in the garage, but still needed something to keep it protected. Made very well with sturdy fabric. It fits a little lose, but we wrapped a rope around to keep it in place.

title: Cute & well made
text: This is such a cute pickleball paddle case! I love the pink color. It is super protecting, and soft padded. Makes carrying paddle & supplies a lot easier!

title: Great quality!
text: We're pretty much amatuers when it comes to foosball, so I don't really know what makes the difference between standard and tournament quality. That said, these are really well made and quality materials. We're very happy with them!

title: Better than masking tape!
text: This is a great way to mark floors in the right place for darts. It's a high grade material that will last and is so much nicer than a piece of masking tape. Great quality.

title: Well made, strong case.
text: This is a great quality, well made case for transporting and storing two piece pool cues. It's sturdy and protects your cue very well. Highly recommended.

title: Great quality.
text: This is a great quality, well made pool cue. Made from Canadian Maple wood, and won't warp or chip. It is in 2 pieces that screw together to allow storage and transportation in a case.

title: Great quality
text: These are a superior quality steel tip dart. Well made with excellent materials. Nice weight and feel. Highly recommended.

title: Work great!
text: We're really just amateurs that play at home, and don't really know what we're doing! But regardless, they seem to work better than the darts that came with our board! They are a slightly heavier weight and we seem to have better control. I'd recommend these to anyone with a soft tip dart board!

title: Pickleball is so much fun! but the right paddle really helps
text:
Pickleball is so much fun! but the right paddle really helps.
I like this one a lot - I am not on the professional level, not even close, but I can tell the difference between poor and good quality equipment, it's comfier to hold, easier to grip, does have a measurable difference to speed and accuracy of your returns.

This paddle did not disappoint. It helped my game.
The design on the Paddle is really cool. The stripe on the grip looks great. The only thing I did not like was the cover on the handle - removing that without damaging the handle underneath was a little tricky. Other than that, there is nothing bad one can say about this racket.

title: The paddle is beautiful! Nicely made
text:
This racket is for the Elite players.
Which means that I am underqualified to review it.
However, I can state that my accuracy and power both increased not much, but an improvement.

The paddle is beautiful! Nicely made, good weight, a very solid covering of the surface, and the handle is both comfortable and very firmly attached to the paddle.

The look is beautiful, the photograph does not do it justice.

This is a lovely paddle

title: A great little dart
text:
Very happy with these darts. I like their size, and thickness. I like their lighter weight.
They are well constructed and easy to assemble.
they fly straight and true.
A great soft tip dart set!

title: Great under bed storage
text: THis is a great way to store extra bedding and seasonal clothes under the bed or in other narrow spaces. THey are durable and well made with quality materials. The sports theme makes it more fun for sports fans, teenage boys especially! The handles make it easy to pull out from under the bed for easy access.

title: Great for emergency, hikers, or world travelers
text: Just what we needed to add to our emergency preparedness kit! With the ability to filter water directly from a water source, or to use with the included soft bottle, or even attach to a plastic bottle, it's super versatile. Throw in a few spare carbon filters (also available on Amazon for about $5 each), and you'll be ready for a few days or more.

title: Great indoor/outdoor set for littles
text: This is a cute set for littles to learn to play hockey. It's flexible enough to be used in an indoor setting, but sturdy enough for outdoor, too. Great indoors for cold rainy or snow days. And safe enough to not damage things in your house!

title: Well made, quality materials
text: THis is the perfect pool cue for my daughter. She's a small adult, so it's a great size for her. Plus, she absolutely loves pink, so it can't get any better. It's well made from quality materials.

title: Great quality, well made
text: This is a great quality, well made medicine ball. It's great for adding a little resistance to some exercises as well as stretches. At 10 lbs, it's the perfect weight for me, sort of as rehab, since I have a ton of autoimmune issues that prevent me from too much exercise, but require me to do some level of exercising.

title: Durable and great quality
text: I love all Contigo products, but this is one of my favorite! Glass is so much better than plastic for health reasons, and the durable silicone sleeve protects this glass bottle from breakage. It's really great for my husband, who thinks all our other glass bottles are 'feminine' looking. This one reminds me of a camera lens!

title: Great darts - they fly straight and sure!
text:
I am very happy with these soft tip darts. I found them to be stable, and they worked very well with my soft dart board (some darts seem to bounce - or fall off more easily than others. At first I thought this was my lack of skill, but I get a better "cling: rate with these darts compared to others).

They look great, they feel well-made, and the box they shipped in even acts as a great storage/transportation box.

title: Great protection for any bike.
text:
Customize the look of your bike as you protect it.
This honeycomb "skin" is amazingly strong. When hit, it deflects, I couldn't get it to snag, stretch or rip. It absorbs the ding, protecting the frame beneath.

And on top of all that, it looks really cool!!

It was pretty easy to apply - but like any decal, you need a steady hand or a friend with a steady hand!

AIf the look doesn't attract you, remember, this is the cheapest "insurance" you can get for your frame. A bargain!

title: A perfectly good, and cool! baseball
text:
I like this. Its well made. The ink on it doesn't smudge or wear (yet!)
The stitching is very strong, as is the PVC covering.
Good weight, nice to hold and throw - and hit!
I was concerned about the digital camo - the last thing a ball needs is to be camouflaged! However, given the colors, this is not an issue!

All in all, a great baseball!

title: Make use of that wheel at the Talkgate party! A great tool!
text:
This is very cool. So simple, so clever - the stability comes from your car wheel! keeps it near to the tailgate too.
This is strong, yes, it's using the car wheel to do most of the work, but the rest of it is strong. Well finished, and a mesh - Easy to clean!
This is surprisingly stable. It folds flat, taking hardly any space whatsoever.
Very easy to set up, to use and to put away again.

title: Great goal, heavy, but strong and stable!
text:
I love how easy this is to set up - an impromptu kick around suddenly becomes a lot more fun!
Its so easy to set up, and take down, you will love it! The only issue is, it's a little heavy. That said, the weight is there from its strength and stability. So you just have to accept it!

A very good piece of sporting kit for street soccer or in a field or yard. I am very happy with this.

title: Excellent versatile storage container
text: This is a great and versatile storage piece for so many things. It would be great for dorm storage, and even folds up when not in use. Perfect in garage, basement, bedroom, teen room, so many places. It's strong & sturdy for most things, but don't try to pic it up if you've got a lot of heavy stuff in it.

title: Fun! It does not get old!
text:
This is a lot of fun. Its like toys me and my friends made as kids, only it works!
You fire the dart at the nets. It's that simple. And that hard!
You can give little ones a help up by having them stand closer - Keeping the fun is balanced throughout the different levels of skill.

The game is well made. The darts are well made. and this is a game that you will keep coming bac to.

title: Rough fun with soft edges
text:
Great fun for 2! Sticks, Puck, and the net. Needs a flat area to play in, but lots of fun.
The sticks are firm enough to work well, yet soft enough to not need the E.R. The goal is well made, soft edges yet strong.
It is all very well put together to be fun, yet gently. It's a great, fun set.

title: A really good practice net.
text:
I can find no fault in this. It is easy to set up, easy to take down, easy to load back into its carrier. It is lightweight enough to be easy to move, yet strong enough to take a beating.

For making practice faster and easier, this is simply excellent.

title: Comfortable, strong, neat looking and practical.
text:
I was very happy with this. A great, classy and stylish container for your Pickleball rackets and accessories.
Made from nice material, and put together really well with solid stitching, and quality zips, this is comfortable to carry when empty, or when loaded with your Pickleball hardware.

title: a good charger to keep you going through the game!
text:
Good little USB charger - perfect for keeping your phone topped up at your tail-gater!
And its good, holds a reasonable amount of power, gave my cell phone a full charge from flat, as well as charging my tablet 1/3.

It is small, it is well made, it is SEAHAWKS!! and its good value!

title: Fun, silly, great for teams or just two!
text:
this is a great fun game. Well, sort of two games, because building the frame is fun in itself!
then the real fun starts - throwing two gold balls, tied to each other, at the bars in front of you.
Tricky! It's easy to get the hang of, not easy to master. When playing little ones, it's easy to set handicaps by having some standing closer, and some standing further away.

The parts have weight, so they don't fall over when the balls hit them. If places outside they will survive rain, dog markings, and anything else nature can throw at them. Inside (hose them off first!!) they will sit on any floor and not damage it.

A great fun game for young and old alike

title: Fun games for one to the whole family and some friends too!
text:
I like this, its lots of fun!
It has lots of games in it, including one player games. So if you are wanting to improve your skills, you can have fun doing so!
The board is very easy to mount on the wall and comes with fantastic mounting instructions. You won't go wrong!

It has a lot of different games. The darts that come with it are adequate. The battery compartment can be accessed from the front - so you do not have to take the board down to change the batteries, which is very good. It doesn't come with an AC adapter, which is disappointing. It does, however, have a connector on it, so you can use a power adapter. You just have to purchase it separately.

title: Fun game for all the family
text:
This is a fun game. a cord with a ball at each end, which does have something of a medieval weaponry feel to it gets tossed at the bars, wraping around them, if you get the throw right!
A silly game, but lots of fun, and great for hand-eye co-ordination.

Well made, with steaks provided to secure it to the ground, this really is fun, for one in practice, or for as many as you can get to turn up for a big day of it!

title: Nice idea, not very well made.
text:
Great toy, but with a few problems.
First, its glow in the dark - very cool at this time of year, but as summer gets closer, dark will be coming much later.
Second, it hangs over the back of a door. Which not only makes this a very noisy toy, it makes it a noise that you cannot get away form inside the home!

Should that not put you off, then his might. The unit is not very well built, easily bending frame (that really should not bend!) makes its longevity questionable.

title: A nice scoreboard to illuminate your scoring
text:
This is very cool - you use the grease pencil to write on the board, and your writing is illuminated! it wipes off fairly easily, and it glows! You can easily read it from the oche.
I would have preferred a higher price and an adapter to come with it so you could just plug it in. I am not a fan of battery power.
Thats really the only bad thing I can say about this. It looks great, works well, cleans fairly easily, comes with the batteries! Looks good whilst its being used, and looks good when its switched off.

title: Great soft tip darts!
text:
I got an electronic dart board recently, and have really enjoyed playing with it. I saw these darts and wondered "Do 'better' darts really make a difference?"

Oh yes, they really do! They fly straighter, they fly faster, more of my shots stay in the board, and more of them are closer to where I was aiming for! I see my play improve when I use these, and I see it lessen when I switch back.

Well worth every cent!

title: Fun, fit and cute!
text:
These are just soooo cute! Its a great game, keeps the little ones playing, the sticks are soft enough so they won't do any damage, but WOW they are really, truly one of the cutest things you will ever see your kid wearing!
Good game play, physical, fun, and can be very energetic!

title: Great for indoor fun!
text: This net is pretty adequate as a portable net for impromptu games. I'm sure there are sturdier, easier to set up nets for the more avid sports enthusiast, but this is great for novices. My favorite use, though, is that with a stuffed plus soccer ball on a rainy day, this is a lot of fun for indoor play! Yes, set up easily indoors and keep everyone moving - in the house! You have to have a big room, and make sure nothing can get knocked over! We like it in the garage for badminton on rainy days, too! Would be great for schools inside the gym, too!

title: Great quality, sturdy internal frame
text: This is a great backpacking pack, with a solid internal frame, and lightweight build. Plenty of pockets and space for everything, including a pouch for a reservoir hydration system, and clips for sleeping pad attachment. It fits my husband's frame well, and holds everything necessary for a weekend hike. Very well made and durable. Recommended for novice backpackers, probably not for pros.

title: A great quality shirt!
text:
This is a great shirt! It is a good fit. This shirt is made of good sturdy material. The screen printed logo is a good quality and I really like the distress look to it. I like that it's tagless, tags constantly bother me and I commonly just cut them out anyway. It did well in the washing and good in the dryer.

This shirt would be a great gift for any Wildcat's fan!

title: Fun game for all the family!
text:
A classic game, and a good version - can be played inside and out.
Would be nice if there was some more weight to the shoes - would make throwing easier. But you have to draw the line somewhere, and dont want damage when playing inside.

title: A very good racket for very good players everywhere.
text:
I really like this racket. The case protects it well, but once out of the case, you have a paddle that the ball almost glues to - so much spin!!! Its perfectly weighted, very comfy to hold and use.
You get a racket like this, and now you cannot excuse bad shots - there is no excuse!
Nicely made, the case is very pleasing, looks like it will last a long time.

title: Your hands will think you are in a sauna!
text:
These are hot! they are so well insulated, your hands are more likely to over heat than get cold. The mitten fingers easily pull back, letting you get a perfect grip on the trigger, when done, pull the mitten part back over your fingers, and warm up in record time!
The stitching is excellent, these are ever so comfortable, perfect for everything from hunting to snowball fights

title: Very comfortable, with a good seal all around.
text: These are so comfortable!  I usually find that they are too tight or lose across the nose, or over the ear or.. well, these are easy to aduct, and simply melt into your face! Ever so comfortable.

title: Great fun for your home or corner office.
text:
Lots of fun! the mat is not flat, so as you putt towards the hole, your ball is going up a gentle, uneven incline, which makes the game require some talent!
Easily rolls up to be put out of the way... but you wont want to roll it up and put it away, you will want to keep it out and keep playing!

title: Great for practice, not for pros.
text: This is great for practice, but I wouldn't consider it for 'pros'. Great for high school kids, or maybe middle school, for practice, but I'd suggest something more sturdy and stable for pros. It's easily portable, and strong enough for the job, and packs nicely into the convenient carrying bag.  It weighs  a little under 30 lbs, so no problem for a player to carry. This would be great for coaches, or for backyard practice.

title: Fun hockey set for tots!
text: This is a great little set for toddlers and preschoolers learning to play either street or indoor hockey. If you're using it indoors, make sure you put them in a room without breakables, since even though it's padded, those little ones can pack a powerful punch! There's a matching net that's sold separately, too.

title: Works great!
text: I am no expert at table tennis, but this racket totally gives me an edge! I didn't think it could improve my game at all, but it does. It grips comfortably and though I just don't know the correct terminology to describe the improvements in my games, I'm a little better than I used to be!

title: Didn't last long at all
text: Franklin sports seem to be either really good or really low quality when it comes to manufacturing lately. I didn't think there would be much to say about a pickleball, but these aren't very well made. They didn't last long before splitting. I'd go for Dura or Onix for better quality in the same price range.

title: Great quality!
text: Franklin tend to make some pretty good quality products, but sometimes lately, they seem to be using cheaper materials. This pickleball paddle cover, though, is excellent quality. I love that I can toss it into the back of the car without fear of my paddle getting damaged, and the pink stripe helps me find *mine* easier! The clip is great to hang the paddle on the outside of my sports bag.

title: Cheap quality product, yet still lots of fun!
text:
When one of the features is "Person with the highest score wins" you know to not expect much.
And it does have a cheap feel to it - from the quality of the plastic to the quality of the art work and the label holding the artwork to the toy.

And yet, its fun! Its a lot of fun. Silly - a toy for a holiday, not one that they will go back to, which is just as well, given the lack of build quality. But for a few fun afternoons - this is a great game!

title: too cute!
text:
I know, I am meant to write about the quality of material and stitching (both excellent) and how well made the mask is (REALLY well made) but all that falls away to the key point about this.
ITS SO CUTE
This is so cute, it could be made of the lowest of standards, and I would still like it.
But it really is a high quality, well made item. A perfect outfit

title: Keep your board like new
text:
Your board needs the best possible care.
And this is it. the brushes are fantastic, different strength on the bristles to get your s board like new.
The cleaning materials also dont leave you wanting.
All in a convenient carry case

An ideal gift for a boarder, or a fantastic present for your self

title: Works great but needs a cover
text: This is a great super portable camping and backpacking pillow! It's comfortable enough for it's small size, and comes in a nice little pouch. The only thing I would like is a cover of some sort to make it more comfortable. There is no reason the pouch couldn't be made in a size that could double as a pillowcase.

title: Indoor fun activity
text: A fun way to keep kids entertained indoors as the weather gets cold and wet. Great over the door game for the whole family! Electronic scoring makes it even more fun. I'd be happier if it was made a little more sturdy, but it's a good value.

title: Indoor activity fun!
text: As the weather gets chilly, kids need indoor recreation that keeps them moving. This football over door game does that! A fun way to practice indoors and keep your tweens entertained during bad weather. Fun for the whole family! It's not sturdy enough to last very long, but it's a good value.

title: Great tool to improve your game
text:
I really like the Zepp sports sensors. They are quite excellent at analyzing your motions and helping you to develop and improve. This tennis one is no different.
The interface is a bit "clunky" to start, you have to click and hope a few times, the documentation is not ideal. Once you have it sorted out, its fantastic.

This will help you learn - especially if you dont have a trainer to help, it will help you improve your game measurably.
If you want to move up the ranks, let this help you!

title: beautifully constructed, built to last
text:
I am very impressed with this Punching bag. Its solid - its a rock... only, its a rock you can punch! The image does not do it justice, I was expecting something smaller - I knew it was 65 lbs, but did not realize just how physically big that would be.
The chains are solid.
The leather around the bag is soft, with good, solid stitching holding the panels together.
This is so nice, its a shame to hit it.
But hitting it reveals all that it is. The bag is so firm, it absorbs the hit nicely. The weight keeps it in place, ready for the next strike.

Its going to last a long time, and take a lot of kicks.

title: Fun family games - a huge amount of different games to keep you all coming back for more!
text:
This is a great game! Darts, with no holes in your walls! Perfect! A computer that scores, and teaches you new games! Perfect.
I dont like how there is no template for wall mounting it - it wasnt too much hassle to measure the holes and draw it up correctly on the wall, but a template would have made that easier/
I dont like that it needs plugging in - why cant it do both? Run off a plug or batteries? Give me the choice?
I love that there is storage for the darts and the spares on the board itself
I dont like the lack of volume control
I do like the games! Great fun for all the family!

title: Awesome glass water bottle!
text: This water bottle is awesome! The glass is thick and sturdy. The silicone sleeve is not removable, I like that I can't get anything between the silicone and the glass bottle. It washed very well in the dishwasher. Unlike my last glass water bottle, I can fit a normal sized ice cube through the top. The two draw backs I have with this bottle is that it's heavier than my last bottle and it won't fit in smaller car cup holders.

title: Great fun for all!
text: What a fun game for the whole family, especially the tween set! It's great to find toys that won't end up laying all over the house, an having this secured to the back of a door keeps that from happening, as long as they store the little baseballs in the pouch! The electronic scoring just makes it more fun, too!

title: Great Stability cushion!
text: This is a pretty good stability cushion for the price point! I would love to have a better idea of how much to fill it, and maybe a list of a few exercises, but if you're a lot more familiar with these, you may not need either. It's a sturdy, durable material, and the pump is compact for storage. I would recommend this for everyone, especially if you're getting older and need to work on balance. Actually great for anyone to practice balance, too!

title: Excellent multi purpose tool
text:
I love this!
So, dont let the main picture fool you, the blade is kept in the handle. Which makes it much more useful!
You have an axe for cutting down/ breaking up kindling. A hammer for driving in tent stakes and a saw, for getting more firewood,
Its light, yet very strong. And so clever, the top and under side of the axe blade are the saw handle! The axe/hammer handle also holds the blade.
The Saw blade is a very serious blade! attaching it to the handles is slightly involved, but well worth the effort.

title: Wrestling fun! Lets Get Ready To,..  Play!
text:
This Lights up to set the mood! there is a desk with two chairs - that are just begging to be used inside the ring as weapons!
The main event though, is the ring. And its awesome! great for re-enacting classic fight scenes, or playing it out how it should have happened!
Because the lights are all LED, the battery will last a very long time, even if tit gets left on over night once in a while!

title: The bag just wont survive! Great gloves!
text:
Very comfortable. a good weight with a lot of padding.
The thumb is comfier than some other gloves I have worn, and the velcro straps are very easy to operate after the 1st glove is on.
A good pair of training gloves.

title: OK shirts - run small
text: These are about 1 size small, and meant to be form-fitting, not loose. They wash well, didn't shrink, and feel comfy. The front feels like patterned vinyl heat set on, which can feel a little stiff, but it's not too bad. I do prefer screen printed Ts.

title: Excellent Training Mitts
text:
Very good mitts. A nice clear round target, enough protection so you dont have to pretend that you have dust in your eye! Comfortable, and easy to wear. I have, in the past, read that something is "easy to wear" and always thought that was stupid, so allow me to expand upon that.
These slide on easily - they are not too tight. Once the 1st one is on, its easy to get the second one on, despite the handicap of wearing the first one.

When the session is over, its easy to remove the first, and subsequently the second one.

and a really hard kick, right on target, will not cause you pain!

title: Bright, comfy and visually impressive
text:
I really enjoyed using these. The white is very "loud" - in a sea of reds and blacks, the white stands out!
Loud and proud!

These are very comfortable, and the padding is good and protective.
Easy to get on and off - I like these gloves a lot.

title: Wonderful! Easiest way to store and set up a net!
text:
Excellent! I like how small this roles up, how easily it opens up. The nets grip to the table very well, and the grip is easy to use. The net stays fixed in position well.

Simply a great net, much easier to attach and use than the one that shipped with my table, but has the advantage of being able to connect to any table (or door over horses) allowing games to occur anywhere!

Very well built, I expect to be using this for many years to come.

title: Great idea, and it is fun
text:
Great idea, and it is fun! But... Franklin cut so many corners making this, it ruins it.
Problems with the game:
* Shoddy build quality, the parts do not stay together as they should. Annoying to build, and rebuild during play
* No volume control! This thing is loud! but its an indoor toy. A volume control would have made it much more enjoyable.
* No storage for the balls - a little drawer or a cover for the channel that contains them during play would have helped hugely
* Only 30 second games. Why not a range? add one minute, three minutes and five minutes!
* Poor design allows the ball to often get trapped behind the goalie
* Poor design allows the ball to easily get trapped behind the player (and with only 30 seconds to play, these two issues can be real game spoilers)
* Poor design allows you to quite often "score" even though the ball did not score, it bounced of the goalie and jumped the side rail/

If you can put up with all of that, it is a lit of fun. It is such a shame that they did not put just a little more work into it to make it a great game.

title: Amazing idea. Awful build
text:
Great idea, and it is fun! But... Franklin cut so many corners making this, it ruins it.
Problems with the game:
* Shoddy build quality, the parts do not stay together as they should. Annoying to build, and rebuild during play
* No volume control! This thing is loud! but its an indoor toy. A volume control would have made it much more enjoyable.
* Two points for a goal. What?
* No storage for the balls - a little drawer or a cover for the channel that contains them during play would have helped hugely
* Only 30 second games. Why not a range? add one minute, three minutes and five minutes!
* Poor design allows the ball to often get trapped behind the goalie
* Poor design allows the ball to easily get trapped behind the player (and with only 30 seconds to play, these two issues can be real game spoilers)
* Poor design allows you to quite often "score" even though the ball did not score, it bounced of the goalie and jumped the side rail/

If you can put up with all of that, it is a lit of fun. It is such a shame that they did not put just a little more work into it to make it a great game.

title: Great tool for practicing baseball
text:
This is a fun tool. It can do one of two things, it can be a batting tee - which, whilst it does it well, the construct is a tad tacky - the head on the base that holds the ball is openly marked as heat shrink tape, and whilst I have no problem with that being the item used to build it, I expect to not see the ingredients list on a quality item. I also worry about the heat tape being affected if the unit is left in a vehicle on a hot day (a very likely situation).
The soft toss feature is excellent. You set some balls on the top of the unit, switch it on, then every 6 to 10 seconds (depending on the setting) another ball is launched, gently.
I really like this - you can practice alone, easily set it up time and again. The height at which the ball is launched from is easily adjustable to a huge range of heights.
The tripod base is very stable. It is all put together quite superbly. A great device for practicing!

title: Great table, AWESOME game!. Shame you have put battereis in something that you plug in
text:
Mostly this is excellent, but it could have been so much more!

Putting this together is easy enough, nicer to have two pairs of hands on the job, no problem with only one. Then you get to use it. Lets start with whats right.
You plug it in, pop up the score board, switch it all on and you are off! The sound effects really help, the fun is fast and furious, the game play is great. It senses goals well, had no false goals or missed ones - just perfect.

What really lets this down is the power. The line to an outlet has a little inline rotating switch (like you get on cheap light fittings) just hanging below the table so you have to scramble on the floor to start and stop the fan.
The gaming computer runs on batteries! The batteries go to a plug on the computer! How stupid is that?
There should be a toggle switch on the underside of the table. That should power the fan, AND a 3.5 v power pack for the computer. For the price, it is insane that it does not have this, and I would see that as a deal breaker. I dont want to have to get on my back, underneath the table, unscrewing the battery case and replacing the batteries once every few months. I am modifying mine to work of one simple switch. That is how it should have shipped.

title: A great way to get out on the water - portable, strong, easy to use.
text:
Surprisingly big - its fairly small in the back pack, but as you inflate it you realize its big and amazingly strong. It does not feel like its inflatable, it feels like a solid piece.

The backpack contains the paddle board, the other bag contains everything else - the fin, the oar (in three easy to snap together pieces) a bright orange water-proof container to store your phone and other goodies and the pump. Its a big pump. The insturctions say 20 minutes to pump it - I did it in about 8, without really pushing. I bet many can do it in under 5!.
This is a lot of fun!
I like how stable it is in the water, how easy it is to clean off.
I dont like how two of the three fins are permenantly attached and protected with styrofoam and packing tape! I appreciate that is for shipping, but it would be nice to have something to cover them and protect them and the board.
I love how easy it is to deflate, roll and put back in the back-pack. Some things just do not want to go back in their container - this did, easily! A one person job, no problem.

Fun on the water, its a wonderful thing!

title: Comfy, easy to put on and take off, good protection
text:
Comfy, well padded - easy to lace, very adjustable, will cover a diverse range of head sizes.
Good padding - gives excellent protection.

title: Well made, comfortable.
text:
Beautiful gloves! Comfortable, solid, well padded.
I am a novice to this sport, so I fear I am missing some of the finer details but these were easy to put on and remove - some (I find) are hard to put on or remove once you have the 1st one on (I told you I was a novice!) (easy to grab Velcro straps)
The stitching is firm, they are made very well - very "solid".
Leather, always good!
and so comfortable. I guess that's not too important, but I like it!

title: Strong, quality product
text:
My Franklin Goal is well built, but one does worry about the replacement parts. My cynical side knows its more (short term) profitable to sell lots of lower quality nets than fewer high quality nets.
I had no cause for concern. This net is high quality, strong, with some give to it, easy to install.

I love how fast changing the net is.
I love that it will be a good long while before this one needs replacing.

title: fun for all, minimal damage from wayward swings
text:
Leight weight and very spongy. The sponge will protect against an accidental ding, be it to a car or a play mate, but this has a solid core, you can still do damage with it.
I like the weight and balance of the bat.
I love the size and color of the ball, it's easy to find even if I didn't more the lawn yet!
Strong, sturdy and tons of fun.

title: Shine and protect any fiberglass, painted surface, or metal!
text: This works great & exactly as stated - Fiberglass protectant and paint sealer. It helped us bring an old canoe back to life! Since it says it can be used on painted surfaces and metal, we decided to try it out in small concealed places on our car. It works great! SO now our car is shiny and protected, too! This stuff really goes a long way, too!

title: Amazing backpack - nothing is missing!
text:
Wow, who knew so much could go into a back pack!
It is comfortable, very well balanced on wide, padded straps (and the padding is very secure, no sliding and getting burns from the strapping)
With easy to reach bits to hold drinks, devices and energy bars nothing was missed.
Its fully waterproof. the top can easily be converted to a sling pack - and it clips back into the correct place easily.

Honestly if I detailed all the things this does, it would be a 10 page review! Suffice to say this was clearly designed by experienced back packers and engineers. It all makes sense - we hardly glanced at the instructions. If you are serious about your backpacking you need the right tools. This is the right tool.

title: Good protection for yor hands when lifting. A nice, simple idea.
text:
Neat idea, I was excited to get this, but...
I am a big guy - 6 ft 6, big hands. I found I could not get the fit perfect on these, the wrist wrap was very comfortable, but the hook needed to travel down another 1/4 inch so my hand could qwrap around the outside of it. As such, my fingers were always straining, and that did impede my lifting slightly.

Yet, even with that handicap, it certainly helped, changed some angles, and tool the strain off my hands. Worthwhile, and either I need to wear it better, or they need to offer another size.

title: Great quality Training Gloves
text: I've only recently gotten into using a punching bag as part of my workout routine. Since I don't have much to compare them to, I'll just talk about their quality. These are very well made gloves. They are stitched well and fit very comfortably. My husband is a large frame (6'6" tall) and these even comfortably fit his large hands.

title: Solid, well finished, instructions not so great.
text:
When its built, this is excellent - strong, sturdy and stable. Building it is not too hard, despite the instructions. Which appear to have come from a different device.
Once you realize that you have to take some of the steps with a grain of salt, it starts coming together. Build time was about an hour.
The angle of the backboard and the height of the pole are all easily adjustable.

If you need a free standing hoop, this is an excellent choice. The wheels in the base make it easy to move, even after it has been filled with water. All the pieces are well finished, no gaps for rust to come in through.

title: Great quality punch pad mitts
text: These are quality, well-made training mitts, with a natural grip that even fits my 6'6" husband's large hands comfortably. They are very durable, and made with strong materials.

title: Great lightweight air pad
text: We were really impressed with the quality of this self-inflating mattress for the price! It's strong and sturdy, inflates and deflates quickly and stores in a little bag. I am not much of a camper, but we have visiting family a lot and like to make things as comfortable as possible. This is much better then a sleeping bag on the floor. We have more on our wish list, and keep this one stored in a front closet with emergency suppliesin case of the need to evacuate. (We're in a flood zone) I'll definitely recommend this item.

title: Great racket!
text: Very nice racket, lovely grip on it, Everything about it says quality - from teh grip to the strings to e materials - its beautiful. very light so a writs snap wont snap your wrist! Strong, sturdy with a nice clean look.

title: No ice? No problem...
text: If you're in a location that doesn't have ice rinks, but your kids love hockey, this is for you! It's no where near professional quality, but kids don't need the best if they're just using this for afternoon play in the driveway. Don't expect it to last very long, regardless. It'll take rough play, but only so much! Once it hits a hard wall, it's a goner!

title: Easy to use, easy to redecorate for artists, good and functional.
text:
Its big, has a nice opening on top, spill proof, keeps things cold (very cold!).
For the artists looking for flasks to decorate - this is perfect - there is a very small amount of vinyl on the front at the bottom (product name) that can be removed - the rest is already clear, with a light brushed finish.

It is light weight, comfortable to carry even when full, and easy to drink from - that is to say, it doesnt slip in your hands, and holding the cap release is easy to do.

title: Great tool, no insytructions.
text:
This is a complex piece - the paddle has many holes it it, some for resistance, and some for connecting the straps to. But there is no manual, no photos - not on the container, not inside the container, not on the website. So working it out is tricky. Loot at the picture of the two next to each other - looking at my hand shapes, I would say the left one is on the right, and the right is on the left. But am I right? I spent a while trying them, to get the feel, and I am not certain that i was using them correctly.

That said, the concept is good, and they do help you to hold your hand in the optimal position (or think you do, see point above) Easy to adjust straps lock firmly in place,

If you know how to set them and wear them, then these are great 0 if not, then you will need to spend some time trying them in different configurations before you really get to use . With documentation these would have probably got a 5 star review

title: This will take a beating - a great stick!
text:
This is well made, light weight and solid. I read a review saying how the labels just fell away as the package opened.
I can only think it was a defective unit, because this one did not do anything like that - its solid and takes a bashing. I expected there to be weakness on the scoop, but resting the toe and heel on the street, and pushing hard against the heel showed what one would hope for - some flexibility and a lot of strength.

title: great for going downhill. Not so great for stopping at the bottom
text:
Parts of this review may be unfair - lets start there.
I reviewed this. All 240 lbs of me. The breaks did not work. I am thinking maybe they were not made to stop someone weight 250 lbs! In which case, the rating goes up. However, once I finished I held the brake with one hand and turned the wheels with the other - it waqsnt too easy, but the break was not great.

On the flat, this is dull. On a hill its scary - especially without brakes! You are very low to the ground. The wheels are small - this means hitting pebbles, cracks in the street etc will bounce you all over the place.

I saw another review lament about the parts not fitting together - that cheered me up, I thought I was doing something wrong! I was unable to get the parts to join seamlessly.
And the safety flag? I know that in my youth that would have been lost in the 1st 2 hours playing with this. It really should lock into place.

Drifting is sort of fun, but not for long. You need to be on a hill going down to get the most out of it, which is limiting and carrying it back up the hill is going to get old.

I would be extremely concerned about the safety of a child on this, and would be concerned about how much play would come from it - the small wheels really do limit it.

title: Safely tow two little ones and groceries!
text:
This is amazing - its light, it folds down to a very small size, it has cup holders for the kiddies, and a "trunk" to hold 2 full shopping bags! there is a waterproof clear screen to keep the tykes dry - remove that, and there is a mesh screen to protect them from flying debris.
There is only one issue, and it would be a bigger issue if it wasn't there! The folding areas have to lock into place. the clips that hold them in are very tight, and not easy to undo. If they were easy to undo, that would be worrying, as they are not easy to undo, it can be frustrating!

To fold it as flat as possible, you take the wheels off and stow them in the seating area inside. So, if you know you need to do that, it would be prudent to carry bags to wrap them in, as they will get dirty as you ride.

I was impressed with how easily it attached to a bicycle. I was more impressed with how light it is, and how strong it is. A marvelous piece of engineering.

title: Not even close to competitive size, cheaply made
text: These bean bags just aren't right at all. First of all, the standard size should be 6x6, and filled with 14 - 16 oz. These are nowhere near that size. They are 3.75" square, and weigh under 3.5 oz. Next, the quality of these are terrible! They are cheaply made, and barely stitched well enough to hold the beans in. And they feel weird - like there's some plastic sheeting inside the bag besides the plastic and gravel. Official bags should be filled with corn! I wouldn't even allow kids to use these because they completely lack durability. Franklin used to be known for quality, but not any longer.

title: Great goal!
text: Great soccer goal made with a powder coated steel frame and very strong, sturdy net. Sets up and takes down easily, and takes a lot of kid powered abuse! Sized for littles, so if your kids are bigger, you'll want to go for a bigger net.

title: Very fun LED Birdies!
text: These are a lot of fun! I really like that the LEDs correspond with the color of the birdie. To turn on the LED, you click it on in the inside. For a birdie, they're pretty sturdy. I like that they light up so you can play at night.

title: Great for street hockey, too!
text: This very sturdy net was easy and quick to set up. Works great on any surface - in our part of the PNW, it's concrete! Regulation size, and has a super strong net. Easy to move from street/drive to the garage. The bonus shooting board makes it easy to to practice on non-ice surfaces. Loads of outdoor fun for the sporty kids in your life!

title: Comfortable boots!!
text: These boots are comfortable but stylish as well! You can fold down the top which has a pretty floral inside, although I found it tricky to fold down.  When I took them out the box, it looked like there was a light coat of condensation over the boots, but it must be some kind of protective coating they put on them. I don't often fish, but they're great for pressure washing and walking in the rain or snow. I normally wear a shoe size 7.5 to 8 but the 9 fit perfectly.

title: Excellent goal, easy to set up and take down, great fun to play with.
text:
Easy to set up and take down. Its a shame it didnt come with a sized bag to carry it in, this is something you will want to add to it. other than that, its great. more accurate than cones! No dispute as to did go inside or outside, and it makes the game feel more, err, professional - real.
Very good. solid, the parts clip together well and unclip equally well.

title: Fantastic, strong, but limited usage.
text:
This is a very solid piece of equipment. Building it is indeed quite a workout on its own. When done, this is not a mobile device - it is very weighty. Its also solid - as I lift my 260lb frame there is no wobble as I lift and lower.
The arm and back padding are very comfortable and the frame supports at the bottom are great steps up for those who are less vertically endowed

An excellent piece of equipment but limited usage and it has a large foot print. Still a great tool

title: Great quality snorkel vest
text: This is a great quality, well-made snorkel vest. I found it easy to inflate with just a few puffs, and the long stem allows it to be inflated while in the water. Has an attached whistle for added safety. The straps are easily adjustable, and you can do it yourself without the aid of another person. It can easily pack flat in a suitcase for travel.

title: Great balls of. err, great balls!
text: Not too much one can say about this. Its a ball. Its round. Its seems strong, and it bounces well. It brings smiles, and fun.

title: Five Stars
text: simply great - nice weight, strong, fly straight. What more could you want from a shuttlecock??

title: Cute and useful!
text: What a fun gift for the golf/Boston Terrier enthusiast! These plush club covers are both functional and adorable.e! They are very well-made and strong. They're not a perfect fit, but if you know someone who sews, a little elastic on the inside can help a lot.

title: Excellent game - lots of fun, you won't want to put it away!
text:
This is a wonderful game! Fun for the whole family, its got us away from our phones, and throwing balls through hoops. Which is not as easy as it first sounds.
After opening the box, it took about three hours to put it all together - when done, its wonderful. The computer in my one didn't work, which is great - it gives s reviewers a chance to find out what the technical support is like. And the technical support was wonderful. Quickly and easily the matter was resolved, a new scoreboard was sent to me, and all the details so I can return the old one.

This thing is big! Even folded up it has quite a big footprint. When you unfold it, lock the wheels, switch it on and grab the remote, the games begin.

text: Stuck in quarantine and not able to go to the gym, I bought some resistance bands to keep from going crazy. title: Quarantine Life Saver
text:
I wanted to wait until I had some time to use these and now I can say that I am so happy I bought these back in March. If you're stuck at home and need to workout these are great. The bands are versatile that you can workout almost every major muscle group you'd hit at the gym. I was a little concerned that after 2-3 months of daily use the bands would snap or be stretched out too much but so far they're still working great. And really resistance wise you can combine bands to increase resistance enough that you can feel like you've gotten a good pump. It takes a bit getting used to if you miss your freeweights or machines but after months of home workouts I have to admit I've gotten great results maintaining my gains from the gym.

From opening the box, you get a lot for your money; this is a great value and a godsend for those who are out of the gym and have to rely on homeworkouts. My only complaint is the door anchor can make certain workouts awkward, but that's really just down to whatever kind of doors you have in your home. Depending on our set up you may want to get 2 anchors or maybe one of those anchors that wrap around the whole door and have multiple loops and anchor points but that's really just up to you.

Overall this a great product and I would recommend it as an investment for homeworkouts. I don't know how I would have survived quarantine this long without them.

Update: I wanted to provide some more information. After 6 months of almost daily use, one the bands finally snapped. Obviously not a big deal; I certainly was happy and got my money's worth. The bands were certainly durable and allowed me to stay in shape. I was ready to buy a new replacement set but I asked Whatafit if by some chance there was some warranty on the band. They sent me a whole replacement set! No problem no fighting, just sent them a pic of the broken band and they were on it. I can't say enough how good this product and this company is. I have totally changed my opinion on the value of bands for working out and I would definitely buy from this company. 5 stars .

title: Not too bad, but be aware…
text:
For what they are, they actually do pretty well. I bought them for my semi-annual trout trip. Keep in mind, folks, definitely NOT lined, so if you’re looking for a warm pair, keep looking. If you’re not a wimp and don’t mind a few layers underneath, then these aren’t bad.

My only issue is that I discovered a few leaks in them near the boots after my first couple of hours using them. It lead me to believe they probably had this problem right out of the packaging. Now, in the grand scheme, I only trout fish a couple times a year, and for how miniscule the leaks were, I sucked it up and just used them for the 2.5 days I needed them. Never got so bad that water was pooling up inside of them, but enough to soak my leg from the top of the boot down. I’d guess that it was coming in at the seam where the leg and boot met. Definitely could have been worse, but that was still a big inconvenience for me. I’m not sure how to contact the seller, because I’d like to possibly get a replacement pair. I’m hoping they see this review and can contact me.

All in all, aside from that leaking issue, the next couple days they held up against me kneeling on rocks/logs to retie and they were pretty comfy after wearing them for several hours. I’d recommend taking them somewhere for 30 mins to an hour and wearing them in water before taking them on a 4 hour trip like me and getting surprised. 4/5 stars due to the small leaks. If the seller holds true to the other reviews I’ve seen, and can make it right, I’d say these are 5/5 stars for sure. title: Piddle Sticks
text:
First, it must be known that the EcoZoom Versa Camping Stove, in our case today, with our first go isn't as handy as using the kitchen stove. Said stove which still works at this junction is less than 15 feet as the crow flies from the EcoZoom Versa Camping Stove which I set up beside the BBQ grill so as to have a place to set stuff.

We cooked hamburgers, hash brown and pork and beans on the thing awhile ago on a cast iron skillet. Good gracious! I mean a mere piddly handful of twigs cooked the whole meal! It's insane, really. Tell you what...when these things first got popular about 10 years ago I took a look, called it nonsense and never looked back. And then, well, things changed. Our EcoZoom Versa Camping Stove is rightfully the backup for the backup. A real 'just in case' thing. However, were I in it just for fun I could prolly think up a dozen reasons to have one for outdoor fun. But I'm not funning here. I'm very serious. Times are serious.

Not being a metal worker or a brick layer I turned to this device which in all of its simplicity has struck just the right note. It is a little smoky to start, but as it heats up there is very little, just like everyone says. It cooks pretty hot to begin, but by jiggling the sticks we got pretty decent heat control. Smaller sticks for a burst of hot, etc. The next morning I wiped off the outside and spritzed the top and grate with a little spray olive oil as a protectant. I'd estimate that one 5 gal bucket of yard sticks will yield 4-5 complete meals such as I described above.

I'm as pleased as punch, and not a little amazed. What pushed me over was a couple of vids done by EcoZoom Versa Camping Stove's biggest fan in England on YT. In answer to my question he advised that he's had his for over 6 years and uses it regularly. Simple, light weight, and it lasts. If you're circling like I did, go ahead and land on it. You'll be thankin' me. Guaranteed.

Lastly a pro tip. If you are unaccustomed to cooking over wood just be advised to scrub the outside and bottom of your cookware as well as you do the inside. It will get smoky.

title: Been looking forward to this review
text:
[[VIDEOID:4e0b9184b5c9003d3a336d7a4e1f708a]] UPDATE: Below I said I might add corn pictures. Well, I did. I set the camera up on my garden 80 days or so ago from the time of this writing not knowing what I'd get or if I'd get. I learned that the cam saves a video each day averaging around 400 megs. 75 videos and I was out of space, just 4 or 5 days before I was going to take the cam down anyway. I just uploaded my two months in two minutes thirty video. I had the cam set to snap a few frames every 10 minutes. If I had it to over again I would have gone for a half hour. Mebbe and hour between runs. You can judge for yourself. This is a heck of a cam for the dough! Thanks, whoever made this thing. Ya done good!

Let's get the one thing I don't like out of the way. The micro SD card. But, looks like all the cams are going to them so it is what it is. Just be darn careful when removing in the woods. I immediately stash mine in one of those full size adapter sleeves before I put them into a sandwich bag to bring home.

The GREAT part. I have a couple of late model trail cams plus a couple of vintage Tascos. I can tell you with no fear of contradiction my new Trail Camera 4K 32MP, Wildlife Camera has the best video definition of all of them. I was astounded, really. Then, the ad blurb promises that the little SD card is included. Well, I've heard that one before so I wasn't surprised when it wasn't in the box. But I was fooled. It was already in the camera! That was a bonus! Another unexpected bonus was the well written instruction booklet in perfect English, not engrish.

Listen, when you open the case for the first time you'll appreciate that it's a pro camera. The design is pretty much like all of them as for controls but the unit looks and feels more deluxe. It's got a newer spiffier look to it. The software in my other two late models is pretty much the same. The setup screen in my Trail Camera 4K 32MP, Wildlife Camera is different, and better, newer.

I haven't had a chance to move it to the woods yet so for the test I attached it to a pecan tree about 30 yards behind the house. The house takes up nearly all of the frame. Well, out of the box as for sensitivity it defaults to medium. Comes in low to high. Well, set on medium the thing took photos about every two minutes. I finally noticed that every time a car would come by it would snap. The road is at least 100 feet away from the camera and one side of the frame you can't even see it. (The side motion sensors can see it though.) Insane sensitivity. I set it down to low and it's perfect. Got great sound too and the time/temp etc readout at the bottom is excellent.

I could go on but I see most others are reporting out great results as well. For your money you can't do better. I highly recommend this trail cam!
PS.... I intend to stash this thing in my garden this spring to use it for time lapse. Mebbe I'll post my corn coming up this summer! A grand bonus with this cam! This is the one you have been looking for, and PS, remember for my first test it kept popping movies until I adjusted the sensitivity? It filled up the 32G card in about 4 days. NO noticeable drain of the batteries. I'm confident this thing will last a long time posted on a lonely tree. Big time!

And PS... Of great importance. How many times have you seen your photo subject look into the camera of an evening with what you're using now? As someone else noted at night there are no lights. Zip. Nada. True infrared. No sound from the unit either. Super stealth!

title: Easy to install...if...
text:
This kit is dog easy the second time around. Unfortunately the second time may be decades away. Hopefully.
I faithfully disassembled my pump from my 45 year old Coleman stove (Bless em! Most of the guys who built the thing are no doubt long gone to their various rewards)....but anyway, I elected to rebuild the old pump which was a mistake. The new cup is designed for the new rod. It does not work on the old one.
On the old rod there is a metal stop that holds the cup. The new cup is different. If you have a super oldie like mine you will take the metal retaining clip off the new pump with needle nosed pliars. Wiggle under the metal clip and wiggle it off. Slide everything off. Put the round metal ring thingy which holds it to the tank on, then the spring. Follow with the NYLON stop ring. Then put the cup on top of that followed by the new round metal spring clip, or the old. That much is the same.
Put it back in the unit. I started it at the bottom and chased it around with my thumbnail until all of the cup was in....then shoved it home. Some people might have elected to put a bit of grease on the cup before installation but I chose the venerable 3-1 oil before...and after.
After all that it worked like a charm. It's quick and simple if you do it right.

title: You'll grow to love it
text:
Last week my former cooler without the Ozark Trail logo, but which was actually an Ozark Trail unfortunately met a tragic demise, being dragged behind Bubba the 4 wheeler. Operator error, actually. But I didn't come here to assess blame. No. I came here to praise the Ozark Trail 12 Can Expandable Top Soft-sided Cooler.
I had had the previous cooler for years and years and years. Could not tear it up. Took Bubba to do that. So within an hour of burying the last one I came here to see if the thing still existed. I found many similar coolers, the most expensive costing $300. At that price it should have come with a complimentary built in solar refrigerator. Alas, it did not. Just an ordinary cooler with a very recognizable trendy logo.
After a time I saw that indeed the son of my cooler DID exist in the form of the Ozark Trail 12 Can Expandable Top Soft-sided Cooler. I pounced.
This early morning before daylight (late summer) it sits just beyond this room stuffed with ice and water for another excursion to the jungles, less Bubba this time. To practicalities: I don't do cans. I do bottled water. It will hold 4 28oz bottles and still have enough room to ice it all down very well indeed. It's sort of like one of those motel ice buckets with a soft cover around it. The ice will last all day, out of the sun. There is indeed a front pouch, which will hold a couple of sammiges, etc. The top comfortably holds a lunch bag and will keep it semi-cold. As you no doubt noted in the sparse description provided above, there is a middle zipper so that the whole top can be expanded a notch if you have more than one sammige. You won't find this on any other cooler, and this alone makes it a wise purchase.
The Ozark Trail 12 Can Expandable Top Soft-sided Cooler is about the cheapest one around...(Even the sales pitch above is sort of take it or leave it cheap) and the most versatile. You can't kill the thing unless you drag it behind an ATV, car, or possibly a boat. Unless you demand Goochie Brand sneakers to go to the opera, you'll be more than pleased with this excellent cooler. Fact. And yes, I have seen the crappy reviews. I have no idea.
I got mine. Get yours. But don't get the last one. Bubba stays hungry.

title: Phenomenal View!
text:
First, this is most important to understand. FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS or you will have hell to pay setting up unless you are very lucky. If you already have a blind you know how vicious they can be to get up. Or mebbe it's just me. Ha. The instructions say clearly to pop the top first. You MUST identify the top. My top pull loop now has a brightly colored piece of cloth on it. Pop the top first and then pop pop pop, it's up in under 45 seconds. Get that right or suffer.
Now for the great part. The view from inside is absolutely phenomenal. From a lawn chair I had a panoramic view unequaled. AND at the RIGHT height. And from the outside you can't see a doggone thing. Lots of room for one, enough for two. From the inside a clear view all around and even a little flap in the back. On those three sides it's made so you can stick a barrel or an arrow out easily. No shooting through the webbing.
I'll tell you one thing it didn't have. No pinholes in the roof like my other one. It's solid. I don't know how much protection it will be in a driving rain, but straight down, it's not going to leak.
If you're new to popup blinds you can pretty much discard the tie down stakes. You'll end up getting something more substantial to peg it but that goes for all popups that I'm aware of. A friend put me onto the perfect cheap solution. Nail spikes. (Really big nails.) You can get them at most any hardware store.I selected the 10 inchers.
Especially if you have hunted pop up blinds before the Primal Treestands Wraith 270 Deluxe Blind is going to blow you away. A VERY well thought out system. I very much recommend this one.
And PS...take down was a complete snap. Top down, pop pop pop. It did kinda take two to get it back in the bag...me to give it the old bear hug while the other slipped the bag up. It's a good piece of equipment!
